yid dag 'gro ba'i mdzisapa la ni/ /'dod chags 'khrug par byed/ /hūṃri bong 'dzin khalas zhu ste lus mchog dga' las ni rdzogs 'bar gtumamo thig le bzang po 'dzag /ā+oṃ ḍa spyan drangs byas te khu ba'i rnam grangs thar pa'i thig le gsum mthar bde ba yeshesathig le mchog gi bde ba lhan skyes ster/ /dga' ba de bas dga' ba'i phyag rgya dga' ba'i dbye ba sogs kyis lta dang reg pa thogs 'gyur bde lha'i 'khrig pa bzhin du 'di dag khu ba ang ga ste yan lag 'go/ /dang po kasam) mi rnams mig gis bltas pas kyang ni 'dod pa'i ni dga' ba byed/ /phyi nas rdzogs pa'i sbyor yang las ni rang gi lus yinadra la la mchog gi dga' ba nyid/ /'bar ba'i thig le 'dzag la dga' bas rdo rje pad+mar bral ba'i dga' ba'o/ /thig le gsum gyimathar zad par son pa lhan cig skyes dga' ste stong pa khu ba ste bde ba rdo rje o das byed/ /dga' ba bcu drug ni dga' ba'i dga' ba/ mchog dga'i dga' ba/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ dga' ba'i mchog dga'/mchog dga'i mchog dga'/ bral dga'i mchog dga'/ mchog dga'i lhan skyes pa ste/ dga' bral dang lhan skyes pa la de bzhin no/ /de ltar na lta ba dang reg pa la sogs kyi dga' ba bzhi ste/ de nyid 'dus pa lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes kyi phye na dga' ba bcu drug tu 'gyur ro/ /sku dga' 'dod dang gsungadaga' dga' ba thugs dga' 'dar dang yeshesadaga' mi 'gyur ba ste sbyor ba bzhi po de ni dga' ba tsam du phyogs gcig /rdzogs kalus kyi mchog dga' dang nus pa ngaye shes mchog dga' dang ni skyed gsems kyi mchog dga' dang mchog khadagar 'gyur ba yang gsung gi mchog dga' ba bzhi mchog dga' rnams phyogs gcig tu byas pa ni ①gnyis pa'o/ phyogs dga' bzhi ste phyogs gcig byas pa/ /'a bzag kasku bral dga' dang thig le ngadang ni brgyal gathugs bral dga' dang dga' bral khagasung bral dga' yang ste gsum 2)na bzhi gcig tu bgrangs pas co / /lhag ①sha cad da lus lhan skyes ye shes lhan skyes gnyis sems kyi lhan cig skyes pa sku bral dga' ste lhan cig skre)sa ngag gi lhan skyes dgar 'a byu/ra bkyangang dga' ba bzhi'i lhan skyes 42—556

rnams phyogs gcig tu byas pa na 'di lnga zag bstu/ pa'o/bzhi gcig tu bgrangs pa/ /dga' ba byed pa'i gzhi byed pas sa'i khams mngal gyi gnas cing sha nye ba ste sdud pas bcu/ sems kyi las rgya'i rnam par dag pa ngasab chab pas gam rung 'gyur reg dang 'khyud pa yis ni sring mo'okha/ /rdo rje zhugs khan bu mo yin te snying rje dang bcas dga' bas yon tan 'dzin pas te dga' ba smin par byed pas/dga' ba 'phel ba ste 'phel bas rlung gi khams 65 cesashes/ /:sgob/ mkhye lhung ba'i gnas yin pa ste thig le stong par byed pas nam mkha'i khams/ lhung na chung ma yin te rnal 'byor ma ni chags bral chagazhan gyi rigs reg par mi 'dod pa ste rigs ngan mo/ /sa kachu khame garlung ngamakha' caste chad pa'i dngos po 'di drug rnal 'byor phyag rgya'o/ /pad+mar rdo rje zhugs dang nges don rdo rje langs pa me dang rlung la thig le drang don rdo rje zhugs drod skyes pa thig le 'dzag pa gsum rim ①bzhin 1nga / /sku gsung thugs kyi gtum mo'i me la srog ste rlung zhugs pas rang bzhin gyi drod skyes pas rdo rje langs pa sku'i phyag rgya des rlung dkus mar zhugs pa gsung gi phyag rgya des thig le gyen du 'phang ba thugs kyi phyag rgya ste des nges don drang don gyi snya gar rdo rje lhung ba sku gtum mo 'bar ba gsung thig le lhung ba thugs byu/ga rgya nges par rnal 'dre/zab gsum pa'i 'di dag rnams la bstan/ /kachags dang khubaphabapa ma phab chags khamed khu ba 'pho ba thog kamatha' khamachog gi de gnyis ka ma yin pa de phab la ma pho ba dga' ster rnal 'byor pas—/ /sku'i rgyal/ stong nyid snying rje bsngo/da pa yan lag drug gis baḥ/ ni sku gsung thugs byu/ga rgyalnga/ yum ye shes mchog rnam bcur rtagasabacu pa dang 'gyur rnams 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal/ /de yan chad dbang ba ta la zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten pa'i byis pa gzhug pa kun rdzob kyi dbang bdun pa bstenaganas lta bu dang gsum pa ste rnam pa bcu'o/ /bzhi pa slar yang de bzhin te gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni rdorjepad+ma gtad pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsum par mi 'gyur te/ bzhi pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni 42—557

mi 'gyur ba'i bde shes rab ye shes rtag bcu pa ste 'di gnyis gnyis su med pa'o yin te slar yang de bzhin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das nya la sa la nas kyisalong dang 'das pa'i don gsungs pa/ bumapa'i dbangashes rab nu ma gang la reg ste gzhan ni dge bsnyen lta bu gsang ba'i dbang bdud rtsi thabasakyi myong dang rnam par shes rab kyi bha ga la lta ba gang //shes rab phrad las slobamadage tshul lta bu skad cig bzhi par bdud rtsi dga' ba bcu drug rtogs so zer ste byang chub sems shesarab ye shes zhu gang / /de dag thams cad 'jig rten par nges snying rje mchog gis lam gyi rgyu ru bstan dperu zer/ /rgyal ba mchog gi bdag po byu/ga rgya mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya chen mo gnas skabs bcu pa bzang po phrad pa gang ni 'jig rten las 'das dbang / /sems ni dri ma dang bcas par 'gyur 'a/sa spyo/ byu/ga rgya dang brtags palnga/ lha'i sku dang thig le na da lta bu ste rang gi rtog pas btags pa yin pasaye shes phyag rgya yang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyu ru mchog gi rgyal ba skyed ma gnas skabs bcu la phyag rgya bzang mo bsgom/ /rtogasagos med mi 'gyur ba'imun marig pa kun 'joms mkha' mnyam khyab drugatshan drug la mdzad rnal 'byor gyis ni bgrod/ /lus la rang gi gnas pa'i khubaye shes kyigazi brjid tsanaḍali sred pa'i sdig 'phrog dus kyi 'khor los rig bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa dbang bzhi pa'i don sems la rangagi snang ba tsam ste rang gi yid las phyag rgya chen mo'i mtshan nyid skyesashing semasamin par me long gzugs brnyan rang gi snang bas bzhin de ltabu ste/ /rgyal ba'i sras bodeg ta rnams dang ni sangs rgyas kyis bstan rnal 'byor dbang pos bsten par sgomapar bya/ /yeshes bsten na yon tan snang ba rab tu rgyas pas bdud rlungabacupa bdud dpung yul bcas rtsam lus sreg par byed//'dod chags la sogs dga' ba bde ba yang lus la ster ste mnyam pa'i logasum zla ba phyed dang gnyis la mos zhes bya rnal 'byor pas ba losazer/ /rtags ①rnam bcur 'gyur ba'i ye 42—558

shes shesarab zer de ni sems ste de nyid 'od gsal ba la sems 'jug pa snang ba'o/ /gang zhig sgribapa'idri bral gsalabs zla 'od lta bu me long gzugs bzhin snangabasadabang 'dir 'jig rten las 'das pa nyid zhugs pa nyid/ /de nas mi 'dzag 'gags pa ste lhan cig skyes dang mi 'gyur bzhi pa dga'ab lhan skyes pa bdemanyam miganas pa'i mya ngan 'das//gang zhig 'di 'dra sangs rgyas zhal gsungs pa dang thugs ka la btang ba gnas dpal ldan bla ma gangagi 'pho ce na ste/ /nacha mkhazab kun chenas 'od gsal ba la sems 'jug pa secha sa kyis stong pa sgom pa las dbang po'i mngon sum mig mi 'dzums pas rdo rje lam la sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la bltas na mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba de'i lam la za ba /nge (1gas/ /stong pa bsgomasan du ba smig rgyu gsal ba dri ma med dang me khyer mar me nyid/ /'bar dang nyi zla rdo rje glog yang ste sgragacan mchog gi cha dang gang zhig stong pa'i ljang khu thig le mthong / /de dbus sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan shin tu yul lnga dang bralastephyiroladu du ma snang b.longs spyod ngo tshas 'chad pa yang 'od zer rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rnal 'byor rtse gcig pa yis nam ka sprin bral la ni khengs pas migalta bar lus drang pos bya/ /ji srid nges par yid kyi mngon sum ni dbugs ri mo nag po dri med gsal ba'i 'od zer dus kyi rtsa dbus ma rumathong chud/ /de la de'inang du thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs ni chu nang nyi ma rtog bral sna tshogs mdog /rnam pa kun ldan khadog dang dbyibs yulabral bdag gi gzung 'dzin gyi sems te gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid/ /ji srid nges par bdag gi lus la 'od kyi 'khor los yongs bskor yid 'di byung nas srog rtsol ma klod na tshangs pa'i bu ga nas shes pa 'gro dgos pa yod mthong ba/ /gzugs mthong nas ni nyin cig bzhin gyi ni dus su deyangasrog gi rlung ni dgag par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams zla ba drug gis ni bde mnyam sems te reg pa dang bral lam du 'gyur/ /chags phabapadang chags bral pho ba 42byed559

thog mtha' sogs skad cig gis ni gtso bo'i dbugs dbusam kyis grangs spel lo//ā+oṃ ḍa khuba'abar ba'i bar dang gsangabaradaga'abral lte ba nas yar log lhan cig skyes pa mgrin pa shes rab rnam shes dbus/ /gnyid dang rgyal ①ba'i dbus snying ka go rim ji bzhin pa yin pa 'di gnyis dang rdo rje pad ma gang zhig 'byor pa bde ba nyid/ /bla ma la nges stobs kyis dpral ba nas yar gyen du gnas pas sems 'di la ni 'phel bar bya ste ngo mtshar med/ /nyon mongs bdud bcas dkugs phyir rgyu ba bcom ste rgyal ba'i go 'phang dbusamar chud pa la gnas rnal 'byor lo/ /yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus de'i mtshan nyid ci zhe na sa'i rnam par snang yang pra min rlan pa chu'i sku ste gsher min chu min phyir/ /me'i rnam par snang yang me ma yin te g.yo ba rlung gi sku yang rlung ma yin/ /stong pa'i rnam par snang yang dkar sngo sna tshogs chen po mdog ste kha dog min/ /rnam pa sems can kun la yodayang mthong min rang stesems dri ma nyon mongs bdud kyi stobs kyi mthu/ /snying sgra chamatshan ma bcu yang 'di ci'i drin gyis mthong zhe na gnas 'di rnams su rlung bcings pa ste de'i mtshan nyid lu gu brgyud ltar bcings pa'i rtsa/ dpral bar gnas pa'i rtsa gsum gsum 'khor lo drug gi bar du ni g.yas g.yon du song zhing 'khor lo la 'dus par bcings/ mgrin 11ba/ 'eb dpralaskub sgo/sa lte ba rnams la sogs pa'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i go 'phang la gnas lu gu rgyud bcings rtsa/ /srog dang thur sel lam gsum rgyu'irgyud rdo rje bu rdorje pad+mar mdzes pa'i spyi bo lam du dbang dus su thabs la dril bu shes rab rdo rje dang 'bras bu bde ba dang stong pa bcas te pad ma nyid ni zla ba 'dzag par rdorjer ldan—/ /steng 'og a ba sgro tir de nyid la sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi dang srog dang thur sel gyi rjesang gnyis 'dom pa dag gi dbus su zerayul dang de'i dus na ci 'byung phyi rol gyi yul can rnams ni grong dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin de dbus su bcug na rlung dbus mar rgyud nas du ba la sogs mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnam rtog 'byung bas na yang ni thams cad gang yang 'di dag skal med byis 42—560

pa la gsang ba'o/ /abasgrotir dbus su srog sku rdo rje (1gsarlung gnyis kyi ras khrag nyi ma srang ri casang khuthabasang/thams nga/ 'ab ba/bya/sa/ la la rnal 'byor goms pa rdzogs pa rang dal la 'geg pa dang ba/pa sa dang kabadeba'aphel bas g.yon khapa bcings te rdul 'dzag par gnas/ /thig le zags pas dus de tsam na sems ni phyag rgyar rab sbyor mchog gi bde gnas kyi don du las kyi phyag rgya rdo rje sbyangs pa dag rjesadran gyi phyag rgya dang ni/ /pad+mar rdo rje'i snyoms par 'jug pa sgra 'am chu skyes pad+ma bya'i rang lag gis gsor bde don du/ /de rnams kyis kyang sa bon mi gtong bde de 'chi bas 'jigs 'joms dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal gdams ngag nyid do/ /sa ni chur 'jug chu yang me ste gsung rdo rje bsam gtan gyi skabs dbus su zhugs pas rlung rnams dag la 'jug par bya 'chi ba'i dus su 'di rnams 'gags pas ye shes kyi rlung la thim tsam na mngon shes lnga bar dor 'byung ba bzhin du sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes rnams rim gyis thim pa bsgoms pas ye shes kyi rlung la thim tsam na mtshan ma bcu pa'o/ /dpe dga' ba mi 'gyur na gzugs las rjes su chags pa'i byang chub sems zhu ba/ /(1nga ni stong pa la ste stong pa mtshan dang mtshan ma rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur/ /mi 'gyur mchog gi bde ba dus kun 'byung ste des ye shes sku la ste ye shes kyi rlung la thim nas rnams kun rab tu 'gro/ /deyisami rnams skye ba 'di la ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul gzhan don byed pa'i'agrub 'gyur mi'i bdag po kye/ /de nyid bcu drug dga' ba'i 'dod las sprul sku nges par 'byung ste dgagi dga' ba zad pa de las 'di ltar rdzogs pa dag /'bar ba'i dri med sems kyi dga' ba zad pa sems ye shes kyi dga' ba 'gags pa ni mchog gi bde byed ye shes las kyang yī ḍa dang byed do/ /dga' lus kyi mchog dga' ba zad pa las longs spyod sku ste mchog dga' ngag gi mchog dga' zad pa dga' bral bcas pa 'di bzhi 'gags pa longs sku'i gsung thugs ye shes su 'gyur ro 'a lnga/lnga( lnga/ma/ pas rus/ /ye shes kyi mchog dga' 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o ngag sems ye shes lhan cig skyes dga' nyid de bde 'byung dga' ba'i dga' ba la sogs 42—561

lus kyi dga' ba zad pa bzhi po 'di 'gags na sprul pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes su 'gyur ro 'a di 'a 'a byu/zab/ /srid gsum phyag byas chos sku mdar ba lus kyi dga' bral 'gags pa las te de las ngag 'di gsum 'gags na chos sku gsung thugs ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /ni 'byung bzab 'byu/ra ngag gi dga' bral 'gags pa/ /srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms sems kyi dga' bral 'gags pa rgyal bas nges par chos kyi sems te gnyid ①las ye shes 'di sems kyi dga' bral 'gags pa'o/ /nges par kha dog lusakyilhan skyes sku dag pa'i sku dang dbyangs gsungagi lhan skyes bral cha dang thig le 'di bzhi 'gags na ngo bo nyid sku gsung thugs ye shes su 'byur ro/ /zug 2) zirdom nga sa sgos ye shes 'pho ba 'gags na lhan skyes su 'gyur ro/ /srid gsum phabapasal gnas ngag sems ye shes rdo rje bde 'byung dag pa'i sku la'o/ /sems can la sangs dang dpral ba nas mgrin par mi lam gyi sad pa la sogs 'gags pa rang bzhin snyingakagazhan yang 'di dag gnyid dang bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ni gsang ba'i lte bar/ /lus gnas sadapa snyeba'i rgyu dbugs thim yul la spyod de mi gam balnga/ sem/sa ni mi lam gyi gnas skabs skyed pa'i rgyu gnyid 'thug po skyed pa'i rgyu ni thig le snying gar thim pa'o/—/ /skusgo sgo/sa 'ab gnas bzhi pa'i gnas skabs skyed pa'i thig le ye shes kyi 'khor lo la gnas so bud med sbyor nas skad cig kyang ni byang chub sems khu 'gyur/ /sprul pa de bzhin dag na la sogs bzhilas ni nges par rim byung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa rim pa bzhi ste dga' ba bzhi bzhi—/ /de ltar srid pa gsum nas phab pas na rnamabazhi'i nang gnas skabs sems ni kun layod pas srog chags rnams kyi thig le'i dbus phobayis so/ /bde mnyam phab la ma phon 'bras ster khyab byed drug drug sum cu drug la thar pa'i rgyu ru rnal 'byor dbang po yis ni pho babasrung bar bya/ /budadha'igo 'phang mchog sgabade rnal 'byor pa'iskye groba'i sa bon thig le bor ba'i thar pa gang layangamed do/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i skad cig pho ba rnal 'byor rnams kyis 'dir ni rnam spang bya/ /'og gnas rgyas pa da na pa ta la nas ā+oṃ.a 42byed562

hūṃ ho/ rim bzhin spyi dang khyad par du gyur pa'i nges pa'i skabs nas dang por 'dir ni rtag tu bsad dang spelabadang sbyang bar bya/ /zla ba zhu ba dam tshig can gyis mthong ba mi stong gzhan du sems kyi bya lta bu'i rim gyis chang ni skadacig gis 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /de'i snod las thig pa yis kyang zla ba'i lag pa ming med dag gis sa la lag g.yon mthil du oṃ las zla ba de dkyil cha'od 'phros 'dus sku'i de ba bsdus zhu des 'gre ni/ /phyir rolazer na zur gsum du de'i nang du nyi ma nyin mo 'byed pa dang 'dra de'i dbus su rlum por gzugasabya/ /de dbus srid gsum la gnas ye shes 'khor lo sngags pas gzugs brnyan gyis yis ni 'dir bsgom bya/ /mthe bong dang ni ming med gnyis kyis nyin dang nyin bzhin dus su dal kyi 'khor lo zil par bya/ /byebragartsa mchog yulaspyi dang grong ces pa lta bu zung tsam na rtswa mchog grong na gapa dag gnas pa dang zhes byas pas chog ma gdang zhes bya ba lta bu tshig kha yar byung na dbus ma'i tshig gi tha ma gang rung gcig por la ma ga'i grong na gang dag bdag la dang por 'dir ni gtor ma thog ma bar tha mdus gsum ming gis so/ /'phrog ma la yang changs po gnyis te gzhan yang sngags pas khro rgyal gtor ma'o/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje pho nya rnams la thog mar chags spangs sa stengs dag tu'o/ /zos pa'i lhag mas 'byung po rnams te gzhan yang dge ba'i don du sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad gdon/ /gnyid dang 'khrig padang lha la mchod pa'i dus la yan lag drug oṃ a haṃ ho he k+ṣa dang rig de kho na nyid gnas pa dang bya'o gnyis pa'i gsum dang kyisama'i yang / /gang du :/ 'grin snying ka lte gsang :/ gtsug dag la rang gi rdo rjes yan lag dgod/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ hre snying gar da yā ya dmakhabaranam/ oṃ tri si ra si mtshogasamar swāha/ā+oṃ tring si ka khaye tso gtsug phud shaṭa/ ā+oṃ s+thā ka pa tsa yan lag kun la ya hūṃ/ ā+oṃ zo ṣ+pe tā ya dmig pa ba sha ta/ skye/ hraḥyi/ sta ya phaṭa phyogs kun la ste dge ba g.yon mi dge las byed na lag pa 42—563

g.yas kyi bya'o/ /se gol 'theb 'dzub kyi bya/ da ni don dam pa'i bden pa la/ bzhi pa slar yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ bzhi pa zhes pa'itshig gis ni rgyu 'thun pa'i bzhi pa'o/ /slar yang de bzhin no zhes bya ba'i tshig gis ni shes rab ye shes de nyid de/ chos sku yin pa sems can gyi 'on kyang de ni las kyi phyag rgya shes pa ye shes kyang zer kyang dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang bral ba'o/ /rgyu 'thun pa'i phyagargyachen mo de ni bde ba'i rang mthunapa'ibazhin byis phyir dang / sku'i phyag rgya chen po yi ye shes las yang dag par byung ba'i phyir/ de'i las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes su mi 'gyur te/ de yang rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyi bud dha'i med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed dga' thigale can/ /thabs shes rab kyi yan lag med par maphabapa'i rtsi las pho ba'i'adas/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i lhan cig dga' rtsemo 'dzin—/ /zhes mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i tshig las gsungs pa'i phyir/ji ltar sems can phal pa gzhan ni thig le 'bod pa ste/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das 'di thig le 'bod pa ma yin rtsemora'adzin no/ /'on kyang dga' ba dang /bde ba'i 'khor lo nas phab pa mchog dga' dang bral dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes dpral ba rlung sogs pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'i partse mo gong bur 'dzin te/ 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i rdo rje nor bu las ma 'das phyir ro/ /de bzhin du yang / rdo rje :kha grungs sems kyis migayobs na ni/ /nor bu'i nang du chud par a ba byu tir blta stong pa'i ra sra dang ma pho ba gnyis pa la/ /bud dha rgyumathun la bde bar sogs bde ba gang / /de ni dri med bral ba dag gi spugamatha'/ /lte bar bdestong rgyu 'thun nyid du brjod/ /rnam par 'phel bas smin pa snying kar dran/ /'grin par skyes bu gsung gis chos ston pas byedapa dang / /bral ba dri med zer dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya'o spyi bor gtso bo'o/ /zhes 42byed564

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de bas na phyi'i dga' bral gyimatshan nyid 'pho ba yis ni sangs rgyas nyid ster ba ma yin te/ srid pa maphabapadang mya ngan las 'das pa phobalal/ rab tu ①gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /yang debashadapas bcom ldan 'das ni srid pa dang phabapamya ngan las 'das pa phobalas mnan pa la rab tu mi gnas pa 'pho ba med pa'i ye shes so de bshad pas srid pa bral ba skye ba'i gnas so/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni rdo rje nor bu'i 'grin pa la thig le bzhi rnams 'pho ba'o rab tu mi gnas pa ni 'phral ba nas rdo rje nor bu thug par phyir mi 'pho'o/ /de bzhin du yang phab pa thogam stong gzugs la sbyang ba dang gnyis tha ma zhi ba phobadang / /dngos kadang dngos med khazad gapa'i rtso zigale stong pa/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med pa mas phab/ /byang chub sems zhes brjod pa yin zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so de bshad pa—/ /thog ma medazhes bya ba dang tha ma ni skye ba phabapadang 'jig pa phobadang yidanibral ba'o—/ /zhi ba zhes bya ba ni dbang po'i 'gyur ba dang bral ba'o/ /dngos dang dngos med zad pa kazhes bya ba ni gang rtag khatshad gdang rnam par bral ba'o/ /gtso bo zhes bya ba ni khams gsum gyi mnga' bdag go/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med zhes bya ba ni rdo rje nor bu'irtsemolas mi 'pho ba mnanapa ni stong pa nyid yinaladang /bral ba srid pa'i gnas ni snying rje lasaphabapa'o/ /'di gnyis kyi dbus su gang zhig rnam par gnas pa ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba mi 'dzag pa ste de ni ye shesaganyis su med pa'i chen po'o/ /de ni mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ dang po ru ni bum pa'i dbang / /gnyis pa gsang ba zhes su brjod/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste/ /ji bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya dang ni 42—565

ye shes kyi/ /brtag pa'i ye shes phyag rgya rnam par spangs/ /mchog dang mi 'gyur sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya chen po nges bsten bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bcu gcig pa zhes bya'o/ /thabasayi ge ā+oṃ gyis sbyangasku rdo rje zla ba'i steng chazhu zla de steng chagazhan kyang 'gre'o/ /yig 'bu de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang rang gi rigs kyi lha bkug nas de bstem nas yang 'od zer gyi sbyang bar 'od dkar ba bya'o/ /yi ge a yis spel bar bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ gis ni sbar bar bya'o/ /yi ge ho yis ni bdud rtsir bya'o/ /yi ge haṃ gis ni dusame'i dal du spyan drang bar bya'o/ /yi ge k+ṣa yis gang la gtong ba'i 〈na dang ni gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yon gyis ni sbyang bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas kyis ni spel bar bya'o/ /thal mo bkab nas sbar bar bya'o/ /mkha' lding gi phyag rgya sor mo bcu nang du bkug ste spyo ba yis ni bdud rtsir bya'o/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya mthe'u chung dang 'dzub mo rgyab tu sa pa ni spyan drang ngo / /lag pa'i rgyab kyis zhi ba la g.yon se gol mngon spyod g.yas kyi ni gshegs su gsol lo/ /chang zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i gzugs su bsgom pa de nas g.yon gyi ming med kyi chang gi thig pa blangs la sa la zur gsum pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas bya'o/ /de'i dbus su thig le'i gzugs su ①rlum por bya'o/ /me long gi phra dang mtshungs par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam ④la dang po de rnams tshim par bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ a hūṃ ho zhes bya ste/ sku gsung thugs su ye shes kyi rdo rje ste sngags kyi 'di rnams kyis so/ /de nas a ā i ā+o u u ri rī li lī rnam par shes pa la sogs pa'i phung po'o/ /nam mkha' la ①sogs pa'i khams so/ /a ā e ste ar ār o ston a la ā la/ a 06dbang po drug dang yul drug gi'o/ /ha hā/ ya yā/ ra rā/ wa wā/ la wā/zhes pa ni thabs dang shes rab kyi sku khro bo bcu ste/ zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pa'i 42—566

rang las kyi dbang po'i 'o/ /ka kā/ kha khā/ ga gā/ gha ghā/ nga ngu /tsa tsā/ tsha tsā/ dza dzā/ dzha dzñā/ nya hā/ ṭa ṭā/ ṭha lbo/ ḍa ḍā/ bye ṭ+wā—/ ṇa ṇa/ pa pā/ pha pā/ ba bā/ bha bhā/ ma mā/ ta tā/ tha thā/da dā/ dha dh+wa/ na nā/ sa sā/ h+pha po/ ṣa ṣā/ sha shā/ ska ṅgā/ha hā/ ya yā/ ra rā/ wa wā/ la ta// k+ṣa k+ṣu①/ zhes pa rgo thabs dang shes rab rigs sum snecu rtsa drug tshim par bya ba'i cho ga /dbang gi rab 'byed pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po zla ba mgon po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba shes rab grags kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o/ /'di bris dge ba yod pa des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /mi 'gyur bde ba thob par shog /dang po gnyis ni kun tu 'gro/ /brgyad dang bcu gsum sku yin no/ /gsum drug bdun dang bcu bzhi pa gsung / /bzhi dgu bcu pa thugs su shes//lnga bcu gcig ye shes so/ /sprul pa la gnyis ste/ rang rgyud pa ni rgyal po grags pa lta bu ste/ 'jam dpal dngos kyi sprul pa'o/ /byin gyi rlabs kyi sprul pa ni/ nyi ma'i shing rta lta bu ste/ 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'dir ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes ma sgos la/ dgyes rdor la sogs par ni 'di skad la sogs pa smos pa ni 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ 'dir dbang po rtul ba rnams la yab rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i sras su skye ba bzhes pa la bstan pa yin pa dang /dka' thub la sogs pa'i spyod pa bstan pa dang / saṃ rjokri ta'i skad kyis 42—567

gsungs pa dang / 'di skad bdag gis zhes pa'i 'dul bar dka' ba rnams la gsungs pa yin pa dang / yul sham bha la na gnas pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab tu gyur pa'i gang zag de la theg pa chen po'i snod du rung ba'i rnams la/zhu ba po phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa rgyal po zla ba bzang po dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon nas chos gsungs pa'o// //de la kun mkhyen ye shes sku zhes pa ye shes nas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can ltar yin no zhes gsungs so// //bsdur mchan/55༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ①〈〈pe 〉thar/553 ①〈〈pe 〉skab/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gi ste dbang rdzogs pa la — bshags pa la sogs pa bya/ sne〈〈pe 〉ra /554 ①〈〈pe〉skabang / ②〈〈pe 〉ra yastedabang rdzogs pa la — bshags pa la sogs pa bya/555 ①〈〈pe〉ridang /556 ①〈〈pe 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgo557 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rims/558 ①〈〈pe〉7martags/56༷ ①〈〈pe 〉ra rgyal/562 ①〈〈pe 〉sngaganyis/565 ①〈〈pe〉7tu/566 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gisu/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasams ①〈〈pe 〉ra sa/567 ①〈〈pe 〉〉khyar+pā/ ④〈〈pe 〉sngagasum/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉tsa rjo〈〈pe 〉ra mas/42—568
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2419)42wa 569

༄ga /rang gi lha ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag pa zhes bya ba/①kho 'phags pa 'jam dpal rmi rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra dar+sha nā nu ma tod de sha pa rīk+ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/ rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag pa zhes bya ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gsum yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /bcu gsum 'bras bu brnyes pa po/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /'dir ni mngon sum bstan 'chos dag /rgyal ba'i thugs sras 'jam dbyangs la—/ /phyin ci log bzhir bcas pa ni/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don du zhus/ /shākya seng ge'i seng ge yis/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor pa rnams la/ /rgyud dang rgyud gzhan du gsungs dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul dang / /bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma ru/ /'gyur ro 'phags pa'i 42—570

yul du ni/ /dbyangs can bdag po bdag la gsungs/ /rang gi lta 'dod mdor bstan du/ /gang la rnam par shes pa'i blos/ /phyin ci log bzhir bcas pa ni/ /bdag gi ①de nyid bshad par bya/ /lam ma yin la lam kyi blo/ /chos ma yin la chos dang ni/ /bdag med pa la bdag blo dang / /de bzhin sdug bsngal la bde ba'o/ /nyon mongs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /mi shes ma lus spang ba'i phyir/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du/ /sems can rnams la bshad par bya/ /sregs bcad brdar bas gser bzhin du/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs brtags nas/ /bdag gsungs blang bya dge slong rnams/ /gus pa tsam gyis ma yin no/ /gang zhig lam bzang dor nas ni/ /chom rkun gyis gang lam mi bgrod/ /de 'dir thub pa bden pa yi/ /gsung ngor brdzun pa su zhig 'dzin/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma yi/ /rtag tu sems can bsam pa'i phyir/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis gsungs/ /thub pas bden par gsungs ma yin/ /nyon mongs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /mi shes ma lus spang phyir du/ /'dir ni bden gsung ②ston pa yis/ /sbyin pa'i lam du 'jug par mdzad/ /'dod chags bsam pa med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan byi bud med ma bzung zhing / /thub pas rang gi btsun mo byin/ /skye ba 'dir ni khyod sangs rgyas/ /zhe sdang bsam pa med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan byi sha rnams ma phrogs shing / /thub pas rang gi sha rnams byin/ /skye ba 'dir ni khyod sangs rgyas/ /gti mug bsam pa med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi 'phrog pa mi mdzad par/ /thub pas rang gi rgyal srid byin/ /skye ba 'dir ni khyod sangs rgyas/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti 42—571

mug rnams/ /'di rnams 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'di rnams 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan chos ni dug mi mnga'/ /chos kyi bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'di rnams 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo/ /bden pa spyad pas skye bo ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni khyod sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas khyod ni skye gzhan min/ /sangs rgyas skye bo khyod sangs rgyas/ /lha yi skye ba lha nyid de/ /lha min skye ba lha min nyid/ /grub pa'i skye ba grub pa nyid/ /mi yi skye ba mi nyid do/ /dud 'gro'i skye ba dud 'gro nyid/ /yi dwags skye ba yi dwags nyid—/ /de ltar la sogs gzhan la yang / /rtag tu mkhas pas shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ /lha yi yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /lha nyid du ni 'gyur ba'o/ /lha min yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /sbyin ma'i bu ru 'gyur ba ste/ /grub pa yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /grub pa nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /mi ru yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /mi nyid du ni 'gyur ba'o/ /dud 'gro yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /dud 'gror yang dag 'gro ba'o/ /yi dwags yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /yi dwags nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ /dmyal bar yang dag 'byung las kyis/ /dmyal ba nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /bsod nams phung pos sangs rgyas khyod/ /ston pa'i sku dang spyod pa ste/ /sdig pa'i phung pos sangs rgyas khyod/ /gdug pa dul ba'i lus nyid do/ /sangs rgyas shākya seng ge yis/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang dag 42—572

gis—/ /sku ni gcig gnyis gsum dang ni/ /bzhi dang lnga ru gsungs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sku/ /ji ltar gzugs kyi sku dang ni/ /de ltar sangs rgyas chos sku ste/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gi phyir/ /bstan bcos skyabs gnas gsum pos gsungs/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye ba yis/ /sku gsum du ni rab tu bsgrags/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa rnams/ /sngags kyi tshul la mi yis sgrub/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin bzhen pa sprul pa dang / /chos sku mdzad par bcas pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag bshad/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang / /gzugs kyi phung po mtha' yas pa/ /bdag gi sprul pa'i sku mchog go/ /sgra yi phung po mtha' yas pa—/ /bdag gi longs spyod rdzogs sku mchog /chos kyi phung po mtha' yas pa/ /bdag gi chos kyi sku rab bsgrags/ /ye shes phung po mtha' yas pa/ /bdag gi ye shes sku rab bsgrags/ /bde ba'i phung po mtha' yas pa/ /bdag gi bde sku 'gyur med mchog /gong bu'i phung po de bzhin sku/ /yang dag bsags par yongs su bsgrags/ /bsgrub bya lus ni rgyal min 'gyur/ /sems can mgu ba'i gnas dang ni/ /stong nyid ye shes dam pa'i bdes/ /gang phyir sku rnams bsgrub ①pa'o/ /bsgrub bya rnams dang sgrub po dang / /sgrub pa rnams ni gcig med ni/ /de bzhin gzhan nyid med par 'gyur/ /de med na ni tshogs pa'ang med/ /bsod nams min las rgyal po min/ /rgyal po 42—573

bsod nams med las min/ /tshul khrims med las tshangs pa min/ /tshangs pa tshul khrims med las min/ /tshogs ma rdzogs las sangs rgyas med/ /sangs rgyas nges par tshogs rdzogs las/ /sdig pa med las sdig can min/ /sdig can sdig pa med las min/ /bstan bcos mi shes mkhas pa min/ /mkhas pa bstan bcos mi shes min/ /bzo rigs mi shes bzo mkhan min/ /bzo mkhan bzo rig mi shes min/ /shes pa med na ye shes min/ /ye shes shes pa med las min/ /shes bya med na shes byed med/ /shes byed shes bya med las min/ /rnal 'byor med na sbyor po min/ /sbyor po rnal 'byor med las min/ /longs spyod med na 'byor ldan min/ /'byor ldan longs spyod med las min/ /nad med pa las nad pa min/ /nad pa nad med pa las min—/ /sdug bsngal med na sdug ldan min/ /sdug ldan sdug bsngal med las min—/ /lus med pa las lus ldan min/ /lus ldan lus med pa las min/ /ngag med pa las ngag ldan min/ /ngag ldan ngag med pa las min/ /sems med pa las sems ldan min/ /sems ldan sems med pa las min/ /de ltar la sogs thams cad 'dir/ /shes par bya'o legs 'gro rnams/ /dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sgu yi rdo rje can gyes ni/ /byen rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs 42—574

pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su ding bdag mdzod/ /rang bdag bya ba rnam 'gags pas/ /sems med pa yi thugs 'chang ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /kun gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /shes dang shes bya bde rnams dang / /shes dang shes bya bde ldan mchog /lus ngag yid dang ldan pa yang /'khor bar rang rang las la spyod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byang chub sems/ /ji ltar sems dpa' chen por bshad/ /de bzhin dam tshig sems dpa' yang / /rnam par dag par yongs su bsgrags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rdo rje sems/ /byang chub sems dpa' de nyid gzhan/ /rang rgyal nyan thos sangs rgyas dang / /sems dpa' chen por bshad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' thub pa'i sras/ /dam tshig sems dpa' de bzhin te/ /de ltar sems dpa' bzhi po rnams/ /sku rnams kyi ni sgrub po mchog /bzhi po rnams kyi snying po ni/ /stong nyid ye shes 'gyur med de/ /kye yi rdo rje zhes brjod pa/ /stong nyid ye shes smra ba'o/ /ji ltar rang bzhin yang dag dag /chos rnams thams cad zag pa med/ /de bzhin rang bzhin dag pa dang / /zhes pa bden par gsungs pa med/ /kun gyi sgra rnams thams cad mkhyen/ /'jig rten gsum spyod spyod pa min/ /ye shes rang bzhin sgra yis ni/ /sgom pa rang gi rang bzhin no/ /gang tshe rang 42—575

bzhin gyis dag pa'i/ /chos rnams thams cad zag med pa/ /de tshe phyi rol 'byung po dang / /sngags pa'i rang bzhin ji ltar 'gyur/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /rang bzhin bdag nyid ces pa dang / /ji ltar rnal 'byor spyod gsungs pa/ /de ltar dbu mar mi 'gyur ro/ /phung po rnam dpyad stong pa ni/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /skye ba med pa 'gag med pa'i/ /shes bya'i don rnams mthong ba yi/ /stong nyid stong pa sgom pa ni/ /phung po rnam dpyad ma yin no/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid/ /rgyal bas snying po med par gsungs—/ /gang rnams stong nyid mthong ba yi/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni gsungs pa'o—/ /snying rje'i chos rnams thams cad rnams/ /snying po med par rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang rnams snying rje mthong ba yi/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni gsungs pa'o/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med zad pa'i gtso—/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes bshad pa'o/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /gnyis po dag kyang med pa ste/ /kun rdzob yongs su shes pa na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zhes par brjod/ /srid pa dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis po dag ni yod min te/ /srid pa yongs su shes pa na / /mya ngan 'das pa zhes par brjod/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mjong na rnam par grol/ /dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /dngos po sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos mi 'gyur/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o—/ /yod dam med las rnam par 'das/ /zag pa med pa'i blo ni gang / /42—576

zab mo de ni dmigs pa med/ /yid ches don can bsgom par bya/ /dang po smig rgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba'o/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste//bzhi pa mar me 'dra ba'o/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che//'od chen rnam par snang ba ste/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgon/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal mchog sngags dbang po/ /sngags kyi rgyal po don chen byed/ /gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs ston/ /dag pa sprin dkar bzhin du dkar/ /'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /'dod chags chen po sen mo'i 'od/ /zur phud bzang po mthon ka'i mchog /skra mchog mthon ka chen po 'chang / /nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rigs 'chang ba/ /du ba m+big rgyu me khyer dang / /sgon ma 'bar ba nyi zla dang / /mun can cha dang thig le che/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'od gsal ba/ /btsums dang ma btsums mig dag gis/ /stong par gang zhig rjes brtags min/ /rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /gzugs de rtag tu sgom par bya/ /ji ltar pra phab gzhon nu mas/ /me long la mthong dngos skyes min/ /de bzhin 'das dang ma 'ongs kun/ /mkha' la de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /de ni dngos dang dngos med min/ /dngos po stong pa'i don mthong phyir/ /dngos dang dngos med don yod pa/ /sgyu ma rmi lam mig 'phrul bzhin/ /med pa'i chos can la ni chos—/ /skye ba 'di ni rab tu mthong / /yid bzhin nor ltar mtha' yas pa'i/ /42—577

sems can re ba yongs skong byed/ /pra phab pa yi gzhon nu mas/ /ma mthong ba yi rdzas rnams mthong / /nyi tshe ba yi mig dag las/ /son nas sgrub pa po yis mthong / /gal te yod pa'i gzugs mthong na/ /rang gi gdong pa cis mi mthong / /'on te med pa'i gzugs mthong na/ /ri bong rwa ni ji ltar min//gzhan gyi mig gis mi mthong zhing / /rang gis mig gis mthong min pa/ /skye ba med pa mthong ba ni/ /gzhon nu ma yi bu ji bzhin/ /don grub grub pa'i kun rtog ni/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog khams mi zad/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad pa med/ /grub pa gal te kun rtog pa/ /don rnams grub par yongs su brjod/ /rnam par rtog med ji ltar brjod/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa'o/ /gser la ra gan du rtog pa/ /kun du brtags par brjod pa yin/ /gser la gser du rtog pa ni/ /rnam par brtags pa med par brjod/ /ji ltar yang dag mi shes pa/ /kun du rtog par brjod pa'o//ji ltar yang dag shes pa na/ /rnam par rtog pa med par brjod/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /chos khams dam pa zad pa med/ /chos kyi dbyings su son rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas de ltar 'gyur ba ci/ /dpag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'dud/ /gang khyod skyon kun med pa'i sku—/ /sdig bral rnams kyis nges par ltos/ /rnam par rtog med ji ltar brjod—/ /dpag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam pa kun byi mchog ldan pa'i—/ /gzugs med gzugs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /skyon med rnams kyi yid rnams dang / /mig dag gis ni nges par mthong / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyang / /rnam par mi rtog pa la bshad/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs 42—578

rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs dang ni/ /thar pa'i lam ni gcig nyid khyod/ /gzhan dag med pa zhes par nges/ /gang zhig rnam par mi rtog pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin lam dran/ /rnam par mi rtog pa 'di ni/ /'di yi lam du brten par bshad/ /'di nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /yang dag 'gro ba de bzhin gshegs/ /dri ma dang bcas dri ma med/ /pha rol sems ni mkhyen pa'o/ /ji ltar nyi ma mkhar gsal yang / /rtog pa med par rab tu grags/ /gsal ba yang dag gnas bsgoms na/ /bum pa la sogs rnam rtog med/ /gsal ba de ni bsgoms pa yis/ /mi dang mi mo gang mthong ba—/ /rnam par rtog pa min par ni/ /kun gzigs rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs—/ /rang rig gzhan rig thams cad pa/ /kun la phan pa'i gang zag mchog /'jig rten dpe las 'das pa ste/ /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /shes dang shes bya'i phung po yang / /kun mkhyen bdag po mchog tu 'gyur—/ /kun mkhyen bdag po mchog rnams la/ /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po med/ /bsod nams ldan pa bsod nams tshogs/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ /ye shes ldan pa yod med shes/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs dang yang dag ldan/ /mi phyed bde ba 'gyur ba med/ /ye shes rdo rje rgyal dbang rnams/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i dbye ba ni/ /dbang po gnyis skyes ji ltar 'gyur/ /brtswa lnga cha yi bdag nyid kyi/ /zla ba byang chub sems su 'gyur/ /ā li'i rang bzhin bde chen po/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams de yi cha/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa de yi phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /'dis ni bden pa gsung 42—579

pa yis/ /snga mar gsungs pa bkag pa ste/ /sngon nyid dang ni phyi ma dag /rim pa phyi ma stobs dang ldan/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /yang dag mtha' ste yi ge med/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /zab cing rgya che sgra sgogs pa/ /chos kyi dung ste sgra chen po/ /chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgra bo che/ /rab tu mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /phyogs bcu chos kyi rnga bo che/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid rang bzhin/ /gzugs rnams thams cad snang ba'i dpal/ /gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rtogs bya ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /gsang sngags skye gnas yi ge med/ /gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa/ /gsang sngags don kun skyed pa po/ /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga/ /thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med—/ /bcu drug phyed byed thig le 'chang / /cha med cha las 'das pa ste/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang / /'di ni chos kyi nges pa'i chos lam ma yin la lam blo gang / /phyin ci log pa bzhi po ste①/ /khyod kyis dor cig rgyal po kye/ /zhes pa rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag par lam yongs su brtag pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las/ /rang gis byas pa dge mi dge/ /lus can 'bras bu longs spyod kyi/ /gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin no/ /lus can las rnams bskal pa ni/ /bye ba brgyar yang nyams pa med/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nges par 'thob pa'o/ /'tshogs pa gsum po gsungs pa 42—580

niske/ /bstan pa dang ni g.yo ba dang / /'dres pa'i las rnams longs spyod par—/ /lus can spyod par 'gyur ba'o/ /bstan pa sa sogs 'byung ba dang //g.yo ba srog chags 'byung po'o/ /'dres pa sna tshogs nad rnams kyis/ /bdag blo nges par 'joms pa'o/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /bde dang sdug bsngal 'gyur ba gang / /rang gi las 'bras longs spyod phyir/ /sa la sogs pa de lta min/ /'chi dang nad rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /rang nyid nges par 'joms gyur na/ /rang gi las 'bras longs spyod kyi/ /nad la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan min/ /sems can tshogs la bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal rgyal pos ster ba yang / /rang gi las 'thas longs spyod do/ /g.yo ba tshogs par gyur pas min/ /de yi bde sdug ster ba nyid/ /gzhan te rgyal po'i stobs kyis min/ /de yang gzhan gyis byen pa nyid/ /gzhan de'ang rgyal po ma yin no//'khor ba na ni 'khor ba yang / /las rnams kyis ni las 'bras bskyed/ /byas dang byed du bcug pa yis/ /sems can srid par spyod pa'o/ /sngon gyis ①las la longs spyod don/ /phyi ma de yang sogs pa na/ /lus can bya bar nges par ni/ /gang gis las rnams zad pa med/ /mi dge bcu po byas pa yis/ /lus can rnams kyi sdig par 'gyur/ /de rnams nges par spangs pa na/ /kun du bsod nams 'gyur ba'o/ /lus can rnams kyis byas pa'i las las kyi 'bras bu longs spyod kyi/ /ster dang 'phrog par byed pa yi/ /byed po gzhan ni 'ga' yang med/ /lus ngag sems rnams kyis byas dang / /dbang po rnams kyis rtag byas dang / /yul gyi 'dzin pas las byas gang / /de rnams 'bras bu ster ba'o/ /mi dang mi mos seng mthong na/ /lus can 'jigs par 42—581

'gyur ba'o/ /skye bos zhi bde mjong ba na/ /lus can rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur—/ /stag chen po yi skad thos na/ /lus can rnams ni skrag par 'gyur//bzang zhing dga' ba'i skad thos na/ /lus can rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /shin tu ngan pa'i dri bsnams na/ /lus can rnams ni mi dgar 'gyur/ /shin tu zhim pa'i dri bsnams na/ /lus can dga' bar 'gyur ba'o/ /mar dang 'o ma'i ro myangs pas/ /lus can rnams ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /dug rnams kyi ni ro myangs na/ /lus can rnams ni brgyal bar 'gyur/ /shin tu grang dang dro ba yi/ /reg byas lus can sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i reg bya yis—/ /lus can rnams ni bde bar 'gyur/ /sems can gang gis sems can ched/ /yid kyis sdug bsngal rgya mtsho byin/ /gzhan de yis kyang yid kyis ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab tu ster/ /sems can gang gis sems can chedarka/ /ngag gis sdug bsngal rgya mtsho byin/ /gzhan de yis kyang ngag gis ni//sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab tu ster/ /sems can gang gis sems can ched/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho byin/ /gzhan de yis kyang lus kyis ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab ster ba'o/ /kha cig ngag gi skyon rnams kyis/ /lus la dbyug pa byin pa na/ /gzhan de yis kyang lus nyid la/ /dbyug pa ster ro mi bdag kye/ /gang zhig yid kyis byas pa 'am/ /yid kyis byed du bcug pa'i lasaske/ /de ni lus kyis longs spyod de/ /rnam gsum las kyi 'bras bu gang / /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi rab byas rnam gsum zhes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis yongs su bsgrags/ /gang tshe mi dang mi mo yi/ /lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyis/ /mi dge byas 42—582

pa de'i tshe/ /lus kyi sdog pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu dang / /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas pa yi/ /'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /gal te 'bras bu sbyang byar med/ /des na de rnams 'bras bur ci/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas phyogs sbyang bya ste/ /longs spyod zad pa de yis ci/ /'jig rten rtag pa'i gzugs can du/ /gang tshe lta bas sdug bsngal te/ /de tshe ster po len pa po/ /gnyis po dag ni tshogs pa med/ /sbyin po sbyin pa'i sems dang ni/ /gang tshe len po'ang yod gyur pa/ /de tshe bsod nams tshogs dang ldan/ /sbyin pa po las gzhan la min/ /gang tshe sbyor po gsod pa pos/ /gsad ①pa'i dus gcig gyur pa na/ /de tshe sdig pa'i tshogs nyid de/ /gsod pa po las gzhan la min/ /sems can rnams kyi yid skyes dang / /ngag las skyes pa'i smon lam byen/ /gang tshe sbyin bcu'i bsod nams te/ /de tshe lus kyi sbyin pa ci/ /lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyesaske/ /mi dge ba ni byas pa na/ /gang tshe bden par dge slong la/ /de tshe pham pa'i sdig par 'gyur/ /rmi lam srog chags bsad pa dang / /gzhan gyi nor ni 'phrog pa dang / /'dod pas log g.yem spyad pa yis/ /dge 'dun pham par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can phan las bsod nams dang / /sems can gnod las sdeg pa ste/ /phan dang gnod pa rnams med na/ /las med 'bras bu med pa'o/ /dud 'gro yi dwags dbul po'i mi/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyis gdungs rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa'i gnas/ /skyon med nyid du gyur pa'o/ /srin po rnams ni rgyal srid dang / /chung ma rang sha mi ster zhing / /gzhan gyi rgyal srid chung ma dang / /rang gi sha rnams 'phrog pa'o//42—583

bdud rtsi za ba rgyal srid dang / /chung ma rang sha mi ster yang / /gzhan gyi rgyal srid chung ma dang / /rang gi sha rnams mi 'phrog pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal srid dang / /btsun mo rang sha ster mdzad cing / /gzhan gyi rgyal srid chung ma dang / /rang sha'ang 'phrog par mi mdzad do/ /bdag gis gzhan srid ma phrogs shing / /rang gi rgyal srid sogs byen pa/ /de yis dbang po'i go 'phang brnyes/ /sangs rgyas khyod ni lhas kyang mchod/ /bdag gis gzhan gyi chung ma rnams/ /ma bsten 'dod pa'i btsun mo byin/ /de yis lha dang lha min dang / /skye dgu'i phyag mchod gnas bla ma/ /bdag gis gzhan gyi sha rnams ni/ /ma gsol rang sha rnams byin pa/ /de yis mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs shing / /'od gsal ldan pa'i sku gnyis brnyes/ /bdag gis dka' ba spyod pa na/ /'bras kyi rdog ma gcig gsol zhing / /chu khyor gcig las ma gsol ba/ /de yis thams cad dbang du byas/ /zho 'thung gis ni rus pa dang / /shi bir rang sha sprin bzhon pas/ /lus byin pha rol phan don du/ /bde gshegs kyis so gzhan min rgyal/ /rgyal po zla 'od dbu dang ni/ /de bzhin dge slong klu sgrub kyis/ /snying rjes stag mo stag phrug la/ /thub pas sngon du lus byin dang / /khyi la zan tsam ster ba yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid kun 'ong bar/ /thub pas chod pa lung bstan to/ /gal te snod min rab byin pas/ /lus can sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur na/ /bram ze la sogs snod nyid las/ /sangs rgyas nyid du cis mi 'gro//zang zing sbyin pa bcu po ni/ /lam du byen pa ji lta bzhin/ /'jigs med sbyin pa lnga rnams kyang / /rigs kyi bu rnams kyis shes bya/ /rin chen lcags 42—584

zas ba lang rta/ /glang chen bu mo nor 'dzin dang / /'dod pa'i chung ma rang gi sha /sbyin pa rnam pa bcu ru 'dod/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus—/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang ni/ /don lam stobs dang ye shes te/ /'di rnams chos kyi rab 'jug pa'o/ /mi 'jigs zang zing dam pa'i chos/ /'di ltar sbyin pa gsum du brjod/ /sems can yongs bzung tshul khrims dang / /mi dge bcu spong byed khrims dang / /sdom pa yi ni tshul khyems te/ /gsum du yongs su bsgrags pa'o/ /sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa dang / /gzhan gyi gnod pa bzod pa dang / /chos la nges sems bzod pa ste/ /de ltar bzod pa gsum du brjod/ /brtson 'grus rab sbyor go cha dang / /yongs su rdzogs de gsum du 'dod/ /skyon dang bral ba'i bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin bsam gtan gnas dang ni/ /nges 'byor bsam gtan brjod pa ste/ /de ltar bsam gtan gsum du brjod/ /thos byung bsam byung sgom byung ste/ /shes rab phung po gsum du ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /shes rab rnam pa gsum zhes bsgrags/ /myur bar bde ba mngon rtogs dang / /chos kun nges par rtogs pa dang / /sems pa la ni 'jug pa ste/ /thabs ni rnam pa gsum zhes dran/ /phung po rab tu 'ching ba dang / /'du byed rab tu 'ching ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing rnams spyod pa ste/ /smon lam rnam pa gsum zhes brjod/ /las rnams be+er log nyid dang yang / /ngag rnams slar log stobs dang ni/ /sems par 'jug pa nyid ces pa/ /de ltar stobs ni gsum du dran/ /dbang po'i mngon sum gyis 'dzin dang / /ma 'ongs pa dang gzhan sems dang / /dngos po thams cad 42—585

yongs mkhyen pa/ /yang dag ye shes gsum du dran/ /so sor gcig dbang dbye ba yis/ /de rnams rmi lam gzugs bzhin du/ /sbyin pa po yis 'jigs med bya/ /sku lnga ldan pa'i rgyal bas gsungs/ /sbyin med bsod nams med 'di dang / /mi dge bcu yi las rnams kyis/ /bsod nams med na shes rab med/ /sangs rgyas sbyin la rab tu 'jug /sbyin dang bsod nams med skyes bu/ /de rnams phar phyin dgu 'bras med/ /stobs med rnams kyi 'dren mi 'gyur/ /shes rab las kyi rjes su 'brang / /gang tshe bsod nams med gyur pa/ /de tshe sdig can legs song nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / /chos kun 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /shes rab pha rol phyin zhi bar/ /rab zhugs bsod nams skas dag las/ /skye bo legs par 'gro ba rnams/ /sdig pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro/ /shes rab pha rol phyin zhi bar/ /rab zhugs sdig pa'i skas dag las/ /ngan song du ni bgrod pa rnams/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro/ /sdig pa'i phung po spangs shes rab/ /de tshe bsod nams phung por 'jug /bsod nams phung po dor shes rab/ /de tshe sdig pa'i phung por zhugs/ /rtogs byed rtogs pa gnyis po yang / /shes rab gcig min rab tu bsgrags/ /rtogs pa po des rtogs pa na/ /shes rab gnyis po'i dbye gang yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i blo/ /stong pa nyid kyis dus gsum gzugs/ /gzung ba gang yin 'dzin pa ste/ /de ltar shes rab gnyis su dran/ /shes rab thabs ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /sbyor ba zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /rang bzhin med gang shes rab ste/ /thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /dper na sa bon med gyur na/ /yan lag lnga ldan spyon 42—586

shing med/ /tshul khrims la sogs phung po lnga/ /skyes bu bsod nams med de bzhin / /gzugs bzang dang ni dbang phyug dang / /brtson 'grus phun tshogs grags de ltar/ /rnam pa bzhi 'bras ston pa ni/ /bsod nams tshogs las byung ba'o/ /kun mkhyen kun gye rnam pa mkhyen/ /de bzhin lam mkhyen pa dang ni/ /lam gyi rnam mkhyen ston pa ni/ /ye shes tshogs las byung ba'o/ /rgyu 'thun pa dang rnam smin dang / /skyes bu byed pa nyid dang ni/ /dri med 'gyur ba med pa'i bde/ /ston pa tshul khrims las byung ba'o/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpar rab tu brjod/ /tshogs gsum yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /ston pa thams cad mkhyen par brjod/ /dka' ba'i las rnams ma byas shing / /sha zos pa dang chos rkun dang / /gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog na yang / /bla med go 'phang thob pa med/ /rang gi sha yang ster ba na/ /dngos kun gzhan la smos ci dgos/ /srog ldan khyod ni rab bsngags te/ /skye dgu kun gyis bsnyen bkur gnas/ /byang chub sems des skal ngan la/ /rang sha bud med sbyin par bya/ /go 'phang 'gro ba'i nus mred de/ /de phyir smad par rab tu brjod/ /gang dag ring por mgu dka' dang / /gang dag ring por gnas pa dag /thams cad dka' thub pas 'grub kyi/ /dka' thub rim pa de mgu dka'/ /mngon sum mthong tshe 'jig rten na/ /rgyal por skye bos phyag rnams 'tshal/ /dge slong tshangs par spyod pa rnams—/ /mthong tshe rgyal po yis kyang mchod/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po 'chang / /tshangs pa ①spyod pa brtul zhugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /khrus ldan go'u ⑤ta ma mchog /bram ze tshangs pa tshangs pa'i 42—587

rigs—/ /tshangs pa mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ /sems can bslu ba spangs nas ni/ /thams cad nges par bya ba'o/ /rdzas kyis nyos pa'i nya yi sha /zos pa bslus pa yin nam ci—/ /glang po'i rtsal dang sprin chen dang / /myang 'das dang ni sor phreng can//lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo sde las/ /bdag gis sha ni ma gnang ngo / /rdzas thob don du srog gcod dang / /bza' ba'i don du rin 'jal ba/ /gnyis po dag kyang gsod po ste/ /ngu 'bod la sogs rnams su 'tshed/ /rdzas kyi don du sems can gsod/ /rdzas steng med na sus kyang yin/ /bya dang byed po yang dag 'byel/ /rtag tu srog chags gsod pa'o/ /gang tshe rdzas kyis nya nyos pa/ /khyim gnas rnams la sdig med na/ /de bzhin sku gzugs la sogs pa—/ /byas na'ang ji ltar bsod nams 'gyur/ /mchod rten thig mkhan gyis byas dang / /nya ni nya pas bsad pa ste/ /mchod rten phyag byed byed po min/ /nya zos gsod pa po la min/ /gang tshe nya de zos pa yi/ /sdig pa za ba por med na/ /de tshe mchod rten byed pa yi/ /bsod nams mchod byed po la med/ /gsod pa po dang za ba po/ /gnyis po dag kyang so so ste/ /gsod pa po ni nor la sred/ /za ba po ni zas kyi don/ /gsod po nor la sred pa dag /bskal pa 'bum du 'tshed pa'o/ /za po sha la sred pa dag /bskal pa bye bar 'tshed pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi ni ched dag tu/ /nya pas nya ni bsad pa dang / /bram ze yi ni ched dag tu/ /chang mas chang ni byas pa dang / /kha na ma tho med gzhan min/ /sha za ba yi mi gang zhig /dang po yi dwags 'gro ba ste/ /phyim ngu 'bod 'gro ba'o/ /sha za ba la snying rje dang / /chang 'thung ba la dga' ba 42—588

dang / /pha rol bud med 'dzin byams dang / /smad pa'i las byed btang snyoms med/ /yul gyi spyod dang rigs spyod dang / /pha dang lha rnams mchod don du/ /sha dang nya rnams bza' ba yi/ /mi dang mi mo skyon med na/ /stag dang ri dwags nyid dang yang / /bya rgod dang ni phag pa dang / /chu srin dang ni nya phyis kyis/ /las sbyang skye ba'i yon tan med/ /yul spyod rigs kyi spyod pa dag /dud 'gro lha rnams la min mod/ /snying rje med dang snying rjer ldan/ /sdig pa dang ni bsod nams 'gyur/ /gang tshe sa la dge slong gang / /sngags kyi theg pa mi shes pa/ /de tshe khyer pa nyer spyod kyang / /dge slong gi ni bla mar bya—/ /khyim pa 'am ni gsar bu la/ /'jig rten smod pa spang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos la sogs mdun bsdar te/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i blos phyag bya/ /mchog min las dang phyag spangs nas/ /gdan bstab pa dang ldang ba dang / /don bya la sogs bsnyen bkur rnams/ /thams cad brtul zhugs can rmis bya/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /kheng ①shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /rang bstod bla mar slob ma ni/ /blo dang ldan pas mi bya'o/ /brtse med sha za ba la gsungs—/ /khro ba dga' bar snun byed dang / /gdug pa legs pa'i skye bor sdang / /khengs pa ye shes spangs pa'o/ /chags pa lha yi dkor la spyod/ /ma bsdams shin du chang 'thung ba'o/ /rang bstod stong pa nyid lam la/ /smod cing gnod pa byed pa'o/ /stong nyid smra ba khyu mchog ni/ /'jam pa yi ni dbyangs gang de'o/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin bdag nyid ces pa gsungs/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med / /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rjer ldan zhing bstan bcos 42—589

mkhas| /dang ba'i bdag nyid dbang po thul/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chang byed slob dpon no/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /phyag rgya bya ba 'dug stangs dang / /gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /'di ni de nyid bcu po ste/ /khro bo sangs rgyas dam tshig rnams/ /gang gis rgya cher mi shes te/ /sa la rdo rje 'dzin pa min/ /byang sems rnams la lha bshos dang / /khro bo rnams la gtor mar bshad/ /dkyil 'khor la ni tshogs 'khor te/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg las kyis so/ /gang zhig khyim pa bste gnas spyod/ /'bangs dang bshol 'dzin tshong pa dang / /dam chos 'tshong ba'i rmongs pa de/ /sa la rdo rje 'dzin pa min/ /de bzhin 'dod na rtag dmyal bar/ /sdug bsngal rdon po bar med 'byung / /rgyal ba'i gnas su lhag bdag pos/ /nyi ma gcig kyang mi bya'o/ /lhag pa'i bdag po'i gnas su yang / /gang yang bya ba nyi ma gsum/ /slob dpon bcas pa yi dwags 'gyur/ /slar yang lo gcig tu ni ci/ /gtsug lag gang gi rdzas la chagasarka/ /rmongs pa mi bden pa ru brjod/ /rnam par rtog pa'i sems kyi bdag /thos ldan bdud rnams kyi ni ris/ /rnam par rtog med kun sbyin pa//bdag sbyin rnam par rtog dang bcas/ /pha rol gyi ni bud med dang / /rang gi bud med ngan pa'i yid/ /dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs rnams/ /dus gsum byon nas mngon phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs bcu'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis—/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par/ /der gnas phung po sangs 42—590

rgyas rnams/ /dus gsum byon nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang tshe phyogs bcur bzhugs sangs rgyas/ /slob dpon la ni phyag 'tshal na/ /de tshe slob dpon gyes skyabs gnas/ /gsum po zad par 'gro ba'o/ /dbye ba'i dam tshig dbye ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni srin po'i yang / /gzugs rnams yongs su bsgyur ba med/ /de tshe mkhas pas shes par bya/ /lha yis srin po'i gzugs nyid du/ /byas pa de ni dam tshig min/ /srin pos lha yi gzugs nyid ni/ /byas pa de ni dam tshig min/ /sa la ba lang phyi sogs mthong / /srin po ring por 'gro ba'o/ /lha yis bshang ba sogs mthong na/ /rang gi gnas kyang spong ba'o| /lha rnams dang ni srin po yang / /dam tshig rnam pa brgyad du dran/ /sha dang bral ba brgyad dang ni/ /sha dang bcas pa brgyad du brjod/ /zho dang bcas pa'i 'bras zan dang / /'o ma bur chu 'o thug mar/ /sbrang dang nā ri ke la'i chu/ /dri bzang chu ste brgyad po rnams/ /lha rnams mchod pa'i don ched kyi//dam tshig tu ni rab tu bsgrags/ /srin po mchod pa'i don du ni/ /lus can gang yang brgyad du 'gyur/ /mig de bya ba 'dzin pa dang / /me tog lus las skyes dang tshil/ /zas dang chang dang skyugs pa ste/ /brgyad du yongs su bsgrags pa'o/ /sdig ldan sha za ba dang ni/ /chos ldan sha rnams mi spyod dang //sgrin po kha na ma tho bcas/ /kha na ma tho med zas sems/ /srin po rnams ni sha sogs dang / /lha rnams bdud rtsi za ba'o/ /yi dwags rnams ni sa la gnas—/ /lha kun lha yi gzhal yas la'o/ /yi dwags rnams kyi dam tshig rnams| /bsrung ba lnga ru rgyal bas bstan/ /rdo rje sems sogs mkha' 'gro yis—/ /'dus pa'i le'u'i nang du gsungs/ /lha rnams sa la gnas pa'o/ /42—591

zhes pa bden tshig ma yin te/ /mtho ris 'jig rten yongs dor nas/ /dur khrod rul pa'i dri ldan min/ /de bzhin gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo kun/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dpa' bo'i zas/ /chang dang sha rnams yongs rdzogs na'o/ /sa la mchod yon sku khrus dang / /rab gnas sbyin sreg las rnams te/ /sangs rgyas he ru ka sogs kyi/ /bya ba'i dbye bar rab tu bsgrags/ /sa la mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /dri bzang chus gang bum pa dang / /dri dang bdug sgos sgon me sogs/ /sangs rgyas skyon med sogs la dbul/ /sa la mchod yon sku khrus dang / /rab gnas sbyin sreg las rnams ni/ /gang tshe slob dpon gnyis de la/ /de tshe rigs kyi dbye bar 'gyur//rigs kyi dbye 'gyur dbye ba yang / /gnyen dang ma dang skye bo rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon gcig gyur pa/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor dag 'dren pa'o/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son/ /nyan thos spyod pa skyong ba ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs gnas pa gsungs/ /thod pa chang gis gang ba yis/ /sa la mchod yon rab sbyin bya/ /chang dang sha rang dzam bu li/ /khrag bsres he ru ka sogs la'o/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas rab gnas ched/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ①ka dang / /spyi bor rin chen lnga tshogs dang / /ring bsrel gzhag par bya ba'o/ /sangs rgyas ring bsrel med gyur na/ /byang sems thugs ka'i gnas su ni/ /gser dang bcas pa'i rin chen rnams/ /skyon med rab tu gzhag par bya/ /khro bo las skyes thugs kar ni/ /dmang rigs rus pa khro sngags bcas/ /he ru ka sogs thugs kar ni/ /g.yung mo'izhurus pa'o dur khrod rgyal/ /lha la sogs pa'i tha snyad bstan/ /srin po rnams 42—592

kyi mchod pa dang / /mi yi 'jig rten rjes 'dren yang / /bdud rtsi za ba'i mchod pa med/ /slob dpon dang ni khyim pa dang / /bram ze dang ni dka' thub can/ /sha zos pa dang chang 'thungs na/ /shi nas yi dwags 'gro ba'o/ /gang yang chos rkun sogs skyon dang / /chang dang sha rnams ma spangs dang / /nyan thos sbyin pa spangs pa rnams/ /shi nas yi dwags 'gro ba'o/ /gang zhig bsod nams chen po dang / /sdig pa chung ngu spyad pa yis/ /shi nas yi dwags 'gro na yang / /yi dwags mgon por 'gro ba'o/ /sngags kyis sngags pa'i yi dwags kyis/ /mi yi lus la zhugs nas ni/ /gtor ma rab slong ra dang ni/ /chang la sogs pa de phyir dang / /sha zos sngon gyi skye bo de/ /yi dwags nang du de shes 'gyur/ /sngags kyis ①sngags pa'i yi dwags kyis/ /mi yi lus la zhugs nas ni/ /gtor ma rab slong chu dang zan/ /kha na ma tho med ldan pa/ /nyan thos sbyin pa spangs pa rnams/ /yi dwags nang du de shes 'gyur/ /sngags kyi sngags pa'i yi dwags kyis/ /mi yi lus la zhugs nas ni/ /'bangs dang gtum por gyur nas ni/ /shin tu sdug bsngal gdung ba'o/ /'dod ldan gzhan gyi bud med bsten/ /yi dwags nang du de shes 'gyur/ /bu mo la sogs rab slong ba'ang / /de bzhin gzhan yang de shes 'gyur/ /kha cig de rnams na ba na/ /nad med nga yis mi nus zhes/ /yi dwags 'dren pas brjod pa ste/ /sa la sngon rmi las 'bras so/ /kha cig de rnams bsod nams sbyor—/ /yi dwags 'dren pas brjod 'gyur te/ /bdag gis khyed la nor sbyin gyis/ /rang gi khang par song cig pu/ /bsnyung gnas la ni gnas rnams la—/ /yi dwags 'dren pas brjod pa ste/ /bdag gis nor rnams cung zad 42—593

dang / /slar yang bu yang sbyin par bya/ /bsnyung gnas gnas pa rnams kyi ni/ /'ga' zhig gis ni sdig pa spyad/ /gang zhig nyer 'tshe ①drag byas nas/ /sdug bsngal la ni 'jug pa'o/ /nor rnams rigs kyi don du bsrung / /za dang ster ba ma yin pa/ /de 'dir chus snezos 'gyur ba ste/ /shi nas de bzhin yi dwags 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'jig rten thob don du/ /skye bo dbang phyug sdug bsngal byed/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyang mi thob na/ /sbar yang gal te thob pa ci//shes rab pha rol phyin tshul la/ /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i thugs can nyid/ /sbyin bcu la sogs bsod nams kyis/ /rgyal bas bskal pa gsum lung bstan/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje'i bdag /rgyal dbang sangs rgyas nyid kyis ni/ /bya rgod phung po lung bstan pa'o/ /mi dge bcu yi las byed dang / /gdug pa 'jug par gsungs pa ste/ /sngags kyi theg par bden byas na/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi dge bcu yi las rnams dang / /kha na ma tho'i rang bzhin bcas/ /'bad pas dor cig blo ldan gyis/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bzhed pa'o/ /sems can mgu byed bsod nams te/ /sangs rgyas lus can rgyal ba yis sems can gnod las sdig pa ste/ /dmyal ba nyid du rab tu bsgrags/ /sems can nyid ni sangs rgyas te/ /blo bur dri mas bsgribs pa'o/ /dri ma de ni bsal ba na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom ①med/ /sems can nyid ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /blo ldan 'dod pa'i lta nyid de/ /sems can mgu ba sgrub byed pa/ /de rnams sha ni ji ltar za/ /sbyin pa la sogs stobs skyes pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags la sogs/ /sha za yi ni dam 42—594

tshig min/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags la sogs/ /bcom lda na thub pas gsungs pa ste/ /yang dag ye shes 'dus pa'i sbyor/ /bdag med pa ni thob pa'o / /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags la sogs/ /sgom dang 'das ①pa'i nan tan kyis/ /bskal pa bye ba du mas kyang / /dngos grub nam yang thob pa med//rtog pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /gang gis de nyid la gnas na/ /skye ba 'dir yang sgrub pa po/ /de la byang chub mchog reg pa'o/ /re shig gzugs kyi sgom pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub pa min/ /rnam pa dang bcas rtog pas kyang / /e waṃ rdo rje sems mi 'grub/ /dge ba dang ni mi dge ba'i/ /rnam par rtog pa dbye ba med/ /don mchog rnam par rtog pa yang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis mi bya'o/ /me yis rab tu sreg byed kyi/ /rten gyi dbye bas dbye ba med/ /tsan dan la ni 'bar bas kyang / /reg par gyur na sreg pa'o/ /sdog ldan skye bo la la gang / /bdag ni rgyal po'o sems pa na/ /bskal pa bar med brgyar bsams kyang / /de yis rgyal por 'gyur ba min/ /rgyu dang 'dra bar skyes pa yi/ /'bras bu 'jig rten rnams na spyod/ /ko dra ba las 'ga' zhig du'ang / /sā li nyid ni skye mi 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig lha yi srid par ni/ /rtag tu sdig pa byed pa na/ /mthar ni sdeg pa'i dbang gis de/ /dmyal ba nyid du nges par 'gyur/ /lha yi srid pa min par yang / /'ga' zhig bsod nams byed pa na/ /mthar ni bsod nams dbang gis de/ /lhar ni nges par 'gyur ba'o/ /khye gang sdug bsngal la gnas shing / /bya rog bkres par gnas pa ni/ /khye dang bya rog so so'i bdag /khyi dang bya rog gis mi 'gyur/ /long ba nyid dang 'on pa dang / /de bzhin lkugs pa sgur 'khyogs dang / /ma 42—595

ning nyid dang dbang po nyams/ /'gyur ba 'ga' yi bsam pas min/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthu rnams ni/ /rje bo nyid kyis 'gyur ma yin/ /sngon gyi sdig pa'i mthu rnams ni/ /khol po nyid kyis 'gyur ma yin/ /sngon gye bsod nams mthu rnams ni/ /lha rnams kyis kyang 'gyur ma yin/ /sngon gyi sdog pa'i mthu rnams ni/ /dmyal ba nyid kyis 'gyur ma yin/ /skyes bu'i sngon gye las 'bras te/ /gza' dang rgyu skar don med pa'o/ /ba shiṣ+ṭhas byin dus sbyor rmis//dzān ka bu mo sdug bsngal snod/ /dus sbyor gyis ni sī ta bde/ /ldan min gnam stong mthu yis ni/ /'thab dka' rnam par ①rgyal min te/ /'jig sde yis ni phye mar brlags/ /skad cig gang la mi skyong dang / /lha rgyal lha yi bdag po skyes/ /de nyid la ni 'bangs dang ni/ /'bangs kyi khol po rnams kyang ngo / /skad cig gcig la skyes rnams kyi/ /skyes rabs tha dad tha dad 'bras—/ /rang rang las la nyer spyod pas/ /de rnams 'bras bu gabyug ma yin—/ /g.yul dang nags bsregs pa dang ni/ /nya pas rgya ni bcings pa las—/ /gang gis lus can mang po rnams/ /cig car du ni 'chi bar 'gyur//gang zhig sdig pas dbul po dang / /rtag tu dbang nyams sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min dbang po 'am/ /de yi bde ba ster ba min/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'byor ldan dang / /lus rdzogs kun du bde ba dang / /gsang dbang srin po'i dbang po 'am/ /de yi nor rnams 'phrog ma yin/ /ye shes gsod pa po yi phyir/ /ye shes kyis ni sdig pa 'joms/ /mtho ris tshangs sogs lha rnams kyi/ /tshe yi tshad ni rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje'i sku lus dang ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po dang mtshungs pa'i/ /skye 42—596

bo gzhan lta ci zhig sems/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /rje bo nyid ni rā mar nges/ /sngon gyi sdig pa'i mthu yis ni/ /mkha' khyim kyi ni mngag gzhug pa'o/ /lha yi rje bor rā ma ṇa/ /dmod pa byin pa des don med/ /phyi nas tshe ni zad pa yis/ /lha ni rā ma shi ba'o/ /sngon gyi sdig pa'i mthu yis ni/ /stobs ldan bcings te gnas pa'o/ /seng ges mngal du gzhag ①pa yang / /sdug bsngal las kyis spel pa'o/ /yā ma asne'i gzhu yi sgras/ /khengs med grags pa zad pa'o/ /yul dbus nas ni nges 'byung nas/ /kom ka nar zhugs mi dge bas/ /rgyal srid nyams nas nags su zhugs/ /chung ma'i sdug bsngal bar med cing / /chu skyar sogs la rā ma yis/ /lam 'dri mi dge'i las kyis so/ /yul dbus yongs su dor nas ni/ /go pa maṇ+ḍa lar zhugs shing / /nag po yis ni g.yul la ni/ /kha lo ba yang mi dge'i las/ /mi dge'i las kyis sangs rgyas kyisasde/ /zhabs kyi mthe bo nang skyes dang / /bram ze'i mgo bo bcad pa dang / /tshangs dang 'phrog byed dag kyang bsad/ /sa gang rdul phran bsags pa ste/ /de ni tshangs pa gdong bzhi min/ /chu gang rdul phran bsags pa ste/ /de ni khyab 'jug phyag bzhi min/ /me gang rdul phran bsags pa ste/ /de ni drag po mig gsum min/ /rlung gang rdul phran bsags pa ste/ /de ni dbang po gdong lnga min/ /nam mkha' dngos med nges grol ba/ /rtag zhing phyag bcu ldan pa min/ /de rnams gzhan gyis byas pa'ang min/ /gang phyir mo sham bu bzhin no/ /smig rgyu'i chu la khrus dang ni/ /nam mkha'i me tog mgor byas nas/ /ri bong rwa yi gzhu 'dzin pa'i/ /mo sham bu 'di gang du 'gro/ /phung po lnga ni rgyal dbang pos/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga ru 42—597

brjod—/ /phung po lnga ni lha la sogs/ /lha sogs lnga po nyid rnams so/ /phung po lnga ni phyugs rnams te/ /phyugs rnams lnga po nyid rnams so/ /phung po lnga nyid mi rnams te/ /mi rnams lnga po nyid rnams so/ /de ltar sa sogs khams rnams dang / /dbang po dang ni yul rnams dang / /las kyi dbang po thams cad dang / /de bzhin las dbang bya ba'o/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sems can kun/ /lus can lus su gnas rnams kyi/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor rnam pa ste/ /tshim pa nyid du ji ltar min/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor zhes brjod de—/ /byang chub sems ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /bha ga dkyil 'khor zhes par brjod / /dkyil 'khor gsum du brtag ①pa'o/ /phung po lnga ni rgyal ba'i sku/ /byang chub sems dpa' khams rnams so/ /las kyi dbang po'i bya ba rnams/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams su bsgrags/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams rtsa rnams te/ /dpa' bo so dang sen mo sogs/ /lus nyid med na de rnams med/ /bsod nams sdig pa gang lar med/ /nya pa'i rigs kyi phung po rnams/ /nya la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs/ /gsod po bsad bya de rnams kyang / /thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa nyid/ /kha ṭī ga sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /ra la sogs pa'i khams rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mkha' 'gro/ /bsad cing zos pa min pa ci/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas e ma chos e ma'o chos rnams ston pa po/ /legs par byas pa byen pa des/ /srin po dang ni bdud kyi ris/ /lus rnams lhar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams dang / /lha rnams kyi ni longs spyod de/ /de rnams lus can yongs su bsgrags//zan dang chu dang sgon me sogs/ /mchod pa'i rdzas su yongs su bsgrags/ /42—598

'di rdzas lha rnams mchod pa ste/ /lus can lus ni lha ma yin/ /lus dor 'gro ba'i lus can ni/ /'di ltar khyim dor khyim byas nas/ /gzhan gyi gnas ni sar par ni/ /bde sdug nye bar spyod pa'o/ /re zhig srog ldan bde srog ldan—/ /'chi bar mi nus pa ni med/ /lus ni thal bar gyur pa'i tshe /slar yang log nas 'ong ba gang / /lha yi rgyal po'i blon po yis/ /'di ni bden pa'i ngag tu brjod/ /lus ni thal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /gang la sbar yang 'gro ba med/ /me yis thal bar gyur pa na/ /lus ni 'ong ba med pa'o/ /de lus phyi rol gyur pa yis/ /de tshe lus can 'gyur ba ci/ /me yis thal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /khyem du 'ong ba med pa'o/ /de khyim phyi rol gyur pa na/ /de tshe khyim par 'gyur ba ci/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag med pa/ /sems dpa'i phung por rab tu bsgrags/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyer spyod pa/ /rtag tu kun rdzob 'khor ba'o/ /dgongs pa'i skad dang dgongs min dang / /ji bzhin sgra dang de bzhin min/ /nges pa'i don dang drang don dang / /rgyud ni mtha' drug mtshan nyid do/ /tso ra'i sgra ni 'jig rten 'gar/ /zan gyi don rab rtogs par byed/ /la lar chom rkun pa nyid brjod/ /de bzhin rgyud du bstan pa rnams—/ /kar ṇa ṭa pa'i kar ṇa'i sgras/ /rdo dang rkang par dran pa dang / /la lar 'on par brjod pa ste/ /de bzhin rgyud rnams su bstan pa'o/ /khyim pa yi ni chos rnams la/ /mkhas pa ma yin mkhas zlos sems/ /'di ni 'jig rten lhung ba ste/ /'dus byas sgra yis spel ba'o/ /mi yi sgra gang don la ni—/ /gal te yang ni gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra/ /mi dang gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra dag las/ /dbye ba'i don ni bshad pa med/ /'ga' zhig tu ni mang po'i sgra/ /don gcig la ni 42byed599

brjod pa'o/ /la la zhig tu sgra gcig ni/ /sna tshogs don la gsungs pa'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas gzugs sku gang / /de bzhin chos kyi sku la min/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas phung po lnga/ /de bzhin tshul khrims sogs la min/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas res gza' bdun/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bdun po min/ /ji ltar sems can kun sangs rgyas/ /de ltar ljon shing sogs la min/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas stong nyid gsal/ /de ltar mun pa'i mkha' la min/ /mkhar snang rtogs par byed pa ste/ /mkha' dang mun stug gnyid dang ni/ /gnyid stug song ba rnams la yang / /mi bzad grang dang dro ba'i rlung / /bsam pa thams cad yod min par—/ /rtogs par bya'o lus can rnams/ /ljon shing rtag par srog ldan na/ /yal ga gcig ni srog rnams spangs/ /bcad nas sa la btsugs pa na/ /shing gang skye ba ga la zhig /lag pa rkang pa bcad pa na/ /skyon med rab tu skye ba min—/ /srog med zhig ste song ba na/ /rang lus srog ni 'jug pa'o/ /ji ltar sen dha ba yi sgra/ /ral gri rta dang lan tshwa gos/ /de bzhin te ru ka yi sgra//mkha' 'gro ye shes bde thub pa'o/ /dzaḥdzaḥ'adir spyon myur bar ni/ /kha kha gsol cig gtor chen po/ /zung cig zung cig yi dwags che/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka'/ /lus la ye shes chen po'i gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba ser/ /bde ba nag po bde ba dkar/ /bde bas thams cad khyab pa ste/ /'jig rten gsum po sku ru brjod/ /gdul ka ①'dul ba po yi gzugs/ /gdug pa gang 'di thub pas mdzad/ /de 'di sgyu ma'i gzugs nyid de/ /skyob pa'i sku yi rang bzhin min/ /dbang po gnyis 42—600

skyes bde de nyid/ /tha shal mi dga' ①smra bar byed/ /de nyid bde ba chen por yang / /rgyal ba mchog gis ma gsungs so/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung las byung ba/ /gal te bde ba cher 'gyur na/ /g.yan pa phrugs pa las byung de/ /ji ltar bde ba chen po min/ /las kyi phyag rgya g.yon can dug /ye shes phyag rgya de bzhin te/ /rnam par rtog ma dor byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po nges brten byos/ /phyag rgya che dang rab 'grogs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'gyur med bde'o/ /'jig rten gsum spyod las grol bar/ /ji ltar dbang po gnyis skyes 'gyur/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba dag /kun du bsdus par byas pas kyang / /mchog gi rdo rje'i phra mo yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /chos 'di yi ni bde ba yang / /rim pa de rnams bkag pas so/ /khyod kyis phyin ci log dor bya/ /rgyud dang rgyud na rgyal po kye/ /zhes pa rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag par legs pa'i chos yongs su brtag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog don du/ /phung po khams sogs bstan pa ste/ /skal pa chen pos de yang gzhom/ /sems tsam la ni rnam par gnas/ /'di rnams thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /gang zhig thub pas bstan pa ni/ /'jigs pa yongs su 'phrog don du/ /ngal bso'i phyir te de nyid min/ /rnam shes spru ba thams cad dang / /rjes shes rig byed mtha' smra ba/ /thams cad rnam par shes tsam ste/ /thams cad tshangs pa'i rang bzhin min/ /chu la khyab 'jug sar khyab 'jug /khyab 'jug ri yi rtse mo la/ /'bar phrang ①rigs la 42—601

khyab 'jug ste/ /khyab 'jug 'gro kun rang bzhin nyid/ /chu la sangs rgyas sar sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas ri yi rtse mo la/ /'bar phreng rig ①la sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas 'gro kun rang bzhin nyid/ /tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje ste/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /rgyal po thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /de yang khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che/ /thams cad khyab 'jug rang bzhin dang / /thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin min/ /skyob pa'i sngags kyi theg pa la/ /'dis ni ring du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /khyab 'jug khyab 'jug la gnas shing / /khyab 'jug khyab 'jug gis za dang / /khyab 'jug khyab 'jug lag pa la/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na 'ong / /sgyu ma chen mo drag chen mo/ /'byung dang sdud par byed pa mo—/ /rang gis 'phrog cir rang gis byed/ /rang nyid rgyal po rang gtso bo/ /phyag 'tshal bzung bya 'dzin po dang / /gsad bya dang ni gsod po dang / /bi shi bil+la'i sngags ched du/ /khyab 'jug 'jigs byed skyob phyir ro/ /gsad bya gsod po gang de dang / /bza' bya za po gang de yang / /gsad bya gsod pa po med na/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig 'bras med/ /ji ltar bum pa bum pa la / /nam mkha' khyab par yang dag gnas/ /gcig bdag khyab pa mkha' bzhin du/ /lus dang lus la de bzhin gnas/ /ji ltar bum pa chag pa na/ /nam mkha' gang du'ang g.yo ba med/ /de bzhin lus ni zhig pa na/ /khyab bdag g.yo ba med pa'o/ /g.yo ba rnam par nyams na de'i/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro med ce na/ /bsod nams sdig pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /slar yang bde dang sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /phyi bdag gyur pa 'byung bo de'i/ /nang gi bdag nyid dbang po bcu/ /mchog gi bdag nyid yid shes pa/ /bzhi po 'gro dang 'ong 42—602

ba'o—/ /lus gnas rkang par gnas pa dang / /gzugs gnas gzugs ni spangs pa ste/ /thams cad byed po gzhan gyur na/ /de tshe gcig gis byas pa nyams—/ /sad pa rmi lam gnyid 'thug dang / /bzhi pa'i gnas skabs gnyis med gzhan/ /'dod pa ye shes bya ba nus/ /lus can rnams la mkha' gzhan nyid/ /bya ba lus can rnams kyi lus/ /byed po mkha' gzhan yod ma yin—/ /bu ldan rnams la bu nyid de/ /'gro gsum mo sham bu nyid de/ /gcig bdag kun 'gro rtag tu ni/ /bya bcas yul rnams spangs pa ste/ /brtan g.yo rnams la mkha' bzhin du/ /thams cad la ni rnam par gnas/ /gcig bdag kun 'gro mkha' bzhin du/ /gal te lus la gnas pa na/ /de tshe btsun mor sbyor bral bas/ /sdug bsngal kun 'gro'i bdag nyid min/ /mya ngan me yis bsregs pa na/ /ji ltar rtag tu rnam 'gyur med/ /gal te dus kun bya bar bcas/ /gnyid kyi gnas skabs ji ltar 'gro/ /gal te rab tu ston bral ba/ /bde dang sdug bsngal ji ltar spyod/ /'ga' zhig rdzas ni lta ba na—/ /ji ltar snang ba'i lag spangs bzhin/ /sems dang ye shes spangs pa yis—/ /shes bya med par rab 'gyur na/ /stug po'i gnyid du song la 'di'i//shes dang shes bya zad par 'gyur/ /sad pa'i skabs song sangs rgyas te/ /thams cad mkhyen par yongs su bsgrags/ /thams cad rig cing nges grol ba/ /mun pa'i gnas skabs med pa'o/ /gang yang gnas skabs 'di rnams ni/ /rnam shes bzhin du stong par brjod/ /slar yang 'jig rten gnas med ces/ /mred par smra don phyin ci log /gcig nyid 'byung po'i bdag nyid de/ /lus dang lus la rnam par gnas/ /rnam gcig rnam pa mang po nyid/ /mjong ba 42—603

chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /ji ltar mkha' dang chu la yang / /zla ba rab mthong de bzhin du/ /'gro gsum 'byung po'i tshogs pa la/ /kha dog du mar yang dag gnas—/ /kha dog du ma'i dbye ba yis/ /nor bu sna tshogs gzugs su 'gyur//yang dag gnas la dbye ba med/ /sna tshogs su rab tu grags/ /chu med na ni chu'i zla ba/ /thams cad med gyur ji lta ba/ /de bzhin lus can med na yang / /'byung po'i bdag nyid kun med 'gyur/ /mngon sum nam mkhar zla ba dang / /cha bcas cha med nyi ma dang / /cha bcas cha med dngos po rnams/ /ji ltar dngos med de bzhin med/ /mngon sum ljon shing cha shas bcas/ /grib ma de nyid cha shas med/ /rtag tu nyi ma cha shas bcas/ /'jig rten nyi ma'i cha shas med / /gang zhig gdugs kyi grib ma de/ /nges dben de ni cha shas med/ /rnam pa kun du cha med 'gyur/ /sna tshogs khyab pa gang de med/ /phan tshun rnam pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ /gzugs med gzugs dang ldan mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha' bum min gzugs min te/ /bum min gzugs min nam mkha' min/ /gcig ni du ma nyid mi 'gyur/ /du ma yang ni gcig pa nyid/ /phra mo sbom po nyid min te/ /sbom po yang ni phra mo nyid/ /cha med pa la cha yod min/ /gal te yod na cha med cing / /mo sham bu dang ldan mi ①'gyur/ /bu dang ldan na mo sham nyams/ /dngos po med la sgom mi 'gyur/ /sgom pa med la'ang dngos med nyid/ /zhi bas drag por nus med de/ /nyi mar ri bong nus pa bzhin—/ /nam mkha' med pas yul gnas min/ /lus gnas nam mkha' gzhan ma yin/ /nges par chos gnyis zhes bya ba/ /bdag dang bdag med de bzhin no/ /ji ltar mo sham bu med pa/ /de ltar nam mkha' med pa ste/ /bu 42—604

ldan rnams la bu yod pa/ /'khor bar lus can de bzhin no/ /yon tan med na thams cad med/ /yon tan yod na lha nyid yod/ /dngos po med na thams cad med/ /dngos po 'gro ba gsum la yod/ /lus can med na byed po med/ /lus can byed pa po la yod/ /lus can med na las spyod med/ /lus can spyod pa po la yod/ /mkha' mchog kun du 'gro mi 'gyur/ /lus can kun du 'gro ba yod/ /mtha' yas mtha' yas skye gnas su/ /rim gyis kun du 'gro ba'o/ /nam mkha' mchog la khyab pa med/ /khyab pa lus can rnams la yod/ /so sor rang rang lus la yang / /rkang mazil spyi bo kun du'o//so so'i nam mkha' de bzhin mkha'/ /nam mkha' yis ni bsgrubs pa med/ /ji ltar lus can de bzhin lus/ /lus can rnams kyis bsgrubs pa med/ /'jim bum byas pas skyes pa ste/ /bum pa byed pa gzhan yod min/ /gser dang dngul gyi bum pa 'di/ /gser mkhan gyis ni byas par nges/ /skyes pas bsgrubs pa skyes pa ste/ /byed pos de bzhin byed po la/ /mo sham bu ni mkha' mthar yang / /skyes dang ma skyes bsgrubs pa med/ /skra yi rtse mo'i stong phrag cha'i—/ /stong phrag cha shas mchog dran pa/ /brdzun gyi ngag 'di mthong ba med//bye ba'i char 'gyur min nam ci/ /skra rtse 'bum gyi cha shas gang / /ba spu'i rtse mo'i lus gnas pa/ /bcad pas gzhan gyi lus 'di la/ /sdug bsngal phra mo'i bdag nyid med/ /kun du 'gro bas khyab nyid kyang / /zad nas phra mo'i bdag nyid 'gro/ /nam mkha' las ni 'das pa'i lus/ /ring nas ring du 'gro ba'o/ /gang tshe skye med phyir rgyu 'bras/ /de tshe ri bong rwa las gzhu/ /skyes phyir rgyu dang 'bras bu ni/ /rtag tu dngos po rnams la 'gyur/ /skye ba 42byed605

gang phyir skye ba ni/ /gzhan las gang tshe dngos po rnams/ /gnas skabs rab sbyor 'di med pas/ /rgyu las rtag tu gyur pa'o/ /mngon du yod pa'i bum pa ni—/ /'jim gong la sogs rgyu las te/ /med na rus sbal spu las ni/ /rgyu med snam bu la sogs bzhin/ /dag pa'i sa bon las shing 'byung / /gang tshe shing las sa bon 'byung / /gnyi ga'ang rgyu ni gang zhig la/ /'bras bu med 'gyur min nam ci/ /de med pa la rgyu med pas/ /dbang phyug la sogs de bzhin te/ /dngos po so sor dngos med kyi/ /'byung ba yongs su grags pa'o//nam mkha' med pas mkha' mchog mtha'/ /de rnams su zhig gis ni mthong / /bse ru'i rwa las gzhu 'byung mod/ /ri bong rwa yi gzhu med do/ /dag pa'i srad bu'i yon tan ras/ /rus sbal spu yi yon tan min/ /lcags las rno ba'i mda' 'byung ste/ /nam mkha' las ni 'byung ba med/ /gzhu 'dzin bu ldan bu yin gyi/ /mo sham bu ni gang du'ang min/ /ji ltar shing skam rtsub las me—/ /de ltar rlon pa'i shing las min/ /til mar gtil ①gyi 'khrul 'khor la//de ltar bye mar 'ga' yang min/ /dri ni shing gi me tog la/ /de ltar nam mkha'i me tog min/ /rgyu med 'bras bu med pa'i phyir/ /las med dge dang mi dge med/ /'byung po 'di dag kun med na/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa med/ /bden pa gnyis la brten nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan te/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyis/ /kun rdzob tu ni yongs su bsgrags/ /kun rdzob med cing 'ga' med pa'i/ /rang bzhin rgyu med dngos po med/ /nam mkha' 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /song dang da ltar 42—606
