ba rnams ni/ /kun rdzob blo dang ldan pas ltos/ /med skye mkha' skyes me tog medaske/ /skye mched drug gi mtshan nyid can/ /las las rab skyes yang dag byung / /slar yang srid pa zhes su bshad/ /de ni mig yor lta bu'o/ /gang zhig sprul pa'i grong khyen dang / /sprul pa rnam par blta ba bzhin/ /las kyis sprul pa'i 'gro ba yi/ /gzugs la de bzhin yongs su ltos/ /chos bstan pa ni sgra rnams ni/ /gang yang thos pa'i spyod yul du/ /rab skyes nyan pos thos pa rnams/ /thams cad sgra brnyan lta bu'o/ /mnam bya myang bya reg bya ste/ /gang yang sred par bya ba'i yul/ /'di kun rmi lam mtshungs pa ste/ /nye bar thob pa ma yin no/ /mi gang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ltar/ /sems kyis nges par dbye bya zhing / /bdag med lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /sems kyis de dang 'dra bar bya/ /sna tshogs brnyed ①pa gang de yang / /skad cig so sor byung ba ste/ 'di dag smig rgyu dang mtshungs par/ /mthong ba med na mtshan nyid med—/ /yid sogs sems las byung ba rnams/ /thams cad gzugs brnyan chuzla lta bu ste/ /rnam pa de dang rnam shes dag /phan tshun gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /bsam gtan pa rnams dag pa'i bdag /ye shes zla gang yang dag 'byung / /de yang chu zla lta bu ste/ /mngon sum du yang yod ma yin/ /rnal 'byor pa la'ang ye shes gang / /de bzhin nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /de phyir shes dang shes bya yang / /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /dang por phra mo'i rang bzhin med/ /gnyis par dbang phyug 'gro ba med/ /gsum par rig byed rtag de bzhin/ /bzhi par rang bzhin med pa'o/ /lnga par sna tshogs bdag med de/ /drug par dus gsum mthong ba dang / /bdun par phan tshun 42—607

sbyor ba dang / /brgyad par thams cad khyab nyid do/ /dgu par 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /shes dang shes bya'ang stong pa nyid/ /de ltar rnam dgu bshad pa rnams/ /lta ba'i mthar ni sgrub par 'gyur/ /rgyu 'bras bdag nyid thams cad dang / /srid pa gsum po las las skyes/ /brdzun lta ji lta de nyid yin—/ /gtan tshigs la sogs 'gal phyir ro/ /bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma pa'i/ /grub mtha' gang zhig chos sogs kyi/ /tshigs bcad sangs rgyas phyag rgyas btab/ /gang zhig chos rnams rgyus byung ba/ /lnga dang bdun du rab tu grags/ /ma rig la sogs rim pa bzhin/ /rkyen rnams so so'i bdag nyid do/ /nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal te/ /yan lag gsum gnyis bdun du grags/ /ji srid nam mkha'i khams kyi bar/ /phan tshun lcags sgogs ①bzhin du bcings/ /nyon mongs las ni las skyes te/ /las las sdug bsngal yang dag 'byung / /sdug bsngal nyon mongs de las las/ /de phyir slar yang sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad kyang / /'jig rten gsum bcas spyod cing rgyu/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu bkag na ni/ /'ga' yang mya ngan 'da' ba med/ /sems can gang zhig myang 'das pa/ /'ga' yang rgyal ba des ma gzigs/ /mya ngan 'das par myang 'das 'gyur/ /chos dbyings rtog par 'gro ba'o/ /gal te sangs rgyas myang 'das na/ /rtag tu ngu ba de nyid kyis/ /spos ldan du ni 'gro ba la/ /lam ni smra bar ci ltar 'gyur—/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sgon ma ni/ /thams cad du ni mthong med na/ /rtag tu ngu ba de nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mthong ba ci/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'bras nges par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'bras zad pa med/ /gang 42—608

tshe go 'phang zad med gsungs/ /de tshe dul bar cis mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe tshangs pa'i go 'phang rtag /de tshe tshangs rnams ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang tshe khyab 'jug go 'phang rtag /de tshe khyab 'jug rnams cir 'gyur/ /gang tshe drag po'i go 'phang rtag /de tshe drag po rnams cir 'gyur/ /gang tshe brgya byen go 'phang rtag /de tshe brgya byin rnams cir 'gyur/ /gang tshe sa skyongs go 'phang rtag /de tshe sa skyongs rnams cir 'gyur/ /gang tshe skye bdag go 'phang rtag /de tshe skye dgu'i bdag cir 'gyur/ /gang tshe rje bo'i go 'phang rtag /de tshe rje rnams ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang tshe 'bangs kyi go 'phang rtag /de tshe 'bangs rnams ji ltar 'gyur/ /de ltar la sogs gzhan la yang / /go 'phang thams cad mi rtag dang / /go 'phang rtag par 'gro gsum du/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /'khor ba'i thog mtha' 'di rnams su/ /sems can mya ngan 'das pa med/ /gal te 'khor ba'i thog mthar ni/ /sems can med na mya ngan 'das/ /sngon med phyi ma med pa dang / /ring du rdzas rnams phyung ba yis/ /rtag tu rdzas kyis snod gang ba/ /zhes pa bden tshig ma yin no//'bigs byed ri yi smyug ma mes/ /bsregs na slar yang 'byung ba med/ /de las gzhan yang skye 'gyur bas/ /smyug ma rtag pa ma yin no/ /phung po rnams ni ye shes mes/ /bsregs na be+er yang 'byung ba med/ /de las gzhan yang skye 'gyur bas/ /phung po rtag pa ma yin no/ /bsregs pa yang dag yongs dor na/ /smyug ma slar yang skye bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig pa'i mthus/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro ma yin nam/ /bsregs pa'i lus ni yongs dor nas/ /be+er yang lus ni skye bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig pa'i 42—609

mthus—/ /bde 'gro dang ni ngan 'gror 'jug /phra rab bsags pa'i cha la ni/ /phyi rol phyi rol gang zag yod/ /khur khur gang zag phan don du/ /rtag dang mi rtag med de bzhin/ /gzugs gzhan zhes pa gsungs pa ni/ /rdul phran lus su de med cing / /tshor ba la sogs de bzhin gzhan/ /thal bar gyur pa de med do/ /bug pa med pa'i lus la ni/ /sha dang rus pa khrag med cing / /dbang po'i gzhu yi rnam pa lta'i/ /sku mthong ba dang ldan par 'gyur/ /nad med mi gtsang 'phel med pa'i/ /lus kyi rang bzhin mchog la ni/ /srid par skye rga 'chi ba dang / /thog med 'gag pa med pa'o/ /shi nas dri za'i sems can la/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin gzhan pa ni/ /grib ma sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dag pa'i 'pho ba slar yang 'byung / /a sogs ka sogs zla nyi yi/ /dbus su mtshan ma gang de dang / /lhan cig skyes dgar yang dag ldan/ /de nyid sems can rnams la bshad/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a yig byung / /a yig yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen 'gyur med dam pa yin/ /srog chen po ste skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed—/ /rigs gsum rigs lnga nyid dang ni/ /rang bzhin kyi ni rigs brgya dang / /bzhi dang lnga yi rigs gsungs shing / /rigs gsum gsang ba gsungs pa'o/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gsang ba dang / /rigs mchog rnam pa brgya po ste/ /gang phyir phung po'i rigs lus la/ /khams rnams nyams par gnas pa'o—/ /srog dang khu ba rdul nyid kyang / /rigs gsum gsang bar gsungs pa ste/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gsang ba yang / /gzugs kyi rang bzhin rigs yin 42—610

no—/ /gsum las rigs lnga gzhan ma yin/ /de nyid rigs lngar 'gyur ba ste//gsang ba chen pos yang dag sbyor/ /rigs drug de ni rab tu grags/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /ro dang ro chen nyid kyang ste/ /khams drug rgyal bas gsungs pa ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med du'o/ /khams drug bdag nyid rab gsungs pa/ /skyes bu chen po'i gang zag ste/ /mkha' khams med pa'i sgra yis ni/ /dngos dang dngos med rab tu bsgrags/ /lag pa rkang pa bzhi po la/ /sor mo yang ni lnga lnga ste/ /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /sen mo'i mthar ni yongs su bsgrags/ /rdo rje'i spu ni myu gu lus/ /rdo rje'i spu ni lus gcig pu/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo sen mos btsams/ /rdo rje snying po lpags pa mkhregs/ /bzhi pa'i dga' ba bde ba yi/ /gnas skabs bzhi par rab tu grags—/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i dus la yang / /'khrig par 'pho ba'i skad cig la'o—/ /mngal du gnas pa'i gnas skabs su'ang / /bcu drug cha can ri bong can/ /zla drug tshad ni ji srid pa/ /de nas shin tu gnyid log skye/ /de nas rmi lam gnas skabs de'i/ /gsal bar srog chags rnams su 'gyur/ /yid las byung ba de la ni/ /de nas phyag rgya skye ba'o/ /skye ba la sogs yid kun la/ /mngal du sdug bsngal bar med de/ /sngon gyi sdig pa'i stobs kyis ni//byis pa rnams ni mi gtsang za/ /gnas pa'i zla ba dgu yi mthar/ /lus kyi khams rnams rdzogs pa dang / /skye gnas bug pas yongs dor nas/ /phyi rol sa gzhir 'gro ba'o/ /srog chags skye gnas sad pa yi/ /gnas skabs gsal bar skye ba ste/ /mig ni 'byed pa la sogs dang / /srog dang thur sel la sogs 'byung / /sprid sogs yal dang le lo dang / /bshang gci 'dor ba'i 42—611

bya ba dang / /sna yis du dang 'thung don dang / /khu tshur 'ching ba rnams kyang byed—/ /gang zhig kha yis za ba dang / /mngal gnas mi gtsang sogs pa dang //de gdong gcod dang de yi ni/ /sha za phyi rol lus kyi'o/ /tshangs pa'i kha yis bcad pa na/ /khrag 'thung yid 'byung min nam ci/ /dbugs kyi rkang pas gar byed gang / /srog ste ①te ru ka nyid do/ /sha za'i skye bo grol ba dang / /lha yi gnas skabs 'gro ba yang / /ma yis 'o ma 'dzin pa las/ /'o ma skyes pas tshim par nges/ /des na 'o mas byen pa yi/ /khams rnams rtag tu tshim pa ste/ /he ru ka yis bde skyong ba/ /sgyu ma chen mor rab tu grags/ /lha yi gnas skabs 'gro ba la'ang / /nya sha chang gi btung ba rnams/ /pha dang ma yis byes pa la/ /de yi go skabs sbyin mi bya/ /de bzhin bza' bar bya ba'i zas—/ /'o ma mar te sha med pa'o/ /bag ma blangs pa nyin bdun par/ /sha med snum khur la sogs so/ /shi na nyin bcu ji srid par/ /sha chang 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /pha dang ma dang gnyen sde yis/ /lha rnams so so'i cho ga'orka/ /lugs la'ang mi dang mi mo rnams/ /bsod nams don du lha chog dang / /sha za la sogs cho ga la/ /phyugs sha sogs kyang rigs la yod/ /rdul dang khu ba mnyam sbyor bas/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i srog chen po/ /srog chen po yis yang dag sbyor/ /khams lnga las ni yang dag byung / /khyab bdag dgu yi bdag nyid de/ /lag rkang dag las yang dag byung / /bcu gsum bdag nyid gyur pa ste/ /skye mched drug ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu dgu yi ni bdag nyid do/ /dbang po che ②ba las skyes pa/ /lnga lnga'i bdag nyid khyab bdag ste/ /de bzhin rigs lnga'i gnas skabs rnams/ /42—612

rtag tu lus can rnams shes bya/ /rkang pa lag par dum bu brgyad/ /rkang pa lag pa'i mthil bzhi dang / /sor mo'i tshigs ni drug bcu rnams/ /nyis 'gyur 'khor lo sdom pa'o/ /so rnams byung zhing skyes pa ni/ /'khor lo'i gsum kyi sdom chung ste/ /khams lnga mnyam par sbyor ba las/ /lus dang lus la rnam par gnas/ /bzhi pa'i dga' bde'i gnas skabs ni/ /mngal du gnas pa'i gnas skabs te/ /bcu drug lo ni thob pa na/ /de yi gnas skabs gsal bar 'gyur/ /sa bon gang las skyes pa yi/ /bcu drug khams kyi bdag nyid lus/ /de nyid las skyes sa bon dang / /khams rnams slar yang bskyed pa po'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa po/ /sangs rgyas sras po dam pa mchog /shes rab srid 'byung skye gnas te/ /chos kyi skye gnas srid mthar byed/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa cu ①drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /rnam dag mchog gi don rtogs pa/ /gang zhig pha las bde thob pa/ /de yi bde ba rang nyid bza'/ /bde ba gang gis 'chi ba na/ /de yi bde ba bsam gtan brjod/ /bha gar ling ga mnyam spyor bas/ /gang zhig khu ba las byung bde/ /de ni skye bo kun gyi srog /lhan cig skyes dgar rab tu bsgrags/ /'jigs byed rang gi grub mtha' la/ /rigs ④byed mthar ni tshangs pa yis/ /dga' ba tshangs pa yi ni gzugs/ /de yang thar par sbyor ba'o/ /gzugs mtha' yas pas de mtha' yas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par brjod/ /rang bzhin pa yi gzugs rnams ni/ /phra zhing chud pa bsags pa min/ /de bzhin tshor ba sogs de rnams/ /rtag tu mkhas pas shes bya ste/ /sems can mtha' yas de mtha' yas/ /shes rab pha rol 42—613

phyin par brjod/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po sangs rgyas ras ( med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs//dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /de bzhin slar yang gshegs pa nyid//'dis ni shes rab rigs pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs zhes brjod pa'o/ /'jug pa dang ni smon pa'i sems/ /'gro bar gnas dang 'gro 'gyur te/ /'ong ba dang ni 'ong med pa/ /gang gis chos kyi dbyings la gsungs/ /chos kyi dbyings su song ba yang / /gal te slar yang 'ong med na/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar nyid/ /bzhugs pa'i tshig ni don med do/ /bcom ldan zhes pa'i sgra yis ni/ /sangs rgyas med par rab bsgrags na/ /de ltar rnam dpyod tshad de la/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod par thub pa'i gsung / /cung zad bden dang mi bden kyang / /bden pa dbu ma pa yi lugs/ /nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag pa ste/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /bdag gis stong zhing byed po med/ /dbang skyes blo ni rnam med kyis/ /phra rab bsags pa dngos su rig /kha che gzhung gi chu gter gyi/ /bye brag smra ba'i gzhung 'dod 'gyur/ /shes pa rnam bcas bskyed byed ni/ /dbang po'i spyod yul snang ba min/ /mo sham bu dang nam mkhar mtshungs/ /'gog pa'ang nam mkha' mtshungs pa'o/ /'du byed bems po yod ma yin/ /dus gsum rjes su 'gro ba'ang med/ /thogs pa med pa'i gzugs yod min/ /zhes pa mdo sde pa yis rig /cha shas can zhes bya ba med/ /phra rab rdul rnams yod pa min/ /sgyu ma rmi lam nges mthong bzhin/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu snang / /42—614

gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam grol ba'i/ /rnam par shes pa don dam yod/ /ces pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung / /rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin rnams sgogs/ /rnam shes de yang don dam du/ /yod par mkhas rnams mi 'dod de/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang / /bral bas nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin/ /yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyi ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ /mtha' bzhi rnam par grol ba yi/ /de nyid dbu ma pa yis rig /nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag pa ni/ /nam mkha'i me tog seng ge'i rwa/ /mo sham bu dang gsum de bzhin/ /gang du rten cing 'byel 'byung ba'i—/ /'dus byas skad cig de min pa/ /'dus byas skad cig mi 'gyur ba'i—/ /rgyu yi bdag nyid med pa'o/ /bum pa rnams kyi rgyur smra ba/ /sa chu bum pa'i rgyu ma yin/ /'byung ba rnams las shing du 'gyur/ /'byung ba de rnams rgyu ma yin/ /'byung ba rnams kyi rgyu med de/ /'byung ba phra rab bsag pa rnams/ /phra rab rnams kyi rgyu la med/ /mo sham bu yis mkha' mchog bzhin//dbang skyes blo ni rnam med na/ /rnam med skye ba spangs pa ste/ /mo sham bu ni rnam med pa/ /mo sham med gang de bzhin med/ /gang zhig mthong ba phyi rol yul—/ /phra rab bsags par gnas pa ste/ /de rnams mthong ba dbang skyes khro—/ /lus can rnams kyi rab 'jug pa'o/ /rang gi rnam med shes pa'i rgyur//yod pa mchog tu phra rab ni/ /gang de yon tan med gyur rnams/ /ji ltar dbang po'i spyod yul min/ /yod min thogs pa med pa'i gzugs/ /gzhon nus me long la mthong ba/ /dus gsum rjes su 'gro ba kun/ /bems min blun po rnams kyis byas/ /me dag rtog ge med 'gal ba/ /de yang du mar 42—615

nyams 'gyur te/ /rgyur snang na yang de rgyu rnams/ /de 'bras sgrub pa ma yin no—/ /'phrul pa'i yul la'ang dbye bshad na/ /gcig dang du ma'i chu zla ni/ /gang zhig yod med de bzhin yod/ /sad dang rmi lam mtshungs don med/ /'khrul pa'i yul 'dir bskyed tshal dang / /khu byug sgra ni grub pa med/ /cig car dbang pos 'dzin pa yi/ /sgra yang don la 'gal ba nyid/ /chu zla gcig dang du ma rnams/ /rgyu gcig nyams na de med de/ /kha dog sna tshogs snod sogs kyis/ /chu la zla ba rab tu mthong / /skyon rnams yod pa rgyal dbang po'i—/ /gang zhig yod min de yang yod/ /sgyu ma med pa rgyal dbang po'i/ /brdzun tshig ji ltar de ma yin/ /ji ltar mi lam de bzhin sad/ /yod min don gyis don byas pa/ /rnam shes smra rnams sgyu ma dang / /rmi lam rgyu 'bras don med pa'o/ /lha dang srin po rnams la yang / /sgyu ma rnam gnyis rab tu grags—/ /rnam shes gcig pur yod pa de/ /mkha' la mig 'phrul ji bzhin no—/ /gzhan byi rnam shes zhugs pa na/ /rang gi gzugs ni yongs bsgyur ba//de yis yul ①du bsnun pa yis/ /srin po rnams ni ②shi bar 'gyur/ /kye yi rdo rje'i gzugs sprul pa/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /lang ka'i srin po gdug can sogs/ /sa la gso sbyong ldan par mdzad/ /ba shiṣ+ṭha yi gzugs sprul pa/ /rā ma ngan pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rā ma'i chung ma sī ta phrogs/ /lang ka'i grong du ma khyer ram/ /bram ze'i gzugs su sprul pa ni/ /bram ze 'dra ba ki dhī tas—/ /dhī ma ma gtogs skya seng rnams/ /bcings te ki nin ri la khyer/ /rā ma ṇa yis sgyu ma yis/ /ngan pa'i bdag nyid dmag tshogs mthong / /bdag gis srin mo'i rig sngags kyis/ /srin po du ma mthong bar 'gyur/ /rā 42—616

ma de bas gnyis gnyis su/ /bcad pa'i 'byung po sa gzhi la/ /mtshon gyis bcad cing bcad pa yis/ /'byung po 'byung po gnyis gnyis gyur/ /srin mo'i sgyu mar des shes nas/ /rā ma de bas bsams pa dang / /bdag gi seng ge'i rig sngags kyis/ /seng ge du ma rab tu mthong / /de yis rnam 'phrul seng ge ni/ /du ma sa dang mkha' la gyur/ /zos so seng ge de rnams kyis/ /phyogs phyogs srin po'i dbang po kun/ /bong bu'i shing rtar zhon pa yi/ /srin po'i dbang po ma zos mod/ /sgyu ma srin po'i bdag po rnams/ /rā ma de bas bcad par gyur/ /sgyu ma'i dmag dpung bsad pa ni/ /rā ma de ba'i sdig pa ni—/ /bsad dang skye ba sgyu ma ste/ /de phyir sgyu ma'i 'bras don med/ /chu zla ji bzhin sgyu ma dang / /mkha' la zla ba de bzhin med/ /mkha' la zla ba 'gribs pa na/ /chu zla'i gzugs rnams med pa'o/ /rmi lam dus la shi yang 'di / /lus can rnams la slar mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir sad dus gyur pa na/ /rmi lam 'bras don med de'i phyir/ /rmi lam chung ma brten pa yis/ /gang la bu ni skye ba med/ /sad dus gyur pa de bzhin te/ /de phyir rmi lam 'bras don med / /chu klung gang la khrus byed 'thungs/ /smig rgyu'i chu la de dag med/ /spyod kyis gang zhig dam bcas pa'i/ /don des don byed gyur pa med/ /nye bar mthong dang rab 'jug dang / /thob dang rjes goms bdag nyid de/ /gtan tshigs rnam bzhi sems can la/ /nye bar mthong ba tsam du zad/ /rmi lam stag la sems pa can/ /stag de bsam pa'i bag chags las/ /stag de rnams kyis bsad pa na/ /gang de slar yang 'gyur ba med/ /sad de gnas na stag gi ni/ /bag chags sems la mi 'gyur mod/ /gang phyir stag gis 42—617

bsad pa ni/ /gang du slar yang gom pa'o/ /rmi lam srog chags bsad pa dang / /gzhan gyi nor ni phrogs pa dang / /'dod log rnams ni spyad pa yis//dge slong pham pa ma yin no/ /sad rtse gsum po byas rnams kyis/ /lus can rnams kyis 'gyur ba nges/ /gang phyir dge slong pham pa yin/ /de phyir rmi lam 'bras don med/ /lus can khams dang phung po rnams/ /sad rtse ①bcwa brgyad dang ni gsum/ /rmi lam khams rnams gsum du bshad/ /phung po rnams kyang de bzhin gsum/ /'di rnams drug gis skyed pa yi/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gang gyur pa/ /rmi lam la de yid kyis bya/ /gnyid 'thug song la de med do/ /rmi lam yid kyis byas pa yis/ /shi na smra shes rnams kyis ni/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /dge 'dun pham pa byas pa yin/ /lus dang dbang po rnams dang blo/ /skad cig steng du gnas mi 'gyur/ /mar me'i 'od bzhin 'khor de rnams/ /phung pos skad cig dregs shing 'phyar/ /srid par skye rga 'chi ba rnams/ /phung po de la rim gyis 'gyur/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa rnams/ /cig car de la ji ltar 'gyur/ /'jig pa med pas skye ba med—/ /skye ba med pas gnas pa med/ /gnas med 'jig pa med pa yis/ /rnam par shes pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'jig pa'i skad cig skye min zhing / /skye ba'i skad cig gnas pa'ang min/ /gnas pa'i skad cig 'jig min pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa rab tu bsgrags/ /bsod nams skad cig sdig pa min/ /sdig pa'i skad cig bsod nams min/ /skye 'jig dang ni bde sdug dag /skad cig gcig la ji ltar yin/ /gang tshe skye med rnam shes pas/ /rnam par shes pa gzhan du 'gyur/ /ma skyes pa yis rgyu byed pa/ /de tshe mu stegs rnams 42—618

kyi lugs/ /gang tshe rnam shes 'gags pa las/ /rnam par shes pa gzhan du 'gyur—/ /'gags pa de tshe snang ba las/ /snang ba skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur//gang tshe rnam shes skyed pa las/ /rnam par shes pa gzhan 'byung ste/ /de tshe snang gsal de las ni/ /snang gsal gzhan pa skye bar 'gyur/ /des na gzhan pa de las kyang / /gzhan pa de phyir gzhan 'byung 'gyur/ /de ltar snang gsal 'phreng ba bzhin/ /rnam shes rnams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gcig las cig car shes pa lnga/ /dbang po rnams kyis phyes pa ste/ /de rnams las ni cig car lnga/ /shes na gcig pa brdzun min cing / /sa bon dang ni 'byung ba rnams/ /cig car myu gu rnams kyi rgyu/ /cig car sa bon 'byung rnams kyi/ /sa bon gcig pu rgyu ma yin/ /cig car du ni lnga rnams la/ /gcig ni phreng bar gang tshe 'gyur/ /so so re yi shes rgyun na/ /ci phyir shes pa rnams las 'gyur—/ /de ltar de rnams skad cig na/ /rgyun dang ldan pa rab tu nyams/ /cig car ba na shing rnams ni/ /chag na mi tshig mtha' med do/ /du ba me 'bar thal ba ste/ /de rnams rim gyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /srang gi dbyug pa mthon dman du/ /cig car du ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /dbyug pa'i 'khyog pa med pa na/ /skye dang 'jig pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /bum pa'i rnam pa rdul tshogs gang / /sa la lhung bas bum pa de/ /gyo mo'i rnam pa de ltar 'di/ /'jig cing skye ba bum pa'i 'o/ /lus can slar yang srid song nas/ /nyams de gzhan las min pa spyod/ /lus can snga phyir mi 'gyur na/ /sgom dang phra ba gang las 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gnyis med shes pa rnams/ /cig car sna tshogs shes 'gyur na/ /sngon po'i shes pa 'gag ①pa yis/ /ser po la sogs dri med 42—619

'gyur—/ /phyogs gcig la ni brten pa yi/ /shes la gnyis med yongs su bsgrags—/ /phyogs gnyis rnam par grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis med do/ /nag dang dkar po 'gag pa gang / /sems can yun ring bag chags rnams/ /sang dus la yang de bzhin no/ /mi rtag skad cig ji ltar yin//bag chags dang ni bag chags kyang / /sad pa na ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar gnyid 'thug song ba na/ /rnam par shes pa nyams par 'gyur/ /rnam shes kun gzhi rnam shes rnams/ /gang tshe lus dang lus la gzhan/ /mchog gi bdag nyid de bzhin 'grub/ /thams cad rnams kyi kun gzhir grags/ /rnam shes kun gzhi rnam shes rnams/ /rtag pa tshangs pa de ci min/ /skye dang rgyu ni de dag kyang / /mkha' gzhan de yis min nam ci/ /shing gi dbus kyi me ji bzhin/ /bye brag pa yi lugs la grub/ /de ni byed po rgyu gcig pu/ /mu stegs rnams kyi lugs gzhan yin/ /bzhi pa'i dus dang gnyid 'thug dang / /rmi lam sad par gnas pa yi/ /lus can zhig la srog 'jug pa/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /gnyid 'thug gnas pa gsal ①ba dang / /rnam shes med pa las byung ba'i/ /rab sangs rgyas kyis skye bo'i tshad/ /srog de srog chags kyis shes bya/ /ma rig pa las skyes pa yis/ /blun min 'gro ba blun por 'gyur—/ /mi shes skye bo ji lta ba/ /de ltar ye shes mig can min/ /nam mkha' rig pa las skyes pas/ /blun po'i 'gro ba blun min 'gyur/ /sna tshogs rig pa las skyes pa'i/ /blun min rnams ni blun med 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rig pa las skyes pas/ /sa yi gzhi la brtan par 'jug /sa min dbang du byas nas ni/ /sems can rnams la snying rje'i bdag /nam mkha' 42—620

rig pa las skyes pas/ /myur bar mig 'phrul du ni 'gro/ /mkha' dang ri bo med byas nas/ /pha rol rnams su rtag slong ba'o/ /'khor lo rig pa las byung bas/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rin chen rig pa las byung bas/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pad ma'i rig pa las byung bas—/ /pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ral gri'i rig pa las byung bas/ /ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i rig pa las byung bas/ /rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dngos po rnams kyi nus pa ni/ /tshad sogs bsam mi khyab bsgrub bya/ /skye ba med pa 'gag med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /sna tshogs don min don gcig min/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /gang zhig rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /spros pa nye bar zhi ston pa//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo rang las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang la yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /rkyen rnams bzhi ste rgyu dang ni/ /dmigs pa dang ni de ma thag /bdag po yang ni de bzhin te/ /rkyen lnga pa ni yod ma yin/ /yod pa min las rkyen med de/ /ji ltar mkha' yi me tog bzhin/ /yod pa'ang mngon sum nyid kyi phyir/ /dngos po'i rkyen ni ji ltar yin/ /rnam rtog las byung 'jig rten ni/ /rnam rtog sems las yang dag byung / /sems ni lus las yang dag byung / /de phyir lus la rnam par spyodarka/ /gzugs ni dbu ba lta bur gsungs/ /tshor ba chu bur lta bu ste/ /'du shes smig rgyu lta bu dang / /'du byed chu shing lta bu'o/ /rnam shes sgyu ma lta bu'o—/ /zhes pa gang rnams phung por bstan/ /sems can bsam pa'i 42—621

dbang gis gsungs/ /skad cig mi rtag smra pos so/ /skye ba 'am ni 'gag pa yang / /sems can tshogs la rab tu grags/ /rtag dang chad pa'i gzugs rnams kyang / /phra zhing chung ba min par brjod/ /dus gsum shes don cig ①min te/ /du ma'ang min par rab tu grags/ /mkha' snang ye shes tshogs la yang / /'ong dang 'gro ba med pa'o/ /ji ltar rnal 'byor spyod gsungs pa/ /ye shes med par smra la bstan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu ma'i lugs/ /de bzhin ma yin sras la gsungs/ /rta yi rwa rnams bsags pa med/ /nam mkha'i me tog bsags pa med/ /rdul phran rnams ni bsags pa las/ /lus nyid du ni mngon par brjod/ /bsod nams sdog pa'i rang bzhin sems/ /rnam rtog rtag tu srog chags la/ /de yi rnam rtog las byung lus/ /skye mched drug gi mtshan nyid do/ /nam mkha' med par rgyal bas gsungs/ /skye mched drug gi mtshan nyid ni/ /rdul phran rnams ni bsags pa yi/ /lus 'dir yongs su bsgrags pa'o/ /cha shas yod dam med pa zhes/ /phyogs gnyis yongs su bzung ba las/ /gcad bya g.yon can tshangs pa yi/ /rnam shes smra ba rnams kyis so/ /cha shas med na sbyor ba med/ /cha de cha yi dbye bas te/ /gang tshe phra rab rdul med na/ /de tshe 'gro ba ri bong rwa'o/ /phra rab rdul gyi cha drug ste/ /mo bsham rnams kyi bu nyid de/ /cha rnams cha yis dbye ba yis/ /cha rnams nyams par mi 'gyur ram/ /phra rab rdul kyi cha drug po/ /de rnams yang yang cha yis ni/ /cha dang cha yi cha drug kyang / /nam mkhar rdzogs pa min nam ci/ /rnam pa med pa'i rnam shes ni/ /cha shas med par yongs su grags/ /gal te rnam shes rnam par bcas/ /cha shas nyid ni 'gal ba'o/ /sngon dang 42—622

phyi ma'i dbye ba dang / /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i dbye ba las/ /drug tu phye ba'i rnam shes rnams/ /nyams par gnas pa min nam ci/ /zangs kyi snod du chu zags pa'i/ /cha shas med pa'i phra rab rdul/ /chu la me yis reg pas shes//phra rab rdul de cha bcas so/ /zangs sogs snod du bzhag pa na/ /seng ge'i 'o ma mi gnas te/ /de rnams nyid ni gser gyi snod/ /dri ma med par gnas par nges/ /ro dbang ske che'i tshad tsam gyis/ /zangs kyi khur bo bsgyur ba ste/ /cha med kun du med pa na/ /cha bcas nyi ma bsgyur ba med/ /'dir ni mang du brjod pas ci/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa las/ /'jig rten so sor bsgyur ba yi/ /ro yi dngos po rtog ges min/ /slar yang ye shes dngos yod ci—/ /dam pa'i don de rtog ges min/ /blo bur dri mas g.yogs pa yis /sems ni bsgyur ba so so'o/ /blo bur dri ma'i sems med na/ /ring po'i dus na sems med de/ /sems med skye ba nyams pa dang / /sems med gnas pa zad pa'o/ /gang tshe blo bur nyid kyis 'dir/ /sngon sems dri med de yi tshe/ /gang tshe ring po'i dus kyi sems/ /de tshe de yi srid pa gang / /gang tshe sems mred skye ba na/ /de tshe nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /gang tshe sems ni rtag gnas na/ /de tshe kun du thar ba med/ /gang zhig zangs kyi nag po ltar/ /ro yi sbyor bas nyams 'gyur te/ /sems can de nyid nyams mi 'gyur/ /dri med nyid kyis yang dag gnas/ /de bzhin sems kyi dri ma ni/ /stong nyid spyor bas rnam nyams 'gyur/ /sems can de nyid nyams mi 'gyur/ /dri med nyid kyis yang dag gnas/ /ji ltar ro yis phug pa'i zangs/ /slar yang zangs su 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin ye shes kyis phug sems/ /slar yang phyugs su 42—623

'gyur ba med/ /ro yis zangs ni phug pa na/ /'ga' yang zangs ni med pa ste—/ /ye shes kyis ni sems phug na/ /'ga' yang bag chags med pa'o/ /gser du zangs ni rab zhugs na/ /nag por 'gyur ba nges pa ste/ /las kyis mdze nang rab zhugs na/ /sems la yang ni mdze nad 'gyur/ /zla ba rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs gnas/ /ri bong mtshan ma nyams pa med/ /rdzogs pa'i sems kyi gnas skabs gnas/ /nag po nyid ni nyams pa med/ /nyon mongs bzhi po ye shes kyis/ /thal bar zad par byas min na/ /gzhan du sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /bzhugs pa'i go 'phang don med do/ /rang bzhin bral ba'i rdzas rnams la/ /rtag tu byis pa rab rtog byed/ /byes pa 'khrul pa 'dzin pa ste/ /sangs rgyas 'khrul pa spangs pa'o/ /rnam 'gyur mi rtag pa la 'gyur/ /rtag pa'i myang 'das gyur la min/ /mya ①'das be+er yang skye ba ni/ /ji ltar mar me med de bzhin/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba las/ /sna tshogs skye ba mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor bral bas sna tshogs nyams pa mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba las/ /shing rnams skye ba mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor bral bas/ /shing rnams nyams pa mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba las/ /lus rnams skye ba mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor bral bas/ /lus rnams nyams pa mchog tu med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba las/ /'byung po skye ba mchog tu med—/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor bral bas/ /'byung po nyams pa mchog tu med—/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba yis/ /sna tshogs cha shas mi 'gyur te/ /phra zhing chung ba sbyor bral bas/ /sna tshogs cha shas de rnams med/ /phra rab 42—624

rdul rnams sbyor ba yis/ /shing gi cha shas mi 'gyur te/ /phra zhing phra ba sbyor bral bas/ /shing gi cha shas de rnams med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi cha shas mi 'gyur te/ /phra zhing phra ba sbyor bral bas/ /lus kyi cha shas de rnams med/ /phra rab rdul rnams sbyor ba yis/ /'byung po'i cha shas mi 'gyur te/ /phra zhing chung ba sbyor bral bas/ /'byung po'i cha shas de rnams med//sna tshogs rnam pas gang su la'ang / /yang dag gnas pa phra rab rdul/ /sna tshogs bsregs na rlung dang ni/ /du ba 'bar ba thal ba 'ong / /shing gi rnam pas gang su la'ang / /yang dag gnas pa phra rab rdul/ /shing bsregs pa na rlung dang ni/ /du ba 'bar ba thal ba 'ong / /lus kyi rnam pas gang su la'ang //yang dag gnas pa phra rab rdul/ /lus bsregs pa na rlung dang ni/ /du ba 'bar ba thal ba 'ong / /'byung po'i rnam pas gang su la'ang / /yang dag bsags ①pa phra rab rdul/ /'byung po bsregs na rlung dang ni/ /du ba 'bar ba thal ba 'ong / /rlung gis bye ma sbyar ba la/ /skye med zad par 'gro ba med/ /bye ma ji bzhin lus kyi na/ /phra rab rdul 'di de bzhin no/ /sbyor ba dang ni bral bas kyang / /thams cad du ni phra rab rdul/ /skye dang zad las nges grol te—/ /mkha' la yang dag gnas par nges/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni mtha' yas pa—/ /mtha' yas 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i lus rnams ni/ /'jig rten khams su yang dag gnas/ /lus la srin bu mtha' yas rnams/ /rang gi las 'bras longs spyod de/ /srin bu gcig ni nyams pa yis—/ /gzhan rnams nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /lus gcig nyams par 'gyur ba yis/ /gzhan rnams nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /khams rnams 42—625

gcig ni nyams pa yis/ /gzhan rnams nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /zhing rnams gcig ni nyams pa yis/ /gzhan rnams nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /cig car skyes pa de rnams ni/ /cig car nyams pa med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang du yang / /sems can 'gro drug rnams su gnas/ /zhing tshig pa na zhing gzhan du/ /'gro ba las la spyod pa'o/ /mtho ris 'jig rten lha gnas dang / /lha min gnas su lha min te/ /dud 'gro'i gnas su dud 'gro dang / /yi dwags gnas su yi dwags 'gro/ /dmyal ba dmyal bar 'gro ba ste/ /bud med skyes pa mi'i 'jig rten/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos dbyings gnas su gshegs pa'o/ /'di ni chos so nges par chos/ /phyin ci log tu rab bsgrags pa'i/ /bdag med pa la bdag blo gang / /de khyod dor cig mi skyod kye/ /zhes pa rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag par bdag med pa yongs su brtag pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //lo rgyus dang ni shed bu'i chos/ /rig byed yan lag bcas dang gso/ /bka' yis grub pa bzhi po ni/ /gtan tshigs rnams kyis gzhom min lo/ /gang tshe bong bu'i 'jug ①ma yis/ /brgyan par byas nas mngon spyod pa/ /de bzhin bram ze'i lo rgyus rnams/ /nam mkha'i gos can pa yi'o/ /rig byed rtag pa lus med kyang / /gal te lus la khyab pa na/ /de nyid bzung nas grangs can rnams/ /'o ma'i rgya mtshor ji ltar 'jug /lha min dang ni grangs can de/ /khyab 'jug nya yi gzugs kyis bsad/ /de yang tshangs pas byin pa'o| /rig byed nya yi lo rgyus las/ /tshangs pa'i zhal las spros pa'o/ /mi 42—626

yi 'jig rten 'dir 'ongs pa/ /tshangs pa'i zhal du zhugs pa'o/ /dmangs rigs kha las dor zhes grags/ /rig byed zhig ste 'gro ba na/ /'dus ma byas shing khyab pa dang / /rig byed rtag par ji ltar brjod/ /gnyis skyes kha yis bklags pas so/ /dur bā sa yi dmod pa yis/ /'o ma'i rgya mtshor zhugs pa na/ /gang tshe lha dbang rdzu 'phrul las/ /khyab 'jug dbang phyug de tshe ci/ /dpal mo dang ni zla ba gnyis/ /lha yi dbang po'i min par bsgrags/ /dmod pas dpal mo zla ba dag /'o ma'i rgya mtshor ji ltar 'jug /stobs ldan gyi ni rgyal srid la/ /rgya mtsho lha dang lha min bsrubs/ /sngon dang phyi ma 'gal ba yi/ /'thad pa min pa mngon par brjod/ /gser 'od kyi ni rgyal srid la/ /lha min lha yi bdud rtsi zos/ /drag po sngon du mgrin sngon dang / /dug nyams spyi bor zla ba'o/ /khyab 'jug pad ma la yar ldan/ /mkha' la zla ba rtag tu gnas/ /stobs ldan srid la bsrubs pa dang / /man da ra yi bsrubs shing gang / /man da ra phyung de bzhin na/ /gnod sbyin sogs kyi khyem ni gang / /lha ma yin gyi lo rgyus kun/ /nyams te phug tu song ba'o /nam mkhar dor nas zla ba ni/ /'o ma'i rgya mtshor zhugs song na/ /gza' tshes rgyu skar sbyor ba dang / /byed pa sa la med par 'gyur/ /tshangs pa dbang po khyab 'jug che/ /lha gsum po ni gzugs gcig na/ /dbang phyug gi ni gzugs gcig gis/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bo bcad pa'ang ci/ /skra dang kaljo li kar bcas/ /hūṃ gi yi ge 'don cing 'don/ /bi bi go gas brgyan pa yis/ /bde 'byung khyab 'jug tshangs pa'o/ /'di ni bden pa gsungs pa ste/ /sngon gsungs don med min nam ci/ /lha gsum po ni gzugs gcig na/ /phan 42—627

tshun du ni 'khon med dam/ /lha yi rje bo rā ma ṇa/ /lha yi mchog ni ster ba dang / /gang tshe tshigs mtha' bden pa na/ /mtshon cha 'dzin pa nyid ni ci/ /dbang phyug gi ni bka' drin gyis/ /rā ma ṇa la bye ba phrag /phyed dang bcas pa'i gsum gyi lor/ /de 'dir tshe byin brdzun min ci/ /'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gsum dang / /khri phrag gnyis kyi lo rnams ni/ /rdzogs ldan la sogs dus bzhi yi/ /lo yi grangs su rab tu bsgrags/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /'bum phrag bcu bdun bshad pa ni/ /tshangs pa grub mthar rdzogs ldan dus/ /lo yi grangs su rab tu bsgrags/ /stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / /'bum phrag bcu gnyis brjod pa ni/ /gsum ldan khyab 'jug grub pa'i mthar lo yi tshad du rab tu bsgrags/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / /'bum phrag brgyad ni sa stengs su/ /gnyis ldan lo ma grub pa'i mthar/ /lo yi tshad du rab tu bsgrags/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /'bum phrag bzhi ni sa stengs su/ /rtsod ldan ma na grub pa'i mthar/ /lo yi tshad du rab tu bsgrags/ /lha dang sha za sbyin ma'i bu'i/ /gang 'dir rigs kyis dus bzhi'o/ /de rnams sa la rgyal po min/ /rgyal po'i phreng ba rab tu bsgrags/ /gsum ldan rā ma ṇa skyes shing / /gsum ldan rā ma ṇa bsad pa'ang / /rtsod ldan gnyis ldan dag dbus su/ /'thab dka' rgyal po bsad pa'o/ /der ni 'jig pa brgyas bsregs nas/ /'thab dka' brgya phrag gnyis na'o/ /rgyal po'i bu rnams gzhan pa yi/ /grangs dang tshad ni gyur pa med/ /bye ba phyed du de med na/ /dus rnams yongs su bsgrags pa yi/ /byed bcas bye ba gsum po ni/ /rā ma ṇa yi tsher ci 'gyur/ /rgyal dbang nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'gyur/ /'khor lo sgyur ba 42—628

de yi phyed/ /stobs bzang dang ni nor lha dang / /nor lha rnams ni so sor dgu—/ /sum cu rtsa drug mi rnams kyi'ang / /phyogs gos can gyis byas pa ste/ /sum cu drug gi lo rgyus kun/ /de rnams gdod nas rnam dbe+ed med/ /khyu mchog sngon du bur gyur pa/ /dang po mu stegs byed la grag /'khor lo sgyur ldan bu yang 'di'i/ /dang po bhā ra ta sa la/ /gzhu ni lnga brgya de yi ni/ /lus kyi tshad du rab tu bsgrags/ /rgyal phran rnams dang 'bangs sogs dang / /skye dgu rnams kyi'ang de bzhin nyid/ /rgyang grags rgyang grags mtha' yi grong / /bye ba bye ba'i rigs ldan rnams/ /bye ba bye ba'i thod pa yi/ /thod las pa rnams rgyang grags phyed/ /stong phrag sum cu gnyis gyur gang / /rang yul 'khor los sgyur ba yin/ /bye ba'i grong gis gyur pa'i yul/ /'bum phrag grong gis rang dkyil 'khor/ /de rnams yul du longs spyod pa/ /yul rnams tshad kyis rgyal phran te/ /yan lag bzhi yi dpung dang ldan/ /de rnams 'bangs la 'khor lo sgyur/ /'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yi/ /glang chen rnams kyi 'khor lo sgyur/ /rlung gi shugs ldan rta rnams ni/ /bye ba bcwa brgyad rnams su brjod//stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gi/ /na chung nyug rum btsun mo rnams/ /skye dgu rnams kyi bran g.yog sogs/ /de rnams grangs ni brjod du med/ /de yi grong khyer a yo rgya'i/ /chur ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis te/ /zheng du dgu pa rab bshad pa/ /thar pa mkhyen pa'i mig gis lo/ /yan lag bzhi yi dpung dang bcas—/ /'khor lo sgyur ba stobs po che/ /a yo rgya yi grong shong ①ba/ /brdzun tshig las ci de med do/ /grog sbur tshad du lag ldan gyi/ /khyu rnams shong ba bzhin du brdzun/ /byis pa rnams kyi smra ba gang / /de 'dra phyogs gos 42—629

can pa'i lugs/ /gzhu ni stong phrag gcig pa yi/ /lag ldan tshad du gang gyur pa/ /de tshe lag ldan nyal khang de'i/ /rgyang grags tshad la ji ltar 'gyur/ /de tshe rgyal phran la sogs dang / /na chung nyung ①rum btsun mo yi/ /khang pa'i shing gi dpangs rnams la/ /dpag tshad gcig pa tsam du 'gyur/ /bsgrags par nges pa'i sa gzhi la/ /sgo rnams thams cad 'phel ba ste/ /skye dgu'i tshad kyi thams cad du/ /gos dang stan rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /rā ma'i ri sogs brag rnams la/ /stobs ldan bisngu na la sogs/ /rnams kyis byas pa'i phug dang ni/ /byed pa'i dus rnams sa stengs grags/ /gsum ldan gnyis ldan rtsod dus la/ /ya ma ag ni'i bu sogs dang / /rā ma sogs dang skya seng ṭu sogs—/ /sngon gyi rgyal pos byas pa na/ /sgo yi tshad sogs mtshungs par 'gyur—/ /kun la lhag po 'ga' yang ci/ /sa la mngon sum mthong bas na/ /da lta'ang nyams pa med par gnas/ /de rnams yul dang ri bo dang / /klu dang mtsho chen de rnams nyid/ /sa yi gzhi la grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rnams dang yi ge'ang de/ /rig chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rin chen seng ge'i khri rnams dang / /a yo rgya yi grong yang de/ /byis pa sgur 'khyogs sogs de bzhin—/ /rā ma de ba'i mgul rgyan byi/ /phreng ba gcig pur rnam bshad pa'ang / /rtsod ldan dus kyi mgon po yi/ /mgrin pa'i tshad las lhag pa'ang med—/ /gangs can ri yi 'tshams rnams dang / /grong khyer grangs dang mngon byas pa'i/ /dus bzhi rnams ni grangs dang bcas/ /da lta'ang zhig nas song ba med/ /go ḍar 'bum phrag bcwa brgyad kyi/ /grong na lag ldan rnams kyi bdag /'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug grong / /yul dbus rta yi 'dren 42—630

pa yin/ /grong khyer 'bum phrag bzhi rnams kyi/ /mi yi dbang po lto'i lam la/ /gsum po de rnams sa la rje/ /glang chen rta dang mi bdag go/ /gzhan gang phra mo'i rgyal po rnams/ /yul dang yul la rnam par gnas/ /gsum po rnams kyi 'bangs kun la/ /de rnams brgya phrag re las med/ /nyi ma so sor 'jigs rung ba'i/ /'byung po ther 'bum dmag gis 'joms/ /yul rnams gang du longs spyod de/ /gang phyir yul sogs 'dir 'ong ngo / /gangs ri'i byang du sa skyongs rnams/ /bod sogs rnams su ba lang za/ /nub tu kla klo'i rgyal po rnams—/ /ba lang gnyis skyes rnams kyang gsod/ /bhā ra ta yis rnam bshad pashā/ /drang srong rgyas pas mkhyen gzigs nas/ /ang gā bang gā ka ling gā'i//rgyal po sogs kyis yongs su bsgrags/ /'bum phrag re yi lag ldan dbang / /rgyal po gsum la med pa na/ /phra mo'i yul du stong phrag ni/ /ka ling ka yir ji ltar 'gyur/ /phra mo dzā lan dha ra'i yul/ /dpag tshad bcu pa'i sa gzhi la//rkang par bcas pa greng ①'bum gyi/ /rgyal po 'bum phrag bcu bzhi lo/ /dpag tshad bcu pa'i tshad can ni/ /rgyal po gang gis sa gzhi la/ /rgyang grags phyed ni mtha' yi grong / /grong dang grong 'tshams med par 'gyur/ /der ni rgyang grags mtha' yi sdes/ /grong gi grangs kyang lhag par med/ /mkha' mkha' rig byed dus te 'di/ /rgyang grags phyed pa'i sa gzhir gang / /rkang par bcas pa grong 'bum gyi/ /der ni gnas pa mi shes so/ /de ltar bshad pa la sogs kyi/ /lo rgyus rnams ni bden par med/ /bhā ra ta dang rā mayi/ /snyan ngag mu stegs byas pa rnams/ /phan tshun rnam par 'gal bar ni//mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /zhes pa rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor 42—631

bstan pa yongs su brtag par lo rgyus dang snyan ngags yongs su brtag pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa yongs su brtag pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i dbang po grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gzhung gi tshad ni sho lo ka brgyad cu rtsa brgyad lhag pa'i drug brgya'i grangs so//'di ni sgra dang mngon brjod la sogs pa tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams la blo'i snang ba rgya ①cher rgyas pa bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dzi shrī dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i bka' drin la brten nas/ lo tsa bar gtogs pa shākya'i dge slong chos grags dpal bzang pos/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por/ gangs ri'i khrod du sngon chad ma byung ba 'di legs par bsgyur ba'o// //'gran phyir ma yin grags pa 'dod phyir min/ /ston dang bstan bcos dag la gus phyir dang / /dam pa 'ga' yi bka' yis bskul ba'i phyir/ /gangs can khrod na sngon chad med 'di bsgyur/ /'di las bskrun pa'i dge ba ci mchis pa/ /de yang 'gro ba'i byang chub don du bsngo/ /bdag kyang gang la gang 'dul skad rnams kyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la dam chos ston par shog /bod la bka' drin che ba 'jig rten mig /kun gyi phyi mo 'thon mi sam sgo ṭas/ /mdzad pa'i yi ge'i gzugs dang brda mkhas pa'i/ /yi ge pa dag gis kyang 'di rtogs ②shog/ //rnam par shes pas dpyod pa la/ /rnam par g.yeng bas g.yengs pa'i phyir//rnam par ma dag mchis srid na/ /rnam par byang ba rnams la bshags/ /42—632

/nge /ri /be+e /rislar yang bzang ldan da na pa gnas su rgya da dang gtugs pa zhus dag kyang grub par bgyis so// //brngur mchan/57༷ ①mar byang 'di chos ྈ 'di'i mar bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/571 ①〈〈pe 〉8sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉rasungs/573 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubab/58༷ ①〈〈pe 〉8/581 ①〈〈pe 〉tha/582 ①〈〈pe 〉misad/587 ①〈〈pe 〉7ra sde〈〈pe 〉rga/589 ①〈〈pe 〉khengs/592 ①〈〈pe 〉〉thug ④〈〈pe 〉la'i/593 ①〈〈pe 〉d+ku/594 ①〈〈pe 〉༅/ sne〈〈pe 〉mkha/ sne〈〈pe 〉ri'i/5/5 ①〈〈pe 〉mizlas/596 ①〈〈pe 〉7/597 ①〈〈pe 〉mizhag sne〈〈pe 〉tha/598 ①〈〈pe 〉thartags/6༷༷ ①〈〈pe 〉raka'/6༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉thaga'/ ④〈〈pe 〉sbeng /6༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉ṭhags/ ②〈〈pe 〉mong /6༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉dz+ran/6༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nyil/6༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉snyed/6༷8 ①〈〈pe 〉spog612 ①〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ④〈〈pe 〉ste/42—633

rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs//①༄4/ /dpal ldan mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas rdo rje tshig gis rnam par dbye ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal loske/ /gang gi dkar dmar rig byed zhabs kyis tshangs dbang rab bsnan nam mkha'i mdog can mgrin gsum dpung drug ldan/ /rgya mtsho'i zhal byi gdul bya la gzigs brgyad gnyis na tshod brgyad gsum phyag gis rnam rgyan gar byi rol/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gser kyi mdog can sna tshogs yum dang lhan cig rnam rol dus kyi 'khor lo la btud de/ /de gzhung dri med ye shes le'u'i zab don sbas pa'i rnam par bde chen rdo rje'i tshig 'di dbye/ /gang zhig khams kyi snying po bde ba 'dzin byed dge slong chen po yin phyir dam tshig gi sdom pas brgyan/ /rgas pa'i 'jigs bral rnam par mdzes ldan gzugs bzang dri med gzi 'od rab brgyan yun ring bde bar 'tsho/ /rdo rje'i sku thob mtshan dpes rab brgyan lha 42—635

dang lha min gnod sbyin gdengs ka mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdud/ /rgyal ba'i thugs mthong dmyal ba'i 'jigs 'joms de'i drung na rdo rje 'chang gnas gshin rje'i grong las ring / /byang chub sems nyams mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer bye ba 'jig ①'gyur lha dang bla mas bsgrubs la spyan mi lta/ /bde ba spangs phyir tshul khrims 'chal 'gyur dam tshig las 'das thub dbang slus pas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /gzi 'od rab zad rgud pas nyer gzir phrin las nyams shing dngos grub ring 'gyur rgas pa'i 'chi bas 'joms/ /rtsang ba'i bde bas ye shes mi mthong 'dod chags dbang gyur rnal 'byor lam min tshe 'dir 'bras bus 'gag /so so skye bo'i nyams phyir 'bras chang zag dang don tshangs spyod skam 'gyur don chung gla rtsi bzhin/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang ldan pas thig le don ldan 'gyur te mdzangs ma'i nor bzhin yon tan rab tu 'phel/ /rnal 'byor lam la yun ring 'bad kyang skad cig ②gis nyams lo zla'i 'bras bus ser bas bcom pa ltar/ /rdzas dang kha zas spyod lam 'khrul 'khor rlung dang dmigs pa gzhan lus sna tshogs 'di 'phel bya/ /tshad med snying rjes rab brgyan skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ①rgya chen sems dpa' gsum ldan sngon du stong ra bsgom/ /rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag gnyis mnyam gzhag lus srang mgrin pa dgug cing dpung mgo legs par brgyang / /sna rtser mig lta phyir la rlung 'bud nang du rngub dang skyar te 'gengs shing 'jug tu gyen la 'phang / /ro rkyang mi byed phra gzugs sten—/ /'dzin rtog med gang ba'i dbus der 'bar ba'i a thung la sems bya/ /me dang nyi ma lan tshwa spangs nas 'thun pa'i rdzas stan thog mar rang lus bsgom bya dge ba bsngo/ /tsha zhing gzer zug 'them chus lhag pa lus dang rtsa yi stong ra 42—636

bug pa rlung me chu sa bsgoms/ /nam mkha' sdig ①mdzub rdo rje rol pa seṅge rnam rol brkyang bskum rol thabs ri bong brgyad 'dzin dang / /ka ra na ste 'khrul 'khor 'di drug mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rdo rje'i gar bya drag po'i rlung gis 'bud//steng dang 'og tu lta zhing 'dug ste brtson pas 'bad na rtsa yis stobs lus kyi nad rnams 'joms/ /dbugs rngam rgod 'gag log 'tshub stor ba rlung dang ngag ste g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab steng 'og bug pa bsgom/ /stag lo'i sgyug stangs sbrul gye bya snyed rgod kyis lding thabs ri bong mchong 'gros rma bya'i mjing skor dang / /seng ge'i sprug stangs 'khrul 'khor 'di drug hā ri nyi thu hūṃ zhes drag po'i rlung dang bcas te 'bud/ /des ni log tshub ②stor ba'i skyon spong rlung gis stobs rgyas dag gis nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /'byam dus steng pa yid kyi skyon te nyams shing skam 'gyur chag dang zug rngu skyes pa thig le'i gag /sems shi bsdu phyir hūṃ gyur snar zhugs dbu mar thim ste gseng zhing 'phang bya gang 'dod yid la bsam—/ /gu gul nyungs dkar ①thal chen gri khrag dug dang rus chen sbrang mar gcan gzan lpags pa tsha ba gsum/ /'khrul 'khor dug dang rdzas sngags dmigs pas bzung bzlog dgram ste thig le'i stobs rgyas yid kyis nad rnams 'joms/ /me 'phreng sdong po rtsub shing 'khor lo sum 'gyur kun khyab me yi dkyil 'khor drod kyis bogs su 'gyur/ /rlung gi gzhu yis me yi mda' 'phang haṃ gi 'beb bcom lte ba'i snyoms 'jug yid 'phrog pad+ma dang / /steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo kha sbyar 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum yid kyi rig pa bde stong bogs su 'gyur/ /pad+mo'i phreng ba til gyi mar me mthing gi rgya mtsho rlung gi ba dan gsal ba'i bogs su 'gyur/ /lag pa'i phyag rgyas rig lnga'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rdo rje zhi bas gsor te dkar gsil ri 42—637

bong dbab/ /'og rlung 'then zhing sgo gnyis bsdams te gling bzhi bsdus nas rig byed sor mos lam gnyis mtshams su mnan/ /yid kyis phyag rgya yid 'ong la sems ting 'dzin g.yo ba'i bde stong dga' ba dang po'o// //mchog gi gnyen pos rtsol ba dor la dmo zlog cing lam gnyis gling bzhi rtsol med mgrin pa dgug /steng 'og rlung la 'dor len bya zhing chags pas mi 'phrog ting 'dzin ro snyoms rig pa haṃ la gtad/ /rdo rje khu tshur gling bzhi bsnyu zhing ngan 'gro'i lam dgag rgya mtsho'i ri rab la sbyar lhun po dgug /ro 'dzin nyi zla steng phyogs thur sel gyen la 'don zhing sems dang thig le nam mkha'i mthongs su gtad/ /lha dbang lhun po glang po sna 'dzin rnam 'gying rol pa rdo rje gtsug tor gyad kyi stobs 'dzin dang / /rtse gsum gdeng ka 'di drug nyig dang hūṃ gis steng 'og rlung bzung drag tu 'then pas bdun gyis 'drongs/ /sprug pa gar dang seng ge rtsal sprug rnam rol rnam 'arming gzhon nu'i kun spyod lha mo'i rol thabs kyis/ /ldang dang 'dug cing thams cad spyod ①pas sna tshogs lus sprug rab tu baṅgag cing dkyil krung gdan las 'phar/ /rlung dang bcas pas ro stod ro smad mgo dang dbang po yan lag bzhi ste gang 'dod gnas su dgram/ /thig le kun khyab ye shes bde chen ros gang bsgoms pas bzhi pa'i dga' ba rdo rje 'chang du 'gyur/ /bsgrubs 'dod slob ma theg chen rigs 'gyur gsang sngags la mos bla ma bzang 'dzin thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /dang po'i don du rnam bdun dbang sbyin mchog dbang bskur la slob ma byun bya skal ldan nyid du bsgrub/ /bla ma la gus blo bzang lang tsho ②brtson bcas gyur na gdam pa mchog sbyin dam tshig gi don du sten/ /rnal 'byor rtog bral dkar po mi nyams ting 'dzin rgyas 42—638

byed kun mkhyen thob phyir thabs dang ldan pas sten/ /gang gi dkar po mi nyams mi 'dor rnal 'byor pas ni rgyal ba'i bde ba bsgrubs phyir pho nya'i lam/ /dpal ldan 'dus sog ma lus rgyud du thub dbang rnams kyis yang dag phyag rgya sten par gsungs/ /dri dang tsan dan ud pa la dang sngon po ji bzhin zag bcas thig le bde chen ye shes gnas/ /rten dang rten pa sku dang ye shes yon tan 'phrin las khams gsum ma lus de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /dbang bskur dang bral ye shes yon tan dngos grub brlag 'gyur khrims 'chal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dge slong nyams/ /bla ma'i lung gis ma gnang de yi bsod nams rab zad mi dge rab 'phel skal ba'i dge ba 'joms/ /'dod pa'i dbang gis ri bong can zag 1nga ba bskyed phyir gang na 'dug kyang mya ngan sdug bsngal rgyu/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan bskyed phyir 'di las gang 'das sangs rgyas lam min dmyal ba'i gnas su 'tshod/ /gag sems 'dod pa'i dbang gyur mi gtsang bu ga la sten 'khrig pa'i ro myang mngal gyi grong du gnas/ /tha shal thar med mi dge'i 'bras bus chu tshag khol mar bskal par gnas pas go cha bgo bar bgyis/ /bsgrub po nad med lang tsho ①lus dar rtsa bzang brtson byas blo gros bzang ldan dbang gi rnam par smin/ /gsum pa'i dbang thob sngags dang rgyud kyi pha rol son zhing bla ma'i lung gis bsgrub dang skyon sel mkhas/ /dbang gi ye shes sngon du byas te rtsa dang rlung 'byongs thig le la dbang gnyen pos 'dzin nus shing / /rang 'dod la snyam rtogs pa'i rtsal gyis 'dod chags zil gnan tha mal chags bral bde chen ye shes sbyor/ /rgas shing rgud dang rmya dang gcong can zhig dang nyams pa bag med 'dod ldan yid mi 'jug phyir spang / /dbang ldan gzugs 42—639

bzang lang 'tsho bzhin mdzes ngag mnyen dri zhim bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u dmangs rigs gdol pa dang / /rig lnga'i rigs can lhan skyes sngags skyes glang sna can dang ri dwags dung can me tog pad+ma can/ /nu ma bsra mkhregs bde skyed rnam 'gyur 'dod pa'i sgra 'byin pad+ma rub cing dam pa'i mchog /kha sbyor bde bas ye shes spros bral yon tan 'phel byed 'dod pa dbang po yid kyis 'dzin nus pa//gzhon sogs yon tan bcu gsum mchog dman khyad par che ste smon lam dbang gyur rang gis byed pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems skyed sngon du tshogs 'khor dbang bdun bskur la thabs kyi phan yon rig ma nges phyogs bya/ /tha mal lus sbyangs skad cig pa lhar bskyed ye shes pa stem ①snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lha skur lta//lus la go cha'i lha dgod gnas gsum dag dang mkha' dang gsang ba sbyangs bskyed byin gyis rlabs nas ni/ /nags tshal ri phug dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la gcer bur 'dug ste bde chen rnam par rol/ /lha dang lha min gdengs chen sgeg mdzes 'dzol ②bag 'byings ldem rnam gzigs sdig 'gros rngam 'dzog ①dang / /gyad dang rol pas 'khril sbyor rab 'khyud mkha' lding seng ge glang chen rus sbal 'dug stangs bcu drug gis/ /rang sems nam mkha'i pad+mo la sems rig byed rtsa dang lam chen thur sel rlung bsdu dal bus bskyod/ /nam yang mi 'dor srog las gces 'gyur ba gzhan mi dmigs sgyu ma'i yul 'di spros bral dbyings su lta/ /reg pas stobs skyed lus 'dar skyig bun thig le g.yo bas gsal ba'i nyams 'di bde dga' dang po'o// //bsnun pas rlan 'byung dbugs rgod rtsa dang lus po g.yo zhing sprud 'gyur rab tu g.yos pas bde dga' gnyis pa'o/ /bskyod pas drod 'byung chags pa'i 42—640

sgra 'byen bde bas rab stsos rnam par rtog bral shin tu g.yo ba gsum pa'o/ /de las thal na dkar po nyams phyir tha mal nyid de bde ba med pas dga' bral bzhi pa'o—/ /ri bong can g.yo rtsol ba dor la dmig med kyis rig byed rtsa dang lam chen thur sel glod/ /steng rlung bzung zhing gzugs dang ro 'dzin bsgrad sgrims bdag sems nam mkha'i dbus su rab tu 'phangs/ /bde chen ma skyes rdzogs bskyed rtse mor mi bzung g.yo dang ro myong mi skyod rdo rje'i rtsa bar bzung / /gang gis zin tshe pad+ma rub 'gyur gtsug tor sra zhing stobs rtsal rnams rgyas nyams na de las gzhan/ /'og sgo'i gnas dang lto ba'i dkyil 'khor rkang lag mgrin pa lce dang mig ste 'di drug dbang du bsdud/ /de drug dang bcas 'khrul 'khor drug gis sa 'brug mkha' la ther zug bgrad cing steng rlung rab tu bzung / /gsang bar hūṃ gis bde chen 'dren byed rig ma zhu bas rdo rjes 'thung phyir haṃ la thim gyur de nyid 'phang / /hūṃ ring hūṃ thung hig dang bcas pas drag po'i sgra ldan gsum lnga bdun byis 'khor lo bzhir ni 'grongs/ /rnal 'byor pas ni sems g.yeng mi 'gyur ye shes yid tshim bde chen 'dzag med rdo rje ma 'gyel bar//zlog pas rdo rje'i ngar 'tshor sbubs su nub 'gyur lus sems dbang po yang dang bde mnyen nyams na gzhan/ /dgram pa'i gnad drug 'og rlung steng rlung bum pa can du sprug sig 'cham brdeb 'phar dang mchong rgyug bya/ /rtsa gnas stong dang bug par bde chen bcud kyis gang zhing mi rtog spros bral chos dbyings ngang du bzhag /gang gi khrems tshe lus po sgra 'byin ro bcud kyis gang bde dang mnyen 'gyur gsal dang mi rtog bskyed/ /dbab bzung bzlog dgram sna tshogs 'khrul 'khor man ngag ro ldan rig pa'i mtshon bsnun nyams dang bral na gan/ /42—641

yul 'di snang stongs sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar bltas la thog mtha' bar du ①dga' bzhi stong pa'i rgyas btab bya/ /bskyod pa'i tshe na g.yo ba'i bde bas rgyal ba mchod dang de yi ngo bo chags bral mtshan mas stong / /'dod pa'i rnam rtog rag ste de dag gi gsal 'gyur byang ⑤sems g.yos pas bde ba bskyed cing ma rtog pa/ /zag bcas bde ba skyed pa'i rnam rtog de ni skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong mtha' dbus med par lta/ /rgas dang bkres sam lus zung ma rgyas nad kyis gzir dang ngal dub rtsa ngan bde chen nyams par 'gyur/ /bskyod pa drag pos mda' 'phangs bzhin 'gyur bde bas rab myos 'dod la chags gyur gnyen pos ma zin nyams—/ /sman dang dmigs pa rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor kha zas spyod lam sna tshogs rig ma 'dug stangs yul gyis sgyur/ /thig le 'tshor 'gyur dngos sam kha chu bde med 'dzag cing lam gnyis zug rngu gshang gci rlung gi skyon/ /lus gnad drug dang 'khrul 'khor drug gis rlung bzung gar bya stong dang bug pa ku snye sprug dang brdung / /gnas nas ma 'drongs rdo rje kha chu haṃ dang ma 'dres spyod lam dang bcas bshang gci'i zhor la 'byung / /lam gnyis sdom dang gsang ba'i gnas lci gtsug tor 'bras bu gzer zug la sogs zlog pa'i gag rnams ni/ /skyil krungs 'theb 'dren rkang mthem phyir 'dren lag gnyis pus 'khyud sor bcu mthil mnon rdo rje rgyab lag dang / /lhun po mgrin dgug 'di drug mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon steng 'og kha sbyar gzung la 'phang zhing drag tu sprug /skran dang rde nad dmu chu skya babs skrangs dang sha khra khol bur na dang spu bye zas mi 'ju/ /lus phyed che chung skam dang 'phrad so yan lag lto ba 'phral spom lci 'gyur 'gram pa'i gag /rta yi bzhi 'phra lug gis stag sprugs spre'u'i shing rtsed khyi yis 'dur 42—642

mchongs phag gi 'jol rgyug dang / /byi la'i gab 'gros glang gi bseg brdung dgram dang brdung zhing sprug dang dku mnye stong dang bug me bsgom/ /pho bde zug bcas mo bde 'jam 'gyur zung 'jug bde stong bde chung yun rig ma spos la bsgrub/ /gzhon mdzes 'dod ldan chags pa'i dbang song sna tshogs gar bsgyur dbe+en par gcer bu pad+ma la lta zhing / /sha dang myos byed mkha' me'i bar rten snyoms par mi 'jug 'dzum dang reg cing lta dang 'khyud par bya/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor rdzas dang dmigs pa kha zas spyod lam mthun pa'i rkyen gyis phyung po rten par bya/ /'o dang 'khyud pa so dang sen mo pad+ma la reg bde ba'i rol rtsed sna tshogs thabs kyis rtsal/ /rgyal po'i dpung gi btsun mo'i pho brang dbus su mi gzhom dmangs kyi grong khyer mtha' nas bshig /dri ①dang rnam 'byung rlan dang dbugs 'byin chags pa'i sgra sgogs rtsa sna bstan phyir rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor bya/ /sems dang ri bong 'khor lo bzhir bzung byang sems 'dzin byed bde ba rgyas 'gyur ye shes mngon du bya/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya me long nang du gcer bu ltas te dbyer med rig ma sgyu ma'i gzugs su lta/ /chos rnams de bzhin ma chags mi 'phreng dze+estong pa'i yid kyis 'khor bas sgyu ma'i sprul par lta/ /bdag kyang ma grub bde chen stong pa chags bya chags byed 'dod pa'i yid 'dir dngos 'dzin mtshan ma zhig /dbang dang dkyil 'khor lha sngags rdzogs rim gzhan lus gzhan gyi sems nyid nges rtog sa bcu mngon du 'gyur/ /lus 'tshong ma'i byi ru sen n+d+ra ra dang me tog glang sna mtshal dang thig les zla mtshan rnams—/ /phye mar btags la snyoms 'jug rlan gyis cig tu bsgrubs te ku ru ku le mtshon gang tshad tsam bya/ /dri zhim gyis byugs mi yi phru ma leb rgan gyis 42—643

gril pad+mar bcug la bdun phrag gsum du bsgrub/ /de nyid phyung la brdar ba'i phye ma srin lag g.yon gyis gang la reg pa bdag gis dbang du 'gyur/ /khyi yi pho mtshan gar chang sbrang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu rdo rje la byug snyoms 'jug 'bral med 'gyur—/ /mi yi thod pa ga bur sbrang rtsi dha ru rtsa tu ra yis brdar la dpral bar byug na gzhan du min/ /byi ba'i bshang lam til mar byi'u sa ka ta'i sha khus chos 'byung byung na chung zhing 'dzum par 'gyur/ /lcam pa'i rtsa ba rab tu bkol te bzhi cha lus pas pad+ma bkrus na 'khrang zhing bsra/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes sa chu dug dang gri khrag gu gul rus chen mtshon rtse sbrang rgod tsha ba gsum/ /ra rtsi 'dod chung 'khrig pa'i sbrang chu tsha bdun gyis byug rdo rjes bsnun pas bha ga gzir bas mchog /thog mar oṃ brjod sri nyi dzhai ta lo ha di ni su tsa pu su byu sham r+ya zhe/ /kha dang rdo rje sngags kyis chu sbyin dkar nag thabs shes g.yas g.yon 'og tu 'dis ni srid pa chod/ /gser dngul ra gan 'khar ba zha nye khab len rdo dang zangs—/ /g.yas rtag tu srid pa chod/ /'khor lo lte ba mu khyud rang ming sngags dang phyi rim rdo rje dang bcas gnan pas srid pa chod/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes sa dang gci ba chu sdebs lam ka'i mtshan ma rngams bcad de mnan na rdo rje 'joms—/ /mda' lam mal 'og steng du me long g.yon du skyes pa gsang ba'i spu sbyin rdo rje zhi bar byed/ /bsgrub bya'i mi la bya rog 'ug pa khyi dang gla ba sngags dang sgrub pas mnan na mdza' ①'o nges par 'byed/ /bing ldog byi la'i phru ma lcags gsum gyis sgril rig ma'i kha ru bcug na de nyid mthong mi 'gyur/ /mdog dmar rmig pa sreg pa'i thal ba mtshal dang bsres la phyag rgyas btab na gzhan gyis spyod mi nus/ /go che shu thag dong kha pad+ma sreg pa'i thal ba rdo rje la 42—644

byug shugs ldan sgom zhing 'khrang / /mon sran rde'u gze ma 'bu srin bkol ba 'thungs na rdo rje 'khrang 'gyur bud med stong phrag dga' byed nus/ /a sho ka dha til gyi ①phye ma mar dang 'o mar sbyar ba zla phyed 'thungs na stobs shed rgyas/ /dbang po lag pa zho gnyis ka ra ba ti'i 'o ma dang bsres 'thungs na stobs dang gzi brjid 'phel/ /dpal ldan rgyud mchog rgya chen bla ma'i man ngag rab zab rnams las dri med bdud rtsi'i bcud bab pas/ /thabs lam man ngag rdo rje'i tshig 'byed me tog 'phreng 'dzin sbas pa'i gnad 'di don yod rdo rjes phye/ /de yi dge bas mtha' yas rgya chen mi nyung nges ni bde chen dbus su lhan cig skyes pas rab rakhyud de/ /'gro ba kun gyi skal pa'i lam chen tshe 'dir bgrod de rdo rje 'chang chen mngon du byed par shog /rgyu dang man ngag thams cad kyi don phyogs cig tu sdebs pa thabs lam man ngag rdo rje tshig gis rnam par dbye ba ces bya ba sdogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar byi grub chen ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po'i drung du/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa ras chung rdo rje grags pas zhus shing spyan drangs pa las/ sbad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dha na shi la'i drung du bal po mtsho kha ras ②pas zhus te spyan drangs pa'o// //42byed645

༄ga /gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/①kho gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/a wa bye ti yo ka na ma a ju bud sgo swā hā/ bod skad du/ gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi bsgrub pa/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnamartog gi spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i a ba dhu ti zhes bya ba/ /rangayid dga' ba'i sa phyogs su/ /rang gi snyingakhana'od sprosa'ogakyis bde gshegs pa/ /mkhar ltas phyag lus rdul snyed du sprul lo/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags/ dge ba thams cad la yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bdag gi bsod nams de thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra gha rnyi snya ra ma ra tsang ku ru ku ru sru hā/ dri chang ma ljang / r+shabadz+ra ma le ma la lar tsang ku ru ku ru sru hā/ me tog ma sngo/ r+shabadz+ra sgro pe/ spos me ma nag mo/ chabadz+ra di pra ti be/ snang gas ma dmar mo/ cha badz+ra a sri de de be ta lka zhal zas ma dkar mo/ chabadz+ra lag de/ yon chang ma ser mo/ chabadz+ra nid mi 42byed647

nid ma/ rol mo ma dmar skya/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa yin la sogs dra/sa te/ /sems can thams cad bde bar 'dod pa'i byams pa/ du kha dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje/ de gnyis yun ring bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba/ chos 'dod 'go snyoms par 'dod pa btang snyoms go /tshangs pa'i gnas don bsam nas su/ /oṃ ka ya waka ciste dzñā na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/brten parabyasagasum stongapa'i rjes su/ /paṃ lasapadazlalasazla ma las nyi ma'i steng du lha'i sa bon ho yongs su gyur pa'i rjes las byung ba'i/ /khrobote ru ka dpal dus 'khor lo/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal cig spyan gsum pa/ /gcer bu mche ba cung zad gcigs/ /dbu skra sma ra smin ma ser pos+dzadu/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs bajidachel 'gying bag can—/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje g.yas dril g.yonabasnams pa/ /sna tshogs yum dang zhal sbyar ro gnyis su med/ /dbulasogs pa rdo rje'i rgyan bcas stag lngags kyis/ /sham thabs smad dkris ye shes pa bsres ste/ /gnasartsi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum oṃ la sogs pa bzla'abakra shis kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bdud ci bum chu blug yar 'khyil ba las spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje lta'o/ /gtsug tu sna tshogs pa'o/ /gong du bstan pa ltar mchodamachog sbyin rdo rje mchog spyod 'dud la sogs pas bstodasha lnga bdud ji lnga la sogs pas bdud rtsi myang byas pa'o/ /zla steng ho la sngags 'dis bskor/ /skyes phyag yi/ ri sngo/ li ba sa/ hā/ phyi las bzhi'i ltar ram gsang ba zhal nas zhal du 'khor ba'am/ nang rdo rje'i 'gro 'ong gnas gsum de kho na nyid mchog tu 'gyur med dam bzlas nas 'du ta'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhiye nas spros pa'i mtshan ma med pa gcig yin pa la/ /deyi 'di'i khyad chos ka ra na lag pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bdeba'i rtag sad de//gnas pa rtsa dang g.yobarlung dang rgyubabyang sems gsum/ /dku mar bcug pa la gting mtha' med par gsad byas nas/ /zla nyams tshes gcig nas nya'i bar lta bu 'char rim pas rgyas par spros bral la/ /rnal 'byor dbang pos rangabazhin gyis lhug par gzhag /las dang popa 42—648

ladu ba 'brengal sogs rtag ldan pas mchog rnam rtog sems su hril tshung pa'i dus su mchog tu 'gyur ba med pa'i r+ṣashes so/ /'das ma 'ong da ltar dus gsum 'gyur med dus med rtog byas la/ /gtor ma bdud ci skyang ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la zlar+shari u li li'i gtad nas ci bder bya/ /de nyid rnalayor slob dpon bsnyen padangaldan pas/ /rdzas med pa'i dbang bzhibaskur ni—/ /a ba byu ti pa rnala'abyor pa la sbyin/ /rdo rje can rnams ye shes pa nam mkha' la spyan drangs nas/ /slob ma la ci tsam bskur ye shes pa la gtan khrims lnga bdag 'jug gso sbyong sbyin par skyabs 'gros thog drangs nas bya/ /bslab bya dus 'di nas byang chub la mchis kyi bar du dge 'dun byang chub sems dpa' la skyabs su 'gro sems bskyem sems can ma grol ba rnams sgrol ba dang / ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams 'da' bar bya'o/ /ma —la lam dal yod na me tog dor medanami dgos/ /badz+ra a bi shin sogs spyo/sa/ /sde: sku gsum ye shes las byung ba/ /ye shes bdud ci dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /mi skyong pa ru dbang bskur ro/ /ma mi ri mu li ma badz+ra — shin tsa me dang cod pan sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dku rgyan rin chen bla na med/ /dbu rgyan rin chen mchog 'gro ma/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /rasna la— shin tsa ma / /dar dpyang dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba —/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin paraspya/ /pu ra ra rnyi shin tsa tu mam/ /dang //rdo rje sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /badz+ra satwa rnyi shin tsa mam/ /dril bu sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring spyod la sbyin par bya/ /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs pa dang / /dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rad na a shin tsa ske /brtul zhugs che/ /'tshe dang bkun saganan bud med/ /rgyal po log 'tsho za ba dang //gzhan nor 'phrog dang chang 'thung dang / /dud 'gro gsod dang byis pa bud med skyes pa gsod/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i rten bshig pa/ /dge 'aspren dang3 stos pa bsru/ /grogs po dang ni dpon la sa /dbang po lnga 42—649

la mngon zhen pa/ /'khor bar 'ching ngo rdo rje'i zhagag /bu shin tsa tu me/ /:sgong rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /cis kyang mi chod mi shig pa'i/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags//badz+ra taste nyi pa ) ta sa rnyi shin tsa mi/ dang rjes gnang yang dag ldan r+shangs khyod lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i duḥkha dag las bton/ /a r+shari u li zur bhu ba zlarnyi shin tsa mi/ dbang bskur bdun po chu cod pan gnyis/ rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ming dang baspyol zhugs gnyis/ gnyis gnyis rjes gnang dang bdun/ (1sa/ /chu cod pan gnyis lus ngag rdo rjedril ku gnyis yidani mingabartul zhugs gnyis yang dag sbyongs/ /rjes suganang ba'i dbangaye shes dag byed pa'o/ /pad can dung can ri mo can glang po ches dpal kun bzang mo sogs sam lag phyag rgyas yang na ka ra na lag pa'i/ /bde ba'i rtags sad ye shes spyan drangs la bsresapa ldan pas/ /shes rab nu ma'i lus reg pa las/ /skyesapa 'i bde ba kum pa'i dbang bskur chu 'dzin dbang bskur bsag drag tu gtad pa —/ /gang thob de ni byes pa'o//phyag rgya'i mkha' la gsang baspyod thigale'irgyun 'byung ba'ibade ba ni/ /de ni dar bab mig drag tu gtad gsang dbang ngo / /rdo rje'i zigale rtser gnas tephab pa'i bde ba ni/ /dmigs pa drag shes rab ye shes nachodadagan po'i dbang / /phyag rgya chen po gsum pa ngo rjod pa'i rjes shes rjes chags las/ /tre/sa pa gsum pacang ba la brjod ma shes pa ka bzhi pa ngo sprod pa yin gang gnas bde ba ni/ /de ni nazad—dgu skye dgu'i bdag por shes/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur gsum po rim pa yis/ /lusabumapangagagasangabayid ni shes rab ye shes yang dag sbyong / /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang gis ye shes dag byed pa'o/ /dang po'i rigapa'idabang bdun gang yin pa/ /byis pa las dang po pa rnams ni bzhugs phyir ro/ /rnam gsum rnal 'byor pa 'dzing po 'jig rten kun rdzogs pa/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya ra po'i tshog gi dbang yang ni don dam nyid/ /dang po rig pa'i dbang bdun byinaka/42—650

lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag pa'o/ /rjes su gnang bas shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /rdo rje slob dpon yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa bum pa'i dbang byang chub kyi sems lce la byin pa gsang ba'i dbang / shes rab ma dngos sam yid kyi rig ma ka ra na'i phyag rgya bde ba sad pa shes rab ye shes so/ /de nyams su myong la brjed ma shes pa gsal la ngos gzung med pa de bzhi pa'o/ /skye'agag med pa'i sems kyi snang ba de rtogs pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes so/ /de longs spyod nas ci 'byor zhe thag pas/ /gtor ma dang tshogs dang de la sogs pas lhag pa'i lha sogs mchod par bya/ /ma 'byor ba dang nyes pa med bde gshegs dngos po mi bzhed pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyalapodabang pos rig par bya/ /gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor ces bya/ dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis bsgrub pa/ /slob dpon chen po shrī ka la tsakra ra ti pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dus kyi 'khor lo zhabs chung ngu dang / bod kyi lo tsa ba tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //grub pa'i skyes mchog bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas yar byon gyi zhabs kyi pad+mo rnyog pa med pa la/ bdag dpon dpal gyis gus par btud de zhus pa'o// //42—651

bya ba lam gyi rim pa/①༄ tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa bzhugs so// rag /oṃ swā snri/rgya gar skad du/ dā shag thā ṭ+wā ma mā rga kra ma/ bod skad du/ tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa/ dpal hi ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo mchog tu bla ma la ni dang por phyag 'tshal ye shes btsun mo rdo rje bde mar gus btud nas / /rigs ②can legs par grags pa 'gu ba byed byed sngags rgyud pham ni spyan ldan kun ④gyis bshad pa dang / /bde ba chen po rdo rje'i lung ni thos par gyur pas nges par bya'o bdun gyi nges pa 'di/ /lam dang bcas pa'i zla ba rta dmar sa yi tshul ni lag pa'i rim pa de rjes spyod dang 'bras/ /rtog pa'i rnal 'byor dang ni dran pa gcig dang gsal bar dmigs pa dang bcas rdzogs pa 'di rnams la/ /rnam gsum tshogs kyi lam du 'gyur te ye shes gsum dang rnam par rtog pa gsum bral ye shes sku/ /phra mo gsum nyams de bzhin byang chub skad 42—653

cig gsum ni bcu gnyis sbyor ba'i lam ste don dam gye/ /dga' ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs mthong ba'i lam ste bcu gnyis sa ni yan lag bdun no de las 'bras—/ /dro ba nas ni chos kyi mchog dang thog ma de bzhin tha ma'i sa mthar ri bong can 'gag go/ /gcig ni rtog dang gnyis pa sbyor ba de dag bden pa mthong bas 'gag cing 'gags pa de las be+er/ /sa bcu'i mtha' ①mar dbugs ngag 'gog pa rags dang dbus ma dang ni phra mo'i dbye ba shes par bya/ /byis pa'i lam dang chos kyi sku ni bcu dang bcas pa 'dir ni sa ste rtsa la sogs rnams kyi/ /bgrod pa 'gyel ba'i sbyor ba bcu gnyis sa ru 'gyur te 'od gsal de bzhin mtshungs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba dang bcas khya ba 'gags pas lus dang ngag yid rdo rje'i rgyu nyid do/ /'phags pa rnams kyi bcu gnyis sa la de rnams nyid kyi phra mo sa bon dang bcas shin tu 'gags/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan cing chos kyi sprin las shin du dbye ba tha ma'i sa gsum po/ /tha dad gzhung lugs sna tshogs rgyud du bstan pa dag ni cung zad cung zad dbye ba kho na ste/ /bar chad med dang rnam par grol bar dus kyi 'khor lo las byung gzhan du sbyor dang bcas pa yang / /khyad par lam yang kha cig tu ste stong pa gsum dang sku yi rab dbye rgyud dang rgyud du ste/ /kun du 'od sogs slob dang mi slob sa rnams re rer bcu gnyis bcu gnyis kun la dbye bas so| /rim pa dang po tshogs kyi sa dang skye ba gcig gis thogs par 'gyur la dro ba chen por ni/ /kun kyang bgrod pa gcig tu zhugs shing snang ba la sogs thob la bar dor 'da' dang skye ba'ang yod/ /bdag la byin brlabs thob nas skye bar mi 'gyur gang phyir gnas skabs gsum la 'phags pa'i gnas thob po/ /42—654

grub pa'i khyad par 'ga' dang brtson ldan min yang rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pas lus gzhan nges par sgyur/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rtog pa'i rgyu can bde ba che dang stong pa'i rnam pa lha yi gzugs brnyan ni/ /bde ba cung zad lam du byed nus snang dang 'dzin pa lhod byed rdzogs pa sbyong ba dang po ste/ /ma rtags lus dang sems las ye shes 'byung ba dbu mar byed pa sna tshogs bcing ba nyid las so/ /skyed pas drangs dang nang gi bde rig mngon sum lha dag lhan cig skyes pa rgyu dang bcas par dbye/ /grub pa spyod pa'i rgyu can dang po pa dang sku yi don dang de nyid rnam par spyod pa dang / /sems can don dang don chen nye ba'i rgyu ni gzhan yang nye tshe lam la sna tshogs dbye ba ste/ /ngo bo nyid dang de bzhin gzhan ni spyod pa'i byed dang dgos pa dag te sbar yang de nas gzhan/ /gnas kyi dbye ba mdzad de dus dang cho ga bsam pa na tshod 'dod chags shes rab kyis kyang gzhan/ /drag shul sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te rim pa gnyis la stong nyid goms pa dag gis so/ /gcig ni 'jig rten dngos grub don no glang po'i bdag po rta yis 'thab bzhin rdzogs pa la gnas pas/ /mtshan ma'i spyod la 'jug pa nyid do dbang skur ba dang yongs su byedal pas nye ba'i rgyu zhes bya/ /sems dbyen pa dang nges par byang chub gnyis kyang dbang las gyur pa sprul dang longs spyod rdzogs las so/ /bzhi dang bcu drug sku ste ye shes rnam pa lnga ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa byedas bu ste/ /sku dang brjod byed zhing dang mdzad pa 'di la rang dang gzhan rgyud bden pa gnyis kyi dbye bas so/ /de ltar bdag gis bla ma chen po'i gzhung ni tshigs bcad brgya phrag gnyis las snying po tsam zhig bsdus / /lam ni lnga pa bstan pa'i don 'dir 'bad pa'i dge las 'gro ba 42—655

kun la ye shes rgyas gyur cig /ces tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa'o/ /slob dpon bud dha gup+tas nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /bla ma de nyid la legs par brten cing nyan nas/ slar yang de nyid kyi slob ma puṇ+ḍa badz+ra la zhus te/ tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/653 lamatshan byang 'di chos mtshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉'ag ⑧〈〈pe 〉bokun/654 ①〈〈pe〉〉tha/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2423)42wa 656

— —pa' sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/①go snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i yab bka' dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog rgyas pa bzhugs so// rag /rgya gar skad du/ bhā ga wa na :/tsakra/saṃ bhā ra sa dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal nye ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po phyag rgya chen po la 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas la/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgrub par bya ste/ de la gnas ri rab kyi steng dur khrod du mos la gdan ro'i steng du skra shig gcer bu kha lhor ltas te/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar bcug la/ sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du/ bdag he ru ka ru bya'o lan gsum brjod te/ ston pa'i nga rgyal du byas la yi ge bzhi'i don sngon du byas te/ thog mar oṃ tha mar hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dang ldan pa'i a li ka li brjod pas| kha nas yig 'bru'i tshogs dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 42—657

dpag tu med pa 'phros byas te/ sbar tshur log bdag ①nyid kyi kha nas zhugs lus kyi gnas thams cad gang bar lta'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa'i byams pa dang sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang / bral ldan gnyis rgyun rtan par 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang / sems can thams cad la khyad par nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pas ma gos par 'dod pa'i btang snyoms tshad med pa sgom par bya'o—/ /de nas shes bya'i phung po khams skye mched lta bu'i ngo bor shes bsal sgrib pa srung ba'i phyir gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par ②snang mdzad mgo bor oṃ dkar po las zhal cig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba rtsigs pa ral pa'i thor rtsugs dar kyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs khar rol pas 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i khro bo stag gi lngags pa'i sham thabs mi mgo zlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag drug gis brgyan pa sku the bong gis tshad tsam la/ g.yas rkyang pas zla ba la bzhugs par lta'o/ /de bzhin du tshor ba'i phung po la rin chen 'byung gnas lte bar tram̐ ser po las 'dus byas kyi yung po la snang ba mtha' yas/ mgrin par a dmar po las 'du byed kyi phung po la don yod grub pa bol gong du kham ljang khu las rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' snying gar hūṃ dkar po las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid shri te ru ka rdo rje ni spyi gtsug tu hūṃ 'thing kha las te/ phyag g.yas thams cad du rim pa ltar/ rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram dang / rdo rje dang / g.yon thams cad de dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs khar 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas mig gnyis la sgo las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 42—658

gzugs rdo rje mas 'khyud pa rna ba gnyis las hūṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po sgra rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ sna la tram̐ las ser sna rdo rje ser po la hri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ lce'i rtsa bar lo las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po la ro rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ gsang rtser haṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu la reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ snying gar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po la chos dbyengs rdo rje dkar mos 'khyud pa skyed de/ thams cad rang gis rigs kyi ①bdag po rnams dang mtshungs pa—/ phyag g.yas thams cad rang gi ②rigs kyi mtshan ma can dang / g.yon thams cad dril bu dang bcas pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum gyi phyag g.yon thams cad ka pa la dang g.yas pas rim pa ltar/ me long pi waṃ dung chos zhal zas gos sna tshogs pa dang chos 'byung 'dzin pa'o/ /sa'i khams las btung bar byed pa ni/ lte bar rigs kyi bdag po'i 'og tu la las sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma spyan gsum ma/ mche ba brtsigs pa g.yon gye dang po thod pa gnyis pa na kha tram̐ kha/ g.yas dang po na 'khor lo gnyis pa na ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba/ rol pa'i khro mo sgeg cing lang tsho ①rol pa gcer bu skra grol rnam par mdzes ma mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i mgo phreng mgul na 'chang ba mi'i rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga yis rgyan par sku the rjobong gis tshad tsam pa g.yas su rkyang pas nyi mar ⑤bzhugs par lta'o/ /de bzhin du chu'i khams la oṃ las gsod par byed pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dang kun tu bzang po'i bar du ma ma ki sngon mo/ g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ me'i khams 'gug byed ma mgrin par snang mtha'i 'og tu paṃ las gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas dang po pad+ma rlung gi khams las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ni mgo bor rnam snang gi 'og tu haṃ las sgol ma ljang 42—659

khu—/ g.yas dang po na sna tshogs rdo rje nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma'i dra ba can ma ni—/ bshang lam du khaṃ las du ba'i mdog can/ zhal gsum phyag drug g.yon dmar—/ g.yas ser spyan gsum gsum mche ba bzhi bzhi rtsigs/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'khyud pa'i tshul du mdzad pa g.yon gnyis pa na kha tram̐ ga /gsum pa na zhags pa/ g.yas gnyis pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo'o/ /gsum pa na lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha tshogs thams cad me long gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal bar lta bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par ltas la/ phyi'i bgegs bsrung bar bya ste/ g.yon pa'i 'dzub mos se gol rtog cing / oṃ sum bha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes kha nas sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba 'phros te/de'i 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo khu gdong ma gang du ltas pa shar yin pa der 'khod do/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ sgosna sgrisna hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang 'ug gdong ma byang du/oṃ rgyut+na pa ya sgrisna pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang khyi gdong ma nub tu oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan badzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang / phag gdong ma lho sgor 'khod/ yang su bha ni dang gshin sreg ma shar lhor/ —sna dang pho nya mo lho nub/ sgrit+na pa dang mche ba can ma nub byang / a na ya la sogs dang 'joms ma byang shar du 'khod/lha mo de dag thams cad sku mdog dmar nag zhal cig phyag gzhi ①spyan gsum ma mche ba rtsigs pa dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon dang po stod rang 'dra la smad lte ba man chad zur gsum phur bu me rab tu 'bar ba ri rab tsam pa gnyis pa na kha tram̐ ga /g.yas dang po na rdo rje tho ba gnyis pa na gri gug bsnams pa/ zhabs dang dbu gser sdegyi sa gzhi dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la 42—660

thug pa shin tu che ba gtum pa'i khro mo 'od zer rab tu 'bar ma stag gi pags ① pa'i sham thabs can rnams brgyad rang zhing gnas/ zhal phyir gzigs nas 'khor bar bltas te/ de dag gis 'od zer bzod par dka' bas bgegs rnams gling gzhan du byer bar bsam mo/ /de nas sngags kyi rab chen mo de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i ra ba dmar nag gru bzhi pa rgyar stong gsum tsam mam sgrub pa po'i blo dang 'thun par ltas la/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa brtan par byin gyis rlab po/ /de bzhin du ra ba las 'od zer rab tu 'phros pas / 'og sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhir ltas la oṃ mi dhi ni badz+ra bha wa badz+ra bhan dha hūṃ/ de las gur gru bzhi pa thog rtse mo can oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ de'i 'og tu bla res gru bzhi pa/ oṃ bhi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ de rnams la phyi rol mda'i dra ba gru bzhi pa steng 'og phyogs mtshalas ①thams cad khyab par ltas la oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tri si tri de las me ri dmar nag 'bar bas steng 'og phyogs mtshalas ④thams cad khyab par ltas la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+dza la a na larga hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa brtan par byen gyes rlab po/ /de nas lha mo de dag gi mdun du dong dpag tshad bzhi khri yod pa/shin tu nag pa kha khyer phrad pa rgyar ltas la/ de nas lha mo de rnams kyis 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bgegs ma lus pa thams cad bkug ste dong gi nang du bcug par bsam la bdag nyid khro'i lta ba dang bcas lha mo rnams la bka' bsgo ba/ oṃ gha gha snya ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭa na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ki la ya ki la ya sarba pa paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ki la ya badz+ra dha rod adzha pa ya ti sarba sgyi ga rna ka ya wa ga tsi ta badz+ra ki la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa dang / lha mo rnams kyis phur ba bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor rtsugs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra mu da ka ra badz+ra ki la ya/ a ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes 42—661

brjod ①pa dang / g.yas pa'i tho ba rnams kyis brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams gdug sems dang bral nas zag pa med pa'i bde ba myong bar bsam/ phur bu rnams sdom pa'i lha tshogs su gyur te/ de nyid du gnas pa dang / lha mo rnams 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i tshogs su gyur nas/ me ri ra gur la thim pas sku gsum ye shes lnga'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi ②snying kar a las zla ba'i steng du/ hūṃ dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bo 'od zer lnga 'phro bar ltas la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa las/ lha drug cu ①rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'khor lo khang pa rtsegs ma dur khrod dang bcas pa'i ngo bo'i dbu'i cha la bla ma bzhugs par sprul/ de nas rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul la thams cad kyi zhabs la gtud de phyag bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis lus 'di dag 'bul bar bgyi zhes phul/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ gis 'od zer las pi wang ma sngon mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma phyag dang po gnyis pi wang grengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dril bu khrol ba/ zhi ba la dar gyi nam bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan rmis rgyan pa mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba nam mkha'i mthas klas pas gang bar/ oṃ a badz+ra bi ni hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas mchod do/ /de bzhin du gling ku ma ser mo phyag dang po gnyis snyug ma'i gling bu zhal du bcug nas 'bud pa oṃ a badz+ra bad se hūṃ/ rdza rnga ma dmar mo rdza rnga kha gnyis 'phrag pa la skal nas brdung ba/ oṃ a badz+ra mu ran rje hūṃ/ rnga gru ma lngang khya rnga chen po khri la bzhag nas brdung ba/ oṃ a badz+ra mu kun dhe hūṃ/ yang thugs kha'i hūṃ gis 'od zer las bzhad ma dmar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis srin lag zhal du bcug nas bzhad ④pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa gnyis pa ḍa ma ru khrol ba 42—662
