sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin phyir/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /des na dang po dbang lnga ni/ /sbyin bya bde ba sgrub byed pa'o/ /gcig kyang du ma nyid kyi gzugs/ /gar ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi gar/ /sangs rgyas gang dang gang bsgoms te/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phangs gnas/ /'di rnams kyis kyang bsngags dang rgyud la sogs pa nyan pa la sogs pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rig pa'i dbang bskur du bshad de/ thams cad du mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bya ba ni dbang lnga'i cho ga'o/ /de'i rjes la mchod pa nus dang gus pa yis/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /snying ga g.yon du thal mo bzhag /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab—/ /'gro ba bskyabs ①phyir gzi brjid gang / /bdag la khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur kye/ /thugs rje'i gnyer gyis bdag la gsol/ /zhes bya ba 'dis gsol ba btab pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma lha'i sgor bzhag ②la/ dpal he ru ka'i gzugs su seng ge'i khri la 'dab ma sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma'i dbus su bzhag ①la phyag rgya la sogs pas brgyan pa/ steng du lha mos bzung ba'i gdugs mdzes pa dang / cang te'u dang de bzhin du glu la sogs pa rnams dang / sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa rnams kyis de ltar 'bad pas mchod la/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od byung mtha' yas kyis/ /lha mo'i tshogs kyis kyang ni nam mkha' gang / /gar gyi phyag gis ye shes chu yis bum pa bsnamasarjo/ /me tog la sogs char 'bab rnam par bsam/ /tshigs bcad brjod pas dbang 42—775

bskur ba/ /'khor lor rab zhug ①gtso bo'i sku ni 'bying / /rdo rje dril mchog phyag gis rig ma 'khyud/ /bde chen go 'phangs ②gang bas rgyas pa'i lus/ /tshigs su bcad pas rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /me tog dang bcas pas rdo rje chu bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dam tshig sum kyang gzung bar bya ste/ rgyu lnga dang ni rigs pa yi/ /rdo rje zhes ni brjod par bya/ /hūṃ yig de nyid las skyes pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba kun gyi bdag /rdo rje bsnyems ma bdag po'i bdag /ces bya ba 'dis rdo rje lag pa g.yas su 'dzin du gzhug go/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /dril bu a yig yang dag skyes/ /sbyin bya mkhas pas ①de rnams la/ /'di de rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces bya ba 'dis lag pa g.yon par sbyin la srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba 'dis dril bu dkrol bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni dril bu'i dam tshig go/ /phyag rgya dam tshig rab tu gsungs/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan pa ste/ /gang gis lus kun brtan pa ste/ /des ni phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /de nas he 42—776

ru ka sbyor bdag /bla ma blo ldan mnyam gzhag pas/ /sdom pa slob ma dam pa rnams—/ /cho ga bzhin du de la sbyin/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod pa//rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen dbang / /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /thal ba rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /drug po de dag phyag rgyar shes/ /sbyin pa la sogs rab 'jug pa/ /kha ṭī ga lha yi sku/ shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgras/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /shes rab ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /ces bya ba ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /de'i rjes la slob dpon gyis slob ma la rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa la sogs pa bzhi slob dpon gyi dbang gi mthar ram bzhi pa'i dbang gi mthar sbyin no—/ /slob ma dpal he ru ka yi gzugs su dmigs la/ 'di de dpa' bo thams cad nyid/ /te ru ka yi phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /te ru ka'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /zhes bya ba 'dis hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje lag tu bzung la oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi two sed dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e kha ṭī dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa tī hriḥhi nyi hi hi hūṃ/ de rnams la rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin la/ rdo rje'i sbyor bas gzung ①bar bya ste/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par sbyin/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyis gzugs su bdag nyid bsam khrul snying gar g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos kyi rna ba bzung la/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi lag pas//'di yis ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /khrag 'thung rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /che ge 42—777

mo zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs par grub par sa ma ya ste bur byu ba swā hā/ zhes bya bas lung bstan la/ phyag rgya 'di yis lung bstan par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa kun gyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par byed de dad par bya'o/ /zhes slob ma la brjod par bya zhes pa ni lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas gti mug mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis dmigs la/rjes su gnang ba ①sbyin par bya ste/ /sems can kun byi don rmi phyir/ /sems can kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs pa/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor ⑧lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes bya ba 'dis chos kyi gnas su rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las gzhug par bya ste/ rim gyis sngar ①gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pas rjes su gnang ba sbyin no/ /de nas gsang ba brjod par bya ste/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan yod min/ /de phyir 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis rtag tu ma byed cig /ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba 'dis gsang ba bstan par bya'o/ /mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa ru/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis//sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ /khyed rnams de nyid legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /slar khrod 'chi ba yod pa min/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /gang zhig skyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos ni spang mi bya/ /nam yang 42—778

dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa 'am rmongs pa la/ /de nyid bstan par mi bya'o//rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis rtag tu bzung ①/ /slob dpon nam yang smad mi bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dngos grub/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par bshad/ /ji ltar bde bas bde bar zung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /khyod ni sngags dang rgyud 'dzin gyur/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi/ /lha rnams kun ni bzhed pa yin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa/ /sdom pa mchog gi go 'phang yin/ /sems can rnams la rtse ba'i don/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga ②bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyar/ /sdom pa mchog ni bsrung bar gyis/ /lhan skyes thabs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /dpal ldan bde mchog las gzhan med/ /ces pas dbugs dbyung ba sbyin pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dpal/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi mchog de la/ /cho ga dag pas dngos grub ster/ /dam tshig sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /na dang ga nga bzhin ha dang / /mthar shwa dang po swa de bzhin/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang mnyam par ldan/ /rtag tu lha yi btung ba dang / /bzang po btung ba bskyang bar gyis—/ /sdom pa dngos grub rgyu yi phyir/ /te ru ka dpal zhes nga rgyal/ /mkhas pas sbyor ba bzhin du min/ /legs mchod dril sgra sna tshogs pas/ /legs bstod bdud rtsi'i btung bas tshim/ /rang gi slob ma dpa' bo bde ldan blta—/ /sngags kyi sbyor ①de cho gas rab tu sbyin/ /bla mas rang gi snying gar nyi 42—779

ma las sa bon bsgoms la/ de la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar bya ste/lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas la de nas de las spro ba'i sbyor bas rnam par phyung la slob ma'i kha ru zhugs te/ snying gar zhugs pa'i phyir brjod pas rang rang gi sngags zhal nas zhal du'o/ /bcom ldan khyod la bdag gis stsal/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /slob mas kyang nam mkha' la song ba de rnams rang gi sems kyis sa bon gyi gzugs la 'jug par byed cing brjod de/bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bya ba 'dis sngags kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes la langs la gdugs dang bcas pa'i slob mas kyang / ḍa ma ru dang /thod pa dang / kha ṭī ga bzung ste/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan la/dkyil 'khor chen po dang / bla ma la bskor ①ba gsum byas te/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ 'di skad brjod par bya/ gang cung zad bka' pa pa de thams cad bdag gis bgyi'o/ /zhes bya ba ni dbang bcu'i cho ga'o// //de'i rjes la yol ba la sogs pas dben par byas pa'i phyogs su/ slob mas rang gi yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs dang lang tsho dang ldan pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i snod du rung ba/ rigs lnga dang 'byel ba/ me tog dang ldan pa'i shes rab ma gsang ba'i dbang gi don du bla ma la dbul bar bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa mchod pa sngon du song bas phyag byas la/ bla ma'i sngon du pus mo phab ste thal mo sbyar la/ skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyob pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ltos pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po/ mgon 42—780

med pa rnams kyi mgon du bdag grub par mdzod cig /ji ltar khyod rnams theg chen la/ /ting nge 'dzin te gtso bos mdzod/ /'khor ba yin ni 'dam tshogs su/ /bdag nub mgon gyi bdag la skyobs/ /zhes bya ba 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la dar gyis gdong ni bcing byas la/ /dam tshig kyang ni sbyin pa gang / /thal sbyar spro ba che ba yi/ /slob ma ring pa min par bzhag /de nas bla mas lung nas gsungs pa'i rim pas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i don du brtsam par bya ste/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i rnal 'byor bstan par bya zhing bsgom pa'i rim pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa de bzhin du/ rigs kyi gtso mo la go cha chen mo la sogs pa rnams kyi go cha gon la sku la sogs pa gsum byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /pad+ma dang rdo rje dag byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /sbar yang blo bzang sems mnyam par bzhag pa des/ lte ba dang snying ga dang / kha dang / dpral ba'i phyogs su sngags kyi tshogs dang lhan cig byin byis brlab par bya ste/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'i sngags gnyis dgod par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i rdo rje rnam par dag par byas pa'i pad+mar bzhag par byas la/ 'khyud pa dang 'o la sogs pa rnams kyis dga' ba'i bstan bcos nas bshad pa bzhin du chags pa chen po nyams su myong ba'i rigs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes pa'i sems la/rdo rje pad+mas kyang ni dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /gsang sngags gsum ni legs par bzlas shing bzlas/ /oṃ ā hūṃ ha ho hri/ zhes bya ba'i yi ge gsum po rnams kyis gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /dus mnyam du nyams su myong ba skyes pas gsang ba gnyis kyi rgan po dang / ming med dag gis mnan la slob ma'i khar 42—781

btung bar bya'o/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sras/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs dbang bskur ba/ /byang chub sems ni mdzes pa yin/ /de bzhin du khyod dbang bskur ro/ /sangs rgyas zhu ba'i yid dbang gis/ /slob ma rtag pa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /kye ma bde zhes brjod par bya/ /longs spyod la ni gzhag par bya/ /shes rab kyang langs la de bzhin du sbyin par bya'o/ /phan yon kyang brjod par bya'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur cho ga mchog gyur pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje rnam dag pas/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i slob ma dam pa la shes rab ye shes kyi don chos sku rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ phyi rol byi yan lag ma de nyid dam/de nyid gzhan yang mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa bstan ①la sbyin par bya'o/ /de la dang po yan lag lnga'i phyag byas te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs la/g.yon pa'i snying gar thal mo sbyar te/ sngon nas sngon du gnas la ④sngon du bshad pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pas bslang bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la shes rab kyi lag par de'i lag pa bzhag la/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad dpang por byas la/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byen par yang khyod kyis long / /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /zhes bya ba rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la brjod par bya'o/ /lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma—/ /blangs nas bu yis dus kun tu/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /42—782

zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la lha mo de yis bka' stsal pa/ /dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro/ /byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang / /rigs lnga las ni yang dag byung / /rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod/ /bshang gci stobs dang dri chen sogs/ /des ni so sor bza' ba dang / /gzhan yang mdzes pa'i dam tshig ni/ /ji ltar spro ba bu yis spros/ /zhes so slob mas kyang 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ lha mo ci'i ①phyir bdag mi spro/ /dam tshig la sogs 'dzin par bgyi/ /bya ba rtag tu cis mi gus/ /bud med pad+ma cis mi mchod/ /de nas dga' bas lha mo des/ /skra bkrol gos dang bral ba yis/ /pad+ma rnam pa brgyas sdebyas nas/ /bde bas pad+ma bsten par gsungs/ /kye ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /cho ga yis ni gang bsten pa/ /nga ni de yi mdun na gnas/ /sdom pa mchod la sogs pa ni/ /ji ltar bya ba pad+mar gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid na ni rtag tu gnas zhes so/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bdag /phag mo'i gzugs su bsams byas la/ /bo la ka ko la sbyar nas/ /cho ga bzhin du rtag tu mchod/ /de'i rjes la mgo bo dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / gsang ba dang / brla nas rkang pa'i mthar thug par/ /oṃ hūṃ a swā hā/ 'bar ba'i yi ges rigs lnga sgogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug ma yi rtsa/ /bud med g.yon pa'i cha la gnas/ /sor mo cung zad bskyod bya ba/ /bla ma'i man ngag las shes bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra sa bhā ba ād+ma ko haṃ/ zhes bya bas dga' ba brtsam par bya'o/ /de nas pad+ma dang rdo rje bskyod pa'i dga' bar gyur pas bar snang gi de bzhin 42—783

gshegs pa'i rigs kha nas bkug la zhu bar gyur pas ni nor bu'i lte ba dag gis dbus su thig le gnyis kyi bdag nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin du gnas par bsams la/ phyag rgya chen po'i don la mngon du phyogs par bya'o//sa bon kha sbyor dbus na gnas/ /thig le gnyis po mi 'gyur ba/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin can/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /byang chub sems ni mi 'dor ba/ /ji srid rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ /de srid rgyun ni chad pa thob/ /dga' la skyes pa'i bde ba'ang ci/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /slob mas snyoms 'jug bltas nas ni/ /bla na lhag pa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /snying ga'i sa bon nges byung lha/ /dbang bskur byas nas rab tu bzhug /de zhu rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /bde ba'i rnam pa bde chen po/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i gzugs—/ /mnyam par bzhag pas slob ma blta/ /zhes bya bas bla ma'i brdas//slob ma'i nyams su stsong ba bltas la/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum rmi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /zhes bya ba'i tshigs su brjod la/ /mkhas pas de kho na nyid kyi rtog pa bskyed par bya'o/ /byang chub chen po'i sems dpa' che/ /gzugs ma 'di ni bde ba che/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob par/ /rdor 'dzin sems can don rnams kyis/ /ye shes 'di ni shin tu phra/ /rdo rje snying po nam mkha' ltar/ /dri med thar pa zhi ba ni/ /de ni khyod kyi pha yang yin/ /slob mas bsams la legs par zung / /pad+ma'i nang du lhung gyur na/ /byang chub sngon du 'gro ba'i sems/ /de nas longs spyod kyis ni blangs/ /zhes bya ba ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// //42—784

de'i rjes la chu la sogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi mthar thug pa mngon sum du legs par thob pa/ yang dag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ /rang gi dbang bskur maṇ+ḍal dang / /ji ltar nus pas gsol ba gdab/ /mchod ①dang bsnyen bskur gus pa dang / /yang dag dad pa mnyam ldan pa/ /bzhi pa'i don ni bstan par bya/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mngon sum du ma thob par/ slar yang tshig tsam gyi dbang sbyin par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir de gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor gang gis dbang ma thob/ /'dir ni rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur rdeg pa dang / /ri dwags smig rgyu 'thung dang mtshungs/ /de phyir kha sbyor thig le'i rgyud chen po las kyang gsungs pa—/ slob ma lhag par mos pas yid kyis brtag /ji ltar gsungs pa'i cho gas dbang bskur sbyin/ /zab dang rgya che'i tshul la lhag par mos/ /dbang bskur rin chen tshig gis sbyin par bya/ /ji ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang kho na dbang bskur ba zhes brjod par bya zhe na/ /de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs par byed pa'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar na bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur ba ni tha dad gsum/ /rgyud 'di ru ni rab tu gsal/ /slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bden de thabs gzhan kho na'o/ /dang po yi ni las can rnams—/ /dam pa'i don la gzhug pa'i phyir/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa bzhin du gsungs/ /de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin du—/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang kho na dang / tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /de 42—785

gsungs pa/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ e yi cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su baṃ yig rnam par brgyan/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gzhi①/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma rtog② /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar dga' ba mchog dang ni/ /dga' bral lhan skyes de bzhin te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par smin/ /rnam par nyed dang mtshan nyid bral/ /bo la ka ko la sbyor ba/ /thams cad shes rab las byung ba/ /bzhi pa'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa de gang yin zhe na/ yul dang dbang po rnams ni mnyam du nub 'gyur ba/ /gang yang mngon dga' rgyal ba mdzes pa'i lus gcig pu/ /su zhig sang ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyi snying la 'dzin/ /dus mnyam 'char ba gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo//tha ga pa'i zhabs kyis kyang gsungs pa/ dga' ba gnyis kyi dbus su skyes/ /shin tu bsod ①nams legs thob pa/ /de dus ji ltar yid ches rdo rje chus/ /skyes sbyor ba yi go 'phang ste/ /de phyir mi 'gyur bde ba kho na skye bo dam pas 'bad pas bsten/ /de la yun rings gnas pa mnyam bzhag skye bos sbar yang de nyid 'dzin/ /gshin rje nag po'i rgyud las kyang gsungs pa/ /rgyal mtshan can gyi khyams mthong nas/ /de ni 'o ma mang po rab tu bsgrubs/ /'o ma la sems rtse gcig goms byas pas/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rdo rje chu skyes yang dag sbyor/ /dga' ba ru ni rab tu grags—/ /shin tu bskyod pa dag ni mchog /'phos pas de bzhin dga' bral skyes—/ /mchog dang dga' bral dag ni dkus/ /lhan skyes yang dag byang chub bshad/ /chags pa ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu ma la yang mi dmigs so—/ /gsum gyis spangs pa kho na la/ /lhan cig skyes pa zhes su gsal/ /42—786

bla ma'i man ngag thams cad la/ /rang blo de nyid shes par bya/ /lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba/ /thabs gang gis bskyed par bya ba yin na/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i thabs dang / rang byen kyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang / bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis dang / rang bsod nams chen po dang ldan pas so/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /ngag gi lam gyis spyod yul 'das/ /byin kyis brlabs pa'i go 'phang 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de rang bzhin/ /skyes pa zhes bya'i mtshan nyid ci zhe na/ /gsungs pa/ dbang po gang du nub 'gyur ba'i—/ /rang gi ngo bo med 'gyur ba/ /de skye lhan cig skyes pa dga' ba'i lus//gsal bar bla ma dag la dris/ /de gang zhe na gzhan gyis ma bstan lhan cig skyes//gang gis kyang ni thob mi 'gyur/ /bla ma'i rgyud pa bstan pa las/ /bdag gis bsod nams dag las shes/ /de phyir bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun nyid/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs par bsten/ /bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur bya/ /bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bskur cho ga byas pa las/ /bsod nams de yis 'jig rten du/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang shog /gzhung la lhag dang chad gyur pa/ /mthong bas de ni sun 'byin pa/ /bla ma la ni skyon yod min/ /rang gi blo sun 'byin pa yin—/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i bdag nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po ā tsār+ya dzñā na badz+ra'i zhabs pa/ bod kyi lo tsa ba chen po zhang zhung gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab po// //42—787
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2435)42—789

༄ga /rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi lhung ba'i bshags pa bzhugs so//①༄4/ /hūṃ rdo rje slob dpon rig mar mtshungs pa dang / /rtsa ba'i dal ①bla na med pa dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ 1 /dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la/ /nga rgyal mthon po'i nad kyis bdag gzir te/ /bag med tshul gyes brnyas pa gang bgyes ①pa/ /bla ma rnam gsum sku la bzod par gsol/ 2 /chos sku'i duspros dang bral ba de nyid la/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul skus gzhan don mdzad/ /de'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' rnams las/ /'das shing khyad du bsad pa 'thol lo bshags/ 3 /bla ma gcig dang rig ma gcig nyid dang / /dkyil 'khor gcig dang bye brag dus gzhan du/ /dam tshig gcig gis bsdus pa'i spun rnams la/ /khros shing nyes par brjod pa 'thol lo bshags—/ 4 /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas snying po can/ /rgyal ba'i 42—790

sras mchog dam par gyur pa la/ /bdag ni mi mkhas zhe sdang dbang gyur te/ /byams sems phan bde spangs pa mthol ①lo bshags/ 5 /chos rnams thams cad byang chub sems yin te/ /kun rdzob don dam cha la ma rten cing / /'jig byen rnam rtog dbang du gyur pa yis/ /bde chen byang sems spangs pa 'thol lo bshags—/ 6 /phyi rol pa dang nyan jos rang rgyal dang / /theg pa che dang gsang sngags bla na med/ /lam tshol ba dang de bzhin lam chen zhugs/ /grub pa'i mtha' rnams smad pa 'thol lo bshags/ 7 /snod min cho ga nyams dang ma smin dang / /zab mo gsang ba'i snod du mi rung la/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya brda dang sngags la sogs/ /zab mo gsang ba bsgrags pa 'thol lo bshags/ 8 /phung po lnga ni rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dngos/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin yin pa la/ /gsad bcad bdeg dang dka' thub bsnyung ba sogs/ /smad cing dman par brtags pa mthol lo bshags/ 9 /chos rnams kun rmi rang bzhin dag pa la/ /yin dang min dang bzang ngan gnyis su btags/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /the tshol som nyi zos pa 'thol lo bshags/ 10 /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog gsum rnams dang / /gsang sngags rdo rje theg la mi mos shing / /pyod cing bkur pa 'debs pa'i mi rnams la/ /tshar ma bcad cing byams bgyis 'thol lo bshags/ 11 /ming rnams thams cad rnam par rtag ②pa ste—/ /rtog pas stong pa'i ye shes chen po nyid/ /de la zug rngu rdul tsam med pa la//yin dang min du btags pa 'thol lo bshags/ 12 /dang po'i las can byis pa'i ngang tshul can/ /dad ldan lung gi rjes su 'brang rnams la/ /zab mo'i tshig brjod brtul zhugs spyod bstan pas/ /pha rol sems sun phyung ba 'thol 42—791

lo bshags/ 13 /mi spangs spyad cing bsrung bar bya ba dang / /shes par bya ba'i dam tshig yan lag bcas/ /shes bzhin khyad du gsad nas mi rten pa/ /rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis 'thol lo bshags/ 14 /phyi nang gsang ba'i shes rab dam pa dang / /thun mongs ①khyad par rig ma bla med la/ /skyon dang nyes pa'i sgo nas smad gyur pa/ /nyon mongs kun nas blang ba 'thol lo bshags//bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde ba thob gyur cig /dam tshig mi ldan rig ma brten pa dang / /tshogs 'khor la sogs nang du brtsod pa dang / /rig ma dman la bdud rtsi blangs pa dang / /gsang chos 'dod pa'i snod la ma bshad dang / /dad ldan chos min gtam la sbyar ba dang //nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'das pa dang / /ming tsam la rten sngags pa yin smra dang / /snod min pa la sngags bshad nyes pa dang / /sgom bzlas la sogs 'gal 'khrul gyur pa dang / /lta spyod la sogs ma dag nyes pa rnams/ /mgon po thugs rje can la bzod par gsol/ /tshangs pa'i dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /sku'i dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags—/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags/ /'thol lo 'thol lo ye shes lha la 'thol/ /bshags so bshags so dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'thol bshags phul 42—792

nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bshags so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'i bshags pa/ slob dpon yin tra bo dhis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/79 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanakyil 'khor/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉rkos/791 ①〈〈pe 〉skorathol/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rtog792 ①〈〈pe 〉stabang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2436)42—793

༄ga /dz+walan dha ra pas bstod pa/①༄4/ /oṃ swa ste sed r+ghaṃ/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje dbyings nas bzhes ②pa'i sgu mchog ni/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes shing / /srid pa sbyong mdzad nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /sgyu ma sprul pas 'gro don rdzogs par mdzad/ /bde mchog 'khor lo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/ /'jigs mdzad dpa' bo bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /phrin las sna tshogs rigs lngas yongs mtshan pa'i/ /ral pa'i thor gtsug sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes—/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /spyi bor zla tshes cod pan 'khor los brgyan/ /zhal gdangs khro gnyer smin ma glog ①ltar 'khyug /skye shi rtsad gcod rkeng rus mche ba gtsigs/ /tshad med bzhi ldan dpa' bo'i zhal bzhi la/ /mi bskyod la sogs rigs lngas yongs mtshan pa'i/ /rdo rje phreng dang thod pa rnam lngas brgyan/ /stong nyid snying rje rab 'khrugs gyur pa 42—794

yi—/ /'od zer phreng ba sna tshogs du ma las/ /sangs rgyas tshogs ni kun tu sprin 'phro ba'i/ /sku gsum dpa' bo ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /sgeg pa la sogs rol pa'i gar byis mdzes/ /snying rje spyan dmar bcu gnyis me bzhin gzigs| /te ru ka ①dpal bde mchog sprul pa'i sku/ /'chad byed tshogs dang nyan pa'i tshogs ldan dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten rab 'das dang / /rang bzhin nyid las khyod ni gzhan ma mchis/ /gsang ba bde mchog bdud bral ye shes sku/ /pha rol phyin drug phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /a la la zhes dur khrod gar dang ldan/ /phem gye sgra sgrogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sdud/ /'du byed rnam dag mgo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /gdug ②pa kun 'dul stag gi sham thabs can/ /rdo rje gad mos khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /ma rig la sogs rten 'byel rnam dag pa'i//byams pa'i thugs mnga' bcu gnyis phyag dang ldan/ /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse lnga ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan dug lnga rnam par 'joms/ /phyag g.yon dang po dril bu rnam 'dzin cing / /rnam rtog spangs pa'i shes rab bdag nyid can/ /gti myug rnam dag de 'og phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon dpa' bo'i gos su gyon| /chos rnams sgogs pa'i ḍā ma ru bsnams shing / /lha sku rnam dag kha ṭī rdo rjes mtshan/ /thugs rje dgra stas drag po'i lta rnams 'joms/ /'dod chags rnam dag thod pa khrag can 'dzin/ /gri gug 'bar bas nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pas bdud dang gshin rje 'dul/ /tri shul rtse gsum skyes bu phug cing 'phyar/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal lha chen rnams bsad pa'i/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bcad dpa' bo'i phyag mtshan bsnams/ /rtag 42—795

chad spangs nga/sa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang / /nyi zla'i dbus na bgegs chen du ma gzir /g.yas/ brkyang zhabs kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan/ /tī tī bzhad nga/'i phag mo sgu la 'khril/ /khros/ pa'i dpung chen bdud dgra brlag nga/ra mdzad / /gsang ba'i mgon po rang nyid la gus shing / /bskyed rdzogs las/ la dngos grub mchog la dga'/ /brtan pa'i blo can brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i//ting 'dzin gzungs dang dngos grub mchog brnyes pa/ /dngos grub mchog stsol te ru ka 'a/ 'dud/ /gsang ba kun ldan rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs byed rgyal po'i yu/ma/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma / /bdud 'dul rgya'/ mo dpal ldan dbang phyug sgu/ /sgu mdog dmar mo/ thod pa'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /gre gug sdigs 1mdzub gdug pa skrag mdzad cing / /thod pa khrag can he ru ka la 'khyud/ /mche ba gcigs shing drag shul 'jigs ldan ma/ /dman pas sgrub nus mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /chags mtha' rtog med 'al gnyis dang ldan zhing / /rdo rje dbang phyug snying rje che/ /bdud 'du'/ dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ye shes sgu/ /gsang ba'i lha mo 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ye shes me dpung dpa' mo glog ltar 'khyug /mkha' 'gro phag mo 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ /'jigs pa'i cha byad bdud bzhi kun skrag mdzad//'khor lo'i rgyan can rdo rje snyan cha can/ /mgul rgyan do shal spyi gtsug nor bu dang / /dpung rgyan lag gdub se ral kha'i shing / /dum bu'i ska rags nasel sil sgra dang ldan/ /bde bar legs skyes chos nyid rang bzhin can/ /ye shes spyan gsum dus gsum gdul bya gzigs/ /dbu skra grol zhing thugs rjes kun khyab pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa/ /grub chen brgyad ni (2—796

sgrub po la ster zhing / /dang ba'i sems kyis 'jigs dus khyod dran na/ /sdug bsngal kun sel dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sna tshogs skur ston pa'i/ /sgrub pa'i don mdzad rnal 'byor khyod la 'dud/ /bde mchog 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma yi/ /phyogs kyi mdab bzhi ma ma ki sogs gnas—/ /zhal bzhi la phyogs dngos grub mchog brnyes ma/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /me long las skyes ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /in+t+ra nī la'i mdog can gtum pa mo/ /bdud 'dul dbang phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /g.yas brkyang dpa' mo srog bral steng na gnas/ /phyag bzhi nag mo 'jigs pa'i gru len ma/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭī cang te'u 'dzin/ /lus rjes dran pa'i ngo bo chu rang bzhin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes dpal ldan ma/ /sems ma sgrol ma dam tshig sgol ma mchog/'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /ḍa ma ru sgogs gtso bo skul byed cing / /kha ṭī gar bcas 'jigs pa'i phem sgra sgogs/ /tshor ba rjes dran rang bzhin rlung gi bdag /ljang gu'i mdog can gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /las rigs mkha' 'gro lā ma khyod la 'dud/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes dbyings phyug ma/ /rwa ga'i mdog can gar gyi stobs dang ldan/ /ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭī g.yon na 'dzin/ /gri gug thod pa 'byung po zhal du gsol/ /chos rjes dran pa'i dpa' mo 'dod chags che/ /me'i bdag nyid pad+ma ①mkha' 'gro che/ /ma rungs pa'i sems can gsod la brtson/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro ha khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin las skyes shing / /bdud 'dul dpa' mo rus pa'i rgyan cha 'dzin/ /gcod mdzad gri gug thod pa phyag na bsnams/ /kha ṭī 42—797

gar bcas ser mo cang te'u sgogs/ /sems rjes dran pa'i rang bzhin spyan gsum ma/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro sa'i bdag nyid dpal/ /mnyam sbyor bde bas gtso bo mnyes mdzad ma/ /gzugs kyi dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud bzhi tshar gcod cing / /dam tshig nyams pa'i sngags pa bso/da 1la brtson/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub mchog ster ba'i/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshams kyi pad+ma rin chen bum pa'i steng / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnam dag pa'i/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mtshan ldan ka pā la/ /bdud rtsi lngas bkang bde ba che ldan pa'i/ /gnas dang nye gnas zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / /tshan sgo nye tshan 'du ba nye 'du ba//dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyi shu bzhir/ /sa bcu rang bzhin bdag nyid sku gsum can/ /pul+li ra mar dpa' bo thod dum can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi se mo so la gnas/ /rab tu gtum mo 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang / /gcer bu mgo gnas ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzā lan dha ra ma hā ka kā la/ /mkha' la spyod cing skra spu la gnas ma/ /gtum mig can ni brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang / /spyi gtsug la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dbu rgyan la gnas dpa' bo kai kā la/ /lpags dang dri ma rnam dag sa la 'dul/ /'od ldan ma ni dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang / /rna ba g.yas gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /arngu tar ni mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /lha rnams 'dul phyir sha la rnam par gnas//sna chen ma ni sems kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang / /rgyab la dbang bsgyur ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /go tā ba rir su ra be+e ri ni/ /rgyus pa rnam dag g.yas brkyang rol pas bzhugs / /dad pa'i dbang po brtan pa'i blo can ma/ /rna ba g.yon gnas 12—798

mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'od dpag med ni rus pa'i khams dag cing / /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ra mi shwa rir bzhugs/ /smin ma'i dbus gnas brtson dbang mi thung ma/ /snyom las rab spangs mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mchin pa rnam dag de bi ko tre ru/ /rdo rje 'od ldan 'byung po 'dul bas na/ /drang po dbang po lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ /mig gnyis la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mā la bar gnas dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku/ /snying la gnas shing drag po 'jigs ①byed 'dul/ /shing grib ma ni ting 'dzin dbang po ste/ /phrag pa gnyis gnas rnal 'byor khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la spyod pa ste/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi rtsibs ni sngon po la/ /thugs kyi rigs mtshon rdo rje ra bas bskor/ /zhe sdang can 'dul mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /myu gu can ni kā ma rur gnas shing / /mig gnyis la gnas e ra ba ti mdzes/ /sa srungs ma ni shes rab dbang po ste/ /mchan khyang gnyis gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ trer gnas pa rdo rje ral pa can/ /mkhris ④pa rnam dag rdo rje ral pa gnas/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo ste/ /nu ma gnyis gnas mkha' 'gro khyed phyag 'tshal/ /tri sha ku nor dpa' bo chen po ni/ /glo ba rnam dag rab tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rlung gi shugs ma brtson 'grus stobs rang bzhin/ /lte ba'i dkyil gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ko sa lar gnas rdo rje hūṃ mdzan ni/ /rgyu ma rnam dag 'jigs pa'i phem sgra sgogs/ /dad pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung dpa' mo ste/ /sna rtse la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ka ling kar gnas rab tu bzang po nyid/ /gnyer ma rnam dag dngos grub mchog stsol zhing / /ljang lha mo ni ting 'dzin stobs rang bzhin/ /42—799

kha'i nang gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /lam pa kar gnas rdo rje bzang po nyid/ /grod pa rnam dag rdo rje bzang po ste/ /shes rab stobs ni rab tu bzang mo nyid/ /mgrin pa la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kañtsi'i gnas su 'jigs byed chen po nyid/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang sgum phyi sa la gnas pa / /rta na 1mo ni ting 'dzin yan lag ste/ /snying ka la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /tī ma lar gnas dpa' bo mig mi bzang / /skra 'tshams rnam dag hā hā'i sgra sgrogs shing / /bya gdong ma ni brtson 'grus yan lag ste/ /mdoms 2par la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gsung gi 'khor lo sa steng spyod pa ste/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi rtsibs ni dmar po la/ /gsung gi rigs mtshan pad+ma'i mu khyud mdzes/ /'dod chags can 'dul mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /pre ta pu ri dpa' bo stobs po che/ /bad kan rnam dag phyag bzhi rnam par brgyan/ /dga' ba byang chub yan lag 'khor lo shugs/ /mtshan ma la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje ni/ /rnag sogs rnam dag g.yas brkyang rol bar bzhugs/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i yan lag dum skyes ma/ /bshang lam la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so so raṣ+ṭar rta mgrin rgyal po che/ /khrag la gnas shing drag po 'jigs byed 'dul/ /chos rnams shin tu rnam 'byed shoṇ+ḍi ni/ /brla gnyis la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /su bar+ṇa dī bar nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /dpa' bo chen po rdul sogs rnam dag pa/ /dran pa yang dag 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /byin pa gnyis gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nā ga rar gnas dpal ldan te ru ka /tshigs sogs dag phyir phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /shin tu dpa' mo btang 7(2—800

snyoms yan lag ste/ /rkang sor la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sen dhu'i gnas su dpa' bo gar dbang phyug /mchi ma rnam dag dbang phyug chen mo tshul—/ /stobs chen dpa' mo yang dag lta ba ste/ /rkang pa'i bol gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ma rer gnas pa rnam par snang mdzad che/ /mchil ma rnam dag dbang phyug chen mo ni/ /'khor lo sgyur ma yang dag rtog pa ste//mthe bong la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ku lu tar gnas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /dpa' bo chen po snabs lud rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus chen po yang dag ngag dang ldan/ /pus mo la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og spyod pa ste/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi rtsibs ni dkar po la/ /sku'i rigs mtshon 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ /gti mug can 'dul mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'gro ba'i don la thugs rje sprul pa'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gnas ldan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru/ /sku gsung thugs gnas sgrub la brtse dgongs pa'i/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rgyal la sogs ma rungs gdul bya rnams/ /gdul ba'i dbang gi khro mo'i skur ston pa/ /sgo mtshams brgyad na ma rungs gnod brgyad gnon/ /khā gdong la sogs sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro brgyad/ /bya rog gdong can sgyeg mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs—/ /zhal gyi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /gar gyi sbyor ldan gcer bu phyag bzhi ma/ /nag mo 'jigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar kyi sgo srungs yi dwags stan ①la bzhugs/ /gcer bu spyan gsum phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan//kha nas khrag 'dzag a la la zhes sgogs/ /yang dag las mtha'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'ug pa'i gdong can bgegs dpung sreg mdzad cing / /zhal 42—801

nas ljags 'dril mche ba rnam par gdags1/ /hā hā bzhad cing spyan mig glog ltar 'khyug /dgra bgegs sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi sgo srung mar gang 'od ldan zhing / /mkha' 'gro mi srun thod pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /sku mdog ljang dmar gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /yang dag 'tsho ba'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nub kyi sgo srungs dpa' mo stobs ldan ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /spyan gsum sdang mig dus mtha'i me bzhin gzigs / /sgrub po'i don mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyi'i gdong can thod pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum dur khrod gdan la bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro mi srun mgo brlon do shal can/ /yang dag rtsol ba'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phag gi gdong can gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma/ /bdud kyi rgyal mo phyag bzhi gar gyis dges/ /rna cha mgul brgyan spyi gtsug nor bus spras//'jigs byed khrag 'thung ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho'i sgo srungs ser mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal nas me 'bar bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams sreg /ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭī g.yon na bsgreng / /yang dag dran pa'i dpa' mo byed phyag 'tshal/ /shar lho'i dbang phyug gshin 4rje brtan ma ni/ /g.yas sngo g.yon ser brkyang bsgum tshul gyis bzhugs/ — /gcer bu rgyan rnams kun mdzes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbang phyug gsang ba'i lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sems can don brtson ma/ /rus pa'i ska rags khrag gi thig le can/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /dge chos yang dag bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub mkha' 'gro gshin rje pho nya ma/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar mkha' 'gro gzugs mdzes ma/ /phaṭa kyi sgra 5sgogs gsod byed mthu rtsal can/ /gcer 72—802

bu khrag 'thung ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcer bu skra bshigs ①cha shas dpal dang ④ldan—/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal lce sgril mthu mo che/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /dge chos yang dag spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang mkha' 'gro gshin rje mche ba ma/ /g.yas dmar g.yon ljang spyan bsgrad 'jigs pa'i gzugs—/ /gsang ba'i lha mo rdo rje glu len ma/ /drag mo stobs mo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs skud mgo'i phreng bas rnam brgyan cing / /rus pa'i ska rags sil sil sgra dang ldan/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum dur khrod gdan la bzhugasaske/ /mi dge bskyed mi byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar gnas pa'i gshin rje 'joms byed ni/ /g.yas ljang g.yon nag 'gying zhing rol par bzhugs—/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum g.yas brkyang tshul gyis bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'od 'bar ma/ /khro gnyer mche gcigs dgra bgegs zhal du gsol/ /bsnyen bkur can la gsang ba'i dngos grub ster①/ /mi dge yang dag spong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal gsang ba'i grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor sde chen sdig pa rnams du'ajoms pa/ /nyon mongs zhi ba pad nyi zlum por gnas/ /mi shes gcod byed gri gug phreng bas mdzes/ /lha rnams mchod phyir yon tan kun ldan pa/ /sna tshogs bum pa bdud rtsis rab bkang ba/ /partse re kha rin chen pha gur ldan/ /'dod yon lha mo yon tan kun ldan zhing / /pi wang gling bu yon tan glu gar can/ /sgeg mo bzhad bcas me tog phreng ba dri/ /mar me bdug spos rdza lnga ⑤cang te'u/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje chos dbyings rnams kyi mchod—/ /dra ba dra phyed rin chen nyi zla dang / /mu tig gser gyi dril bu 42—803

legs dbyangs pa/ /brtson 'grus rlung gi bskyod pa chos sgra sgrogs/ /da ru ka sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /yid 'ong ri dwags ba dan bcu drug ldan/ /ba so nga/d+ma'i bkra shis bum pa dang / /thos pa'i 'phreng ba rdo rje ra bas mdzes /legs nga/'i sgo khyud dpal ldan phyogs bzhi mdzes/ /'dod yon rgyas phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /rin chen 'khor lo rta babs gdugs kyis phug /rin chen ka ba rta rna bzhi yis mdzes/ /bgegs rnams bsrung phyir sna tshogs pad+ma dang / /rdo rje'i sa gzhi bla re ra ba gur/ /mda'i dra ba 'jigs pa'i me dpung ldan/ /lha klu gshin rje 'byung po sha za dang / /ma rungs 'dul phyir bgegs la phur bu gdab / /drag po skrad 1phyir tsha tsha be+er mda' 'phro / /tshogs brgyad dag phyir dur khrod rab 'jigs pa/ /shi ri sha sogs byang chub shing brgyad la/ /kha gdong la sogs sprul pa'i sprin dang bcas/ /klu dang gnod sbyin lha chen brgyad por ldan/ /dbang po me la gshin rje srin po dang / /chu lha rlung lha gnod sbyin dbang ldan dang / /sa'i lha mo nyi zla tshangs pa dang / /drag po zhing skyong phyogs mtshams brgyad na gnas/ /mchod rten brag sogs me dang chu brgyad dang / /mkha' 'gro gnas ldan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru/ /'byung po 'dus pa'i lce spyang phem sgra sgrogs/ /sha za ro langs phra men ma brgyad dang / /dbu ma dus mtshan dur khrod bdag mor bcas/ /rgyal po bzhi sogs 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ldan/ /grub chen brgyad po phyag rgya mchog ldan zhing / /grub pa'i rnal/ 'byor cod pan rnam nga/ra mdzes/ /grub pa'i rten 'gyur bde gshegs kun gyi gnas / /sgod bcud dag pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /rin chen ldan nga/ thar pa'i grong mchog la/ /bdag ni rab gus dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /(2—80

lhan cig skyes rgyal bde mchog 'khor lo yi/ /'khor lo lnga sogs dur khrod bcas bstod pa/ /dge ba gang byung 'dis ni 'gro ba ma lus pa bde mchog la gnas mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa shrī dzā lan ṅgā ra pas bstod pa kha cig las dril bu pas mdzad zer mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/794 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉stor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉7zhengs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉glogs/795 ①〈〈pe 〉ra ka'/ ②〈〈pe 〉ra dug796 ①〈〈pe 〉stabag ②〈〈pe 〉〉ngag797 ①〈〈pe 〉lad ma'i/798 sti〈〈pe 〉sngagasod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ma sa/799 ①〈〈pe 〉skorajig ①〈〈pe 〉marakhris/8༷༷ ①〈〈pe 〉ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉ra doms/ ①〈〈pe 〉thazhis//༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉thastan/8༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉thacigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉rapal/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉'a/ rjo〈〈pe 〉rgan/ 0〈〈pe 〉lto//༷3 ①〈〈pe 〉thashig ①〈〈pe 〉7dang / ①〈〈pe 〉lte/ du〈〈pe 〉ram/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ra/8༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉thaskrad/ ①〈〈pe 〉mas/ ①〈〈pe 〉sna /42—805
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2427)42wa 806

༄ga /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam par sprul pa dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgyu mtshan bzhugs so//①༄4/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dpal bde mchog ji ltar sprul pa'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su/ sems can mi rnams la yon tan bzhi ste/ tshe dpag tu med pa thub pa dang / longs spyod la bdag gi ba med pa dang / kha dog rang la 'od yod pa dang / rdzu 'phrul nam mkha' la 'phur shes pa'i dus so/ /de nas tshe 'grib pa ni gsum ldan gyi dus so/ /longs spyod 'grib pa ni gnyis ldan gyi dus so/ /de nas sa zhag la sogs pa zos pas/ shi ba rnams la ro byung ste/ /ro de dag bskyal ba'i sa la dur khrod ces par grags la/ de phyogs 'tshams la sogs par chags so/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul dang kha dog gnyis nyams pa ni brtsod ldan gyis dus so/ /de'i dus su pu li ra ma la ya dang / dzā lan dha ra dang / u rgyan 42—807

dang / ar bu ta dang / bzhi ru sum cu rtsa gsum gyis lha 'ga' zhig babs nas sprul zhing gzhi bzung bas de la gnas zhes brtags so/ /de nas go ta ba ri dang / rasmi shwa ri dang / de bi ko ṭi dang / ma la wa ru/ dri zas bzung bas de la nye ba'i gnas shes zer la/ de dag ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang / dri zas bzung bas mkha' spyod ces grags so/ /de nas ka ma ru pa dang / o ṭi gnyis gnod sbyin gyis bzung ba la zhing du brtags zhing / tri sha ku ṣ+pe dang / ko sa la gnyis gnod sbyin gyis g.yog gis bzung bas nye ba'i zhing zhes so/ /de nas ka lo ka dang / lo bi ka gnyis srin pos bzung bas/ts+tshan bye ha zhes btags la/ ka: dang / hi ma la ya gnyis srin po'i g.yog gis bzung bas/ nye ba'i tshan sgo ha zhes so/ /de ltar gnod sbyin dang srin pos bzung bas sa spyod zhes grags so/ /de nas pre ta pu ri dang / shrī ba de ba gnyis klus bzung bas de la 'du ba zhes btags la/ sau raṣ+ṭa dang / su wan gri ba gnyis klu'i g.yog gis bzung bas/ nye ba'i 'du ba can ces bya'o/ /de nas ri rab kyi khong gseng nas lha ma yin byung nas/ na ga ra dang / sen dhu gnyis bzung bas dur khrod ces zer la/ ma ru dang / ku lu ta gnyis lha ma yin gyis g.yog gis bzung bas nye ba'i dur khrod ces so/ /de ltar klu dang lha ma yin gyis bzung bas sa 'og ces grags so/ /de ltar de rnams ni drag po nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur nas/ zas su sha za/ skom du khrag 'thung la/ 'gro 'chag /nyal 'dug rnams su so so rang re'i chung ma rnams dang mkhyud cing /gos su mi lpags la sogs pa gyon pa/ lag tu dgra sta dang / tri shu la sogs pa thogs nas ni rang shu'i rgyan gyis brgyan te/ de rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i gling 42—808

gi mi rnams ma rungs par byas so/ /dus de'i tshe drags pa can de dag bgros pas/kho bo bdag ①la dpon cig dgos pas/ de ri rab kyi stengs na ma hā de ba zhes pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid phrin las bzhi'i ngo bo zhal bzhi mnga' ba ste/ de'ang zhal re re zhing yum re re yod pa/ de ltar thun dang po la/ shar phyogs su gau ri dang spyod la/ thun gnyis pa la lhor e ka dzā ti dang rol cing / thun gsum pa la nub tu ka la ra tri dang rol cing / thun tha ma la byang du u ma dre bi dang mnyam par gnas pa ste/ de dag ni nye ba'i yum mo/ /sbas pa'i yum bzhi ni/ skra can ma dang / nye ba'i skra can ma dang / mun pa ma dang / nye ba'i mun pa ma'o/ /de lta bu de la dpon zhus so/ /de ltar dpon g.yog nyi shu rtsa lnga po des/'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams la 'tshe zhing phung bar byas so/ /de'i dus na—/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dregs pa dpon g.yog de dag gis 'jig rten kyi khams brlag par gzigs nas/ de dag 'dul ba'i phyir 'og min nas ri rab kyi rtser byon te/ rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzhal yas khang par sprul/ 'od dpag med kyi sku ru mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gtsug tor du brgyan/don yod grub pas dal gyi lha tshogs su sprul/ mi bskyod pas go cha'i lhar mdzad nas—/ de'ang / sgu bzhi las longs sku dpal rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ yum kun tu bzang mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ sku mdog dkar po gcig tu sprul te/ de las 'bras bu'i he ru ka sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang mkhyud par sprul nas/sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sprul 42—809

nas—/ de'ang sku'i mdzad pas drag po nyer bzhi brtul zhing / de'ang mdzad pa gsum ste/ longs spyod pa dang / thim pa dang / dbang du byas pa'i/ longs spyad pa ni gnyis las/ btsun mo'i tshogs rnams he ru kas phrogs shing spyad pa ni—/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pa yin la/ rus pa'i brgyan cha rnams kyang rang la brgyan ①pa ni/ brgyan la longs spyod pa'o/ /thim pa la yang gnyis te/srog thim nas ni/ pho rnams bsad nas rnam par shes pa bsgyur ba'o/ /ye shes thim pa ni ma hā de ba thal ba'i dbang por gyur la/ drag po nyer bzhi bsad nas dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i ye shes dang bsres la/ mo rnams bsad cing rnam par shes pa rnams rnal 'byor ma rnams dang gnyis su med par byas pa'o/ /'jigs byed nyer bzhi ni dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i gdan du bya ba'o/ /ngag dbang du bya ba ni/ de dag gi ngag rengs par byas la/ yid dbang du byas pa ni thams cad kyi yid rgyal du bcug pa'o/ /de ltar pho rnams ni zhe sdang gi tshul gyis brtul zhing / mo rnams ni chags pa'i tshul kyis brtul lo/ /de dag gi phyogs su rtogs pa'i mi'am ci pho 'dul ba'i don du sgo ma bzhi la/ mi'am ci mo 'dul ba ni/ 'tshams ma bzhir snang ba'o/ /de ltar 'dul bya rnams brtul nas—/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang / dpa' mo nyer bzhi rnams sprul pa ma rtogs par da ltar bzhugs so/ /de nas ri rab kyi rtser byon nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor thog mar rgyud ②le'u 'bum pa gsungs so/ /de mangs par gzigs nas/ yang mchod pa phul nas zhus pas/ kha pa ma ya ces pa sho lo ka 'bum pa gsungs so//de nas yang nang gi mchod pa dang / bstod pa phul nas zhus pas/ mkha' 42—810

'gro ma dra ba sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud tshig rkang pa 'bum pa gsungs so/ /de nas yang mchod pa sna tshogs phul nas zhus pas/ le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa yi ge 'bum pa gsungs so/ /de nas bshad pa'i rgyud rnams gsungs so/ /dpal bde mchob/ gi byung tshul// byed //na mo shri te ru ka ye/ de la pu zhes bya ba ni pu li ra ma la ya ste/ phyis ①'dzam bu'i gling ②gi ri ma la ya'o/ /de'i rked pa na 'char ba can zhes pa'am/dri chen po can zhes bya bar yang 'gro ste/ de tsan dan rmi dri ngad ldang ba'i ri bo//de yang nang lus kyi dal ltar na/ mgo bo'i rked nas mig 'char ba yin zhing /ji ltar tsan dan kyi thang chu la ga pur byi dri mnam pa ltar/ lus kyi gnas de nyid na byang sems kyis dri bzhi mnyam lta bu'ang gnas pa'o/ /dza lan dha ra zhes 'bar ba 'dzin pa ste/ phyi ltar tho ling gi gtsang po sha pa ru pa bya ba dang / gar bzhi'i ①gtsang po byi ba sha zhes pa dang / shi ka'i gtsang po mer ba shes pa dang gsum 'dom pa'i mdo na grong don chen po gcig yod de/ de las rgyang grags gcig gi pha rol na sngon gyi bsgrub gnas brag phug brgyad cu/ chu mig brgyad cu/ shing drung brgyad cu yod la/ de'i thad ka'i brag gi dbus na chu 'bab pa'i stegs la/ mu stegs pa dang yul shi ka ba khrus byed pa ste/ yul de la 'bar ba 'dzin pa ces par grags so/ /nang ltar na spyi gtsug tshangs phug kyang drod rnams rgyu zhing 'bar ba'o/ /u rgyan zhes thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ nub phyogs mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas te/ sa'i dbyibs chos 'byung ltar gnas zhing / de 42—811

na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang shes rab che ba'o/ /nang ltar na rna ba g.yas pa ste/des thos pa 'dzin pa'o/ /a rngu ta ni rdo 'jog ces bya ste/ grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya ba ni/ ri dbus mtho la mtha' gzhol ba/ 'brang rgyas lta bu la nags tshal 'thug po yod pa—/ phyugs rdzi la sogs pa'i mi mang po rgyu zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas so/ /de la rdo rje brtsegs pa can zhes grags so/ /nang ltar na ltag pa'ang rgal tshigs kyi steng na rdo brtsegs pa ltar gnas pa'o/ /de dag tu mkha' 'gro ma rnams rgyun tu tshogs pa'i gnas yin pas na/gnas zhes bya'o/ /nang ltar na bde stong nyams kyis brten byang sems rgyun du gnas pa ①na'o/ /go ta wa ri zhes thos 'dzin rmi khyad par ro/ /de'ang ba'i mchog sbyin ces pa ste/ bal bo cig gi ba cig yod la/ de ri la btang bas nu ma stong par byung ste bltas pas sa skyongs cig na 'khor yul cig 'o mas gsang gnas ①gnang ste/ de brkos pas rdo las grub pa'i ma hā de ba'i ling kha cig byung ste/ de'i shar phyogs na chu 'bab la/ de'ang brgal ba na 'be+egs byed ces bya ba'i ri/ nags tshal dang me tog tu ldan pa nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs cig na/ ba'i mchog sbyin byas pa'i mtshams su brkos pas rdo nag po zo zo ba gcig ①la chos 'byung gi rnam pa byang sems kyis gang ba cig snang ste/ de lta bu'i gnas so/ /nang ltar na mchog sbyin ltar rna ba nas kyang rna lpags 'dzag pas rna ba g.yon pa'o/ /ra me shwa ra zhes pa ni/ dga' ba'i nags tshal zhes pa ste/ de'ang rdo 42—812

rje gdan gyi shar phyogs/ rgyal po dga' byed dbang phyug gi grong na sngon gyi bsgrub gnas brag rta'i rngog ma 'dra ba cig yod la/ de la nags kyi 'tshams zhes grags so/ /nang ltar na smin ma 'tshams ①dang chos 'thun pa'o/ /de ba ko ṭa zhes lha mo'i mkhar te/ shar phyogs bha ren tra'i grong khyer pañtsa pa ta na rgyang grags bzhi'i pha rol na/ rgyal po de so pa la'i lha khang na lha brten mig lta bu gnyis yod la/ de la lha mo mkhar zhes u ma de ba'i brten de la gzhan gyis gzugs brnyan 'char ro/ /nang ltar na mig gnyis la gzhan gyis gzugs brnyan 'char ro /ma la we zhes phreng ba 'dzin pa ste/ yul de na bsgrub gnas g.yas g.yon dma' zhing dbus mtho ba phreng ba lta bu cig yod de/ de na rdo'i chos 'byung bsgrub pa pos res mthong res mi mjong ba cig yod la/ de la phreng ba 'dzin pa zhes grags so/ /nang ltar na/ lag sor phreng ba lta bu dpungs la brten pa'o/ /de dag la nye ba'i gnas zhes pa ni/ mkha' 'gro sogs re 'ga' tsam gnas shing rgyun du mi gnas pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pas mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /ka ma ru par ni drod ldan zhes pa ste/ shar phyogs na lta brten 'chan khyang lta bu cig na rdo'i chos 'byung las dag pas mthong ba cig yod la/ ming ni 'dod gzugs ces so/ /nang ltar na 'chan khung yang rdo bas so/ /o ḍi ni/ bso byed de/ lho phyogs kyi rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i gnas na/bsgrub gnas na/ lha brten ro'i ling kha nu ma lta bu cig yod pas/ de la 42—813

bso byed ces grags shing / yul de yo byad shin tu mang ngo / /nang ltar na nu mas kyang gzhan bso zhing mi mdzad pa'o/ /zhing zhes dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rgyun tu 'tshogs pa'o/ /tri sha ku ṇa zhes gsum 'dus ces pa ste/ tu ru ka'i yul na chu bo gang gā dang / pak+ṣu dang / sin dhu gsum 'dus pa'i sa na rdo'i chos 'byung lta bu cig yod la/ de la bya ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / sa ra sa dang / bzhad pa dang / de tso la sogs pa mang po skad snyan pa sgogs cing nyams dga' ba cig yod la/ ming ni gsum 'dus ces grags so/ /nang ltar na/ lte bar rtsa gsum 'dus pas so /kau sa la ni nub phyogs rgyal po sas rgyal gyis rgyal khams nas rgyang grags cig na bsgrub gnas na sna lta bu'i ling kha gcig yod de/ de la mi rgyud byed ces so/ /nang ltar na sna rtser sems rgyud pa'o/ /res 'ga' 'tshogs pas nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka ling ka ni zad byed ces te/ rdo rje gdan nas dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi pha rol na yul glang pos 'dzin ces bya ba na/ kha lta bu'i bsgrub gnas spang dang nags kyi mtshams legs po cig yod la/ de ni zad byed ces so/ /yul der yi dwags mang bas ro bskyal ba tsam gyis med par byed do/ /nang ltar na khas kyang zas myur du med par byed pas na'o/ /lo pa ka ni/ 'phyang ba can zhes te/ gar log gi rgyab na bsgrub gnas 42—814

brag dang chu 'thab pa ste/ de na rdo'i leng kha skye mgrin lta bu cig yod do/ /ding sang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gros bzung bas mi ma yin gnas so/ /der brag cig 'phyang ba ltar 'dug /'phyang ba can zhes bya'o/ /nang ltar na mgrin pa'i sgog na glo snying 'phyang ba'o/ /sgon sgo ha ni phan 'dogs dang tshar gcod la 'dun pas na'o/ /nang lus kyi'ang de dag nas byang sems kyi tshar gcod dang phan 'dogs byed pa'o/ /ka— ni gsal la 'dzin pa ste/ tu ru ka'i yul nas dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa'i grong khyer chen po cig yod la/ de'i dbus su rdo'i ling kha snying lta bu cig yod de/ ming gsal ba 'dzin ces so/ /gnas der gnas pa rnams shes rab gsal skad/ nang ltar na snying yang don gsal ba'o/ /hi ma las zhe ①kha ba can no/ /de ni gangs te se te/ rdo mtshan ma mi tsam la chu 'bab pa'o/ /der kha ba 'bab pas na kha ba can zhes so/ /nang ltar na/ 'doms te/ der kyang dri chu 'bab pas na'o/ /nye ba'i mtshan ②sgo ha ni/ res 'ga' tshar gcod rjes bzung byed pas na'o//nang du'ang / de dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gsung gi 'khor los mi la sogs pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams rjes su 'dzin pas na/ /sa la spyod pa'o/ /pre ta pu ri na yi dwags grong ngam 'dod pa can no/ /de rgya bod kyi mtshams na/ bsgrub gnas ngam grog dang / gcong rong dang / 'bar 'bur gyis dbus na/ rdo'i ling kha mtshan ma lta bu cig yod de/ de yi dwags kyi 42—815

gnas bya ba cig yin la/ /der gnas pa rnams zas skom gyis gdungs pa'o/ /nang don mtshan ma ste/ 'dod chags kyis brdungs pa'o/ /byu ha de ba ste/ zhes lha'i rnam can ces so/ /li yul gyi lcang ra rmug po na—/ bsgrub gnas rdo'i ling kha dpal bshos lta bus mtshan pa cig yod la/de lha'i khyem zhes grags so/ /nang ltar na/ bshang lam yang rnam snang gi gnas yin pas de skad ces bya'o/ /'du ba can zhes dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma kun ga na tsakra la rgyun tu 'du bas na'o/ /sau raṣ+ṭa zhes pa 'khrang byed ma ste/ tu ru ka'i yul na grong khyer bu mu bya ba cig yod/ kha cig ni pa ra ṇa se yin par 'dod/ bsgrub gnas de na brla lta bu'i ling kha cig yod la/ ming ni bzang po 'am 'khrang byed ces bya ste/yul de'i sa dang brag 'khrang zhing bzang bas na'o/ /nang ltar na rked pa'ang 'khrang zhing brtan par byed pas na brla'i rtsa'o/ /su par+ṇa ①dī wa zhes gser gyi gling ngo / /de ni rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i rol gser gyi gling zhes te/ kha cig ni/ rgyal po dpal ldan gtsug gi nor bu'i yul rgya nag stong kun yin pas de dang nye ba na bsgrub gnas kyi ling kha byin pa lta bu cig yod de de na rang mang zhing 'phel ba'o/ /nang ltar na byen pas kyang lus kyi tshil bskyed pa'o/ /nye ba'i 'du ba can ni tshogs la res 'ga' tsam 'du ba'o/ /42—816

na ga ra zhes mgo brgyan ces so/ /de na srin yul lang ka pu ra te/bsgrub gnas mtsho'i do cig la rdo'i ling ga rkang sor lta bu cig yod do/ /kha cig ni/ kha che dang rgya gar nub byang mabyedas na gling cig yod pas de yul pu ra bya ba yin zer ro/ /ming ni klu'i mgo brgyan zhes so/ /nang ltar na rkang sor rnams kyang sbrul mgo ltar rkang mgos brgyan pa'o/ /srin dhu zhes brlag byed de/ dzā lan dha ra dang / tu ru ka'i bar na yod de/ de'ang dzā lan dha ra nye ba na chu bo sen dhu'i 'gram na bsgrub gnas rdo'i ling ga rkang bol lta bu cig yod de ming ni brlag byed ces/ nang ltar na rkang pa'i bol du byang sems brlag par 'gyur bas na'o/ /dur khrod ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byer mas ma rungs pa tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pas na'o/ /ma ru zhes chu mi 'bab pa ste/ dzā lan dha ra'i byang phyogs na/ brag phug bsgrub pa po brgya rtsa brgyad shong ba cig yod la/ de na rdo'i ling ga rkang 'theb lta bu cig yod de/ gnas der mas yar ni mi thar la/ yas mar spyad thag 'dom bcu gnyis tsam gyis sleb pa la 'dom do tsam chad nas bsgrub pa po gtong ba'o/ /de la ming ni drod med dam/ nus chu zhes bya'o/ /nang ltar na rkang 'theb kyang drod chung zhing / byang sems kyi nus pa zhan pas na'o/ /ku lu ta zhes 'byar ba can te/ de ni gar zha'i yul gyis rgyab/ nyung nyi bya ba'i yul gyi phug na/ bsgrub gnas su ling ga /pus mo lta bu mtshan pa gcig yod de/ thur du brkos pas chos 'byung cig kyang yod skad/ de'i 42—817

ming ni 'byar ba can zhes bya ste/ yul de'i ri brag rnams cig la cig mnyes shing 'byar ba'i tshul du yod pa'o/ /nang ltar na/ rkang pa'i pus mo gnyis kyi lha nga 'byar ba'am/ brla dang byin pa 'byar ba'i rtse na pus mo yod pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /nye ba'i dur khrod ces tshar gcod kyi las res 'ga' byed cing / gtso bor byed pa ma yin pas na'o/ /sku'i 'khor los ngan song la sogs pa'i sa 'og gi 'gro ba rnams 'dul bas na/ sa 'og spyod ces grags so/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/ na ro paṇa chen gyis zhal mnga' nas gsungs pa/mar pas bsgyur ba'o// ste/ //42—818

bsdur mchan/807 lamatshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/809 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dag81༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉min/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉brgyud/811 ①〈〈pe 〉〉phyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉mi gling / ③〈〈pe 〉stana'i/812 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉cig813 ①〈〈pe 〉〉patshams/815 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa ya zhes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tshan/816 ①〈〈pe 〉〉zaṇi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2438)42wa 819

༄ga /spra shād lung bstan te lo'i gsung bzhugs so//①༄7/ /rang rig lhan cig skyes kyi sku/ /bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /u rgyan mkha' 'gro sku gsum bdag /dpa' bo chen pos brtan pa yis/ /srog 'chang de yis 'phrin las mdzod/ /nga'i dgongs pa ji lta ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs yin te/ /tshig phyir 'byengs pas rtogs mi srid—/ /ma bcos ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /byen brlabs gnyis med de shar yin/ /des na byen brlabs shugs 'byung gis/ /rang rig lhan cig skyes rtogs na/ /de nyid mngon sum nga yin te/ /rigs brgyud ma chad rdo rje 'chang / /'di la dus gsum sangs rgyas dag② /srog 'dzin sku gsum mkha' 'gro yis/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs dngos grub ni/ /brgyud 'dzin de la smin par mdzod/ /des na nga'i dgongs pa 'di/ /yi ge'i ①tshig la mi ltos par / /rnal 'byor rig pa'i mngon sum du/ /nor bu rin chen gsum 42—820

rtogs na/ /brgyud pa brgyud ldan bya ma 'phur/ /dgongs pa byin brlabs drod tshad ldan/ /bla med don rtogs bstan pa 'dzin/ /des na 'di nyid sbyin pa'i yul/ /byen brlabs shugs 'byung rten 'byel yin/ /de phyir nga'i rgyud 'dzin pa/ /thabs shes zla phyed grangs nges che/ /u rgyan yul du sku gsum gyis//bsdu ba byas nas bstan pa 'dzin/ /mi rnams tshig gi rjes 'brang zhing / /dgongs pa'i byin brlabs na bun yal/ /nga srog yid bzhin nor bu gtong / /nam mkha' skra bshad brag cha la/ /tho yor log pa'i shes pa yis/ /mngon sum nor bu ga la rnyed/ /nga yi dgongs pa ji lta ba/ /rtogs par 'dod na yid bzhin gyis/ /nor bu rin chen me long ltos/ /rang gi bzhin ni mthong ba'i tshe/mtshan mkhan dag la legs zis nas/ /rdo rje gdan gyi rgyal sa gtad/ /gzhi ni 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang byung ye shes rang gsal bas/ /lhan cig skyes pas che ba yin/ /de ①na 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i/ /phyi nang rten 'brel rang la 'char/ /gshis la tha dad chos bden na/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa gnyis med 'khrul/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes ci la 'char rang sems mtha' dbus med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas sems can mu mtha' med/ /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya sogs/ /sems kyi che ba cir yang gsal/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rang la 'char phra mo'i rten 'byel smos ci dgos/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar kyang / /mnyam nyid dus sam cig gi ngang / /de'ang rang grol ye shes yin/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng gi pho ②'gyur med/ /phyi nang rten 'byel rang gis gsal/ /rang 'byung 'gag med rig ①pa'i brtsal/ /rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi sdangs/ /42—821

mun khung sgon mes de nyid rig /dngos su mthong ba'i rgyal ba yis/ /rten 'byel sgo rnams ma lus rtag /kun kyang gsal ba'i mi rtog ste/ /rang gsal rang gsal dngos su mthong / /yid bzhin nor bu brtson pa yis/ /ded dpon rgyal po 'dzin pa des/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu gzhan la gter/ /rten 'grel che ba thugs su chud/ /de phyir bu yis bla ma la/ /lus dang srog la ma ltos par/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs bsgrub byed cing / /dngos po bdag tu mi 'dzin par/ /ji ltar mchod dang bskur byed pa/ /zlosas ①sems med par gyur pa'i tshe/ /dgongs pa rgya mtsho'i brlabs bzhin 'gyur/ /des na gzhan gyi tshul mi bzung / /der spyod nor bu rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /bdag nyid kun gyis bskur bar 'os/ /drod thob skyes bu de la 'dun/ /nga'i srog 'dzin nga yin te/ /skyes bu dbugs phyin pa la gnas/ /tha dad zhen bral mchod byed na//yid bzhin nor gter kha phyed phyir/ /ltos pa med par gsung bsgrub na/ /rang gter rang gi 'don du gzhug /skyes bu gter chen thob pa yis/ /ltas gsum mthong bar ma gyur na/ /dbul ba bral ba'i nor dang sprad/ /zas kyi phung po'i rtsa mdud grol/ /zag med ye shes mngon du gyur/ /za hor yul du sprul pa bstan/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'khor lo bskor/ /mchog thob skyes bu grangs las 'das/ /skyes bus ④gter chen de thob na/ /mtshan mkhan dag la legs bris la/ /phrin las tshad med don la brtag /smin byed bltas chen ma mthong na/ /lha phrug mdzes pa brgyan gyis bcom/ /rang rtog mdzes pa'i me tog la/ /ltas chen mthong na bu yin ni/ /nga'i yid bzhin nor bu long / /bdag nyid rgyal po dmangs su phob/ /mnyen dul gus dang bcas pa yis/ /42—822

'dud par gyur na bdag nyid kyis/ /'dod 'jo'i 'o ma 'thungs nges pas/ /ngoms nas gzhan la ci gter na/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skyong la bris/ /'dud par 'dod pa'i skyes bu des/ /dregs tshig nga rgyal gzhogs ngoms na/ /rjes 'jug de'i don bsgoms kyang / /nor bu sbyin pa'i yul mi rnyed/ /chos la skyon 'tshol bcos tshig smra/ /rjes 'jug mkhas kyang 'dam du byings/ /pra mo co 'dri the tshom gyi/ /tshig smra tshe thung gus phyir du/ /mdud pa bya rog bu dang mtshungs/ /phrad ma thag gam yun du ni/ /brtags pas gus pa'i tshul rnams shes/ /rten 'brel ngang lugs thugs 'byung gis/ /legs pa'i bltas chen mthong ba'i tshe/ /myur du nga rgyal oṃ la zhugs/ /rdo rje 'dzin par ma shes shing / /rlung sems nad kyis byis pa 'khrul/ /nor bu gus par blangs gyur kyang / /rdo rje slob dpon grogs spyod la/ /nga yi che bar ma shes pas/ /'jig rten bcas pas dgongs pa yi/ /ngo tsha zhum pas gzhan dag la/ /rgyal mtshan spro bas brten ma nus/ /nor bu bcangs kyang don med 'gyur/ /rang che nga rgyal gzhan ngoms kyis/ /rlung sems nyams nga'i rtsar phyin pas/ /nor bu 'dam gyis khrod du sbas/ /gal te song song smra 'dod kyang / /nor bu len pa cig 'ga' tsam/ /skyes bu don chen spyod pa na/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse la 'phyar—/ /klu rgyal ri bo'i rtse nas ni/ /ya nga med pa'i skyes bu bde/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /dngos po rdzas rnams ma lus la/ /don med bya rog sa skungs dang / /yi dwags phyag rgya 'dzin pa ni/ /mthong ba de yi 'bras bu 'byung / /tshe 'dir 'dod don mi grub la/ /'og min gdul bya'i me tog yal—/ /de tshe pre la skyes bu yis/ /rlung sems bde ba byis pa yis/ /sbyin 42—823

pa'i 'bras bu nyams par byed/ /lus srog longs spyod thams cad la/ /ltos pa med pas bdag gzhan gyis/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gong ma yis/ /dgongs pa'i bdud rtsi phab pa'i tshe/ /de ltar gyur pa'i ci kho zhes/ /khrel dang the tshom gyur pa'i tshe/ /log pa'i shes pa'i skyon la brjod—/ /nyi zla khyab 'jug kha ru tshud/ /myur 'gro mi med rtser sleb ste/ /lho sprin chen po dgung la yal/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa lce yis blangs/ /chu bo rgyun la ngoms par 'thungs/ /'dzam gling tshangs pa'i gsung sgrags tshe/ /'gyur cog lon ni brjod gyur na/ /rang gi ①don yod brjod gyur kyang / /yid du mi 'ong tshig lan 'debs/ /myur 'gro 'phro bdag kha la smin/ /rdo rje'i gsung du shes pas bsgrubs/ /mnyam 'dod brjed ngas sgongs so kyis/ /bdag gzhan the tshom yid ma ches/ /myur 'gro mdun nas dri ma sleb/ /de ma thag par gsung rjes 'jug /rgyus med la 'byel the tshom dang / /mu cor smra na de'i tshe/ /myur 'gro rnam shes dza la thim/ /de tshe bag dang ldan pas spyad/ /don chen smras par gyur pa'i tshe/ /tshod yod po med phyal pa yis/ /che sar 'dod dang dma' ba ltar/ /'gro ba med de 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /de tshe rlung sems ngang la thim/ /'du shes phyogs 'dzin skad cig la/ /log par rlung sems 'dus pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /nges na rten 'byel che ba 'dis/ /nang gi bsams pa'i khyad par yin/ /bag yod lus ni gus pa yis—/ /dang po'i rten 'brel che ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lhan cig skyes—/ /nga'i srog gi snying po 'di/ /mthar ni mi nub bcang ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang du gsol/ /mgon po khyod la gtad pa'i phyir/ /42—824

rang gi rjes thob thogs thugs sras/ /bstan pa'i srog 'dzin nga'i bu/ /ye shes rgyun lam ma chad par/ /mchog thob rjes zhugs 'di min pa/ /nyi ma'i zer chen yan gyur na/ /nga srog dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsdus/ /bka' lung zo lums ra chod byed/ /ming tshig rjes 'byengs skyes bu de/ /bstan pa'i spyan min 'di nyid du/ /u rgyan sku gsum mkha' 'gro dang / /srog 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ /don 'dral de yis srog chod la/ /rjes zhugs bdun rgyud ①tshun chad du/ /dam 'gal mi mthun rkyen thong ste/ /byang chub sems dang gtan bral nas/ /'khor dang bcas pa ngan 'gro'i gnas/ /'di la rten 'byel las kyis bsgrub/ /ltos pa med pa'ang rjes 'jug pa/ /na ros dka' spyad shes par gyis/ /bla ma'i bya ba gang la yang / /gsung gi brjod pa ma byung kyang / /rang gi legs par brtags byas te/ /ltos pa med par bsgrub par bya/ /'di dang mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /phrin ④las chen po lhun gyis grub/ /rgyal tshab skyes bur 'os pa'i tshe//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'byung / /sngon du pra khrid legs mthong na/ /de la bdud kyi bar chad med/ /rdo rje 'chang gi lung byin la/ /dbang bskur bstan pa'i srog kyang gtad/ /de tshe bu'i dam bca' 'di/ /tshe rings bsod nams rgyas pa'i phyir/ /dngos po gang la'ang ma chags par/ /rang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa mchod/ /rab 'bring lo'i grangs tshad kyis/ /bsgrub pa'i dam bcas srog tu bzung / /bla ma ci gsung bsgrub ①byed cing / /de nas bzung nas rang ched kyis/ /bya ba nam mkha'i me tog yal/ /drod tshad rnyed na skyes bu des/ /ltas chen mthong ngam yang na ni/ /legs par rtogs pa'i dben 42—825

gnas su/ /lung bstan skyes bu de yis bsgrub/ /tha snyad la brten theg chen gyis—/ /go ba dog phyir lus pa la/ /mngon sum dag tu ngo sprad la/ /dbugs phyin pa la skyes bu bzhag /yang dag don gyi dgongs pa la/ /mtho dman 'phel 'grib med pa la/ /sku gsum rang chas ngo sprod la/ /bag chags rang grol ye shes bstan/ /tshig la bstan pa'i thad ka yis/ /go ba skyes kyang the tshom gyis/ /sgo 'dogs can la gang snang la/ /bde sdug rang snang bla ma bstan—/ /spang blang rang grol chos skur ①rtogs/ /rjes yengs ye shes ngo sprad kyis—/ /'khrul snang rang grol mngon sum bstan/ /gnas dang longs spyod thams cad la/ /rang snang zhen 'khris med par go/ /snang ba dbang du 'dus pa yis/ /'gal rkyen rang grol bogs 'don bya/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i skyes bu des—/ /ma bgrangs bcu gsum sa sgol te②/ /nga dang dbyer med rdo rje 'chang / /des na nga'i rang bzhin ni/ /chos dbyings mu mtha' bral ba yis/ /dam chos srog bcad bla ma bslus/ /nga'i thugs rjes mi skyob ste/ /nges par 'di yi srog chen kyang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ /las ngan myur du bcom pa'i phyir/ /de ma thag tu srog chod la/ /dri med snyan brgyud dgongs pa 'di/ /u rgyan gnas su bsdu bar mdzod—/ /lung bstan rje'o snod ldan kyis/ /yid bzhin nor bu rnam pa gsum//brda' dang byin brlabs la brten nas/ /snying gi snying po'i don nyid ni/ /dbyer med lhan cig skyes rtogs te/ /bstan pa'i srog 'dzin skyes bu des/ /nga dang tha dad ci zhig gu/ /'gro rnams don du skyes bu ni/ /lha mo'i grangs kyis 'dzin par shog /nyi zla gnyis kyi gter chen 'dzin/ /na ro chos 42—826

dbyings pho brang snyogs/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas bde chen 'jo/ /gnyis med ngang du kun tshims nas/ /te lo thugs kyi klong du thim/ /rigs gsum khyab 'jug gza' yis zin/ /nam mkha'i 'brug sgras stong gsum khebs/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyi stilo tog rgyas/ /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya ru/ /sgron me'i rnam pa kun gsal kyang / /zla ba rgyas pas mun pa sangs/ /ri rab rtsa nas rgyangs mig gis/ /khyab 'jug chen po'i srog dang 'jal/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor lo bskor/ /thub pa'i dbang po lag tu gtad/ /gcig gis 'dzam gling kun tu rgyas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis srog chen bzung / /thub pa'i dbang po nyid la gtad/ /shes bya'i sgo 'dogs ma rig spangs/ /rang bzhin gnyis med don ston te/ /rgyal ba de nyid de nyid rang / /dgu la bstan pa'i srog bzung ste/ /rgya mtsho rba rlabs tha dad grol/ /ngar ldan mtshon kyis dgra bo bsadarka/ /gza' dang rgyu skar srog bzung ste/ /thabs shes ldan pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i rting gi mun pa gsal/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lag tu gtad//yul 'khor bsrung gi gter kha bye/ /dur khrod nyi shu yul chen te/ /gtso bo yul kyis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /bdag sems nor bu rin chen 'di/ /ye shes lnga'i brgyan dang ldan/ /kun tu rtog pa sna tshogs kyang / /bzung 'dzin gnyis kyi khol por 'gyur/ /nam mkha' stong ldan 'di nyid la/ /'byung ba lnga'i 'gro don byed/ /skye 'gro srid pa ma lus kun/ /'phags pa'i lam la de nyid 'jug/mo bsham bu yis mda' ka des/ /shar phyogs ri bo'i ri dwags bsad④/ /dus mtshams ④byed pa sgra sgrogs tshe/ /kun gyi chos nyid gter rnyed de/ /rgyud dag rab tu rgyas pa'i tshe/ /re re drung du sku gsum gyis/ /mkha' 'gro mya ngan 42—827

'das 'og tu/ /u rgyan gnas su bsdu ba byed/ /da nas nga'i chos nyid 'di/ /rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs yin/ /phyi nang rtsa khams grol ba yis/ /za hor tshangs pa'i gnas su drangs/ /nga yongs 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /srog 'dzin skyes bu dus mda' yis/ /rang srog nor bu rin chen bzung / /des na nga'i rtsa khams 'di/ /'khor 'das kun gyis 'byung gnas yin/ /nga yi dus gsum mnyam nyid rtogs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs la gsal/ /des na dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ /deng 'dir gzugs dang dpa' ①mdzod la/ /kye ho yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa/ /rgyal chen bzhi las gtad de e/ /rgyal tshab skyes bu dpang ④gsol te/ /de dus yongs su rdzogs par sbyin/ /rgyal chen dngos su ma bstan kyang / /bla ma rdo rje 'chang du 'dzin/ /nor bu rin chen bstan khugs na/ /de la dam tshig legs bsgrags te/ /brda' tshigs mkha' 'gro dpang gsol te/ /chu srin lta bu'i gdams pa bcwa'/ /gnyis kyi gang la gang bltas pa/ /nga yi dam tshig ma 'da' bar/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro de nyid du/ /srog chen snying khrag dron mo mthungs/ /bstan pa'i gnyer chen bstod de kye/ /gal te rdo rje slob dpon rmis/ /'jig rten grags pa gtsor bzhag ste/ /ngo dga'i tshul gyis smras gyur na/ /dam tshig rjes 'byengs mkha' 'gro dang / /dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ /bcas la 'gal byed slob dpon te/ /de ma thag tu bsgol bar mdzod/ /dgongs pa mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bsdus/ /snying du bsam pa'i slob bu yis/ /bcas pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di bral na/ /dam tshig dag las 'gal ba'i phyir/ /'di 42—828

yis bstan pa'i srog gcod pa/ /de ma thog tu bsgral bar gyis/ /gnyer chen 'di las gang 'das pa/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro khyed rnams kyang / /dam tshig gdung ba yal lam ci/ /de bas dus 'dir 'phrin las mdzod/ /kye ho lung bstan rjes thob pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la bdud rtsi yis/ /char chen srog yang 'dzin mdzad cing / /tshad yang brjod cing tshad ma ru/ /de nyid brten pa de la sbyin/ /'jig rten bya ba kun spangs te/ /lus dang longs spyod srog bcas la—/ /ltos pa med pa'i bu 'di la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /dbang bskur byin gyes brlabs pa dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis//'di yis bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /yid bzhin nor bu gtad pa'i gnas/ /gsum ldan cig la nges pa med/ /rang gi rang gter 'don pa'i phyir/ /srog dbang bskur la de la byin/ /ngag gi yon tan tshad gyur kyang / /lus kyi yon tan mi ldan pas/ /srog gi bar chad 'byung bar nges/ /lus kyi yon tan ldan gyur kyang / /ngag gi yon tan mi ldan na/ /'gro don ston ka'i me tog yal/ /lus ngag gnyis kun tshogs gyur kyang / /sems kyi yon tan mi ldan na/ /bcud chen sgod kyis mi thub ste/ /thugs nas yun rings ma lon par/ /de tshe ri srog nyams par byed/ /gong ma'i yon tan mi ldan na/ /sems kyi yon tan mi 'byung ste//'di ni bstan pa'i spyan chen yin/ /des na 'di 'dra'i lag tu ni/ /bstan pa'i spyan chen sho ra re/ /phrin las rjes su bsgrub pa yis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpang gtsugs la/ /rgyal chen rgyal mthe gnyis ka yis/ /mchod rdzas gtor ma sbyin blangs te/ /dpang du gtsugs la mna' chen dor/ /des na bla ma'i thugs dgongs 'di/ /slob mar nges par gyur na ni/ /snyan brgyud 42—829

༄ga /gtor ma tshogs mchod kyi dbu lags so//①༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi rol byi mchod pa la/ chang byin gyis brlab pa dang / chang gis mchod pa dang /lag pa byen gyis brlab pa dang / lag pa mchod pa dang / maṇ+ḍal byin gyis brlab pa dang / maṇ+ḍal gyis mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor byin byis brlab pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyis mchod pa dang / gtor ma byen gyis brlab pa dang / gtor mas mchod pa dang / tshogs byin gyis brlab pa dang /tshogs kyis mchod pa'o/ /de la dang po chang byen gyis brlab pa ni/ thod pa la sogs pa'i nang du chang bzang po ma nyams pa blugs la/ rang dam tshig sems dpar bskyed pa'i mdun du bzhag la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du oṃ bsam/ de rang gi kha la gtad pas oṃ byi 'od zer kyis chang dam tshig gi bdud rtsir bsam/ g.yas pa'i mthil du a bsam a kha la gtugs pas skye 42—831

med kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ lag pa gnyis sbyar ba'i bar du hūṃ bsam/ hūṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsis spyan drangs te chang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ lag pa nyis ①kyis chos 'byung gi mu tra bcas la chos 'byung gi dkyil du ho dmar po cig bsam/ ho las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa dang rang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis ka snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems chang la zhu bas chang dam tshig dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams la srin lag gis ②chang la chos 'byung cig bri/ zur gsum la 'bru gsum dkyil du ho/de nas ho nas nas blangs te oṃ ā hūṃ byas la spyi bo'i bla ma la gtor/ bla mas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ de nas rang gi lte ba'i hūṃ sngo nag la thugs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ ā hūṃ ho zhes gtor/snying ga na ā dmar po gsung gi ngo bo 'am lha tshogs la gtor/ spyi bo'i yī dkar po sku ①ngo bo'am lha tshogs su bsams te gtor/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du bsams te gtor ro/ /de nas gnas khang la gtor/ rdo rje'i gnas khang du byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas la gtor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med par byin gyis brlab/ mched dang lcam dral la gtor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar byin gyis brlab po/ /chang byin gyis brlab pa dang / chang gi mchod pa'o/ /lag pa byen gyis brlab pa dang / lag pa mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga lte ba dang drug bsams la/ lte ba la oṃ baṃ/ 'dab ma 42—832

la g.yon bskor du/ haṃ oṃ hri mo hri hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa bsam/ de yang dang po dam tshig gi yig 'bru gnyis pa ye shes kyi yig 'bru spyan drangs la stem/ yig 'bru de dag kyang oṃ baṃ rdo rje phag mo dang / haṃ oṃ na ma ni sngon mo dang / hri mo rmongs byed ma dkar mo dang / hri hri skyong byed ma ser mo dang / hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed ma lngang gu dang / phaṭa phaṭa tsan ḍi ka du ba'i mdog can te①/ lha'i ngo bor shes par bya'o//de nas sor mo rnams la mtheb sdemo dang 'dzub mo dang gung mo dang srin lag dang 'the'u chung dang rnams la/ oṃ haṃ/ na ma ni/ swa hā hūṃ/ sgo shad te/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ lnga ka 'dus pa la/ phaṭa phaṭa haṃ bsam/ yig 'bru de yang dang po dam tshig gi yig 'bru gnyis pa ye shes kyi yig 'bru spyan drangs la bstem/ yig 'bru de dag kyang ngo bo lha ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang /'od dpag med dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / don yod grub par blta bar bya'o/ /lag pa la gnas pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni/ltung byed ma dang / gsod byed ma dang / 'gugs byed ma dang / gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang / pad+ma'i dra ba can du blta'o/ /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo de gnyis kyang yab yum du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /lag pa'i rgyab tu 'khor lo gsum la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi gong ma ltar bskyed/de nas lag pa mchod pa ni mdun rgyab rim pa ltar/ yī ha/ oṃ badz+ra pus pe a hūṃ/ badz+ra dhu pe a hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra de pe a hūṃ/ badz+ra ghan dhe a hūṃ/badz+ra de bi te a hūṃ zhes pas me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me dang /zhal zas dang / dri chab la sogs pas mchod do/ /nang gi mchod pa ni/ā+oṃ ha zhes rim pa ltar gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /42—833

reg gi lha mos mchod de/ ā+oṃ sarba be+e shi pra sa ra pu tsa me ga sa mun tra sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni lha mo thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba dpag tu med pas mchod de/ oṃ ā hūṃ a mri te hūṃ zhes pas mchod par bya'o/ /rgyab kyi 'khor lo la dpa' bo'i sa bon hūṃ re la 'bru gsum gyis mchod de/ de nas yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas stod/ yi ge brgya pas sdig pa bshags/lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khrul pa bzod par gsol/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin par gsol ba gdab dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa sems can thams cad la bsngo/phan yon ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dag pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis zlob pa dang / zas nor longs spyod 'phel ba dang / ma 'ongs pa na mkha' spyod du skye bar 'gyur ro// //maṇ+ḍal byin byus brlab pa ni me long gi ngos lta bu'i maṇ+ḍal la oṃ badz+ra bhu me a hūṃ zhes ma dal dang sa phyogs la byug pa bya'o/ /de nas ā+oṃ badz+ra re khe pad+ma ma ḍa la hūṃ zhes brjod pas pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i steng du ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa ri rab kyi rtse la gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa/ 'gron sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma dang bcas pa bskyed do/ /oṃ haṃ ma ha bhi ra na ma lan gsum gyis dbus su dbul/ yī yo sarba bi re ya na ma shar du lus 'phags po/ oṃ ram̐ dzam pu ris na ma/ lhor 'dzam bu gling / ā+oṃ lo a pa ra ho ye na ma/ nub tu ba lang spyod/ ā+oṃ baṃ ku ta ku te na ma/ byang du sgra mi snyan/ ā+oṃ ya u pa de ba ya na ma/ shar gyi g.yas skor 42—834

gnyis su me tog re/ lan gsum gsum gyes dbul/ ā+oṃ ra u pa de pa ya na ma—/ lho'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su lan gsum gsum byus me tog re dgod/ā+oṃ skyel u pa de ba ya na ma nub kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su lan gsum gsum gyes mre tog re dgod/ yī ba u pa dhi pa ya na ma byang gi g.yas g.yon gnyis su me tog re lan gsum gsum gyis dgod/ de nas nang gi phyogs dang mtshams su /ā+oṃ ya ga dza rad na ya na ma/ shar glang po che/ ā+oṃ ra su sha rad na ya na ma/lho blon po/ ā+oṃ la a sha rad na ya na ma/ nub tu rta mchog /oṃ paṃ shri rad na ya na ma/ byang rin po che/ ā+oṃ ya khad ga rad na ya na ma/ shar lho rgyal po/ā+oṃ ra ma ni rad na ya na ma/ lho nub tu btsun mo/ yī tsakra ya na ma/ nub byang 'khor lo/ yī sarba ni bh+yo rad na ya na ma/ byang shar gter chen po/ā+oṃ srur+ya ya na ma/ ā+oṃ tsan dra ya na ma/ nyi zla gnyis lan gsum gsum gyis me tog re dbul lo/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ④dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab rol pa'i mtsho bdun phyi'i lcags ri nag po dang bcas pa phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pas gang bar byin gyis brlab po/ /'bul ba ni yi dam gyi lha la phyi nang gsang ba gsum kyis gang bar sprul te dbul/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la yang de ltar sbyar ro/ /de nas mchod stod gnyis/ bshags bsdam gnyis/ gsol sngo gnyis sku ①rang gnyis rgyas par bya'o/ /phan yon ni dpag tu med do / /rjolus kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ 'byung ⑤bzhi rang sar dag pa/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba re las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi lus yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin du bsam ste/ pu dza u/ a ku ra/ de ma ka /o ki go ka la ka /hab sra bhi/ so bu 42—835
