ma—/ si ma ku zhes lan gsum brjod pas yul na nyi shu rtsa bzhi sa na bcur bsam par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig gis stong pa'i rjes yo las rlung ram̐ las me baṃ las chu lo las sa bye las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba ma las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ baṃ 'dus pa las yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ go rdzogs par bgo'①/de nas rang dam tshig sems dpa' thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la rang gi lus stong gsum byi stong chen po gang bar dmigs te ngag tu ā+oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhan dha na ka ro mi zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas rnam lnga dbul te/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pus pe a hūṃ zhes pas me tog dbu la/ gdug dze+espos shangs la/ mar me spyan la/ zhal zas zhal du/ dri chab thugs kar dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ ā+oṃ pad+ma ka ma le swā hā lha rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ de nas mchod bstod gnyis/ bshags bsdam gnyis/ gsol sngo gnyis rjes bskur gnyis so/ /stod pa spyi ni bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la bstod pa dang / 'gron gsum la bstod pa spyi'o/ /bye brag gi stod pa ni dpa' bo thams cad yab kyi rkang brgyad du bsdus/ dpa' mo thams cad yum gyi rkang brgyad du bsdus te bstod pa'o/ /mchod pa ni rang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa'i zla ba'i steng gi hūṃ las mchod pa'i lha mo spros te/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pus pe a hūṃ/ zhes pas rnam lnga dbul te/ me tog dbul/bdug ④spos shangs la/ mar me spyan la/ zhal zas zhal du/ rol mo snyan la/dri chab thugs kar budabul lo/ /yang snying ga'i hūṃ las gzugs rdo rje ma dang /42—836

sgra rdo rje ma dang / dri rdo rje ①dang / ro rdo rje ma dang / reg rdo rje ma spros te/ā+oṃ sarba bi sha sra sa ra pu tsa me ga sa mu tra a hūṃ des dbul lo/ /de kho na'i mchod pa lha mo thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa yang sngags des dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang / sku gsung thugs la sogs pa sgo 'tshams ma thams cad la yang rgyas pa ltar mchod na gong ma ltar sbyar ro—/ /bsdus pa ltar mchod na ā+oṃ ā hūṃ gis gsham ④du mchod pa gsum sbyar bas mchod do/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa ni sngar byas pa la 'gyod pa bskyed/da ltar ba ①bshags/ phyis srog la bab kyang mi byed par dam bca'o/ /rgyun bshags dang yi ge brgya pas kyang bshags so/ /sdom pa gzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yid rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /byang chub mchog gi sems ni skyed par babyi/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis 'gron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas grub par shog /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas gsol sngo/rjes bskul gdab pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal rang gi spyi bor spung / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga'o// //bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma byen gyes brlab pa dang / gtor mas mchod pa ni dang po rang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gye mdun du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba cig gi nang du phyogs bzhir bi mu ra shu ma las bdud rtsi lnga bskyed/ gho/ ku/ dha/ ha/ na 42—837

las sha rnam pa lnga la sogs pa gtor ma'i rgyu rnams blugs la/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kha gab kyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa gcig ①bskyed/ 'og tu mi mgo skam po gsum gyi sgyed po dang /de'i 'og tu re las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa re byis mtshan pa'i steng du/yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa rnams bsam mo/ /yi las rlung g.yos te ram̐ las me 'bar bas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas khol te/ rang gi spyi bo dang / 'grin pa dang / snying ga rnams kyi 'od kyis dkar po dang /dmar po dang / sngon por khol snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ⑤rnam pa sna tshogs bkug ste/ be+er rdo rje dang / zla ba yang zhu nas/ dam tshig dang ye shes gnyis dbyer med par bya ba'i phyir ā+oṃ ā hūṃ lan gsum brjod do//gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /'gron spyan drang ba ni/ rang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor/ 'gro ba rigs drug kyang dpa' bo dpa' mor bskyed/ rkang pa g.yas kyis g.yon pa'i 'the bong mnan te/ lag pa gnyis dra ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ dmig gyen la zlog nas ngag tu/ oṃ shi badz+ra te he ru ru ka dha ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra phe phe zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa nam mkha' sa gzhi khengs pa spyan drangs te—/ de dag la mchod pa lnga dngos saṃ yid kyis dbul/ de nas mchod bstod gnyis—/ bshags bsdams ①gnyis/ gsol sngo gnyis/ rjes bskul gnyis rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma dbul ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a ra l+li ho/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ sa ma ya sto/ tri sha ho/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ zhes lan lnga'i bar du 42—838

mngon par bsngags la/ phyogs g.yas skor mtshams g.yon bskor du dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod brgyad la dbul ba ni/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba ju ta pre ta/ pi sha tse/ ud ma tai/ a pa sma ra/ dha ki bya/dha ya i me bha ling gh+rit+na du/ sa ma ya rak+ṣa na du/ ma ma sarba sed rda me/ pra yad tsan du/ ya te baṃ/ ya te stso/ 'bun dza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi kra tha/ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+ya dha ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shud dha ye/ sa ha yi/ka bha ban dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum brjod la dur khrod brgyad la dbul lo//de nas ma mo zhing skyong dang phyogs skyong srungs ma spyan drang bar bya ste/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la spyan drang ba'i sngags/ ā+oṃ ka ka kan dha na/ bha ba bha na dha na/ kha kha khan dha na/ sarba dus sta nam/ ha na ha na/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/a mo gha sa hūṃ dza zhes pas bkug la/ phyogs 'tshams su pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la mchod pa lngar byen gyis brlabs pa de nyid dbul te/sngags de nyid kyi 'jug la/ a mo ka gya shan ting ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pas dbul te so so'i lce la hūṃ las rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs la/ lce'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi drangs te mchod par bsams la/ bdud rtsis mchod pa ni/ā+oṃ khye tra pa la pan tsan a mri ta kha nyi zhes lan bdun/ chang gis mchod pa ni/ā+oṃ khye tra pa la ma da na kha nyi gtor mas ①mchod pa ni/ ā+oṃ khye tra pa la i me bha ling spru na sarba sad ta dz+wa shan ta te tsa ta khye na swā hā/ de nas stod pa bya ste/ā+oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul dang / /grong dang bzhi mdo nyid dang ni/ khyad par du ni khrukhang stong dang / /rdol pa'i gnas dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag mo drag mo drag 42—839

chen mo/ /lha bzhin mnyam du sten pa dang / /nag mo rtsigs dang mi sdug dang //bka' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed mo dang drag mo dang / /mi sdug ma dang ud ma dang / /rgyal ma rnam par rgyal ma dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyar ba mo/ /'phrog ma dang ni mar me ma/ /'jigs byed ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /nag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba rtsigs dang thod chen mo/ /thod 'phreng can dang /wā gdong ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta bcas/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i gzhu chen ma/ /de bzhin chen mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /las kun rjes su bsgrub byed ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor zhi ba mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /de nas chos bshad bya ste/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing bcad du med/ /rgyu dang las la yang dag byung / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod—/ /smon lam gdab ste/ sems can thams cad snyig med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /rang lam nyid nas grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas/ /rnal 'byor bstan chos gnas la dgod/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa dang / gtor mas mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po/ dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa 42—840

rdzogab/ cas// //bod kyi lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/831 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉rtor bkod/832 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gnyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉ston/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sku'i/833 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ste/ (yi〈〈pe 〉toratheb/835 ①〈〈pe 〉stago ('di'i 'og gi skye/ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉pa oṃ zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/)②〈〈pe 〉〉rgyad/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉bsku/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ska/ // du〈〈pe 〉〉〉ba/836 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bko'/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dbu'al/ bdug ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsdug du〈〈pe 〉stanakur/837 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ma/ ②〈〈pe〉〉bsham/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wab/838 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ཿga ②〈〈pe 〉ste:ra/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉bsnam/839 ①〈〈pe 〉stabar/ ②〈〈pe 〉to/ni/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2440)42wa 841

༄ga /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/①sgo chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang ④/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma ṣaṭa badz+ra yo ge tha nā ma/ bod skad du/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ dpal zung 'jug bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig brjod bral lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /kha sbyar bde chen longs sku gang 'dul shar/ /sku gsum bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang gis/ /theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos//dbang bzhis smin byas dad dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro bas/ /lam mchog 'di la gang gis 'bad gyur na/ /zla drug lo'am tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ /sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ /rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ /'pho ba ma sgoms sangs rgyas/ /bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku/ /42—842

rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan/ /shes rab kha ga mu kha'i snyoms 'jug gis/ /zag bcas zag med dga' bzhi rim bzhin no/ /bcud bsdus dag byed stong ra'i gnad gsum dang / /drod myur gtum mo'i chos drug rim bzhin te/ /ri bong dbab bzung zlog 'gram ①rlung dang bsre/ /zag med ye shes chen pos brgyan par bya'o/ /gtum mo zas su za ba/ gos su gyon pa/ stan du 'dings pa/srid pa'i dbang zhu ba/ gegs rang grol dang rlung rtar zhon pa'o/ /sgyu lus bden med dbang po rab 'bring gsum/ /'bral med mos gus rang lus cir snang kun/ /snang stong bden bral lha sku'i lam khyen bya/ /chags sdang rang grol bcu bzhi'i sa thob 'gyur/ /dbang po rab grogs su bla ma dam pa brten pa/ 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par khrid pa/ tha ma mal cig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o/ /gang gis bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas//rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad la 'bral med bya/ /nying 'khrul yang dag sgyu ma lam rim rmi/ /yon tan nyin mtshan dus su rang shar 'byung / /mi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul pa/ bsgyur ba/ yul snang ngo / /'khrul 'a mas/ bde 'byams/ stong 'byams rnams/ mos gus tshogs sogs gar sel brgyan par bya/ /'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang / /bde chen zag bcas zag med lta stangs kyis/ /bde gsal mi rtog dbyer med rang shar 'byung / /spyor dngos rjes gsum dus gnad brgyan par bya/ /'od gsal bzung ba lam khyer bsre ba mthar thug go/ /'od gsal mngon gyur dam pa nyams myong can/ /42—843

'char sgo gegs sel bogs 'don brgyan par bya/ /'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba yang rab ste/ /'bring dang tha mas chags sdang spang byas nas/ /dga' zhing mos gus dmigs pa rtse gcig gis/ /gyen du 'phang zhing smon lam brgyan par bya/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /dus gnad lus gnad rdzas dang ngag gnad la/ /sbyangs shing brtan pas 'pho ba mchog yin no/ /bar do snang sogs 'od gsal chos sku dang / /gang 'dul sprul skus mtshalas sbyor skyo shas gnad/ /chags sdang phrag dog ①'od gsal lha skus sbyang / /sgrib gnyis rang dag sku gsum mngon du 'gyur/ /bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar/ tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar—/ spyi gnad 'chug med lam 'khyer ro/ /gzugs sgra ②chu snang byed la sogs pa yi/ /thim 'gros rang bzhin brgyad cu shes par bya'o// //log ltas rgyud dkrugs rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus/ /yang dag chos ni nyin skar ru sbal spu/ /chos log tshong dus 'o ma'i chos spyod tshe/ /nyams myong lung dang them yig brgyan pa gces/ /lim kyi mchog gyur 'di ni nyams len rnams//gzhan gyi dus min 'di'am bar ma dor/ /bde stong dbyer med rang shar nas//rnam par dag pa'i mkha' spyod nyid du 'gro/ /'di nyid mi rabs bdun du chig brgyud las/ /mi spel rdo rje'i rgya yis gdab par bya/ /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis 42—844

bsgyur ba'o/ /bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas pa'o/ /phyis tho ling du lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/842 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ṅkabazhugasaso//842 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dgram/844 ①〈〈pe 〉stedegs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skus/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2441)42wa 845

༄ga /rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang /sdeg phyag chen rdo rje'i tshig rkang ②/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu tra/bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po/ dpal zung 'jug bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal loske/ /bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen byis/ /skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /tha mal shes pa e ma ho/ /sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum/ /dngos gzhi skyon bzhi ①rang grol/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar ro/ /gnasadabe+en par skyil krung bcas lag pa sanon phyag rgyas brgal tshigs bsrang la tshigs bzhi dang / rtsa dang chubasdud pa thams cad lhod kyis glod pa ni/ lus rang babs soske/ /ma 'byed 'dzums kyi rtsol ba med cing / ngagasmra brjod dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag pa ni—/ ngag rang babs so/ /sems mig gi lta stangs dngabacas pa sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa dang bral ba ni/ sems rang babs so/ /gnyis pa dngos bzhi ni de nyid skyon bzhi dang bral bar bya ste/ semasachos kyisku 42byed846

dang 'du 'bral med kyang nye grags pas ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyi 'khor bar 'phas so /rang phyagargyachen po la shar yang zab grags dpes mtshon mi nus pasango bo kha dog la sogs pas ma grub pasangosam zin/ grags slabasarang babs nam bzhag kyang 'char bas yid ma ches par yengs med dubasgoms pa dang bral lo/ /sku gsum rang la shar bas bzangagrags yanganges shes ma skyes pas blor①ma shong bar chosaskur thag chod dang bral bas 'iskyonagyi sems 'khor bar 'gas so/ /gsum pa sku bzhi rang shar ni mthar thug mnyam rjes dngablos byas thamasacad dang bral ba'i rkyenagyisarang shar phyag rgyachen po del/ snang bsna tshogs su rangashar du gsal ba de sprul pa'i sku/ sna tshogs su gsal ba de la gsal 'dzin kyirtog pa dang bral ba'i rtog med de chos kyi sku gsal la rtog med de nyid zagamed kyi bde bar shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ de gsum rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pas mthar thug bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /de nyid la rtog med kyi cha/ de ji lta ba b.raganas pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /mi rtog pa shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la ji ltar gsal zhingamar+ṣa ba'i cha de ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /de gnyis rang bzhin gyis dbyer mi phyed pas chosakyidabyings dngaye shes bzhi gnyis su med pa zhes bya'o/ /rang babs rnam gsum gyi sngon 'gro'i dam tshig rkun bur ngo sprad pa de gsang ba'i rdo rje'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don ni snying rje tshad med pa bla ma'i mos gus gsol 'debs so/ /'gro 'chag la sogs pa spyod lam bzhi'i dus su lam khyer ci snang de nyid do/ /lngos bu mngon du gyur pa nisgom du rdul tsam yang med yengs su skad cig kyang med do/ /nyin mtshan gnyis bsre ba rtog med 'od gsal du gnyid dang mi lam gyi bar lam khyer ro/ /gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar gyi rtog /gnyid kyi 'od gsal glangapo che'i lta stangs kyisabogs 'don byas pas gnyid du song tshad 'od gsal du 'gro ba'o no/ /gnyid sad rjes la snang ba thams cad gsal la 'dzin med du bsgoms la mtshan mo dang nyin mo bsre/ /nyin par dang mtshan modangabar do'i 'od gsal gsumani/ /42—847

sku gsum dbyer med lngolamed du rang shar ltos shig /gang gis mi shes rgyud du sbas pa'i don/ /mthar thug tshig gcig grol ba 'di yin te/ /bsgom med yengs med goms shing brtan pa las/ /sa lam rim pa dus 'dir sgod byed de/ /yid la mi byed sgrib gnyis rang sar dag /sku gsum rang shar 'bras bu lhun kyis grub/ /mdo rgyud kun tu bstan yang rang bzhin gab/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhal las shes par bya/ /chos sku'i nam mkha' rtog pa'i sprin tshogs las/ /dug lnga'i glog 'gyu ba rnams kyi rang bzhin de nyid ye shesachen por ltos/ /phyagargya chen po yidal mi byed 'khor 'das la re dogs kun bral ba'i/ /tha mal shes pa bcosabaslad bral ba'i ngang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// //mkha' 'gro ma de nyid mnyes par byas te/ gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus—/ lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //42—848
bsdur mchan/846 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skobazhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhir/847 ①〈〈pe 〉snosgo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2442)42wa 849

༄ga /chos spyod mi dge rang grol zhes bya ba/①sto chos spyod mi dge rang grol sogs 'ga' yar bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharmā tra tha ka ri sa ta na ma/ bod skad du/ chos spyod mi dge rang grol zhes bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog bla med 'gro ba skyob pa'i zhing / /thugs rje'i 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam lha/ /phyi nang ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs dang bcas—/ /phyogs bcu'i bstod 'os rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas skyob pa'i dam chos dang / /'dren pa'i dge 'dun bla ma rin po che/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrungs ma la/ /byang chub bar du rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i sems can snying re rje/ /mkha' mnyam mar gyur bde skyid rab ldan zhing / /mi mthun bdud dang gnod pa kun bral nas/ /'gro kun bla med sangs rgyas thob pa'i ②phyir/ /gus pas byang chub bar dang tshe 42byed850

'di'i bar/ /ding nas sang gi bar du dge la bkol/ /bdag nyid ci 'dra 'gro kun de 'dra zhing / /sgrib gnyis rab bral mkhyen pa rab rgyas shog /byams dang snying rje tshad med sa gzhi la/ /ting 'dzin rin chen dag pa'i gzhal yas khang / /thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bshams pas①/ /gus pa'i yid dang gsal ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor bcas dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /rgyal ba rab 'byam ma lus spyan 'dren gyis/ /'gro la brtse dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni badz+ra dharma pa la sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ 'gro ba'i don du dge ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba yid 'ong rgya mtsho yis/ /mchod par 'os pa rnams kyis rgyal ba mchod/ /'gro kun tshogs rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang phyir bzhes/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /sems dpa' bla ma yi dam chos skyong tshogs/ /ma lus tshogs bcas zhabs pad ze 'bru la/ /spyi bos rab tu gus par phyag 'tshal lo—/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /deng 'dir bsags pa'i mi dge ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bshags⑧/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'khor lo bskor/ /bdag sogs 'gro bas bgyis pa'i dge ba kun/ /bla med don du byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /chos skyong bsrungs ma ma lus 'khor bcas kyi/ /snang stong 'gyur med ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mthong ba don dang ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /chos skyong bsrungs ma ma lus 'khor bcas kyi/ /grag stong 'gyur med brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung / /42—851

thos pas don dang ldan la/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /chos skyong bsrungs ma ma lus 'khor bcas kyi/ /gsal stong 'gyur med ye shes rdo rje'i thugs/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan la/ /yon tan kun ldan 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /grag stong don ldan ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ /ye shes lnga ldan kun la khyab pa'i thugs/ /sbu gsung yon tan ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig bcu kun bral nas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma ci 'drar bdag gyur cig /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ /gsal ①byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes/ /rin chen sna bdun gter rmi bum par bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba yid 'ong mchod pas spras/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mdzes pa'i zhing khams 'di/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum bla ma yi dam dang / /ḍa ki chos skyong ma lus 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas 'bul byus 'gro ba'i don du bzhes—/ /oṃ gu ru de ba ḍa ki ni rad na maṇ+ḍa la pu tsa me gha sa mu tra spa ra na sa ma ye hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal zhal zas dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan phreng ba sna tshogs 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra pu྾ pu tsa me ga sogs dang / de bzhin du byu pe/ ghan dhe/ a lo ke/ ni wi te/ shap+ta a hūṃ/ gzugs sgra dri ro 'dod yon sna tshogs 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri dhi pu tsa me ga sa mu tra spa ra na sa ma ye hūṃ/ 'jig rten khams na dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul/ /mchod par 'os pa ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba'i tshogs la 'bul—/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /thugs rjes nyer gzigs 'gro kun skyabs su gsol/ /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /mchod 'os kun gyis mchod cing bstod pa yis/ /'gro kun tshogs rdzogs sgrib 42—852

gnyis rab gsal nas/ /te ru ka dpal bla med mchog thob shog /bla ma yi dam phyi nang gsang ba'i lha/ /ḍa ki chos skyong tshogs bcas ma lus pa'i/ /bde legs yon tan ma lus rab rgyas pa'i/ /bde legs des ni bkra shis bde legs shog /skyob pa'i rjes slob gang dang gang zhig gis/ /nyin re bzhin du thun gsum glags ①gyur na/ /sdig bcom nyes bral mkhyen gnyis thob par 'gyur/ /gang gis thos gyur don ldan bde bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di nyid don du gnyer bar bya/ /dge des 'gro kun mkhyen gnyis thob par shog /chos spyod mi dge rang grol zhes bya ba/ grub chen ra snu las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi grub thob ra snu la badz+ra'i zhal mnga' ④nas/ /lots+tsha ba chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //42—853

bsdur mchan/85 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉bona'i/851 ①〈〈pe 〉stanas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bshad/852 0)〈〈pe 〉〉bsal/853 yo)〈〈pe 〉〉migs/ 90〈〈pe 〉〉snga/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2443)42wa 854

༄ga /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa myur du sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i thabs/sdeto bde mchog gsang sgrub bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra si bha ra sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa myur du sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i thabs/ dpal bde chen ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems bskyed tshad med sngon 'gro bas/ /chos rnams stong pa nyid du sgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid kyi/ /spyi gtsug yi ge 'bye khrudakar las/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhir gyur/ /de'i lte ba padamadang nyi zla'i steng / /hūṃ dkar baṃ dmaralas 'od 'phros pas/ /srid gsum gyi sems can bde mchog dkar po'i go 'phangs labakod/ /'od zeratshur 'dus yab dkar yum dmar dugyural/ /bde chen lha mo sku mdog dkar—/ /g.yas gri gug g.yonathod khrag snams la kha ṭi ka dang bcas pa bzhi/ /rtsibs kyi steng du bsam par bya/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtsemolaram̐ bzhi la/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis/ /gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi dang kho na nyid phyagachen gyi mchod pas/ /42—855

yab yum snyoms 'jug sbyor 'tshams nas/ /byang sems dkar la dmar mdangs chags/ /chu rgyun rang gi spyi gtsug zug /'khor gyilhamobazhi kha ṭī yab kyi dze+e du snyoms 'jug byasapas/ /gsang gnas nasabyang sems rgyun rnams babs/ /rang gi spyi gtsug gcig tu gyur nas ni/ /gnas spyi bo mgrin pa la snying kha lte ba bzhir babs pas sdig sgrib dag /'khor lo myur 'khor nad gdon rnams/ /bcad dang gtubs pas me dpung bsregs/ /rlung gis rang bzhin med par gtor/ /chu rgyun 'khor lo me dpung rlung / /de la ma yengs gsang sngags bzlas/ /dmigs pa stod na rmi lam 'byongs/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku rang shar 'byung / /de ni sku yi 'khor lo'o/ /de nas mgrin par bye dmar las/ /'khor lo dmar dang pad nyi yi/ /steng du hūṃ dang baṃ dmar las/ /'od 'phros gong bzhin spro bsdu bya/ /dbus su bde mchog yab yum ni/ /pad+ma ra ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rus pa thod pa skam rlon brgyan/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o//phyogs bzhir lha mo gri thod can/ /mdog dmar kha ṭī bcas pa'o/ /rtsibs kyi ram̐ las gong bzhin du/ /ye shes me 'bar mchod pas mnyes/ /gtso 'khor yab yum sbyor 'tshams nas/ /byang sems dmar ba'i chu rgyun byung / /mgrin pa man chad khengs pa yis/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ /chu rgyun 'khor lo dmarapo me dpung rlung / /snying po bzlas par khyad par sngaradang med/ /dmar ba khongapa'i nang me'i 'obs ltar bsam/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po'o/ /rang gi thugs kyis 'khor lo sngon po ni/ /snying khar bye sngon be+e dur mdog /no ngar ldan pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa lte ba pad+ma bsam/ /nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng / /hūṃ dang rdo rje'i spro bsdu las/ /bde mchog sngon po yum dmar 42—856

zhing / /drag po'i rang bzhin 'khor bcas bsgom/ /rtsibs bzhi'i rtse la lame dpung sngo nog 'ur sgra thug sgra dang bcas pa 'bar/ /yab yum snyoms 'jug rgyud bskul nas—/ /zag med bde ba cher rgyas shing / /hūṃ phaṭa gad mo 'brug stong sgogs/ /spyor 'tshams byang sems 'thing shun mdog /snying kha man chad khengs pa yis/ /sems kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /khyad par gdon dang zhe sdang rnams/ /'khor los stubs shing me dpung bsregs/ /ye shes rlung gis gdengs par bya/ /byang sems chu rgyun drag po yis/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad thal ba'i ri bo la chu rgyun babs pa bzhin bkru/ /gti mug dngatshad pa'i nad zhi b.rabyed pa ba la/ /spyi gtsug sku yi 'khor lo dkar po ga bur gyi chu rgyun dang bcas pa bskor/ /dbang dusdudapadang 'dod chags dngagrang nad la/ /mgrin pa gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po lcags bsreg pa bzhin dang zangs zhun lta bu bskor/ /gdon bgegs zhe sdang bad kan la/ /snying kha thugs kyi 'khor lo chu rgyun sngon po me sngon nag 'bar ba bskor/ /rbad gtong ngan pa bzlog pa la/ /sa bon hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /gnod byed bkug la 'khor los stubs/ /mes bsregs rlung gis gtor bar bya/ /lha rnams zhal ni phyir bstan la/ /snying po'i rjes su ma ra ya/ /btags pa bzlas pas dam nyams sgol—/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun bdun byis/ /sa rnams g.yo zhing zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams 'grub/ /bcu bzhi'i sa rnams rdzogs byed pa'i/ /bdemachog nye bar sgrub pa 'di la 'bad/ /mkha' 'gro'i srog snying shangasapa rdu gu pa khyod la gtod/ /chig rgyud las ma spel tsi ti'i ①pho brang du/ /rang srog ltar hosgrub 'di dang bla ma gces par zung / /ni gu ma nga rang byen zlob spyi bor sgoms lagasol ba thob/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i rim pa rnams/ /42—857

༄ga /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang mchog bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bi ti na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig ting nge 'dzin kyi dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ thog ma kho nar yid 'jug pa'i gnas star ba legs par byas/ der bcom ldan 'das bde mchog gi bris sku la sogs pa legs par dgram/ de nas maṇ+ḍalagyi sa gzhi la ba'i rnamalngadang dri bzang dang chang la sogs pas legs par byug /de la drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi maṇ+ḍal lam bcu gsum 'am/ lha lnga'i maṇ+ḍal byas te/ de yang pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ phyogs tshonashar mthing byang ljang nub dmar lho ser lteb dang lnga la me tog gi tshom bu lnga'agod/ de las lha lnga bskyed/ mchod pa lngadang gtor ma lnga lasogs pa rgya chen po bsham/ de nas slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gral la 'khod du bcug ste/nyams pa can la 42—859

sogs pa yin na/ te ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa 'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa gang rung bzlas pa byed du bzhug /de la 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pa sngon 'gro'i chos rnams bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor du zhugs te/ de yang sgrub pa po rang gi thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ sngon po cig bsam/ de la yi ge bdun pas bskor bar bsam zhing / /bsnyen pa ci rigs cig bskyal lo/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ hūṃ la thim pa las drug cu rtsa gnyis sam/ bcu gsum mam/ lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed do/ /de la sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa dbang bskur rgyas btab la sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa'i sngags kyi phyi'i mchod pa rnam lnga dang nang mar gsang mar dbulalobastod pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas chang byin rmis brlab pa ni/ ka pa la'i nang du bde mchog yab yum lhan skyes kyi tshul du skad cig gi bskyed nas/ sngags bzlas pas yab yum kyi sbyor 'tsham nas/ thig le byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam pas/thod pa'i chang bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas yab yum gnyis bde ba'i ngo bor zhu nas—/ thod pa ltem khengs par bsam mo/ /des tshogs kyi yo byad dang mchod rdzas la gtor bas thams cad bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dnga'ajigs byed dus mawo rmi steng du hūṃ/ mgrin par paṃ las pad+ma dmar po/ de'i dkyil du a dmar po 'bur skyes cig /snying khar yang pad ①nyi'i dang 'jigs byed dus mawo gyi steng 42byed860

du hūṃ/ lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du baṃ dmar po ①cig bsam du bzhug go/ /de nas spyi bo'i hūṃ las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa/ yab yum gyi rnam pa ḍa ki rnam pa bzhis bskor ba can du bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi yi ge las/ 'od zer byung bas rang gi spyi bo bde ba chen po 'od kyi khyab pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum dbang thob par bsam/de nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang dbang thob par bsam/ de nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'od kyi khyab/ /yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ de nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ lus ngag yid gsum kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa thob pa'o/ /de nas snying kha'i hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yang rtsa ba'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhis gtso bo la bskor bar ④byed pa la shes pa gtad do—/ /de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas/ chos 'byung nang gi baṃ la phog /baṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas na cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ sku mdog dmar mo rus pa'i brgyan cha can/ /khro ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa gar byed pa de la shes pa btad do//de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu/ /snying kha'i bcom ldan 'das la thim/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu/ lte 42—861

ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ rnal 'byor ma'i sna ①bug g.yas nas a le byung /g.yon nas ka li byung / smin mtshalas sdesu g.yung drung dmar po gcig tu gyur nas drag tu 'khor bar bsam mo/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thimaske/ rang gi phung po yang 'od phung lta bu la stong sangs kyi song nas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la dar cig bsgom du gzhug go/ /de ltar spyi bo'i bla ma la sems btad nas bsgom pas drod skye/ de bum pa'i dbang gi ngo sprod/ dga' ba'i dbang du byas na/ nyams su stsong ba'i dga' ba'o/ /snying kha'i lha tshogs la shes pa btad pa'i dus su/ lus sems la mi rtog bde ba skyes pa de/ gsang dbang gi ngo sprod/ dga' ba'i dbang du byas na mchog dga' 'o/ /chos 'byung gi rnal 'byor ma la shes pa btad pa'i dus su/ lus sems la mi rtog pa skyes te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo sprod/ dga' ba'i dbang du byas na dga' bral gyi dga' ba'o/ /dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo gcig tu 'dug pa de/ dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod/ dga' ba'i dbang du byas na lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /de nas chos sku skye ba med pa la longs skur 'gag pa med pa lta ba'i tshul gyis/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lhasku snang la rangabazhin med pas snang stong tsam du yang zhen pa med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur sgom du gzhug go/ /de la mchod pa rnam pa lnga tshan cig dbul maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa slob ma'i snying khar bsdu'o/ /des ni dbang bzhi ma thob pa thob pa dang / thob nas nyams pa gso ba dang sdig pa thams cad myur du zad nas/dpal bde ba chen po'i sku mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes nas/ tshe 'di nyid du bcu bzhi bde ba chen po'i sa 42—862

thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gtor ma btang / tshogs la longs spyod/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ bsngo ba bya'o/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma ni gu mas sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las phyung ba'o / /rdzogs so// //bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas mkha' 'gro ma de nyid mnyes par byas nas zhus pa'o/ /lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyi ①bsgyur ba'o// sbi //bsdur mchan/859 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/86 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nem/861 ①②〈〈pe 〉〉ba/862 ①〈〈pe 〉skasnag ②〈〈pe 〉toratshams/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2445)42—863

༄ga /dpal 'chi med ste shes chen po zhes bya ba/①༄/ 'chi med rdo rje'i tshig rkang la sogs pa 'chi med kyi bskor rnams bzhugs so/ /sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri a ma ra dzñā na ma hā na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'chi med ye shes chen po zhes bya ba/ dpal 'chi med ye shes chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chosasku'i ngo bo rgyal ba rnamasalongs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /'chi med ye shes sprulasku'i 'phrin las rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /skyesabugang zhig bla ma la gus pa dad ldan dbang gzhan dang 'dir thobartsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig can/ /bla ma mchog tu gyur pa bsten 'di don la'achimed rtogs par gyis/ /gang gis dadagus can tshe 'di blos phyis kyis btang nas/ /tshe gcig tu bsgoms na rab/ tha ma zhagabadun 'bringalozlabayis/ /ji ltar nyon mongs pa'ilus 'didag nas/ /ye shes 'chimedalus ni rang dgar 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad med pagazhidang sems bskyed sngon 'gro bas/ /cho ga gsum 'am skad cig gis/ /rang lus yi dam yab yum bde mchog gyis/ /spyi 42byed864

gtsug hūṃgis bon 'od zer gyis/ /lus kyi phyi nang thams cad kun/ /dag cing stong gsal gnyid dusbyangs pas/ /snang stong 'ja' tshon ltabu'od kyi sku/ /snang la rang bzhin med bzhin sku mdog dang / /zhal phyag brgyan dang me dpung bcas—/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa yi/ /zag med bde stong chen por lta b.rabya'o ltos—/ /rang lus snang stong lha sku'i sems derang gi yin pa la/ /sems ni snang stong shāsti yib ྅// /se/ma sa 2)nga lnga/ (1 sems spangs pa'i pha rol na lha sku med/ lha sku spangs pa'i pha rol na sems grub pa med pas dbyer med de/ /rmi lam yul dang chu zla ltar/ /rang bzhin gyis dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug chen po yi/ /ngo bo brjod padang/ bralabasablolasa'adas te—/ /de'ingobobarngod bral ni dus ①gsum sangs rgyas kyis/ /'das pas ma gzigs ma 'ongs pas migazigs daltar gyis gzigs mi 'gyur/ /de la na rgyu meda'achi rgyu medadang //'khor b.ra'akhyam rgyu med mya ngan ①'das sangasargyas rgyu ma grub cing / /'pho bya dnga'apho byed thamasacad dang bral bas na/ /yeshesade phyir 'chi med rang grol lo/ /de ltar sems 'chi med du ma rtogs pa'irnal 'byor pas/ /bskal pagrangs med par sgrubs kyang ngal bdon med du'agyur zhing/ /log pa'i lam 'ba'azhig zhugs pakho nar zad/ /skyes bu gang gis 'tshams med pa lnga yongs su rdzogs pasakyang / /nama'achi kha'imatshe 'di'i dus gzhan du/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'chi med rdo rje'i tshig rkang pabazhi po 'di//skad cig gamayud tsam gcig la'ang / /dran yid la bsam pa 'am/ ngag thosarnam par lus la reg par gyur pas kyang / /gnad gcod kyisdug bsngal thamasacad rangadag la song nas—/ /dang po bar dor rgyalabalongasaskur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya/ /sgrib pa chung la smos ci dgos/ /'di ni 'chug med gnad yin no/ /gal te lus sems rkyen dbang gis/ /'chi khar gsal bar ma gyur dang / /42—865

dper na sgogs kyi 'khrul 'khor zhin①/ /sngags kyi gnad kyis bar ma dor/ /rgyal ba longs skur rang shar 'byung / /mtshalas sbyor ngan pas rgyud dkrugs kyang / /gsal dngas rdzing bur rdo rgyab bzhin/ /sngar gyi gnad kyis bar ma dor—/ /longs sku bde chen rang shar 'byung / /brtan par ma gyur long med kyang / /bco lnga'i nyi rgas zla shar bzhin/ /'di 'am 'chi khar dran thos kyis/ /bar dor longs sku the tshom med/ /rang sems skye med chos sku la/ /'gag med gzugs sku rang shar kyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par/ /gang 'dul gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /ngo bo rnam pa 'phrin las rnams/ /zung 'jug chen por rtogs par gyis/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /'chi rgyu med pas dbang po rab/ /de don skad cig rtogs gyur pas/ /dag pa bde chen mkha' spyod 'gro/ /dus gsum rgyal bas 'di rtogs pas/ /bdud brtul sangs rgyas 'khor lo bskor/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i thugs bcud 'di/ /mdo rgyud du mar bstan gyur kyang / /dam pa'i drin ni ma rtogs pa/ /thabs gzhan gang gis rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de phyir bla ma mchog sten nas/ /gus shing mnyes pa gnang yin no/ /snyigs ma'i log ltas rgyud dkrugs tshe/ /yid ches lung gis brgyan par bya/ /'chi med ye shes chen po 'di/ /chig rgyud rdo rje'i rgya yis btab/ /mi rabs bdun nam gsum la'o/ /rang sems 'chi med rang grol rdzogs so// //ye shes ḍā ki mas seng sdeng gi nags gseb tu gsungs nas/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos kyang gtan la phab pa'o/ /ḍā ki ma de nyid la bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas gser srang lnga brgya phul 42—866

nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas pa'o// //bsdur mchan/864 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/865 ①〈〈pe 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉smugang /866 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhin/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2446)42wa 867

༄ga /rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang /①go phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang / tshig gsal bzhugs so/ /༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu tra/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po/dpal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /longs sgu rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /tha mal shes pa e ma ho/ /sngon 'gro rang babs rnam pa gsum/ /dngos bzhi zhuskyon bzhi rang grol/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar ro/ /dbe+en par sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas tshigs bzhi dang rtsa bzhi rlod pa ni lus rang babs so/ /mchu rtsol ba med cing smra brjod dang bral ba ni ngag rang babs so/ /sems mig gi lta stangs bsgom 'dod dang bral ba ni sems ④rang babs so/ /de nyid skyon bzhi dang bral bar bya ste sems chos sku dang 'du 'bral med kyang nye grags pas ngo ma shesarka/ rang la shar yang zab grags pas ngos ma zin/ sba duyang yid ma ches 42—868

— pas yengs med dang bral lo/ /bzang bas blor ma shongs pas thag chod dang bral bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'o/ /mthar thug mnyam rjes blos byas dang bral ba'i rang shar de la sna tshogs su gsal ba de sprul sku/ gsal 'dzin dang bral ba'i rtog med de chos sku/ gsal la rtog med de nyid bde bar shar ba longs sku/de gsum rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pas mthar thug pa bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /de nyid la rtog med kyi cha de ji lta ba'i ye shes/ mi rtog pa la ji lta bar gsal ba'i cha de ji snyed pa mabyed pa'i ye shes so/ /de gnyis rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pas dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa zhes bya'o/ /sngon 'gro'i dam tshig gsang ba'i rdo rje'o/ /bogs 'don snying rje gsol 'debs so/ /lam don cir snang de nyid do/ /mngon 'gyur bsgom med yengs med do/ /bsre ba rtog med lam 'khyer ①ro/ /'od gsal lta stangs bogs 'don no/ /sang rjes gsal la 'dzin med bsre/ /nyin mtshan bar do'i 'od gsal ni/ /sku gsum dbyer med rang shar ltos/ /gang gis mi shes rgyud du sbas pa'i don/ /mthar thug tshig gcig grol ba 'di yin te/ /bsgom ④med yengs med goms shing brtan pa las/ /sa lam rim pa dus 'dir bsgod byed de/ /yid la mi byed sgrib gnyis rang sar dag /sku gsum rang shar 'bras bu lhun rmis grub/ /mdo rgyud kun tu bstan kyang rang bzhin gab/ /bla ma'i byin brlabs zhal las shes par bya/ /chos sku'i nam mkhar rtog pa'i sprin tshogs las/ /dug lnga'i khrog 'gyu ye shes chen por ltos/ /yid la mi byed re dogs kun bral ba'i/ /tha mal shes pa byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// //42—869

ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid mnyes par byas te/ gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus so/ /lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/868 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanazhi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wasems/0〈〈pe 〉skusar/869 ①〈〈pe 〉〉khyer/ ②〈〈pe 〉sgrosgom/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2447)42wa 870

༄ga /rang grol phyag rgya chen po bzhugs so//①༄4/ /chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro la na mo/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yis/ /sems nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas/ /tha mal rnam rtog dag bya'i phyir/ /rang lus lhar gsal bla ma la//lhag bsam dag pa'i mos gus bya/ /bla ma yi dam mi dmigs shing / /dngos dang dngos med la sogs pa/ /gang yang yid la mi bya bar/ /ma bcos snyug ma'i ngang du bzhag /rang sems ma yengs chos kyi sku/ /de la ma yengs sgom pa'i gnad/ /mtha' bral chen por rtogs par bya/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor sgyur byed pa'i/ /nyon mongs chags sdang rnam rtog 'di/ /skye med mtshon cha rnon po yis—/ /rang bzhin med par bcad par bya/ /sdong po rtsa ba bcad gyur na/ /yal ga skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho la/ /chu sbur byung zhing chu la thim/ /de bzhin rnam par rtog pa yang / /chos nyid min pa gzhan 42—871

med kyi/ /skyon du ma lta glod la zhog /gang shar gang skyes de nyid la/ /der 'dzin med par rang sar grol/ /snang grags ①chos rnams rang gi sems/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan med/ /sems ni skye 'gag spros dang bral/ /sems kyi de nyid shes pa nges/ /'dod yon lnga la spyad gyur kyang / /chos nyid ngang las g.yos pa med/ /dper na gser gling phyin pa yis/ /sa rdo rtsal bas mi rnyed ltar/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings chen po la/ /spang blang mnyam bzhag rjes thob med/ /gang gi tshe na mngon du gyur/ /de tshe lhun byis grub par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skongs mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur/ /gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum/ /blo yi rim par shes par bya/ /rang grol phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //42—872
bsdur mchan/871 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉ltar bkod/872 6)〈〈pe 〉〉gragabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2448)42wa 873

2522༄ga /lam khyer gyi chos gsum zhes bya ba/①༄/ lam khyer rnam gsum gyi gzhung khrid yig dang bcas pa gnad kyi snying po sogs bzhugs so// sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ dha na dharma tre ya nā ma/ bod skad du/lam khyer gyi chos gsum zhes bya ba/ dpal sku gsum bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bla ma mchog bsten dbang thob pas/ /dben par gnas shing 'jig rten blos btang nas/ /lam mchog 'di la rtse ②cig 'bad gyur na/ /lo zlas lhun grub rnam gsum thob par 'gyur/ /'di ltar snang ba sna tshogs la/ /brten nas bla ma yi dam dang / /sgyu ma bde stong gsal bar ni/ /lam khyer sku gsum rang shar 'byung / /blo ldan mi rtag skyo shas dang / /byang chub sems mchog sngon 'gro bas/ /rang lus yi dam spyi gtsug tu/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs byas nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun thabs gcig tu/ /snying rjes kun slang gsol ba gdab/ /de yi mos gus skyes pa dang / /snang ba 42—874

sna tshogs thams cad kun/ /rims kyis bla mar lta bar bya/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du/ /rang lus snang stong lha sku sems/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /'bral med bla ma lam khyer bas/ /cir snang bla mar 'char bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i lam khyer mchog yin no/ /bzhipade ltar brtan par gyur pa dang / /bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis/ /bzod dka'i rgya mtsho che las bsgral/ /grangs med mi thogs tshe 'dir thob/ /drin bsam 'bral med gsol ba gdab/ /phyag sogs bdun po rnam dag bya/ /lngapasgra rnams grag stong bla ma'i gsung / /drugapadran rtog thugs su lam khyer bya/ /bla ma'i sku gsum lam khyer ro/ /bdunapade ltar khyad 'phags lam khyer des/ /nyin mtshan mnyam rjes thams cad du/ /brgyadapacir snang thams cad bla mar shes/ /bla ma de nyid rang gi sems/ /sems dang bla ma dbyer med de'i/ /sprulaskugasalachosasku stong bde chen rang shar dbyeramed de 'byung / /de nas yi dam lam khyer bshad/ /tha mal shes pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rang lus snang stong sgyu ma'i sku/ /gsal la rtog pa med par bsgom/ /dgupa de nas sdugapal chagasami sdug pa la sdangashes bya shes dka' ba rmongs gsum yul/ /phyi rol gzugs snang sna tshogs kun/ /rim gyis ①lha yi skur shes bya/ /de la dad cing gus ldan pas/ /bdun rnam dag phyag la sogs pa gong bzhin no/ /bcupa cir snang lha sku sgyu mar shes/ /lha sku de nyid rang gi sems/ /sems dang lha sku dbyer med pa'i/ /sprulaskugasal chosaskustong bde chen lha dbyeramed sku de/ /sku gsum lam khyer nyid du bshad/ /de'iyon tan bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /'bral med lha sku zla drug gis/ /skye ba 'di 'am bar ma dor/ /rgyal ba longs sku thob par 'gyur/ /bcugacig pa ste snang ba'i cha la bskyed rims dang / /stong pa'i cha 42—875

la rdzogs rims te/ /bskyed rdzogs ma yin chos 'ga' med/ /zung 'jug tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /bcuganyis pa rang dang snang ba lhar bltas nas/ /dgra rnams grag tshad sngags su lta/ /sngags rnams grag stong rang bzhin med/ /sgrags gsal ye shes stong pa'i dbyings/ /dbyer med shes pas grol gyur te/ /gang 'dul sprul sku thob par 'gyur/ /bcugasum pa dran rtog lam khyer bshad kyis nyon/ /dus gsum ma 'gags rang shar la/ /ma spangs 'dzin med sku gsum du 'dod chags ngo bo bde ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin/ zhe sdang ngo bo gsal ba sprul sku/ gti mug ngo bo rtog pa chos sku 'thob/ /sgo/sa pas 11la 'gyur the tshom med/ /yang na dug gsum lta stangs kyis/ /rang bzhin med 'gyur chos sku 'thob//de nas sgyu ma lam 'khyer ni/ /'di ltar rmi lam sna tshogs dpes/ /snang ba sems su gtan la dbab/ /sems ni sgyu ma rmi lam ste/ /bzung sbyangs spel sprul bsgyur ba rnams/ /nyin par spyod lam thams cad du/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /gnyid song 'dun pas nyams blangs pas/ /rmi lam dus su rang shar 'byung / /bzung 'dzin bral ba'i 'od gsal ni/ /mos gus lta stangs stobs las 'char/ /longasasku bde sprulaskugasal mi rtog chosaskubarjod bral ba'iske/ /sku gsum dbyer med ngobonyidakyi sku bde chen ni/ /nyin mtshan kun tu rang shar 'byung / /bde gsal phyag rgya chen po'o/ /mjug bsdud mdor na dam pa'i mos gus dang / /rang lus snang stong lha skur lta / /ngag ni zlas brjod grag stong ste/ /sems ni dran rtog der 'dzin bral//de ltar rtse gcig nyams blangs pas/ /lo zlas 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /gsang sngags mngon sum lam pa ste/ /kun las mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /khyad 42—876

'phags lam khyer gyi chos gsum zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /ḍā ki de nyid la gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te/ bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas nyams su myong bar byas pa'o// //bsdur mchan/874 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉bortse/875 ①〈〈pe 〉7)/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2449)42—877

༄ga /sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/①sdo sgyu ma lam rim bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma ya dha na kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung 'gyur zhing / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /sems nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi bcud—/ /brjod bya'i snying por gyur pa yi/ /sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa 'di/ /gzhan la phan phyir bshad par bya/ /sgyu ma gdod nas ma grub pa/ /thog ma med pa'i dbyengs nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun kyis ④sa bon te/ /bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de/ /snying po kun gzhir ①grags pa'o/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dad brtson gus pa'i mchog ldan pas/ /sgyu ma lta bur sgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur 42—878

mngon sangs rgyas/ /de yang lam lnga sa bcu rnams/ /legs par bshad kyis nyan ①par byos/ /brtan dang g.yo ba ji snyed pa/ /sgo lnga'i yul du gang snang kun / /thams cad snang stong lha'i sku/ /lha sku mtha' bral sgyu ma te②/ /byang chub phyogs chos thams cad dang / /lha sku sgyu ma dbyer med par/ /mkhas pas nyams su blang bar bya/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams/ /mos gus stobs kyis bsgod par byed/ /bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral ba/ /rgyud bde dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /de ltar snang grags chos rnams kun/ /lha dang bla ma'i rang bzhin du/ /nyams su len pa khyad par 'phags/ /dbyibs dang ①kha dog dug lnga dang / /las rigs grub pa rigs lnga ste/ /cir snang snang dang stong pa nyid/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang zung 'jug go/ /gang zhig dag byed bum pa ste/ /dbyer med dkar dmar gsang ba la/ /bde ba'i cha ni gsum pa ste/ /brjod med bzhi par shes par bya/ /gang la bde gsal mi rtog pa/ /de ni sku gsum rang shar te/ /gsal la mi rtog mkhyen gnyis so/ /de yang zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis/ /zung du 'brel pa'i phyir dang ni/ /bla na med pa'i phyir dang ni/ /phyin par 'dod pas lam zhes bya/ /sdig pa chung yang sgong byed cing / /dge ba rnams ni dang du len/ /chos nyid sgyu ma thob don du/ /tshogs sogs pas na tshogs lam mo/ /de la che 'bring chung gsum ste/ /re re la yang bzhi bzhir 'dod/ /dran pa bzhi dang spong ba bzhi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam bzhi'o/ /bag med dran nyams nyung ba'i 42—879

rgyu—/ /de phyir thog mar dran pa bshad/ /snying po med lus rgyal ba'i sku/ /snang stong dbyer med sgyu ma la/ /dran dang shes bzhin nyams su len/ /lus kyi dran pa nyer gzhag go/ /bde sdug btang snyoms dmigs pa dang / /chos su btags pa thams cad kyi/ /tshor ba la ni tshor bar shes/ /tshor ba ①dran pa nyer gzhag go/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te/ /sems ni phyi nang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems gang ma grub sgyu ma ste/ /sems kyi dran pa nyer gzhag go—/ /nyan thos rang rgyal thams cad kyi/ /ji snyed chos su btags pa yin/ /ming ⑤tsam btags pa blo bur ste/ /chos kyi dran pa nyer bzhag go/ /mi dge ba ni sdug bsngal rgyu/ /de las thar par 'dod pa yis/ /sdig rnams dug du lta ba'i phyir/ /yang dag spong ba rnam bzhi ni/ /sdig pa mi dge ba yi chos/ /ma skyed ①pa rnams mi skyed phyir/ /'dun pa 'bad rtsol sems 'dzin cing / /yang dag rab tu 'jog byed do/ /gang zhig sdig pa mi dge'i chos/ /skyes pa rnams ni spong ba'i phyir/ /mdun pa bskyed rjodang 'bar la sogs/ /gong bzhin du ni shes par bya/ /dge ba'i chos ni ma skyes pa/ /rnams ni bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /'dun pa'i sprul ba bskyed pa dang / /'bad pa la sogs gong bzhin no/ /dge chos skyes rnams gnas pa dang / /'phel ba nyams par mi 'gyur dang / /chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir/ /mdun pa bskyed sogs gong bzhin no/ /de yang sdig pa mi dge'i chos/ /ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed cing //'dun ⑤pa bskyed ces bya ba ni/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ste/ /cir snang sgyu mar nyams blangs pas/ /mi dge'i chos rnams 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de yang tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab mi mthun phyogs rnams ni/ /sdig pa 42—880

mi dge'i chos zhes bya/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yis/ /mi dge de dag spang ba'i phyir/ /mdun pa la sogs bskyed pa ni/ /yang dag spong ba dang por 'dod/ /gzhan yang mi dge'i chos rnams ni/ /'dod pas chags la khong khros sdang / /ma rig pas ni gti mug go/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ni//mi gtsang 'dod chags zhi bar byed/ /byams pas zhe sdang rten 'brel gyis/ /gti mug zhi bar byed pas te/ /rang bzhin med par shes pa yis/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed pa ni/ /yang dag spong ba gnyis par 'dod/ /dge chos ma skyes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mdun ma bskyed cing 'bad rtsol gyis/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub la mdun pa ni/ /dge rtsa kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /sems 'dzin nyams len dge ba'i mchog /yang dag spong ba gsum par 'dod/ /dge chos skyes rnams mi nyams dang / /chud mi za phyir 'dun ①pa bskyed/ /'bad rtsol sems 'dzin yang dag 'jog /dge rtsa sgyu ma'i nyams len ni/ /khams gsum dag tu mi gnas pa/ /thams cad mkhyen par bsngos pa yis mtha' ni zad par mi 'gyur ba/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi par 'dod/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la/ /rgal nas mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /sa la phyin par 'dod rnams kyis/ /nying 'dzin rdzu 'phrul rnams bzhi ni/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ltar/ /gang du ma grub mtha' bral ba'i/ /chos la mi skrag spong zhing 'dun/ /de phyir 'dun ②pa'i ting 'dzin no/ /'dun ma sgyu ma'i nyams len tshe/ /'jig rten zhen pa dor byas nas/ /le lor gyur spangs brtson 'grus ldan/ /de nas brtson ①'grus ting 'dzin no/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brtson 'grus des/ /sems ni phyi nang gang du yang / /mi dmigs 'dzin 42—881

bral sgyu ma la/ /rtse gcig sems kyi ting 'dzin no/ /rtse gcig gyur pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'gro 'chags nyal 'dug thams cad du/ /bden med sgyu ma'i lam 'khyer gyis/ /spyod pa'i phyir na spyod pa'o/ /spyod pa'i ting 'dzin la sogs pa'i/ /'du byed dang ldan rdzu 'phrul gye/ /rkang pa zhes bya kun la sbyar/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin ni/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni rkang pas te/ /'dzin med de yis log pa yis/ /chos rnams yang dag spangs nas ni/ /dge dang yang dag dge bar byed/ /gang zhig dge ba'i chos de yang / /rnam par mi rtog rtog bral byed/ /ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul rang bzhin no/ /lam mchog dri ma med pas te/ /yang dag gnas su phyin byed phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa zhes bya'o/ /tshogs lam rtags ni dad brtson ldan/ /tshul khrims dag phyir dbang po'i sgo/ /kha na ma tho phra la 'dzem/ /phyi rol chags snang yul rnams kun/ /gzhan min rang la skye bar shes/ /skyes pa de nyid sgyu mas te/ /nyin mtshan spyod lam kun du spang / /'dun pa drag po'i bag chags 'byung / /'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po la/ /sngon gyi bag chags btab pa yis/ /rtag cing bden par mi rtog pa/ /bden med the tshom skye mi 'gyur/ /brgya la the tshom skyes pas kyang / /srid pa'i dra ba 'jig gyur na//'dus byas chos rnams mi rtag par/ /shes shing thag chod smos ci dgos/ /de phyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin btang byas pas/ /mi de bde dang phrad pas nges/ /mi ma yin mthong mchod bstod byed/ /gang gis 'dun ①pa sngon song ba'i/ /sems ni dang po bskyed pa nas/ /drod kyi ye shes ma skyes par/ /tshogs lam yin par shes par bya/ /42—882

mthong lam mi rtag sgyu ma la/ /sbyor ba'i phyir na sbyor lam mo/ /drod dang rtse mo ting 'dzin no/ /dbang po rnam pa lnga yin te/ /srog la bab kyang sdog mi byed/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs stong nyid dang / /sgyu ma'i don la dad pas te/ /dad pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /dad gyur sgyu ma'i nyams len la/ /rgyun chad med par goms gyur pa/ /brtson 'grus dbang po bskyed pas na/ /brtson 'grus dbang po zhes bya'o/ /brtson 'grus las byung sgyu ma ste/ /dran pas chus zos mi byed par/ /bden zhen thams cad spangs pas ni/ /dran pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /dran 'dun ①sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin la/ /ma yengs rtse gcig gyur pa ni/ /ting 'dzin rtse gcig bsdus pa'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin byi dbang po yi/ /ting 'dzin bsdus pa'i sgyu ma de/ /shes rab so sor rtags byas pas/ /chos rnams rang bzhin ma grub par/ /shes pas shes rab dbang po'o—/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zil gnon pas/ /de phyir dbang po lnga zhes bya//de ltar nyams su blangs pa yi/ /nyin par snang grags chos rnams kun/ /bden med sgyu ma'i nyams myong 'byung / /dus dang lus dang dmigs pa yin/ /bden ②pa'i gnas su rmi lam bzung / /rmi lam ji snyed rmis gyur kyang / /bag chags bzhi las mi 'das te/ /dge dang sdig dang lung ma bstan/ /goms shugs ye shes chen po'o/ /de phyir blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rmi lam gser snang lta bu la/ /dge sdig bcas nas blang dor bya/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i don la sbyar/ /rmi lam zin tsam don yin te/ /mi rtog sgyu ma rang shar gye/ /me'i snga rtags yin par drod/ /gzugs sogs snang stong dbyer med cing / /'phel 'grib med pas sgyu ma ste/ /sgyu ma rmi lam rang shar du/ /bag tsam 42—883

'byung ba rtse mo'o/ /de yang dran 'dun mos gus dang / /bsre 'pho'i gnas kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ /gnyid log sad par gyur pa de/ /sngar gyi rmi lam zin pa dang / /sad pa'i 'khrul snang khyad med bsgom/ /de yang mig ni mi 'byed par/ /dran snang rtogs pa'i ri mo rnams/ /sgyu ma rmi lam thag bcad nas—/ /'dun ①pa drag pos nyams su blang / /'khrul snang byung na yang yang sbyang / /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun/ /rten dang brten par bsgom byas nas/ /de nyid sgyu ma rmi lam du/ /yang yang sbyangs pa gnad du che/ /'khor ba skyed med dga' gdung dang / /snang ba bslu 'brid mkhan 'di la/ /skyo shas drag pos rgyab phul nas/ /mdun ma drag po'i bcud la bor/ /tshe 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /ci byas don med sdug bsngal te/ /'khor g.yog mang yang grog tshang 'dra/ /longs spyod mi rtag sprin dang mtshungs/ /nags khrod 'dug kyang ri dwags la/ /tha snyad mkhas ④kyang ṣ+pe tso 'dra/ /de phyir bsam dang ldan pa yis/ /'jig rten 'di la chags mi bya/ /spyod lam snang grags thams cad kun/ /gnyid song 'dun pas nyams su blang / /dngos su snang dang rmi lam gnyis/ /khyad par cig kyang yod min te/ /ma rtogs pa la gnyis su snang / /de phyir de las gzhan du min/ /drod rtags phung po lnga pa yis—/ /bden 'dzin 'du shes sgyu mas bzlog /yang dag zab don sgyu ma la/ /the tshom sems nyid med pa dang / /bdag gzhan dge ba dag la sbyor/ /lus sogs rang bzhin byams sems ldan/ /gnyid rmugs la sogs dbang mi 'gro/ /nyon mongs bag chags 'joms pa'i phyir/ /sgyu ma'i dran dang shes bzhin ldan/ /rtse mo'i rtags ni gos gdan sogs/ /dri ma'ang mi 'chags shing lus kyi phyi nang 42—884

sems can med/ /ser sna med cing lus ngag yid/ /g.yo rgyu med dang dben pa'i gnas/ /dga' zhing rten par byed pa'o/ /bzod dang chos mchog ting 'dzin ni/ /stobs ni rnam pa lnga yin te/ /dad mos sgyu ma'i nyams len tshe/ /bdud ni sangs rgyas gzugs sprul nas/ /de ni chos min bzlog sngags ①zhes/ /bsgyur kyang mi 'gyur dad pa'i stobs/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni sgyu ma la/ /brtan pa'i stobs kyis mthu stobs kyang / /mthar phyin tshe na lhar bcas kyi/ /bzlog par mi nus brtson 'grus stobs/ /dran pa'i stobs bskyed sgyu ma yi/ /don la sems ni mi yengs pas/ /rtog par yer bar mi nus shing / /nyon mongs 'jigs pas dran pa'i stobs/ /rtog bral sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /chags sdang yul rnams thams cad la/ /der 'dzin pas 'du 'dzi las/ /dben pa'i stobs thob ting 'dzin stobs/ /shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kyang / /rang bzhin ma grub sgyu ma shog /'jig rten pa dag sgrol bar byed/ /shes rab las byung shes rab stobs/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi g.yo ba'i/ /de phyir stobs lnga zhes bya'o/ /snang yang 'dzin med sgyu ma yi/ /zab don mi skrag bzod pa ste/ /rmi lam zin pa'i sbyong spel byis/ /mi skrag pa na bzod pa'o/ /de'i rtags ni spyod lam kun/ /sgyu ma'i don dang ldan pa dang / /tshig gis mtshon la bzod ldan zhing / /don 'gyur dmyal sogs skye bar nus/ /log pa'i chos kyis mi 'gyur zhing / /chos ltar bcos pa'i bdud rnams kyis/ /dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam nyid du shes pa de/ /bzod pa dag gi rtags yin te//ngan song gsum du yongs mi lhung / /rmi lam zin nas lha yi sku/ /rang shar yud 42—885

tsam byung gyur na/ /bar do zin par the tshom med/ /sgyu mar gyur pa de dang mtshungs—/ /chos rnams skye 'gag bral gyur pa/ /sgyu mar gyur pa chos kyi mchog /rmi lam yul rnams rang sems su/ /rtogs pa 'jig rten chos kyi mchog /chos mchog rtags ni spyod lam kun/ /ci byed sems can don du byed/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pas te/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pas 'khris dang bral/ /chos brgyad dug gi me tog rnams/ /sgyu ma nyid du yang dag grol/ /rmi lam zin nas 'od gsal rtogs—/ /des ni bar do 'joms pa yin/ /drod nas 'jig rten chos mchog bar//sbyor ba'i lam du shes par bya/ /chos mchog skad cig phyi ma la/ /mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang shar nyid/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid can/ /snga ma mthong ba mthong bas na/ /mthong ba lam gyi ye shes so/ /byang chub yan lag rnams ①bdun ni/ /mthong ba lam gyi ting 'dzin te/ /sgyu ma blo las 'das pa yis/ /dran pa yid la byar med phyir/ /chos rnams dngos po med mthong ba/ /dran pa byang chub yan lag go/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur nyams blangs pas/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /chos rtogs ④mi grub mi dmigs pa/ /chos rnams 'byed pa'i yan lag go/ /sgyu ma 'dzin pa kun 'dra ba—/ /'du shes thams cad bshig pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams mi len mi 'dor ba—/ /brtson pas brtson 'grus yan lag go/ /dgag bsgrub bral ba'i sgyu ma la—/ /dga' dang mi dga' bshig pa'i phyir/ /'du byed kun la dga' mi bskyed—/ /gdul sems dga' ba yan lag go/ /sgyu ma ngo bo ma grub pas/ /42—886

gang dmigs thams cad mi dmigs phyir/ /chos rnams kun la sems sbyangs pas—/ /sems sbyangs byang chub yan lag go/ /sgyu ma nyid kyang ma grub pa/ /chos rnams bshig pa rjes rtogs pas/ /sems ni gang dag mi dmigs pa/ /ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag go/ /sgyu ma gang du'ang mi gnas shing / /rten dang 'chag dang 'ching mi byed/ /chos rnams rjes su mi mthong ba/ /btang snyems byang chub yan lag go/ /ting 'dzin de la goms byas pas/ /nyin dang mtshan phyed bar dag du/ /snang grags rnam pa thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin ma grub mtha' bral ba'i/ /snang stong dbyer med sgyu mar shar/ /de yang dngas pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /chu bur 'byung zhing thim gyur pa/ /de bzhin rnam rtog chu bur yang / /chos nyid rgya mtsho ma rtogs pa/ /gzhan du 'gyur bar mi srid kyis—/ /dgag bsgrub mi bya glod la zhog /de tshe rtogs tshogs na bun rnams/ /gzhi med gyur pas g.yo mi nus/ /nges shes bskyed cing thag bcad nas/ /gsal gzhag med pas goms par bya/ /mos gus bsre bas mtshams sbyar nas/ /lha sku gsal la rtog pa med/ /bde ba 'dzin med zhen bral ba'i/ /rang shar rang grol 'dus ma byas/ /tog ①bral kun mkhyen 'od gsal ba/ /gnyid dang rmi lam bar do 'am/ /yang na rmi lam zin pa dang / /rang shar 'gyur ba longs sku ste/ /ji srid ma g.yos bar du'o/ /nyin mtshan dbyer med bsre ba dang / /cir snang 'khor sneyug sum ldan du/ /ma yengs nyams su blangs byas na—/ /mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /de yis rmi lam sprul bsgyur ba//bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas nas/ /'jag mig srin bu yan chad la/ /sgyu ma'i rtsal ni sbyangs pa las/ /dmigs med sgyu lus dngos gyur nas/ /sgyu ma 42—887

lha sku mngon gsal rnams/ /dbyer med gyur pas gsal snang mched/ /yul snang ji bzhin bgrod gyur pas/ /mthong spangs brgya dang bcu gnyis spangs/ /mngon par shes par gyur nas ni/ /dga' zhing 'jigs pa'i snang ba 'byung / /sgyu ma'i gsal snang skyes pa'i rtags/ /gnyid kyi dus su gzhan du yang / /skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ /yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis te/ /ting 'dzin brgya la snyoms 'jug dang / /sangs rgyas brgya yi zhal lta dang / /sangs rgyas brgya la chos nyan dang / /'jig rten khams brgyar bskyod pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang / /zhing brgyar 'od kyis 'gengs pa dang / /sems can brgya ni smin byed dang / /chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa dang / /bskal pa brgyar ni gnas pa dang / /sngon dang phyi mtha' brgyar 'jug dang / /lus kyi ①sprul brgyar 'gyed nus dang / /lus re la yang 'khor brgya yis/ /yongs su bskor nas ston par byed/ /chos phyir srog kyang btong nus phyir/ /'dod pa'i yon tan grogs su 'gyur/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rdzogs byed cing / /lhag ma rnams kyang ci nus byed/ /sa thob 'jigs pa lnga bral te/ /'tsho ba med dang 'chi ba dang / /ngan 'gro'i tshigs bcud ma yin brjod/ /'khor gyi 'jigs bral bag tsha spangs/ /des ni snang grags thams cad kun/ /bden med sgyu mar rtogs las byung / /nyin par dang ni rmi lam gyi/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags ma dag na/ /sa brgyad la yang mi gnas te/ /pad+ma can la smos ci dgos—/ /de phyir snang ba sna tshogs ni/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes bsal dngas la/ /yid kyi 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa/ /de ni gsal stong dbyer med de/ /zhen med rgyu ma rang snang ngo / /rmi lam dag gi chos rnams kun/ /bde chen gsal stong 42—888

'dzin med rtogs/ /mthong ba lam gyi ye shes de/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su bshad/ /chos mchog rjes gnang sa gnyis par/ /mthong lam yin par shes par bya/ /sgom lam mi rtog sgyu ma'i don/ /mthong ba goms phyir sgom lam mo/ /sa ni gnyis nas bcu'i bar/ /yid la byed pa'i ting 'dzin ni/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad yin te/ /'khor 'das la sogs chos rnams kun/ /thams cad sgyu mar mnyam pa ste/ /lta ba'i dmigs gsal kun bral ba/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /gang du rtog pa thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma nyid du yang dag khrol—/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /gang du rtog pa thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma nyid du yang dag khrol/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa'i/ /tshig gi bdag gzhan rtog pa bral—/ /cho ga brjod pas chos rnams kun/ /mnyam nyid sgyu mar rtogs byed paske/ /de ni yang dag ngag yin no/ /las kyi mtha' ni zas gyur te/ /dkar nag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /thams cad mtha' dang bral ba ni/ /yang dag pa yi las mtha'o/ /'tsho ba gang zhig gnod 'tshe bral/ /sems can 'tsho ba dag gyur te/ /bdag gzhan don rnams mthar phyin pa/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'o/ /zab cing spros bral sgyu ma'i don/ /bsgrub phyir sems ni rab tu 'dzin/ /rtsod dang mi zhum nan tan byed/ /de ni yang dag brtsol ba'o/ /gang zhig sgyu ma rang shar la/ /bdud dang mi dge gol sa yis bar chad skabs ni mi rnyed pas/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa'o/ /bdag gzhan sgyu mar 42—889

mnyam pa nyid/ /chos rnams sgyu mar rnam dag ste/ /skad cig nyid la thams cad mkhyen/ /thob pa yang dag ting 'dzin no/ /sa ni gnyis pa dri med nas/ /bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi bar/ /bsgoms spangs bzhi bcu bzhi ste/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan la sogs/ /sa dgu'i rtags dang yon tan rnams/ /sa bcu'i skabs las shes par bya/ /mthong lam rjes la thob pa nas/ /sa bcu man byechad sgom lam mo/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /sgyu ma yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub ste/ /myur du thob par byed pa la/ /chos gzhan bar chad med pas na/ /bar chad med pa'i lam shes bya/ /sgom lam sgrib pa kun spangs nas/ /sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la/ /sgyu 'dzin phra zhing phra ba ni/ /shes bya'i sgrib par shes par bya/ /yang na lta ba mthar thug pa/ /bzang por 'dod pa'i sgrib pa yin/ /sgrib pa de nyid spong ba ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin te/ /gsal stong 'dzin med bde ba che/ /'od gsal rang shar 'dus ma byas/ /byin brlabs stobs kyis 'byung ba ste/ /mun khung sgon me gser srang ltar/ /phra zhing phra ba'i sgrib pa ni/ /thogs med nus pas rang dag pas/ /'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings nyid dang / /ye shes gnyis su med pa ste/ /nyon mongs shes bya yang dag pa'i/ /chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan no/ /sku ni rten dang bsags pa dang / /khyab dang rang bzhin grub pa ste/ /mi 'gyur ma skyes mtshan med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /de la bzhengs bzhugs mi mnga' yang / /sngon kyi bsod nams sems bskyed dang / /smon lam bskyed 42—890

rims stobs las ni/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis rang shar te/ /de yang 'og min pho brang du/ /longs sku snang mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan bzangs dpe byad rab tu ldan/ /spros bral snang stong dri med sku/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mtha' bral theg chen chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sgogs par byed/ /sprul sku rang shar gang 'dul te/ /gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor sogs/ /gdul bya gang la gang mos pa/ /bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas—/ /de dang de yi skur bstan nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par/ /'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'am/ /nor bu dpag bsam lta bu yis/ /sems can smin cing grol bar byed/ /ye shes tshogs dang rdzogs rims lam/ /skye 'gag bral ba'i chos sku thob/ /tshogs gnyis bskyed rdzogs dbyer med las/ /sku gsum dbyer med bde chen thob/ /mdor bsdus mkha' 'dra'i chos sku las/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon rang shar ba/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' thams cad mkhyen/ /dbyer med rang grol lhun grub po/ /ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa chos sku mdzad par bcas/ /rnam bzhi'i legs bshad gang yin pa/ /spros pa la ni dga' 'gyur na/ /mdo dang byams mgon mdzad pa rnams/ /gus pas blang zhing shes par bya/ /'dir ni bsgrub pa gtsor byed pa①/ /tha snyad dmigs rgyud dag dang mtshungs/ /de phyir tshe la long med pas/ /'jig rten 'di ni blos btang ste/ /bla ma dam pa mchog brten nas/ /rtogs pa mngon du gyur par bya/ /tshe 'di yun thung shes bya mang / /tshe'i tshad kyang mi nges pas//ngang pas mtsho la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi dgos pa blang bar bya/ /ji srid 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /'du shes med 42—891

par gyur pa na/ /theg pa med cing brjod du med/ /lam dang sa'i rtags rnams ni/ /goms pa che chung stobs khyad dang / /rgan gzhon dag gi khyad par gyis/ /phyi rol yul snang mthong snang dang / /ngo bo mthong dang yon tan thob—/ /dgra bcom rgyan can rgyan med dang / /rgur chu tshes stod tshes smad sogs—/ /phyi rol rdzu 'phrul rim pa rnams/ /mdo dang rgyud las shes par bya//sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma nas/ /mkhyen gnyis sku bzhi mdzad par bcas rang gzhan ⑫lhun grub par dag tu/ /mthar phyin lam du shes par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sa bcu legs par bshad kyis nyon//'jig rten 'das pa'i zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong zung du 'byel pa ni/ /'dzin med sgyu ma rang shar te/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes so/ /yon tan dag gi gzhi rten cing / /gong du bgrod pas sa zhes bya/ /dbye na rab dga' la sogs dang / /sa ltas bcu ni shes par bya/ /de yang sa bcu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /blo 'das mtha' bral sgyu ma'i don/ /snga ma mthong ba mngon gyur cing / /don grub gyur pas dga' ba skyes/ /de phyir rab tu dga' ba'o/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'khrul pa'i tshogs/ /skye ba med pas sgyu mar rtogs/ /tshul khrims dri ma'i skyon bral bas/ /dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /snang grags chos rnams thams cad kun/ /gsal la 'dzin med sgyu mar shar/ /ye shes dbang gis 'od snang bas/ /de phyir 'od byed pa zhes bya—/ /gsal snang 'dzin med 'od de yang / /rang bzhin ma grub sgyu ba ste/ /nyon mongs bsreg byed 'od 'phro bas/ /'od 'phro can zhes bya ba'o/ /spang bya 42—892

gnyen po'i bden 'dzin kun/ /gang yang bden med sgyu mar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs gdul dka' thul ba'i phyir/ /de nas sbyangs pa dka' zhes bya/ /'khor 'das la sogs chos rnams kun/ /dbyer med mtha' dral sgyu ma ste/ /rang bzhin gnas pa mngon gyur pas/ /mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /chos rnams sgyu mar yang dag grol/ /dmigs med snying rjes don rnams byed/ /nyan thos rang rgyal ring gyur pas/ /de phyir ring du song zhes bya/ /sgyu ma blo 'das brtsol ba med/ /lhun grub rang shar chen po la/ /nyon mongs g.yo bar mi nus pas/ /mi g.yo ba zhes brjod par bya/ /ji srid chos su 'dzin pa rnams—/ /sgyu ma nyid du grol gyur pa/ /blo gros yang shing thogs med phyir/ /legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya'o/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug sgyu ma yis/ /phrin las la ni dbang thob cing / /chos sku'i mkha' la ye shes sprin/ /khyab pas chos kyi sprin zhes bya/ /sa bcu pha rol phyin bcu'o/ /gang gis gang non rim pa ni/ /dang po sbyin pa gtso zhing rdzogs/ /lhag ma rnams ni ci nus bsgrub/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /gsum pa dag gis bzod pas te/ /bzhi pa brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /lnga pa yis ni bsam gtan te/ /drug pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bdun pa yi ni thabs yin te/ /brgyad pa smon lam pha rol phyin/ /dgu pa yis ni stobs yin te/ /bcu pa ye shes pha rol phyin/ /de ltar pha rol phyin bcu yis/ /mtshan nyid ma nor bshad par bya/ /ye shes 'tshol phyir sems can ni①/ /dge rtsa stong pa ⑤sbyin pa ste/ /nyon mongs gdung ba thams cad kun/ /zhi ba'i phyir na tshul khrims so/ /byams dang snying rjes sems can la/ /'tshig pa med pas bzod 42—893

pa ste /dge ba'i chos rnams tshol ba las/ /mi ngoms brtson pas brtson 'grus so/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon byed la/ /'gyod med sems ldan bsam gtan no/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa/ /mngon du gyur pas shes rab po/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes tshad med pa/ /sgrub par byed pa thabs yin te/ /ye shes las ni 'gyur bas na/ /mngon par bsgrub pas smon lam mo/ /phas kyi rgol dang bdud tshogs kyis/ /lam brgyud mi gcod stobs yin te/ /chos rnams ji bzhin rtogs pa 'di/ /ye shes pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas la/ /sa ni bcu dang bcu gcig yin/ /rgongs pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /sgrib pa gang yin shes par bya/ /gang gis rmongs na der 'dzin rmongs/ /de phyir sa yi chos rnams la/ /gang du 'dzin pa yongs spangs nas/ /'dzin med sgyu mar rtogs par bya/ /gal te sgyu ma tsam de yang / /'dzin par gyur na de yang spangs/ /sgyu ma yod med las 'das shing / /spang thob dgag sgrub rang sar grol/ /gang du 'dzin pa kun rdzob ste/ /'dzin med rang grol blo las 'das/ /de phyir sa yi chos rnams kun//'dzin med goms byas sgrib pa 'dag /rang shar rtogs pa'i rim pa dang / /rtags rnams rim par 'char bar 'gyuraspyo/ /sgyu ma rang shar don rtogs pas/ /'khor gsum yongs dag sbyin rtsol med/ /nyin dang mtshan mo dus kun tu/ /sgyu ma lta bur rang shar 'byung //de yang chos dbyings sgyu ma ni/ /kun 'gro khyab pa'i don du rtogs/ /gsal snang brgya phrag bcu gnyis so/ /phyi nang rtags ni gong bzhin no/ /dri med pa la sgyu ma dang / /lha sku zhen bral dri med sku/ /'gro 'ong yod med blo las 'das//42—894

de nyid goms brtan mchog yin te/ /chos dbyings sgyu ma rang shar nyid/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i don du rtogs/ /rtags ni nyin mtshan gang la yang / /skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ /ting 'dzin stobs la snyoms 'jug sogs/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis shes par bya /'od byed pa la 'od gsal dang / /lha sku bde chen dbyer med do/ /gsal dang rmi lam dus nyid du/ /sems can dpag med 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bsam kyis mi khyab lha yi sku/ /rang shar khams khengs chos sgra sgogs/ /chos kyi dbyings su chos rnams kun/ /sgyu mthun ①dag gi don rnams rtogs/ /ting 'dzin brgya stong snyoms 'jug sogs/ /brgya stong phrag ni shes par bya/ /'od 'phro can la lha yi sku/ /rtsol med goms phyir 'bad byas pas/ /rtsol ba'i dug las grol gyur nas/ /chos dbyings yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /med pa'i don du rtogs pa'o—/ /ting 'dzin khrag khrig snyoms 'jug sogs/ /khrag khrig phrag ni bcu gnyis so/ /sbyang dka'i sa la chos rnams kun/ /skye med rtogs pa'i ngang nyid nas—/ /'gag med dmigs med snying rje yis/ /gzhan don lha sku phyag rgya che//spyod lam kun dang dbyer med gyur/ /chos kyi dbyengs rnams thams cad kun/ /rgyu gzhan tha dad med par rtogs/ /skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ /ting 'dzin khrag khrig stong dag la/ /snyoms par 'jug la sogs pa ste/ /khrag khrig stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ /mngon du gyur la 'khor 'das kyis/ /rgyu 'bras thams cad mngon gyur pas/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung lha yi sku/ /gsal la 'dzin med 'od gsal 'char/ /chos dbyengs kun nas nyon mongs dang / /rnam byang tha dad med par rtogs/ /ting 'dzin khrag khrig brgya stong sogs/ /42—895

khrag khrig brgya stong bcu gnyis so/ /ring po sa yi chos rnams kun/ /skye 'gag bral ba sgyu ma'i sku/ /zung 'jug mtha' 'bral ①bde ba che/ /nyin mtshan spyod lam thams cad du/ /zhen med de la dran thob pas/ /phyir mi sdog par shes par bya/ /chos dbyings chos kyi mtshan nyid dang / /tha mi dad pa'i don du rtogs/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la/ /snyoms par 'jug sogs bcu gnyis so/ /mi g.yo'i sa la nyin mtshan kun/ /lha sku 'od gsal rtsol ba bral—/ /rang shar longs sku'i cha 'thun de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams sgyu ma'i bkod pas spyod/ /rnam dag lhun grub mkha' bzhin no/ /chos dbyings 'phel 'grib med gyur cing / /zhing dag pa la dbang thob rtags/ /skad cig la ni ting nge 'dzin/ /stong dang sum brgya stong phrag bcu/ /rdul ni phra rab rnyed thob pa/ /phrag ni bcu gnyis shes par bya/ /blo gros sa la 'od gsal ni/ /chos ni mtha' bral 'dus ma byas/ /'gro 'ong skye shi dgag bsgrub bral/ /smra bsam brjod 'das skye ba bral/ /bsgom bya bsgom byed gnyis med cing / /sprin med dag pa'i mkha' bzhin no/ /spobs pa thogs pa med pa yi/ /ye shes dam pa'i don du rtogs/ /skad cig la ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni grangs med pa/ /brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul snyed la/ /snyoms par 'jug sogs bcu gnyis so/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug chos sprin la/ /mi gnas gnas med 'od gsal te/ /rang bzhin rnam dag rtog med sku/ /'dzin pa'i rtog bral sa le mkhyen/ /blo 'das dmigs pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /nam mkha' lta bur skye 'gag med/ /mtshan nyid kun bral mkha' ltar dag /smra bsam spyod bral blo las 'das/ /nyin mtshan dus 42—896

rnams thams cad du/ /snang stong bde stong dbyer med mchog /'phel 'grub ①med par 'char ba ste/ /phrin ②las dbang ba'i don du rtogs/ /de yang sa bcu'i mgon po lags/ /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che/ /khams gsum gyi ni yang dag che/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la bzhag /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i phyag dang ni/ /'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /skad cig yud tsam thang byug la/ /chos kyi snang ba chen po dang / /'od dang chos sprin tshad med dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa'i/ /chos kyi snang ba chos kyi 'od/ /chos kyi sprin chen tshad med thob/ /srid pa tha mar gyur pa des/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa legs spangs nas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin rtogs/ /nang ltar bcu gcig mgon po ste/ /'og min btsun mo'i gzhal yas su/ /zag med ma hā'i dbang bskur bas/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i ting 'dzin rtogs/ /bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas khyad/ /rgya mtsho ba lang dmig ①rjes mtshungs/ /dag pa sa gsum yon tan kyang / /dpag cing gzhal bar mi nus na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ /brjod cing dpag par smos ci dgos/ /nam mkha' sa gzhi gang yin pa/ /skra rtses gzhal bar nus srid kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ /bskal par grangs med brjod mi nus/ /de phyir thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /spyod yul brjod las 'das pa'o/ /de ltar sa rnams bgrod pa yis/ /lcags sregs bzhin du gnas gyur te/ /nyon mongs yid la mi rtogs dang / /sgo lnga'i rnam shes ye shes lnga/ /42—897

kun gzhi gnas gyur mthar thug sku/ /zag med bde chen 'dus ma byas/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med cing / /phrin las lhun grub rgyun chad med/ /mtha' bral rang shar chen po'o/ /sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa 'di/ /lung bstan thob nas mdo rgyud nas/ /legs btus nyams su stsong ba ltar/ /'gal 'khrul med par yi ger bkod/ /dge ba dri med rgya chen des/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal gzir gyur rnams/ /sgyu ma'i lam la rab sbyangs nas/ /'od gsal chen po thob par shogasgyu ma lam gye rim pa dri med snying po zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid dang / lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /slad nas khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhus te nyams su stsong bar bgrinas pamadza// //①bsdur mchan/878 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ sne〈〈pe 〉tha/ 1〈〈pe 〉thazhir/879 ①〈〈pe 〉stom/ ④〈〈pe 〉ste/ ①〈〈pe 〉ridang/8naX ①〈〈pe 〉tha'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉dz+ra / ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyes/ du〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉75dun/881 ①④〈〈pe 〉zodun/ ①〈〈pe 〉7brtson/882 ①〈〈pe 〉glodun/883 ①〈〈pe 〉rabe+en/ ②〈〈pe 〉zodun/884 ①〈〈pe 〉7dun/ ②〈〈pe 〉khis/885 ①〈〈pe 〉ra sngags/886 ①〈〈pe 〉ram/ ④〈〈pe 〉d+kugs/887 ①〈〈pe 〉rkog ④〈〈pe 〉skabar/42—898

888 ①〈〈pe 〉4)sa/89༷ ①〈〈pe 〉stanam/891 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/892 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhan/893 ①〈〈pe 〉mi ni/ ②〈〈pe〉〉pas/895 ①〈〈pe 〉torathun/896 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bral/897 ①〈〈pe 〉〉'grib/ ②〈〈pe 〉toraphrin/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dmigs/898 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉shu r+ghaṃ/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2450)42—899

༄ga /sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa'i 'grel pa jes bya ba/①༄ sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma ya dha na kra ma brid ti nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rdo rje 'chang / /khyod zhabs bdag ni gus btud nas//sgyu ma lam rim gsal byed don/ /mdo dang rgyud las gsungs bzhin bris/ /deng 'dir rgyal ba'i bka' yang dag pa'i don nye bar mngon sum du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos phyin ci ma log pa gang zhe na/ gang gis gang brten gang brtsams/ de'i rgyu/ dgos pa/ don rab tu gsal byed do/ /de la dang po gang gis na/ /dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas shing / /rdo rje 'chang gis rjes gnang thob pa bdag gis so/ /gang la brten na/ nyams myong mdo rgyud du ma las so/ /gang brtsams na/ sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa'o/ /rgyu ni 'gro ba la phan 42byed900

'dogs pa de la spro ba'o/ /dgos pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la 'dzin pa'i bdud kyis bcings pa las grol bar byed pa'o/ /don gsal bar byed pa gang zhe na/ bar chad las grol bar byed pa'i phyag dang / mthar phyin pa'i dam bca' dang / don gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung ngo / /de la thog mar sems nyid nor bu rin po che 'di la/ tshogs gnyis kyi bye dor byas pas/ dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas na phyag gi 'os te/ bram ze chen pos/ rang gi sems ni kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang na sems lta ba'i dra ba 'dzin byed thams cad bral ba'i gsal stong 'dzin med bde ba chen po la bzhag pa ni phyag rnams kyis ①nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar/ /rang gis rang gi ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /dam bca' ni/ drang srong rnams kha 'og tu lus tshud pa'am/ rgyal po'i bya ba khas blangs pa lta bu'o/ /don rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung ni/ ye shes mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud rgyas pa las/ sgyu ma chos dbyings kun gzhi ste/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgya/ /42—901
