lam lnga sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /'di ni gzhan gyis rtogs pa min/ /gzhi dang rang bzhin 'bras bu'i don/ /zab dang rgya cher dbyer med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de'i don gang zhe na/ ji ltar gnas pa'i gzhi zung 'jug gtan la dbab/ thabs kyi rang bzhin lam zung 'jug nyams su blangs/ 'bras bu zung 'jug mngon gyur rang shar/de la ji ltar gnas pa'i gzhi zung 'jug kun gzhi dang / dbang bzhi las—/ ji ltar gnas pa'i gzhi gang zhe na/ kun gzhi ①rnam par shes pa dang / /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /de la kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa la dbye na/ kun gzhi'i rig pa lung ma bstan dang / kun gzhi kun gyi sa bon dang / kun gzhi las bag chags su smin pa dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes su ji ltar bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni rig pa gsal stong lung ma bstan kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ snying po rab tu gsal ba'i mdo las/ rig pa gsal stong kun gzhi ste/ /lung ma bstan du grags pa'o/ /zhes so/ /kun gzhi gsal stong de cig dang tha dad pa ma yin pa'i zung 'jug ste/dri med snying po'i mdo las/ kun gzhi gsal stong lung ma bstan/ /cig dang tha dad ma yin zhing / /stong dang stong min zung du 'jug /de ni chos rnams sa bon no/ /zhes so/ /de las rig pa gsal la stong de/ las kyi bag chags kyis g.yogs pas zla ba 'grib pa dang / 'grib med kyi dpe ltar/ kun gzhi sems can gyi khams na 'khor yang skye 'grib med pas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal te/rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ /lus can kun gyi gzhi 'di ni/ /las kyi bag chags 42—902

rnams kyis g.yogs/ /dbang po tshes pa'i zla log ltar/ /dbye ba'i zhing du snang ba ste/ /ri rab gnas shing 'khor ba yang / /dngos po'i 'jig pa ma yin no / /de bzhin sems dang rnam shes yid/ /sems can khams na 'khor mod kyi/ /rtag tu rang bzhin 'od snang ba'o/ /ces gsungs so/ /kun gzhi kun gyi sa bon ni/ /kun gzhi'i steng du dge mi dge lung ma bstan gye bag chags bsags pas sa bon du gyur te/ de nyid las/ kun gzhi sna tshogs gzugs can ni/ /rnam shes kun kyi gnas yin no/ /bag chags rnams dang ldan pa yi/ /kun gzhi kun gyi sa bon can/ /de las bag chags snga ma'i sa bon las phyi ma ste/ snying po gsal ba las/ snga ma snga ma'i bag chags las/ /phyi ma skye phyir sa bon no/ /bag chags de rnams bsags zhe na/ stug po bkod pa las/ byis pa rnams kyis 'khor gzugs rtags①/ /de yi dbyibs las thog ma med/ /gnas ngan len dang las kyi rkyen/ /bag chags thog ma med pa bsags/ /de ltar thog ma med pa'i kun gzhi dang / /bag chags gnyis ji ltar gnas zhe na/ /snying po rab gsal las/ gser dang g.ya' ni ji bzhin du/ /kun gzhi'i bag chags de bzhin no/ /yang chu rdo dang nya phyibs lta bu ste/ /rgyan las/ ji ltar chu rting rdo ba dag /nya phyibs dag gis yongs dkris pa/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang / /bag chags dri ma can du byas/ /zhes so/ /kun gzhi las bag chags su smin pa ni/ kun gzhi'i steng du dge mi dge 42—903

lung du ma bstan gyi bag chags phra ba las rags par smin pas/ rigs drug so so'i rnam par smin pa'o/ /snying po rab gsal las/ dge dang mi dge bar ma yi / /bag chags smin las rigs drug 'khor/ /zhes so/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes su ji ltar bzhag pa ni/ kun gzhi stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin du rnam par shes shing / rig pa'i cha nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/sa sde las/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gsal la rtog med kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par shes te/ rnam par shes pa nyid gsal la rtog pa med pa'o/ /zhes pas/kun gzhi'i rnam shes la phyi rol gyi yul du grub pa ma dmigs pas/ dmigs pa brgya ①yongs su chad pa med do/ /de yang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gzhi rten par gyur pas na/ rnam byang dang tha dad pa med do/ /rgyan las/ rnam par byang dang tha dad med/ /kun gzhi tha dad gyur pa min/ /de de rnam byang tha dad na/ /kun gzhi'i rtag pa ma yin 'gyur/ /snying po gsal ba las/ kun gzhi kun gyi gzhir gyur pas/ /de phyir rnam byang gzhi yin no/ /mdo gzhan las kyang de ltar ro/ /de las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /gzhi khams zhes bya ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings—/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun kyang //mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /yang na kun gzhi 'am/ bde gshegs snying po ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ thog ma med can gyi ni khams/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun kyang / /mya ngan 'das pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang na kun gzhi 'am—/ bde gshegs snying po ste/ rgyan las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gyi 42byed904

gzhi—/ /bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de/ /snying po de yang kun gzhi'i sgra//de bzhin gshegs pas ston par byed/ /snying po kun gzhi ①grags pa yang /blo ngan rnams kyis mi shes so/ /yang na len pa'i rnam shes lus kyi gzhi/ /kun gyi gzhi/ sems brten pa zhes bya ste/ sa sde las/ rnam par shes pa des de ltar lus 'di bzung zhing nye bar blangs pa nas len pa'i rnam shes zhes kyang bya'o/ /lus 'di'i gzhir gyur pas na kun gzhi zhes bya'o/ /lung ④du ma bstan pas ni sems can zhes kyang bya ste/ rnam par shes pa thams cad de la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar thog ma med pa'i dus—/ rig pa/ dbyings/ khams/ kun gzhi/ de bzhin nyid/chos dbyings/ snying po/ chos sku/ ma skyes pa/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa—/ sems can kun khyab gzhi rten/ gsal stong / lung ma bstan/rig pa 'od kyi khang pa/ gnas pa'i gzhi la sogs pa/ mdo las/ rnam grangs dpag tu med do/ /sngags nas rgyu'i rgyud/ gzhi'i rgyud/ bcud kyi rgyud—/ brten pa'i rgyud/ kun byi rgyud/ thog ma med pa'i rgyud/ snying po'i rgyud la sogs pa rnam grangs du ma bshad do/ /de ltar mdo rgyud nas/kun gzhi'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa bshad pa'i ming don la ma rmongs par kun gzhi dang / sems dang rnam par shes pa'i gsang ba la mkhas pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la ma rmongs shing / /khong du chud pa'o/ /zhes sa sde'i mdo las gsungs so/ /nyon mongs pa can kyi yid ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa rig pa 42—905

gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin de la dmigs pa ma yin pa'i bdag tu 'dzin pa ni nyon mongs pa can gye yid do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos sam yul rnams 'dzin par byed pas na yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ /ngar sems de ni nyon mongs yid/ /gang gi yul rnams 'dzin pas na/ /de ni rnam par shes par brjod/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /mig gi rnam shes kyis gzugs 'dzin pa'o//rna bas sgra/ snas dri/ lces ro/ lus kyis reg bya 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar yul de rnams kyi rnam par shes shing rig pas na rnam shes su 'dzin pa'o/ /yang sems kun gzhi ni lung ma bstan no/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ni mi dge ba'o//yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni dge mi dge gnyis su 'gyur te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ sems ni kun tu lung ma bstan/ /yid ni gnyis kar 'gyur ba ste/ /rnam par shes pa 'byung ba yang / /de ni dge dang mi dge ba'o/ /zhes pas yid kyi dge ba ni bcu'o/ /yid kyi mi dge ba ni drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'o/ /des na yid ni dge mi dge gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ni lung ma bstan no/ /de ltar yang / ting nge 'dzin mchog gi mdo las/ /sems ni lung du ma bstan pa'o/ /nyon mongs can ni mi dge'o/ /yid ni dge sdig gnyis ka ste/ /sgo lnga lung du ma bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /42—906

gsang bsngags kyi gzhi ni dbang bzhi ste/ ye shes mngon byung las/ gzhi yi rgyud ni dbang bzhi ste/ /bskyed rdzogs gzhi rten yin phyir ro/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba las/ rgyud ni dbang bzhi'i ngo bo ste/ /brjod bya rjod byed rgyud du 'gyur//zhes gsungs so/ /de dag gis ji ltar gnas pa'i gzhi bstan to/ /de nas thabs kyi rang bzhin nam/ lam zung 'jug rtags mtshungs ldan du bstan par bya ste/ de dag gang zhe na/ lam mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / sgyu ma rmi lam dbyer med du bstan pa ni/ khri brgyad stong pa las/ lha'i bu dag dran pa nye bar bzhag pa rnams ni/ rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang /'phags pa'i ①yan lag brgyad pa yang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu yin no/ /lha'i bu dag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu yin no/ /de bzhin du mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu yin no/ /dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ gsang ba'i bdag po sgo lnga'i yul gyi rten dang /dbye ba thams cad rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha sku sgyu ma lta bur rtogs par rmis shig /de ltar rten dang rten ①pa de dag kyang / byang chub 42—907

kyi phyogs kyi chos dang dbyer med du rtogs par byis shig /de ltar rten dang brten pa de dag kyang / sgyu ma dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la gnyis su med de/ gnyis su byar med do/ /zhes so/ /de las kyang lam mchog tu gyur pa/ bla ma'i mos gus lo zlas sa lam bgrod de/ ye shes mngon 'byung las—/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /bla ma'i mos gus lo zlas bsgrod/ /bla ma'i snang ba ma bral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas/ /zhes so/ /dam tshig bkod pa las/ g.yo med mos gus zla drug gis/ /rdo rje 'chang gis thob 'gyur zhes so/ /rgyud sde lnga bcu las kyang de ltar ro/ /de yang snang ba thams cad rigs lngar gnas pa de lam du blangs nas bsgoms pas—/ snang ba gzhan gye sel mi 'jug pa ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la gnas pa ste/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig bkod pa las/ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba gang de la rigs lnga'i dam tshig la gnas par 'dod pas/ snang ba'i dbyibs thams cad phyag mtshan lngar shes par bya'o/ /kha dog sna tshogs rigs lngar shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'byung ba lnga dang / phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang /sems can sna tshogs pa'ang rigs lngar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dbyibs dang /kha dog dang / 'byung ba dang / phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang /sems can sna tshogs pa dang / rigs lnga la gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do—/ /yang na cho gas bskyed pa'am/ rang shar lha sku de'i snang cha bskyed rim/stong cha rdzogs rim/ rang bzhin dbyer med zung 'jug ste/ mngon 'byung las/tha mal dag byed lha'i sku/ /snang ba'i cha las bskyed pa dang / /stong pa'i cha las rdzogs rim ste/ /dbyer med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /yang de nyid 42—908

las—/ dngos rnams snang stong dbyer med pa/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang zung 'jug dang / /bskyed rdzogs ma yin chos 'ga' med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /lha'i snang ba gsal ba sprul sku/ bde ba longs sku/ mi rtog pa chos skur lam du blangs te/ dam tshig bkod pa las/ chos rnams gsal ba sprul pa'i sku/ /de la mi rtog chos kyi sku/ /rtog bral bde ①phyir longs spyod sdogs—/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /de ltar chos thams cad gsal la rtog pa med par shes pa ni lam gyi ye shes tshes gcig ②gi zla ba lta bu dang /'bras bu'i ye shes zla ba nya gang ba lta bu dang / dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las—/ gang gis ting 'dzin mchog la gnas/ /de ni gsal la rtog med do/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' sa le mkhyen/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i ye shes te/ /tshes cig dbang po rgyas bzhin no/ /de ltar snang ba dang lha dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / sgyu ma rnam gnyis su med par lam du slongs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud thams cad khong du chud par shes par bya'o/ /de nas nyams myong dang / lam lnga sa bcu sgyu ma dbyer med du rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ de yang lam gyi ngo bo zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong zung du 'byel ba'i lam mo/ /nges tshig ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la phyin par 'dod pas na lam mo/ /dbye na tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/bsgom lam/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /de la tshogs lam byi ngo bo sdig pa spong zhing dge ba dang du len pa'o/ /42—909

nges tshig ni/ chos nyid thob pa'i don du tshogs stsog pa'o/ /dbye na tshogs lam chung ngu / 'bring po/ chen po'o/ /de la bag med pa dran pa nyams pa thong ba'i rgyu yin la/ tshogs lam chung ngu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi 'byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rab brtan gyi mdo las/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol ba/bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ gang de la byang chub sems dpa' lus la lus kyi rjes su lta ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gang zhe na/lus sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba so so'i brtags te/ kye ma/ lus 'di rgyu dang rkyen la brtags pa mi rtag cing 'gyur ba sgyu ma lta bu ste/ lus 'di la nga yir mi bya bar/ lus 'di snying po med pa la snying po blang bar bya'o/ /snying po gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsgrub cing thob par bya'o/ /de ni lus kyi dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan/ tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gang zhe na/ tshor ba gang ci'ang rung ste/ bde ba'i tshor ba la dga' bar byed/sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la zhe sdang bar byed/ gnyis ka ma yin pa la rmongs par byed—/ bdag gi tshor ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin med par sbyangs la/sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba rgyun chad pa'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rtogs pa'i tshor ba ni bde ba/ ma rtogs pa'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas na/ dmigs pa dang / yid la byed pa thams cad dang / ji srid chos su brtags pa thams cad kyi tshor ba thams cad sgyu ma 42—910

lta bur shes pa ni tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag go/ /blo gros rab brtan/sems la sems kyis rjes su lta ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gang zhe na/ sems ni skyes nas 'jig cing mi gnas pas/ bdag gis thog mar sems bskyed cing /gnas pa de yang zad cing / gang nas kyang mi gnas pas/ sems kyis sems mi mthong ngo / /de la sems kyi ①mtshan nyid ni/ sgyu ma 'dra ba ste/mtshan nyid med pas 'dzin pa dang bral ba la gnas par bya'o/ /de ni sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan/ chos la chos kyi rjes su lta ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gang zhe na/ gang stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ma gtogs pa'i chos su grub pa'ang rdul tsam mi dmigs te/ chos de la lta zhing gnas pa ni chos nyid yang dag pa mthong gis/chos ma yin pa la yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de la dran pa nye bar bzhag pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyis chos ji snyed du btags pa thams cad ming tsam mo/ /ming dang chos phyi nang gang du'ang mi rnyed pas mtha' med cing ma grub pa ni chos kyi dran pa nye bar bzhag sdego/ /de yang tshogs lam 'bring por sdig pa mi dge ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la dug tu bltas nas spong ba'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi bsgom pa ste/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol ba/ yang dag spong ba bzhi ji ltar lta bar bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam bzhi gang zhe na/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad pa byed/ brtson 'grus brtsams/sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par rab tu 'jog go/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i 42—911

chos skyes pa rnams rab tu spong ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa la ①sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'dun pa bskyed pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas pa dang / phyir bzhin 'phel ba dang / nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / chud mi za ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /blo gros rab brtan/gang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams zhes bya ba ni/ tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi mi mthun phyogs so/ /tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs ni/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang / tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur ba'i chos rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun phyogs ni/ sems g.yeng bar byed cing / ting nge 'dzin nyams par byed pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi mi mthun phyogs ni lta ba nyams pa dang / lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi yang dag par sgrib pa'i chos rnams so/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ni/ mi dge ba'i chos sgong ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus rtsom sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par 'jog pa ni yang dag par spong ba dang po'o/ /gzhan yang mi dge ba'i chos rnams zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod pas chags/ khong khros sdang / ma rig pas rmongs te/ rgyu gang las byung zhes pa'o/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ni/ mi gtsang bas 'dod chags/ byams pas zhe sdang /rten 'byel gyis gnyi mug zhi bar byed do/ /gang nyon mongs pa de dag tha dad du brtags pas spong zhes bya yis/ gang spong ba de ni rnyed par mi 'gyur bas yang dag par sgong ba gnyis pa'o/ /gang dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad/ brtson/ sems yang dag par 42—912

rab tu 'jog ces bya ba ni/ bsgrub par bya ba'i dge ba'i chos tshad med pa la 'dun pa dang / sems rab tu 'dzin pas nyams su len par byed pa ni/dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/ yang dag par spong ba gsum pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa gnas pa dang / nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang yang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad khams gsum la mi gnas par thams cad mkhyen par bsngos pas de la zad par 'gyur ba gang yang med pas yang dag par spong ba bzhi pa'o/ /de nas tshogs lam chen por ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin/ rdzu 'phrul byi rkang pa bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ blo gros rab brtan byang chub sems dpa'i lam la bzhi ste/bzhi gang zhe na/ 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa dang / spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan/ gang de la chos thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu dang / gang du yang mi dmigs shing 'dzin pa ①bral ba'i chos thams cad la mi dngang / dngang bar mi 'gyur bar dga' ba spro ba 'dun pa de ni 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab brtan gang dad pa rtse cig dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa des 'jig rten gyi chos thams 42—913

cad kyi brtson pa 'dor zhing / le lor gyur pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par brtson 'grus rgyun chad med pa dang ldan pa ni brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab brtan gang rtsol ba'i rtsol ba rgyun mi 'chad pa dang ldan pa des sems ni gang du yang ma grub cing mi dmigs te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de la sems rtse cig pa ni/ sems kyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab brtan/gang rtse cig tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa des 'gro ba dang / 'chag pa dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba'i dus thams cad du'ang ting nge 'dzin las mi 'da' bar spyod pa ni spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /yang blo gros rab brtanaske/ de la ci'i phyir rdzu 'phrul rmi rkang pa ces bya zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin des log par gyur pa'i chos thams cad spong bar byed/ yang dag par dge bar byed de/ yang dag pa'i gnas su phyin par byed/ bgrod par byed pas na ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya'o/ /tshogs lam chung ngu'i thar pa'i cha 'thun dkon mchog la dad pa'i dmigs pa khyad par can dang / chos thams cad so sor 'byed pa'i dad pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'o/ /'bring po'i thar pa'i cha 'thun ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dmigs pa'i spro ba dang brtson pa skye ba'o/ /chen po'i thar pa'i cha 'thun ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyun thung la grangs mang ba rgyud la skye ba'o/ /de ltar tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi rtags ni/ tshul khrims dag pa'i dbang po'i sgo tshul bzhin ma yin pa las bsdams nas/ kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa phra mo la 'dzems pas/ phyi rol chags sdang gi dgra thams cad rang las byung bar shes shing bdag dang gzhan med par shes pa'o/ /42—914

spang bya ni dug gsum gyis bsdus pa'i mi dge ba bcu'o/ /sa 'tshams ni/'dun pa sngon du song ba'i sems dang po bskyed pa nas drod kyi ye shes ma skyes par du tshogs lam mo/ /de nas sbyor lam bshad par bya ste/ sbyor lam gyi ngo bo ni/ zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'jug tu go ba'o/ /nges tshig ni/ mthong lam la sbyor ba'i phyir na sbyor lam mo/ /dbye ba la bzhi ste/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/chos mchog go/ /mtshan nyid ni/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me'i snga ltas yin pas drod/ yang na nyon mongs pa skyes pa rnams gzhi med dam rang bzhin med par rtogs pas drod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams g.yo ba'i phyir ram/rnam byang gi chos rnams gsal stong 'dzin med du bag tsam rtogs pas rtse mo'i ye shes so/ /yid la byed pa'i bsgom pa ni drod dang rtse mo'i dus su dbang po lnga bsgom par bya ste/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dbang po lnga gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ blo gros rab brtan/byang chub sems dpa'i lam la lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i dbang po dang /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang bo'o/ /de la dad pa'i dbang po gang zhe na—/ 'khor ba na spyod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la mngon par dad ste/ las kyi rnam smin la 'jigs pas/ sdig pa srog gi phyir yang mi byed 42—915

pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thos nas the tshom med par dga' zhing dad pa ni dad pa'i dbang po'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang la dad pa brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos bskyed par byed de/ de brtson 'grus kyi'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang brtson 'grus kyis bsdus pa de dag dran pa'i dbang pos chud mi za bar byed pa de dag ni dran pa'i dbang po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang dran pa'i dbang pos chud mi za bar byed pa'i chos de dag ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse cig tu ma yengs par byed pa de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po gang zhe na/chos gang ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse cig tu byed pa de dag shes rab kyi dbang pos brtags pas chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar yongs su ma grub par shes pa ni shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /de la spyir sbyor lam bzhi la gnas pa'i rtags nyi shu las/ dang po drod rtags bcu ni/ byams mgon gyis gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang / /the tshom yid la zad pa dang / /bdag nyid dge la gnas pa dang / /gzhan yang de la 'god pa dang / /gzhan gyi rten sogs sbyin pa dang / /zab mo'i don la som nyi med/ /byams sems lus sogs sgrib pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang / /bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang / /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /ye shes mngon byung las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams myong ni/ /cung zad drod kyi ye shes te/ res 'ga' spyod pa'i ye shes bstan/ /de yis 42—916

nyams myong 'phel bar byed/ /ces so/ /rtse mo'i rtags bzhi ni/ byams pas—/ gos la sogs pa gtsang ma dang / /lus las srin bu rnams mi 'byung //rgya gyu med sems sbyangs pas ni/ /len dang ser sna med sogs dang / /rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs/ /rtse mor phyin pa spyor ba'i rtags/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /rgya mtsho'i rgyud phyi ma las—/ /rmi lam nub cig zin gyur na/ /rnal 'byor zla phyed bar du bde/ /lha klu dri zas mchod cing bstod/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du/ /ngan song mtsho las sgol ba'i gru/ /zhes so/ /de nas stobs lnga bzod pa dang chos mchog tu bsgom par bya ste/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das stobs lnga gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam la lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang /shes rab kyi stobs so/ /de la dad pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ gang la dad cing mos pa rtse gcig pa de la gang gis kyang mi brdzi ba ste/ de'i drung du bdud kyis sangs rgyas su bsgyur nas 'ong ste/ khyod kyi de ni chos ma yin no zhes bsgyur bar byed do/ /bzlog par byed kyang / de ni 'bral bar mi byed 'byar bar mi byed do/ /de yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni 'gyur srid kyi/ dad pa'i stobs la mos pa de ni/ stobs de las 'bral bar mi nus pas na dad pa'i stobs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs gang zhe na/ gang brtson 'grus rtsom zhing dge ba'i chos gang dang gang la brtan pa'i stobs kyi mthu stobs kyang gnas der ma phyin bar la 42—917

brtson pa'i stobs de sus kyang bzlog par mi nus pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi stobs so—/ /dran pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ chos gang dang gang la dran pa nye bar bzhag pas sems mi g.yengs te/ de la nyon mongs pa gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa dran pa'i stobs te/ nyon mongs pas dran pa de mi tshoms pas na dran pa'i stobs zhes bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs gang zhe na/ dran pa bag yod nyon mongs pas mi brdzi ba de gang du gnas kyang 'du 'dzi las dbe+en pa ste/gzugs la sogs pa chags sdang gi yul thams cad la der 'dzin gyi 'du shes ma zhugs par chos gang la yang rnam par mi rtog pa ni 'du 'dzi las dben pa'i stobs thob pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs zhes bya'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs gang zhe na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad shes rab kyi stobs des yongs su shes nas/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'khor ba las sgol bar byed pa de ni shes rab dang ye shes kyi stobs las byung ba ①na shes rab kyi stobs zhes bya'o/ /de la ci'i phyir stobs lnga zhes bya zhe na dbang po lnga brtan zhing / de'i stobs rgyas pas na stobs lnga zhes bya ste/ de la bzod pa'i stobs ni/ byams pas—/ chos nyid ldan par 'gro ba dang / /sems can don du dmyal rtsol dang / /gzhan gyis sgrib par mi nus dang / /lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud dang / /bdud ces bya bar rtog pa dang / /zhes dang bu mo bzhis zhus pa las/nags khrod cig pur gnas bcas nas/ /chos rnams sgyu mar nyams blangs pas//rmi lam sna tshogs rmi lam shes/ /bzod pa la gnas ngan song bral/ /chos mchog rtags ni cig pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa'o/ /rtags ni nyi 42—918

shu de dag gis/ /drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang / /chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub la mi ldog /khye'u rab snang las/ 'jig byen zhen pa kun bral nas/ /phan pa'i sems dang gang ldan pa/ /rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa yi/ /chos gzhan yod pa ma yin no/ /spang bya ni gong bzhin no/ /sa 'tshams ni drod kyi ye shes nas 'jig rten chos mchog gi bar ro/ /de nas mthong lam bshad par bya ste/ mthong lam gyi ngo bo ni/ bden bzhi don dmigs med do/ /nges tshig ni sngar ma mthong ba'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong bas mthong lam mo/ /dbye na bzhi ste/ sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam mo/ /dbye ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden bzhi stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni/ chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ de'i steng du skad cig phyi ma'i shes pa stong nyid de rgya cher mthong ba ni/ mthong lam gyi chos nyid mthong ba'o/ /bzod pa dang chos shes pa gnyis byang chub thob pa'i rgyu phyin ci ma log par 'dug snyam du rtogs pa de/ bden pa bzhi la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa'o/ /de ltar rtogs pa de ma nor thag chod nges shes skyes pa ni bden pa bzhi la rjes su chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o/ /de ni mthong lam rmi ye shes kyi mthong ba'o de rnams ni chos nyid rgya chung ba che ba de bas che ba dang / shin tu che ba dang bzhi ste/khyab che chung gi khyad par du byas pa'o/ /yid la byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/byang chub kyi yan lag bdun te/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 'byung gnas 42—919

kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ blo gros 'byung gnas kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ①blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa ste/ gang de la chos thams cad ngo bo ma grub par mjong ba de ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas gang gis dge ba dang mi dge ba dang /lung du ma bstan pa yang ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /chos su btags pa thams cad gang du mi dmigs pa sgyu ma lta bu ni/ chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang gi chos thams cad kyi 'du shes shin tu bshig pa'i phyir khams gsum dang rgya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mi len mi 'dod par①/ lam gyi de mngon par rtogs pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba la/spro ba dang / mi rtog pa'i mos pa dang / brtson pa mi 'dor ba 'di ni/brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/gang gis dga' ba dang / mi dga' ba thams cad rnam par bshig pa'i phyir 'du byed kyi chos thams cad la dga' ba mi bskyed par/ kun nas nyon mongs pa sel ba 'di ni dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas gang gi dmigs par 'gyur ba'i chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa'i phyir/chos thams cad lus shin tu sbyangs pa dang / sems shin tu sbyangs pas sgrib pa med pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sems gnas pa ni/sems shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas—/ gang gis chos thams cad kyi 'dzin pa rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ram/42—920

—rtogs pa'i phyir sems ni gang la yang mi dmigs te/ gang la sems mnyam par bzhag cing chos rnams rtogs par 'gyur gyi/ sems mnyam par bzhag pa ma yin pa dang / sems mnyam par bzhag pas sangs rgya yi/ mnyam par ma bzhag pas ma yin no/ /de ltar 'dzin pa dang bral bar mnyam par 'jog pa de ni ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/gang gis chos thams cad gang la'ang gnas par mi byed/ bsten par mi byed/chags par mi byed/ 'ching bar mi byed/ gang yang yid bde sdug bar ma la sogs pa'i chos thams cad la sems mi 'dzin te/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis mi 'phrog shing / des chos thams cad yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba'i btang snyoms can du gyur nas/ dga' ba thob pa 'di ni btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas byang chub kyi yan lag bdun de ltar du blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar ting nge ①'dzin de stobs kyis/chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba dang / /mngon shes dag dang ldan dus su/ /dga' la ngu bro'i shes pa dang / /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa dang / /sems phyir lus 'di bsgyur stub dang / /chos phyir srog ni gtong phod dang / /blo ldan mthong ba'i lam la skye/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su bshad/ /de ma yin pa'i yon tan ni/ /brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phal po che las/sa thob gyur ma thag tu 'jigs pa lnga dang bral/ /'tshe ba med dang 'chi ba mi bsngags ngan 'gro dang / /'khor gyi 'jigs bral de la bag tsha'i rnam pa med/ /ci'i phyir zhe na de la bdag gis ②gnas med do/ /zhes pas 'jigs pa lnga bral du shes par bya'o/ /42—921

de las dang po'i/ mthong spangs ①brgya rtsa bcu gnyis ni/ /kun brtags kyi nyon mongs pa drug gi bye brag ste/ drug gang zhe na/ ma rig pa/'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog /khong khro/ the tshom lta ba'o/ /lta ba la lnga ste/ 'jig tshogs kyi lta ba/ mthar 'dzin/ log lta/ tshul khrims/brtul zhugs kyi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'o/ /de la lta ba lnga dang / ma rig pa la sogs lta ba ma yin pa lnga sdebs pas nyon mongs pa bcu/ de ltar lta ba'i nyon mongs pa bcu po de/ 'dod khams na bden pa bzhi po re re la phrag bcu bcu 'byung bas bzhi bcu'o/ /khams gong ma gzugs khams dang / gzugs med kyi khams gnyis na/ khong khro ma gtogs pa'i dgu po de bden pa bzhi la dgu dgu sbyar bas/ gzugs khams la dgu bzhi sum cu so drug /gzugs med na dgu bzhi sum cu so drug so drug de'i steng du 'dod khams kyi bzhi bcu bsnan snepas mthong spang brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis zer ba don thog du dgos sam snyam pa de dag yin na gong du mthong spang brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis ①zer ba'ang dgos ste/ bdun cu don gnyis/ de'i steng du 'dod khams kyi bzhi bcu mnan pas mthong spang brgya dang bcu gnyis so/ /de yang spong tshul ni/ mthong spangs kyis nyon mongs pa chen po'i chen po mun nag lta bu ste/ ye shes chung ngus te/ mar me lta bus spong ngo / /de yang gong bzhin bden pa bzhis spong ba dang / bdag med rtogs pas cig char du spong ba'o/ /de yang bsngags kyi bden pa mthong tshul ni/ /ye shes sngon 'byung las/bde chen las kyi phyag rgya yis/ /nyin par bden 'dzin rtsa 'dud grol/ /mtshan mo 'khrul pa'i rtsa 'dud grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /de 42—922

nyid las/ phyag rgya'i bde ba bde ba che/ /bla ma'i drin las byung ba yi/ /chos nyid dngos su mthong ba ste/ /dang po'i bden pa zhes su grags/ /dam tshig bkod pa las/ /nyin par snang stong sgyu ma dang / /mtshan mo rmi lam lha'i skuske/ /rang shar de las ma g.yos tshe/ /de ni rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /skad cig bar dor mya ngan 'das/ /rgyun la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /sgyu ma 'od gsal de bzhin no/ /'di ni gzhan du brjod mi bya/ /ye shes gsal ba'i rgyud phyi ma las/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gang yin pa/ /mi lam lus kyi bkod pas sbyangs/ /dang pos sa yi yon tan rnams/ /de nas byung gis gzhan du min/ /de nyid las/ nyin par dang ni rmi lam gyi/ /'khrul ba'i bag chags ma dag par/ /sa brgyad la yang mi gnas na/ /pad+ma can la smos ci dgos/ /tshangs pa kun dge'i mdo las/ sa dang lam gyi yon tan rnams//rmi lam skabs las rtogs par bya/ /sa 'tshams ni/ chos mchog nas mthong lam gyi bar ro/ /de nas/ bsgom lam bshad par bya ste/ ngo bo ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /nges tshig ni chos nyid bden pa mthong zin goms par bya ba'i phyir bsgom lam mo/ /dbye na bsgom lam la sa dgu ste/ dri ma med pa'i sa la sogs pa'o/ /yid la byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad de/blo gros 'byung gnas kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ji ltar blta bar barmi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 42—923

bka' stsal pa/ blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ni—/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/ de la bdag tu blta ba dang / gang zag dang /sems can dang / srog dang / stong nyid du lta ba yang dag par mi byed do/ /de la lta ba'i dmigs pa chung ngu nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar dang / gang yang rab 'bring tha ma'i lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba ni yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas de la rtog pa gang gis rtog pa spong bar 'gyur ba'o//de yang zhi gnas kyis bsdus pa'i lhag mthong la mkhas sdepa ste/ de la chos bzang ngan du rtogs pa dang / yongs su rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs te/ cir yang mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog /yang dag par yang mi rtog pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtog pa'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la tshig gang gis bdag gzhan thams cad la mi gnod pa ste/ de la bdag kyang nyon mongs par mi byed/ gzhan yang nyon mongs par mi byed par/ tshig gang gis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du nges par rtog par byed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i ngag go/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la las gang zad cing ma grub pa ni las kyi mtha'o—/ /de la las nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur gyi/ nyon mongs pa 'bar ba'i phyir ma yin pa dang / las gang nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'gyur gyi/nyon mongs pa skye ba'i phyir ma yin pa dang / dkar ba dang / gnag pa dang /'dres pa'i las kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing / ma grub pa ni yang dag pa'i las mtha'o /42—924

blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la nyon mongs pa mi sog pa ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ste/ de la 'tsho ba gang bdag la yang mi gnod par gzhan la yang mi gnod de/ chos kyi don rdzogs par 'gyur ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la zab cing spros pa dang bral ba 'dus ma byas pa'i chos bsgrub pa la rtsol ba ste/ de'i phyir sems rab tu 'dzin pa dang / 'dun pa dang / brtson pa dang / mi zhum par yang dag pa'i nan tan mngon sum du byed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la dran pa gang gis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi skabs mi rnyed pa'o/ /de la byang chub kyi yan lag sems dang / tshad med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dran pa ste/ dran pa gang gis bdud kyi skabs mi rnyed pa dang / dran pa gang gis lam log par mi 'gyur ba dang /dran pa bgo ba lta bus sems dang sems byung gi chos mi dge ba thams cad kyi skabs mi rnyed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i dran pa'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ bdag mnyam pa nyid las chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid dang / bdag rnam par dag pas chos thams cad rnam par dag pa dang /bdag stong pa nyid las chos thams cad stong pa nyid du yang dag par snyoms par 'jug la/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang gis sems skad cig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis thams cad mkhyen pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par sangs rgyas pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam yan lag brgyad de ltar blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rtags ni/ zab mo'i don khong du chud nas/42—925

goms zhing brtan par 'gyur bas/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par 'gyur te/sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar du/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis bsam gyis mi khyab par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang bsgom spangs kyi nyon mongs pa bag la nyal ba'i lhan skyes las phyi nang drug ste/ drug gang zhe na/ ma rig pa dang /'dod chags/ khong khro/ the tshom/ nga rgyal/ 'jig tshogs su lta ba'o/ /'dod khams na nyon mongs pa drug po re re la che 'azing dgu dgur phye nas/ de la ye shes kyang che 'bring dgu dgur phye nas spong ste/ dgu pa drug la lnga bcu rtsa bzhi—/ gzugs khams nas khong khro bor ba'i lnga po la/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs pa lnga po la che 'bring dgu dgur phye nas de ye shes che 'bring dgus spong ngo / /dgu pa lnga la bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa rnams la zhe lnga lnga ste/ brgya brgyad cu/ gzugs med la yang /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ de bzhin du rnam shes mtha' yas dang / yod min med min dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched gsum po la zhe lnga lnga ste/ brgya dang brgyad cu/ de ltar brgya brgyad cu gnyis la gsum brgya drug cu/ de'i steng du 'dod khams kyi lnga bcu rtsa bzhi mnan pas bsgom spang bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi'o/ /de nas mthar phyin pa'i lam bshad de/ bsam rmis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ de la rigs kyi bu/ mthar phyin pa'i lam gang zhe na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob par byed pa la chos gzhan gyis bar chad med pas na bar chad med pa'i lam zhes bya/ gang de la rigs kyi bu/ bsgom par bya 42—926

ba'i lam gyis sgrib pa kun spangs nas/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba de nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa des 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /dgongs pa bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ gsal stong 'dzin med bde ba che/ /'od gsal rang shar 'dus ma byas/ /ge sar gsang ba'i bde ba dang / /byin brlabs stobs las 'byung ba ste/ /mun khung sgon me gser gsal ltar/ /phra zhing phra ba'i sgrib pa de/ /rang dag rang grol stobs kyis 'joms/ /'di ni gsang ba'i spyod yul lo/ /de ltar shes bya'i sgrib pa dag pa'i sangs rgyas de ji lta bu zhe na/ ye shes bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyengs nyid dang / /ye shes gnyis su med pa ste/ /nyon mongs shes bya yongs dag pa'i/ /chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan te/ /mi 'gyur ma skyes mtshan med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /de la bzhengs bzhugs mi mnga' yang / /sngon gyi sems bskyed bsod nams tshogs/ /smon lam bskyed rims rgyu rkyen las/ /gzugs sku gnyis ni rang shar 'byung / /de yang 'og min pho brang du/ /snang mdzad longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan bzang dpe byad rab tu ldan/ /dpe bral snang stong dri med sku/ /zhen bral bde stong dbyer med rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas bskor/ /mtha' bral bde stong dbyer med chos/ /skye med rang sgra sgogs par byed/ /gnas dus ston pa 'khor la sogs/ /sprul sku gang 'dul rang shar rmis/ /gdul bya gang 'dul skur gyur nas/ /skyon bral pad ltar smin grol byed/ /yang na nor bu dpag bsam ltar/ /yang dgongs pa bla na med pa las/ /bskyed rims bde ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /de la sku 42—927

gnyis 'byung 'gyur te/ /rdzogs rims las ni chos kyi sku/ /dbyer med byed 'di bstan pa'o/ /de yang chos sku las longs sku/ longs sku las sprul sku 'byung ba 'am 'char te/ gser 'od dam pa las/ dper na/ nam mkha' stong pa la brten nas glog snang ngo / /de bzhin du chos sku la bsten nas bsod nams kyi sku snang ngo / /bsod nams kyi sku la brten te sprul sku snang ngo / /sku gsum du bgrang du yod kyi/ ngo bos ni gsum du med do/ /mdor na chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la/ gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu 'byung zhing / rtog bral shes bya thams cad ma lus pa ji lta bu bzhin mkhyed te/ rnam rtog mi mnga' cir yang sa le mdon/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes sku ldan/ /de la chos sku'i ngo bo gsum ste/ 'dus ma byas pa lhun gyis grub ste/de la rkyen gzhan gyis bsgyur bar mi nus pa'o/ /gzugs sku'i ngo bo la yang gsum te/ mdon pa dang brtse ba dang / nus par ldan pa'o/ /de ltar yang byams pas/ lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pas/ /mdon dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /de yang ye shes lnga las sku bzhi grub tshul dang / bskyed rdzogs dang / tshogs gnyis las sku bzhi dang /dbang bzhi las sku bzhi 'grub tshul la sogs pa spros pa las ①dga' bar gyur na mdo rgyud du ma las shes par bya'o/ /'di ni rtse cig tu sgrub pa'i nyams myong dang / mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa mi 'gal bar mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin gyi—/ shes bya dang theg pa ma lus pa shes par bya ba'i long med cing thug mtha' med de/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji srid 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /theg 42—928

pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /'du shes med par gyur pa na/ /theg pa med cing brjod du med/ /ces gsungs so/ /sa 'tshams ni/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma nas sku bzhi 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bar la mthar phyin pa'i lam du shes par bya'o/ /de nas sa'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ sa'i ngo bo ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lhag mthong gnyis bral lo/ /nges tshig ni/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten nam ①gong du bgrod pa'i gzhi yin pas na sa zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las—/ 'byung po dpag med 'jig byed phyir/ /dpag tu med pa de dag la/ /phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir/ /de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do/ /ces so/ /dbye ba ni rab tu dga' ba la sogs sa bcu'o/ /sa bcu so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ gser 'od dam pa las/ de la rigs kyi bu ②phyir na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya zhe na/ de ni thog mar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems sngon ma mthong ba de mngon du gyur te/don chen po'i bsams pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i phyir/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /lhung ba phra mo'i dri ma dang / tshul khrims kyi nyes skyon thams cad dag pa'i phyir—/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa med pa'i tshad med pa'i ye shes dang /ting nge 'dzin byi ye shes kyi 'od snang ba de bskyod par mi nus shing gang gis kyang 42—929

zil gyis mi non pa dang / thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs la gnas pa'i phyir sa gsum pa 'od byed pa zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi me des nyon mongs pa thams cad bsreg cing / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos bsgoms pa'i me 'od 'phro ba phyir 'byung bas na/ sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba zhes bya'o/ /de bsgoms pa'i thabs dang / mchog gi ye shes la dbang bsgyur dka' ba dang / mthong spang dang / bsgom spang gi nyon mongs pa thul bar dka' ba thul ba'i phyir sa lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /'du byed kyis chos thams cad bar chad med pa mngon du gyur te/ mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa thams cad mngon du byed pas/ sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /zag pa med pa'i chos la bar chad med cing mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pas rnam par grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin yun ring du bsgoms pa de rnams dag cing thogs ①pa med pa dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal las ring du song ba'i phyir—/ sa bdun pa ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa bsgom pa la dbang thob ste/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyis g.yo bar mi nus pas na sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad la chos ston pa la dbang du byur pa dang / kha na ma tho ba med cing blo gros shin tu yangs pa thogs pa med pa thob pa'i phyir/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu la ye shes chen po sprin lta bus khyab par 42—930

'grems pa'i phyir sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa bcu pa'i snga ①ltas ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo las/rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po'i snga ltas ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten kyi khams gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su gang ba mthong / rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa'i snga ltas ni/ stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lag mthil lta bur gyur pa la/ rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas rab tu brgyan par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu zhes 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /sa gsum pa'i snga ltas ni/ bdag nyid dpa' zhing lag cha dang go cha sra ba thogs nas phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'dul bar mthong ngo / /sa bzhi pa'i snga ltas ni/ phyogs bzhi ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang ldan pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ me tog sna tshogs kyis mngon par mthor ba ②mthong /sa lnga pa'i snga ltas ni/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bud med kyis dbu la me tog tsam pa ka'i phreng ba 'dogs par mthong ngo / /sa drug pa'i snga ltas ni/ rdzing them kas bzhi dang ldan pa'i gser kyi bye ma brdal ba rnyog pa med cing dang ba la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang / me tog ud pa la dang / ku mu ta dang / pad+ma dkar pos brgyan pa'i chur 42—931

mthong ste/ de la bdag nyid rtse dga' zhing longs su spyod pa mthong ngo / /sa bdun pa'i snga ltas ni/ phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis nas sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa mthong ste/ de nas bdag nyid ma gnod ma nyams par be+er ldog par mthong ngo / /sa brgyad pa'i snga ltas ni/ phrag pa gnyis na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod pan thogs pa gcan zan phra mo thams cad skrag par byed cing 'dug par mthong ngo / /sa dgu pa'i snga ltas ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por mthong ste/skye bo khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing / mdun gyis bltas la/mgo bo'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gdugs dkar po 'dzin par mthong /sa bcu pa'i snga ltas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mthong ste/ kha dog gser lta bu/ 'od 'dom gang ba/ tshangs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis ltas na chos ston pa mthong ste/bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i snga ltas yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gser 'od dam pa las kyang de ltar ro/ /sa gang gis pha rol tu phyin pa gang non pa ni/ rigs kyi bu/ de la sa dang po'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa non to/ /de bzhin du sa gnyis pas tshul khrims so/ /sa gsum pas bzod pa/ sa bzhi 42—932

pas brtson 'grus/ sa lnga pas bsam gtan/ sa drug pas shes rab/ sa bdun pas thabs la mkhas pa'i/ sa brgyad pas spyon lam/ sa dgu pas stobs—/ rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i mtshan nyid ni/ phal chen las/ de la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tshol zhing / sems can rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su gtong ba ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba thams cad rab tu zhi ba ni tshul khrims so/ /byams pa dang snying rje sngon du 'gro bas sems can la 'tshig pa med pa ni bzod pa'o/ /gong nas gong du dge ba'i chos tshol bas mi ngoms pa 'di ni brtson 'grus so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba la 'gyod pa med pa'i lam dang ldan pa 'di ni/ bsam gtan no/ /rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa mngon du gyur pa 'di ni shes rab po/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes tshad med pa bsgrub pa 'di ni thabs so/ /ye shes de la dmigs shing de nyid mngon par bsgrub pa 'di ni smon lam mo/ /phas kyi rgol ba thams cad dang bdud kyi tshogs thams cad kyis lam rgyud yongs su mi gcod pa 'di ni stobs so/ /chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa 'di ni ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bcu'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gong bzhin du sa dang po'i byang chub kyi sems yan lag bdun dang / sa gnyis pa nas sa bcu pa'i bar gyi 'phags pa'i lam brgyad do/ /spang bya ni mthong spang dang bsgom spang ngo / /42—933

rmongs pa nyi shu'i sgrib pa ni/ de la rigs kyi bu chos dang gang zag la mtshan ma can du zhen pa'i rmongs pa dang / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi nyon mongs pas 'jigs pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyi ①sa dang po la sgrib pa'o/ /be+eng ba phra mo'i 'khrul pa la rmongs pa dang / las dang spyod pa sna tshogs skye ba la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa gnyis pa la sgrib po/ /ma thob pa thob par 'dod pa'i rmongs pa dang gzungs dam pa'i mchog thob pa la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa gsum pa la sgrib po—/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i ro'i dga' ba la sred pa'i rmongs pa dang chos rnam par dag pa'i sred pa la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bzhi pa la sgrib po/ /'khor ba la shin tu skyo ba'i rmongs pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon par gzhol ba la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa lnga pa la sgrib po/ /'du byed kyi rgyu ba sngon du gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang /mtshan ma sbom po'i mngon du gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / rgongs pa 'di gnyis kyi du sa drug pa la sgrib po/ /mtshan ma phra mo mngon du gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang /mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa med pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bdun pa la sgrib po/ /mtshan ma med pa la ched du rtsol ba'i rmongs pa dang / mtshan mar 'dzin pa la dbang thob pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa brgyad pa la sgrib po/ /gang chos ston pa la tshad med pa dang /tshig dang yi ge tshad med pa la mkhas par ma gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / sgobs pa la dbang ma thob pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa dgu pa la sgrib po/ /mngon par shes pa chen po la dbang bsgyur ba ma thob pa'i rbongs 42—934

pa dang / don dam la sogs pa'i phra mo la mkhas par ma gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bcu pa la sgrib po/ /spyod yul shin tu phra ba thams cad la shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rmongs pa dang / nyon mongs pa shin tu phra ba'i gnas ngan len la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi sa la sgrib bo/ /sgrib pa dang bral ba'i rtog pa sa gang gis gang rtogs pa ni/ khye'u rab snang gi mdo las/ rigs kyi bu gang de la sa dang po ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyis kun tu khyab pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa gnyis pa chos kyi dbyings dri ma dang bral ba mchog gi don du rtogs so/ /sa gsum pa chos kyi dbyings su 'thun pa rang bzhin 'od gsal bar rtogs so/ /sa bzhi pa chos thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa lnga pa chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings su cig pas rgyud tha dad med pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa drug pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtogs pa thams cad ma grub pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa bdun pa 'khor ba la mi skyo ba dang / chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa brgyad pa zhing dag pa dang / rtogs pa'i tshogs dang bral ba'i don du rtogs so/ /sa dgu pa chos dang yi ge tshad med pa dang spobs pa thogs pa med pa'i don du rtogs so/ /sa bcu pa 'phrin las dbang bsgyur ba'i don du rtogs so/ /sa bcu gcig pas ni kun gnas 'gyur ba'i chos kyi sku dang /sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas 'gyur ba'i longs sku dang / nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa sna tshogs kyis yid gnas 'gyur ba'i sprul sku dang / dbyer med cing mtha' thams 42—935

cad dang bral ba mchog tu gyur pa dang / gong na med pa yang dag pa'i don du rtogs so/ /khye'u rab snang gi mdo las/ khye'u rab snang gis ①gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtags ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i rtags ni/ 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la ting nge 'dzin brgya rab tu thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba dang / de dag gis byin kyis brlabs yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgyar bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya yang dag par snang bar byed pa dang / sems can brgya yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa brgyar gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa brgya dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa brgya la 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus brgya yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor brgya brgya yang dag par ston pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom zhing yon tan de nyid dang ldan pa'o/ /sa thob 'jig pa lnga dang bral/ /'tsho med 'chi dang mi bsngags dang / /ngan 'gro 'khor byi 'jigs bral ba/ /ci phyir rang bzhin shes phyir ro/ /sa thob gyur ma thag tu ni/ /dga' la ngu bro'i shes pa dang / /chos phyir srog ni 'dor nus pa/ /blo ldan de la skye bar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu sa gnyis pa la gnas pa ni/ skad cig yud tsam thang cig la 42—936

ting nge 'dzin stong thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas stong mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang /'jig rten gye khams stong bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong du snang bar bya ba dang / sems can stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa stong du gnas par bya ba dang //sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa stong dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa stong la 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo stong 'gyed pa dang / lus stong yongs su ston pa dang /lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong stong rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa gsum pa la gnas pa ni skad cig yud tsam thang cig la nying nge 'dzin brgya stong rab tu thob po/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong mthong ba dang /de dag gi byin brlabs yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong rab tu bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong du 'gro ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong snang bar bya ba dang / sems can brgya stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa brgya stong du gnas par bya ba dang /sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa brgya stong dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa brgya stong la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo brgya stong 'byed pa dang / lus brgya stong yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brgya stong brgya yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bzhi pa la gnas pas skad cig yud tsam thang cig la ting sde 'dzin khrag khrig thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang /42—937

'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khrag khrig tu 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig snang bar bya ba dang / sems can khrag khrig yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa khrag khrig tu gnas par bya ba dang / sngon byi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig tu gnas pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig la 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo khrag khrig 'byed pa dang /lus khrag khrig yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa lnga pa ①gnas pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam la ting nge 'dzin khrag khrig stong thob cing / de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang /sangs rgyas khrag khrig stong mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig stong bskyod pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams khrag khrig stong du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten rmi khams khrag khrig stong snang bar byed pa dang / sems can khrag khrig stong yongs su smin par byed pa dang / bskal pa khrag khrig stong du gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig stong dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig stong du 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo khrag khrig stong 'byed pa dang / lus khrag khrig stong yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig stong yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa drug pa la gnas pas/ 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la ting nge 'dzin khrag khrig brgya stong thob cing / de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba dang / de dag gi 42—938

byen brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khyeg brgya stong bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khrag khrig brgya stong du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig brgya stong snang bar bya ba dang / sems can khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong dang / phyi ma'i mtha' ①bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong du 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo khrag khrig brgya stong 'byed pa dang / lus khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig brgya stong yang dag par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bdun pa la gnas pas/ 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong thob cing / de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba dang /de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snang bar bya ba dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su byun par bya ba dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'gyed pa dang / lus bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig 42—939

brgya stong yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa brgyad pa la gnas pas 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin sum stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed ⑫ thob cing / de dag la stoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin gyis brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed du bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed du snang bar bya ba dang /sems can stong gsum ④brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed du gnas par bya ba dang / sngon kyi mtha'i bskal pa stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed la 'jug pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed la 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed yongs su ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong sum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed pa yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa dgu pa la gnas pas/ 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed rab tu thob cing / de dag la snyoms par 'jug 42—940

pa dang / sangs rgyas grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin ni brlabs yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed du bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed du 'gro ba dang 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed du 'gro bar bya ba dang / sems can grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed du 'jug pa dang / sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed du 'jug pa dang /chos kyi sgo grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed yang dag par ston pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed yang dag par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bcu pa la gnas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa cig las kyang / skad cig yud tsam thang cig la chos kyi snang ba chen po dang / chos kyi 'od chen po dang / chos kyi sprin chen po tshad med pa rnams bzod do/ /yang dag par len to/ /yang dag par 'dzin to/ /bdag gir byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis dang gsum nas tshad med pa'i bar dag kyang / skad 42—941

cig yud tsam thang cig la chos kyi snang ba chen po dang / chos kyi 'od chen po dang / chos kyi sprin chen po tshad med pa'i bzod pa thob po/ /yang dag par 'dzin to/ /yang dag par len to/ /bdag gir byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na—/ 'di yang nam mkha' lta bu'i chos sku las/ ye shes sam chos kyi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas tshul ni phar phyin dang sngags kyi lugs so/ /de yang pha rol tu phyin pa la theg chung dang / theg chen gnyis so/ /de la theg pa chung ba ni/rgyal bu don thams cad 'grub pa des/ sa bcu rang rgyud pa cig 'og min nam/rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas para'adod do/ /theg chen pa ni/ rgyal ba 'dis bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon du sangs rgyas zin par 'dod do/ /mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs kyi bu nga ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang po 'das pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas so zhes pa dang / yab sras mjal ba las/ nga ni 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dpag tu med pa grangs med pa 'das pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas so zhes so/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor gyi lugs kyis rgyal bu don grub 'og min du byon pa dang / til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod ji ltar sangs rgya bar ①bya snyam pa'i rjes la/ phyi'i mngon byang lnga la bsten nas sangs rgyas par 'dod do/ /42—942

rnal 'byor bla med pha rgyud ni/ 'og min du rnam par snang mdzad chen po la dbang bskur zhus nas/ der sangs rgyas la/ de'i sprul pa 'dir sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ zla gsang thig le las/ gtsang ma'i rigs dag spangs nas ni/ /'og min stug po nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po cig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /yang na sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' de 'og min gyi gnas su rdo rje 'chang la dbang bskur zhus pas/ de nyid kyis dbang bskur des sangs rgyas— par 'dod de/'dul ba don yod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'og min dam par ni—/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtso chen dbang phyug des/ /chos kyi pho brang der ni dbang bskur ba/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje dbyings kyis bskur①/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rjes byin brlabs pas/ /de nyid du ni mngon par yang dag byang chub pas/ /bla med snying po rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ /rang byung bde ba chen por mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /ma rgyud pa ni/ grags chen gyi sangs rgyas sa bcu gcig ②pa de/ 'og min btsun mo'i gzhal yas khang ①du dbang bzhi rdzogs par ⑦zhus pas/ bud med mchog la bsten nas/ sa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob ste/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bcu gcig sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / /bud med phyag rgya bsten byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /yang na sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des 'og min du longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen po zhal sbyor bde ba chen po'i sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po de la dbang bzhi rdzogs zhus pas/ sa bcu bzhi bgrod do/ /rdo rje bde ba'i rgyud dang / ye 42—943

shes thig le'i rgyud las/ bum pa'i dbang ni bcu gcig ste/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni bcu gnyis mchog /shes rab ye shes bcu gsum pa/ /de ltar de bzhin bcu bzhi pa/ /dbang re la ni sa re ste/ /'di rnams sa yi dbang phyug bdag /ces so/ /de la 'ga' zhig ni/ gtsang ma'i rigs kyi 'og min ni 'jig pa yin la/ 'og min stug po bkod pa ni mi 'jig ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las—/ 'og min bstug ①po nyams dga' zhing / /stug po zhing khams 'jig med par/ /de na sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /rdzogs par longs spyod tshul 'di 'byung / /zhes pas/ rnam snang gangs chen mtsho chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de la 'khor sa bcu pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i gnas ni stug po bkod pa yin no/ /de ni mi 'jig la/ de'i nang na gnas pa'i zhing khams chung ngu thams cad ni sprul sku'i zhing khams yin pas 'jig pa'o/ /zhes 'dod de—/ de ltar na gangs chen mtsho'i zhing mi 'jig na/ 'di yang mi 'jig stekhru/'di yang de'i zhing khams su bshad pa dang / gnyis ka la 'jig rten gyi khams su bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de la dper na/ skyes bu'i yan lag dang / mig dang rna ba la sogs pa'i bye brag thams cad la mi rtag na/ phyi lus kyang mi rtag ste—/ spyi dang bye brag gi mtha' can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gtsang ma rigs kyi gnas ni 'og min yin la/ gtsang ma'i rigs dag spangs pa'i gnas 'og min ni grong las dgon pa lta bu ste/ de ni mi 'jig dze+este sa bcu 'ba' zhig gi snang ngo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig pa ni ma dag pa so so skye bo'i snang ngo yin te/ de na so so skye bo med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lung thams cad de nyid kyi lung ste/ gnyis med rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las/ ye shes bla na med pa'i 42—944

gnas—/ /gtsang ma'i gnas mchog legs gnas pa/ /bcom ldan 'og min 'dir rtag bzhugs/ /kun tu bzang po'i sa phyogs so/ /zhes so/ /yang na sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'og min te/ ye shes bla na med pa'i rgyud las / sems nyid bde stong lhan cig skyes/ /'og min gtsang ma'i gnas mchog go/ /zhes so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas kyi khyad par ni rgya mtsho dang ba lang gi rmig ①rjes kyi chu lta bu ste/ phal po che'i mdo las/ /byang chub sems dang sangs rgyas khyad/ /rgya mtsho ba lang rmig rjes mtshungs/ /dag pa sa gsum yon tan kyang / /dpag cing gzhal bar mi nus na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ /brjod cing dpag par smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa dang / bsam mi khyab bstan pa'i mdo las/ nam mkha' sa gzhi gang yin pa//skra rtses gzhal bar nus srid kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ /bskal pa grangs med brjod mi nus/ /dpag cing brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /de phyir bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /zhes so/ /sgyu ma lam rim gsal byed pa'i/ /'grel pa 'di ni bdag gis byas/ /dge des 'dzin byed bdud bcom nas/ /dbyer med sku bzhi thob par shog /sgyu ma lam gyi rim pa'i don 'grel/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid dang / lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /slad nas bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhus te nyams su stsong bar byas pa'o— sbyi //42—945

942 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rgyas par/943 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉cig ②〈〈pe 〉〉gang / du〈〈pe 〉〉wapar/944 ①〈〈pe 〉skamag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉'di yang mi 'jig ste/ ①〈〈pe 〉torajigs/945 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2451)42—947

༄ga /rnga ki'i zhal gdams bzhugs so//dhi༄gro/ /na mo gu ru/ rtsa kha 'byed pa'i man ngag ni/ /spyil krungs kyesgal tshigs srang byas la/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur brang khar bzhag /g.yas pa thur du drag por brkyang / /g.yon pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /de yi 'og tu sug bzhi ni/ /phyir la drag po brkyang bya zhing / /kha gdangs mig kyang sgrad par bya//de nas sug bzhi drag tu sprug /de 'og bla ma'i gtum mo sgom/ /rang lus rnam snang chos bdun la/ /dbu ma drang por gnas bsams te/ /spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsams/ /de 'og ye shes me de ni/ /yang spar dbu ma'i nang zhugs te/ /bla ma'i zhabs la reg gyur pas/ /bdud rtsi dbab cing bde ba bsgom—/ /bla ma mi dmigs me sor gnas/ /bdud rtsi mi dmigs stong par sgom—/ /ni gu ma'i zhal gdams so// //42—948
bsdur mchan/948 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanakrungs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2452)42wa 949

༄ga /ni gu ma'i gdams pa bzhugs so//①༄4/ /na mo gu ru/ rtsa rlung la sogs sgom pa yi/ /lus la bde ba skyes gyur nas/ /bde ba smad du lhung ba yis/ /bde ba phyi ru shor dogs na/ /rtsa sgor rlung gdon shin tu gces/ /dbe+en zhing 'bol ba'i gdan dag la/ /langs la lus gnyis srang bya ste/ /rlung gi 'khor lo thur du bshig /lag gnyis spyi bor brkyangs byas la/ /me yi 'khor lo mnyam du sbyor/ /rting pa bteg cing sa la rdab/ /dmigs pa lte 'og sor bzhi na/ /rtsa gsum 'doms pa'i 'dom ②sa nas/ /gtum mo ye shes me sbar te/ /a ba dhu ti'i nang nas yar—/ /nar gyis song bas spyi bor sleb/ /tshangs bug k+ṣa yig phyir gsal te//me lce nyug gis byung ba dang / /me dang 'grogs pa'i rlung de ni/ /kha dog sngon po phyu ru ru/ /du ba'i tshul du thon par bsam/ /de nas 'jog pa'i dus tsam nas—/ /me de gnas su song ba dang / /k+ṣa des tshangs bug dkag ①par 42byed950

༄ga /ḍā ki ma'i zhal gdams bzugs so//①༄4/ /na mo gu ru/ thabs lam gtum mo sgom pa yi/ /rlung sems gnad du ma tshud pas/ /lus la zug skyon byung ba na/ /dben pa'i phyogs su song nas ni/ /rdo rje'i gar la 'bad par bya/ /dang po dbu mar gzud pa ni/ /drang dang tsha bsdu gsum yin no/ /dang po dbu mar gzud pa ni—/ /'bol ba'i gdan la sar gyis langs/ /rkang pa bshibs la drang por bsrang / /lag gnyis khu tshur brla zur brkyang / /rlung gzung 'og rlung drag por bden/ /ting ②pa lan gsum brang la brdeg /'phar ba gsum bya lag pa ni/ /rgod shog bzhin skyong ro stod sprug /lus po bsrang la lag pa gnyis/ /khu tshur snol la nu mar mnan/ /sku 'debs g.yas g.yon drag tu bden/ /lan gsum yin no rlung gzung ces①/ /de nas langs la lag gnyis snol/ /dpung pa dag la dgab par bya/ /rked pa g.yas g.yon drag po bcu/ /42—952

dmigs pa lte bar a bsams la/ /rtsa rnams thig le a la 'dus/ /a ni skye med stong par sgom/ /gsum gsum byed pa thams cad 'dra/ /snying rlung byung na snying nang du/ /a bsams 'od zer 'phro ba la/ /sems gtad de yis sel bar byed/ /rdo rje gar gyi gdams ngag 'di/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gdam ngag go// sbyi //bsdur mchan/952 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉ltar bkod/②〈〈pe 〉skong / ①〈〈pe 〉gces/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2454)42wa 953

༄ga /ḍā ki'i zhal gdams dug gsum zhi byed bzhugs so//①༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ thabs lam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /rgyud la dug gsum skyes pa yis/ /de yi 'bras bu nang seng na/ /lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor dag gis bcos/ /gti mug stobs kyis byung gyur na/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'dug stangs dang / /'od zer dkar po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /gti mug mun pa gsal bar bya/ /nyon mongs gti mug zhi bar bsam②/ /rgod pa'i stobs kyis 'gro 'dod na/ /rang lus rdo rje'i skyil dkrung dang / /srin lag nas bzung ltag pa nas/ /bkug nas g.yas g.yon dag tu ni/ /drag po gsum gsum bcu par bya/ /spyi bor thal brgyab thim par bsam/ /yi dwags stobs kyis 'khro 'tshig na/ /don yod grub pa'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /rang la gnod pa'i yi dwags kyis/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis tshim par bya/ /der rjes rdo rje skyil krung ①dang / /'bar ba'i phyag rgya snying gar bca'/ /khro bo'i spyan gyes 42—954

phyogs bcur lta/ /phyogs bcu'i sa bon me 'khor gyi/ /rang la gnod byed bskrad par bsam/ /khro bo'i bzlas pa bag tsam bya/ /rgyud la zhe sdang skyes gyur pas/ /'bras bu stod du gzer byung na/ /rdo rje skyil krung ①brang kha ru/ /sor mo snol te brang kha ru/ /g.yas g.yon du ni gsum gsum bcu/ /khro bo'i spyan gyes g.yas g.yon lta/ /der rjes mnyam bzhag phyag rgya yis/ /'pho bar sdams te lan gsum rdengs/ /rgyud la 'dod chags skyes pa yis/ /'bras bu smad du nad byung na/ /lus po rkyang sdeste rkang pa g.yob/ /lag pa zan spru'i phyag rgya bca'/ /de gnyis dmigs pa cig yin te/ /snying gar yig ge ma dang ni/ /thig le dkar dmar sbyor ba yis/ /rgyud la bde stong skye bar bsam//phyir shor nang du drod med na/ /lus sems phral te bsdu bar bya/ /gtum mo dag ni me yin te/ /me de phra ba skud pa tsam/ /dbu ma dbu zhabs sleb bsams la/ /de la sems gtad gsal bar bsgom④/ /drod skyes bde ba med gyur na/ /thig le dbab pa'i man ngag ni/ /'dom gsum chod pa'i gdan la ni/ /sgog gis langs la sdig 'dzub brkyang / /bcu zhing bcu zhing 'dun rjomatha' dang / /de ni rgyab mtha' de 'og tu/ /sems dpa'i spyil krung 0srin lag gzung rjo/ /rtag tu bcu zhing lag ngar bshud/ /de 'og lan gsum sprug par bya/ /de yis bde ba 'bebs pa yin/ /lus sbyong de dag gang byed kyang / /rlung gzung ba ni shin tu gces/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i zhal gdams so// khru //42—955

bsdur mchan/954 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsams/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dkrung /955 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dkrung / ②〈〈pe 〉〉brkyang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉sgrosgom/ rjo〈〈pe 〉stabadun/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉dkrung / du〈〈pe 〉〉bzung /bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2455)42wa 956

༄ga /ḍā ki ma'i zhal gdams bzhugs so//①༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ rang lus rtsa yi 'khor lo 'di/ /brkyang ba rnams ni bskum pa dang / /bskum pa rnams ni brkyang bar bya/ /des ni ma byas sgoms pa ni/ /rtsa zug rlung zug 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la dben pa'i gnas nyid du/ /rang nyid sar gyis langs byas la/ /lag gnyis 'khar ba cig la bzung / /g.yas pa'i 'thil de g.yon pa yis/ /pus mo snyan gong dag tu sbyar/ /g.yas pa'i pus mo phyir bskyed de/ /lus po steng phar ②'og tu ni—/ /g.yon pa'i rting pa lan gsum gdab/ /de bzhin g.yas pa'ang shes par bya/ /de yi 'og tu rkang pa gnyis/ /mnyam par bshad ①kyis brkyang byas la—/ /g.yas pa'i rting pa sa la ni/ /drag po lan gsum gdab par bya/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'ang gsum gsum mo/ /de 'og mkhar ba bcag byas la/ /lag gnyis sor mnol brang la dgab/ /'theb chen gnyis kyis nu ma dang / /42—957

༄ga /'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/①ga smon lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pra ni dha na rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa smon lam kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yis/ /thugs rje'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yis—/ /bdag gi smon lam 'di rnams thams cad kun/ /ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /'di nas gzung ste rnam pa thams cad du/ /mos gus tshad med bla ma mnyes byed cing / /rnam dag lus dang longs spyod mkha' snyam mchod/ /skad cig mi 'bral phrin las rgyas byed shog /skye ba kun tu rigs bzang nad med cing / /dbyangs snyan gzugs bzang gzi brjid stobs ldan nas/ /tshe ring 'khor dang longs spyod chos rnams kun/ /lhun gyis grub cing kun gyis bkur bar shog /gang du skyes pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /42byed959

sems can rnams kyis mthong thos dran reg tshe/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas mi ngoms shing / /mi mthun phyogs bral kun dang 'thun par shog /bdag ni mkha' snyams sems can thams cad kyi/ /mgon skyab ①re gnas dpung gnyen gyur nas kyang / /gang la gang 'dod re ba thams cad kun/ /tshul bzhin ma lus bdag gis skongs par shog /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs rnams dang / /lus ngag yid gsum smon lam cig tu spyad/ /dus 'di nas bzung skad cig mi 'bral zhing / /dag snang bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /gar skyes yid bzhin nor bur bdag gyur te/ /dgos 'dod thams cad yid la bsams ma thag /phun sum tshogs pa dpag med char phab nas—/ /sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog /bdag ni gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du/ /'gro kun nad gdon 'thab brtsod dbul phongs bral—/ /tshe ring nad med chos dang longs spyod ldan/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba thams cad du/ /longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' mnyes nas/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi phyogs bcur gtong byed cing / /pha rol phyin bcus 'gro kun smin grol shog /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /chags thogs med pa'i shes rab phun tshogs nas//dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ /skad cig tsam gyis thams cad mngon 'gyur shog /bdag ni basbab gsum dri med legs brgyan zhing / /brtsod bral lha bcas 'jig rten mchod cing bstod/ /tshul khrims mchog la 'gro ba kun bkod cing / /legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs shog /ri khrod dgon par chog shes zas gos ldan/ /phyi nang bar chad skad cig mi 'byung bar//42—960

nyams rtogs mthar phyin phrin las tshad med kyis/ /sems can ma lus smin cing grol byed shog /lha 'dre stobs ldan dregs can ma lus kun/ /bsnyen bsgrub rbad bskul skad cig ma dgos par/ /srog snying 'bul zhing bran bzhin nyan pa dang / /mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /bdag gis byams dang snying rje mngon gyur te/ /khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /gcig la gcig 'apa'i gnod pa rab zhi nas/ /bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bar gnas par shog /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe//gnad gcod mi 'byung chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /gzugs sku rang shar gzhan don lhun grub cing / /sku gdung ring bsrel 'gro ba 'dren par shog /rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas skal pa'i rdul snyed rgya mtsho la—/ /kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' snyam pa yis/ /skal pa rgya mtshor bdag gis mchod byed shog /zhing khams rnam dag rgya mtsho mngon gyur te/ /spyod pa rnam dag shes rab tshad med kyis/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho thams cad rab mthong nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho ma lus rtogs par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsungs ①dbyangs mngon gyur nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshangs pa'i dbyangs sgog zhing / /'gro rnams skad du bdag gis chos bstan nas/ /sems can ma lus sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /kun bzang sgyu ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /mtha' bral sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas sku dang ma lus zhing khams kun/ /rdul cig steng du skad cig 'grub par shog /sems can khams dang rgya mapa'i gting mtha' dang / /nam mkha'i khams dang chos dbyings dbyer med lta/ /bdag gi shes rab byed lam ting 'dzin rnams/ /42—961

gting mtha' dpag med tshad bzung med par shog /'khor los bsgyur rgyal dpag med bdag sprul nas/ /'gro kun re bskong chos kyi rgyal srid skyong / /mkha' mnyam zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur nas/ /sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog /ma 'ongs dus su nad mtshon skal pa yis sems can sdug bsngal nyams thag gyur pa'i tshe/ /bdag ni sman mchog rgyal por gyur nas kyang / /skad cig nyid la sdug bsngal zhi byed shog /mu ge'i skal pas bkres skom gyur pa'i tshe/ /bza' btung dar zab gser dngul longs spyod rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa mkha' mnyam sprin bstebs nas/ /phyogs bcur 'dod yon rnam lnga'i char 'be+ebs shog /byang chub sems kyi spyod pa brlabs chen rmis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur tshe/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can ma lus kun/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston shog /log pa'i lam zhugs stobs ldan dregs pa can/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal bas ma thul ba'i/ /'gro kun ma lus bdag gis rab brtul nas/ /skad cig de la sangs rgyas sar 'khod shog /ji srid 'khor bar sems can gnas kyi bar/ /de srid phrin las rtsol med rang shar gyis/ /sems can ma lus smin cing grol byed pa'i/ /'gro don lhun grub rgyun chad med par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yis so so skye bo byang chub sems dpa'i tshe/ /bskal pa grangs med sems bskyed 0na lam btab//tshogs gnyis mthar phyin mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /phun sum tshogs mnga' yon tan rgya mtsho yis/ /sems can dpag med smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ /rngon lam phrin las cig tu sdoms pa bas/ /bdag gi don lam phrin las rgya cher shog /gzhan don lhun grub dpag med 'byung gyur pa'i/ /bdag gi 0na 42—962

lam de rnams thams cad kun/ /byang chub mchog mos dad pa rab bskyed de/ /gang gis 'debs pa de la yongs rdzogs shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'khor 'das thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ /bdag gzhan phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par shog /'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po ye shes kyi ḍa ki ni gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs cas// 〈sna //①bsdur mchan/959 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/96 ①〈〈pe 〉mugabs/961 ①〈〈pe 〉stanasung /962 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉sarba maṅga lo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2457)42—963

༄ga /ba༅ gsum gyi bdag nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga①༄/ bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tra ye da shād+ma ka shrī tsakra sasbrar maṇ+ḍa lo pā yi kā—/ bod skad du/ bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus gsum yang dag rig mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar spyi bos phyag byas nas/ /bcu gsum bdag nyid can gyi sdom pa de yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po spangs nas mchog grub mi 'gyur zhes/ /nges par bsams nas gzhan gyi don byi blo yis ni/ /dbang bskur rab gnas cho ga sgrub thabs sogs rnams kyi/ /cho ga nyid ni sngags pas 'di las nges par byed/ /brtan zhing zab mo'i chos shes pa/ /rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son//42—964

sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor de nyid shes/ /rig gnas kun la shin tu mkhas/ /gsang sngags tshul gyis rim par gus/ /gzugs bzang lta na sdug pa dang / /bla ma la gus snying brtser ldan/ /sdom pa 'byung ba'i ston pa po/ /lha khang mchod rten gnas dang ni/ /'khor gyi khyams dang gtsang ma'i sa/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du'ang / /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsams par bya/ /yongs su brtags pa'i sa yi char/ /rko ba la sogasadze+e bya ste/ /lag pas reg nas hūṃ yig gi/ /sngags bzlas pa yis sa sbyang bya/ /sna tshogs pa rnams stong nyid du/ /ro gcig par ni brtan mos na/ /de yis sa ni dag 'gyur te/ /de bzhin nyid dag rgyu phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha'i/ /nyis 'gyur gye ni sa sbyang bya/ /rang gi sems ni yongs dag na/ /de nyid kyis ni sa dag 'gyur—/ /zhes bya'o sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas 'dir slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor bya ba'i dang po nyid du yid dang mthun ①pa'i gnas su re shig sngon du bsnyen pa bya ste/ de'i rjes su rdo rje khrob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa la me tog bkram zhing dbus su 'dug nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du sdus par gyur pa'i bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rang bzhin gyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la sogs pa byas nas/ bgegs gzhom pa'i phyir spos kyi snod thogs shing lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer byas te/ rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bur gsel bar gyur pas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar barmi/ /sangs 42—965
